attorneys.name: Jennifer Ruth Beltz
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St. Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jennifer Ruth Beltz is admitted to practice in all Florida state courts and the Middle District of Florida. She has jury trial experience, having tried automobile accident claims, medical malpractice claims, nursing home abuse claims and premises liability claims.

Jennifer has also handled arbitrations in Florida and Wisconsin, and argued appellate cases at the Second District Court of Appeals in Tampa. In recognition of successful resolution of personal injury claims during her career, Jennifer is a lifetime member of the

Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

Raised in St. Petersburg, Florida from a young age, Jennifer Ruth Beltz is a trial attorney with almost 30 years of litigation experience focused in the area of personal injury. Jennifer worked for Beltz & Ruth for 14 years prior to working with some other law firms and ultimately opening her own firm – only to be joined a few years later by her father. The firm focuses on advising and representing those who have been injured by others. She has successfully represented individuals in automobile accidents, nursing home neglect cases, medical malpractice claims, slip and fall claims, premises liability claims, and more.

A second-generation injury lawyer, Jennifer Ruth Beltz is proud to have followed in the footsteps of her father, Larry D. Beltz, a renowned personal injury attorney here in the Tampa Bay area, who attended high school in St. Petersburg.

Jennifer received her undergraduate degree in 1993 from Emory University and her law degree in 1996 from Florida State University College of Law. While in law school, Jennifer served as secretary of the Student Bar Association and president of the Mock Trial team, participating in state and regional competitions. Jennifer is proud to call St. Petersburg home.

attorneys.name: Tony Bennett
attorneys.practice_type: Boating Accidents Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
"Tony Bennett is a talented personal injury trial attorney with extensive trial experience. He attended the University of Florida as a Bright Futures Scholar before obtaining his Juris Doctorate from Nova Southeastern University.

After law school, Mr. Bennett worked for the Public Defender's Office in Orange and Broward Country, where he gained invaluable trial experience in two culturally and demographically distinct jurisdictions. He proudly served as the first chair in 38 trials during his tenure as an Assistant Public Defender, representing people accused of crimes ranging from simple misdemeanors to homicide, robbery, and white-collar crimes.

Following his work as a Public Defender, Mr. Bennett left criminal law to become a managing attorney for an insurance defense firm in Jupiter, FL. Working for insurance companies helped Mr. Bennett gain a unique insight into how insurance companies evaluate cases and approach litigation to deny claimants the fair value of a claim. He served as the first chair for many trials in Palm Beach, Martin, St. Lucie, Indian River, and Dade County as an insurance defense attorney, without losing a single case he tried for the insurance companies.

Armed with this knowledge and comfort in the courtroom, Mr. Bennett returned to his roots, representing Plaintiffs. His insight into insurance litigation allows Mr. Bennett to demand and pursue nothing less than the full and fair value for his clients. He prides himself on being able to "cut through the fog" and get to the core of the issue to efficiently resolve cases.

In June 2014, Tony Bennett was co-counsel in a wrongful death trial obtaining a $15.2 million-dollar verdict in a tractor-trailer versus motorcycle accident. Mr. Bennett is admitted to practice law throughout the State of Florida, the Southern District of Florida in Federal court, and Washington D.C."

attorneys.bio:
William J. Berger is a Senior Trial and Appellate Attorney with the firm. He has practiced trial and appellate law since 1975, and he served as an elected Circuit Judge for Palm Beach County. As a Judge, Bill was assigned to the Civil, Criminal and Family Divisions of the Circuit Court. He presided over hundreds of trials. He also was invited to serve as an Associate Judge on the Fourth District Court of Appeal, where he authored several opinions for the Court. During his tenure on the bench, Bill was designated Administrative Judge of the South County Courthouse. He also was appointed by then-Chief Justice Fred Lewis to serve on the Florida Supreme Court's Commission of Judicial Evaluations.

As a practicing attorney, Bill has tried dozens of jury trials, many more non-jury trials and argued dozens of appeals. His practice includes trials and appeals in the areas of commercial law, family, business, trusts and estates, land use, partnership, employment discrimination, personal injury, real estate, mortgage foreclosure, criminal, and complex civil litigation.

attorneys.name: Ivelisse Berio LeBeau
attorneys.practice_type: ERISA Lawyers in Miami (Coral Gables), FL
attorneys.bio:
Ivelisse Berio LeBeau joined Sugarman & Susskind in 2007, after serving as a Trial Attorney in the Solicitor's Office of the U.S. Department of Labor for 13 years. While at the Department of Labor she primarily represented the Employee Benefits Security Administration (EBSA), the DOL agency charged with protecting the integrity of pension plans, health plans and other employee benefit plans governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA).

As a DOL attorney enforcing ERISA Ms. Berio LeBeau assisted EBSA during DOL investigations and brought legal actions claiming that fiduciaries to ERISA employee benefit plans breached their fiduciary duties to such plans. She worked on many different types of cases, including cases involving trustees to ERISA pension plans who breached fiduciary duties in making investment decisions; service providers to ERISA health plans that failed to disclose their receipt of additional revenue in connection with pharmacy benefit management services or hospital reimbursements; fiduciaries to 401(k) plans who failed to ensure that employee contributions were properly transferred to such plans; and service providers to ERISA retirement plans that failed to disclose and receive authorization to retain revenue, such as float income, generated while providing contracted services. Ivelisse also created training materials for EBSA investigators to use in drafting subpoenas and in preparing cases for litigation.

While at the Department of Labor Ivelisse also worked on enforcement actions brought under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and other federal labor statutes claiming that employers violated minimum wage, overtime pay, non-discrimination, employee training, housing, and health and safety standards.

Ms. Berio LeBeau is active in the Employee Benefits Committee of the American Bar Association's Labor and Employment Law Section, a national organization of union, plaintiff and management lawyers who specialize in ERISA and employee benefits law. From 2004 to 2006 she served as a Government Fellow to the Committee, and currently she serves as a Co-Chair of the Subcommittee on ERISA Preemption and Effects on Other Laws.

sections.content:
Ivelisse Berio LeBeau joined Sugarman & Susskind in 2007, after serving as a Trial Attorney in the Solicitor's Office of the U.S. Department of Labor for 13 years. While at the Department of Labor she primarily represented the Employee Benefits Security Administration (EBSA), the DOL agency charged with protecting the integrity of pension plans, health plans and other employee benefit plans governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA).

As a DOL attorney enforcing ERISA Ms. Berio LeBeau assisted EBSA during DOL investigations and brought legal actions claiming that fiduciaries to ERISA employee benefit plans breached their fiduciary duties to such plans. She worked on many different types of cases, including cases involving trustees to ERISA pension plans who breached fiduciary duties in making investment decisions; service providers to ERISA health plans that failed to disclose their receipt of additional revenue in connection with pharmacy benefit management services or hospital reimbursements; fiduciaries to 401(k) plans who failed to ensure that employee contributions were properly transferred to such plans; and service providers to ERISA retirement plans that failed to disclose and receive authorization to retain revenue, such as float income, generated while providing contracted services. Ivelisse also created training materials for EBSA investigators to use in drafting subpoenas and in preparing cases for litigation.

While at the Department of Labor Ivelisse also worked on enforcement actions brought under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and other federal labor statutes claiming that employers violated minimum wage, overtime pay, non-discrimination, employee training, housing, and health and safety standards.

attorneys.name: Stephen Berlin Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Sarasota, FL
attorneys.bio:
Managing Attorney Stephen Berlin has advocated for injured workers since 1995 when he was admitted to the Florida Bar.

Licensed in Florida and Georgia, he has devoted his legal practice to handling work injury claims and is a renowned workers’ compensation attorney with more than 30 years of experience.

For 17 years, Stephen Berlin managed the in-house legal operation for a major Florida workers’ compensation carrier. Working side-by-side with insurance adjusters, he saw them strategically deny claims and offer lowball settlements or deny benefits outright that the claimant was rightfully entitled. Based on this real-world experience and desire to make a difference in injured workers’ lives, he opened Berlin Law Firm in Sarasota. His comprehensive expertise and outstanding client results enabled the firm to grow and expand with a second office in Tampa.

Stephen Berlin completed his undergraduate work at the prestigious Vanderbilt University and received his law degree and MBA from the University of Florida. He has spoken at over 100 workers’ compensation seminars in Florida and represents clients from all walks of life with the utmost dedication.

Past clients describe him as caring, responsive, and hardworking. He strives to educate his clients on the salient legal aspects of workplace injuries and to prepare them for the tactics used by insurance adjusters to decrease the value of their claims.

His favorite part of being a workers’ compensation lawyer is receiving positive feedback from clients, who praise his transparency, integrity, and personal attention. When he is not practicing law, this proud parent of three children can be found on the golf course or attempting yet another epic marathon.

attorneys.name: Bradly Roger Bettin Sr.
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Cocoa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brad brings over four decades of legal experience and a deep-rooted commitment to the people of Brevard County. Born in Des Moines, Iowa, and raised just outside Rochester, New York, Brad relocated to Florida in 1972 following his father’s retirement. Inspired by his father’s academic path, Brad attended the University of Florida, where he earned his Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration in 1979 and his Juris Doctor in 1982.

Since moving to Brevard County in 1984, Brad has witnessed the region’s tremendous growth and evolving complexities. He understands that life today presents more challenges than ever before—and he views his role as an attorney through the lens of a problem solver. His goal is to help clients navigate legal issues as quickly and efficiently as possible, always working to restore a sense of normalcy and peace of mind. Brad maintains a diverse and varied civil litigation practice. His experience includes handling complex matters such as partition and quiet title actions, as well as shareholder and partnership disputes. He is known for his practical approach to resolving conflicts and his ability to deliver strategic, client-focused solutions both in and out of the courtroom.

Brad's approach is rooted in practical wisdom, clear communication, and a commitment to achieving favorable outcomes with integrity and efficiency.

attorneys.name: Kristian Bie
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
As a third generation Palm Beach County native, I have strong ties to our local community and dedicate my practice to helping people and their families who have been wrongfully injured due to the negligence of others. My practice focuses on litigating personal injury and wrongful death matters involving auto and commercial truck accidents, boat crashes, slip/trip and falls, cruise ship injuries, negligent security, and other insurance disputes.

I earned my undergraduate degree from Florida State University, where I had the opportunity to play for the Seminoles football team, prior to pursuing my law degree at Louisiana State University’s Paul M. Hebert Law Center. As the only law school in the United States to offer degrees in both civil and common law, I was fortunate to obtain both my juris doctorate as well as a G.D.C.L. in 2010.

As an attorney, there is no greater honor than being trusted to represent someone who has suffered a severe injury or lost a loved one. It is my passion to fulfill that responsibility. Having begun my career defending hospitals and insurance companies against injury claims, I am uniquely equipped with valuable insight into the insurance industries’ tactics and practices. I now use this “insider knowledge” to aggressively seek justice for my clients.

I recently was elected to serve on the Palm Beach County Justice Association Board of Directors. For me, it’s about staying involved in the same legal community where I fight for injury victims and their families every day. I’m looking forward to collaborating with other trial lawyers across Palm Beach County, helping to strengthen the civil justice system and advocating for policies that protect the rights of those who have been hurt. It’s just another way of making sure that the people represented by LaBovick Law Group have a strong voice — not just in the courtroom, but throughout the legal system.

On the personal side, I love spending time with my wife, Katie, and our two boys, Walker and Sawyer. As a lifelong Floridian, I have a passion for the water and outdoors and you will usually find us boating, fishing, or attending one of many little-league sports events.

attorneys.name: James G. Biggart
attorneys.practice_type: Negligent Security Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jim Biggart began his legal career serving in the United States Navy Judge Advocate General's Corp, where he represented Naval commanders and sailors in courts martial and administrative hearings. He also provided command services and legal counsel to naval commands such as the USS John F. Kennedy (CV-67). Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Biggart was the Managing Partner of the Tallahassee office of Banker Lopez Gassler, P.A., a statewide litigation firm, where he represented national and regional trucking companies, trailer manufacturers, airports, national department stores, restaurants and hotels, as well as insurance carriers.

In 2013 Mr. Biggart joined Morgan and Morgan and opened the firm's Tallahassee office where he now utilizes his years of experience representing clients in personal injury and wrongful death cases. Mr. Biggart is an AV rated attorney by Martindale-Hubble with extensive trial experience in federal and state courts. He has been recognized as a Florida Legal Elite by Florida Trend magazine, named a Florida Super Lawyer since 2007 (representing the top 2 percent of attorneys in the state), a Super Lawyer in Transportation Law since 2008, and The Best Lawyers in America since 2012 for his high caliber work in the practice of personal injury litigation.

Mr. Biggart received his BA from the University of Florida and his JD from the University of Louisville. He is admitted to the Florida Bar and the U.S. District Courts for the Middle District and Northern District of Florida.

Mr. Biggart and his wife, Stacy, are the proud parents of four boys, Cameron, Jackson, Nathan and Alex. He is a member of the Faith Presbyterian Church in Tallahassee, is an avid Florida Gator fan and an enthusiastic, although often, middle-of-the-pack long distance runner.

attorneys.name: Joseph Bilotta Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Joseph Bilotta aids individuals and families in the areas of Personal Injury, Wrongful Death, Workers' Compensation, Social Security Disability and Labor and Employment Law. He attended Fordham Preparatory High School, received his BA from Fordham University in the Bronx, New York and his law degree from Pace University in White Plains, New York.

Joe was admitted to practice in New York in 1989 and Florida in 1991. He is a also a member of the United States District Courts for the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida, the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, and the Supreme Court of the United States of America.

Joe was a recipient of the American Jurisprudence Award for Criminal Law, a member of the Pace University Law Review and graduated cum laude. He is a member of the Palm Beach County Justice Association and the Palm Beach County Bar Association. He is a current member and former president of the Boynton Beach Kiwanis Club, a community service organization.

He practiced law in New York City from 1989 through 1993 before moving to Florida and becoming an Assistant State Attorney in Broward County where he tried over 100 felony cases. He then reentered private practice and began working with Mr. Vassallo helping the people and businesses of Palm Beach County.

Joseph Bilotta has been an attorney since 1989 and is admitted to practice in the state and federal courts in Florida and New York, in addition to the United States Supreme Court. He has represented clients in collective actions against major national companies and individuals against smaller local companies.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Wayne W. Bilsky, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Worker's Compensation Lawyers in Winter Park, FL
attorneys.bio:
Wayne William Bilsky graduated from the University of Florida with a BS/BA in Finance in 1986. He graduated Law School at the University of Florida in 1989. While in session in Law School, Mr. Bilsky interned for a plaintiff's firm, specializing in Personal Injury and Workers' Compensation cases. Each summer break during law school, Mr. Bilsky worked in Orlando at different law firms, specializing in Workers' Compensation and Personal Injury Defense, working on the side of the insurance companies. Upon graduation, Mr. Bilsky immediately began working with one of the insurance defense firms that he interned with during those summers; and worked with them as an Associate Attorney for three years. The experiences, from working on the side of different insurance companies has provided Mr. Bilsky with valuable insight; which in turn has enabled Mr. Bilsky to provide his clients with successful representation and service of their cases. In 1992 Mr. Bilsky began his dedication to representing exclusively plaintiff's and claimant's as an Associate Attorney. After a few years, he was made partner in the oldest Personal Injury firm in the Orlando area. On September 23, 1999, Mr. Bilsky started his own firm and has since, successfully represented hundreds of injured persons.

attorneys.name: Mason Binkley
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mason Binkley is an attorney at Sass Law Firm who has over fifteen years of legal experience. A Florida Bar member since 2011, Mr. Binkley has practiced law exclusively in the Tampa Bay area, building a reputation for thoughtful counsel, tireless advocacy, and a practical approach to complex legal challenges.

Before joining Sass Law Firm, Mr. Binkley worked at a large Florida-based law firm, where he primarily represented employers in employment discrimination and breach of contract claims. He has also represented corporations, universities, hospitals, small businesses, and individuals in a wide range of other litigation matters. His legal career includes serving as a Partner at a multi-state insurance defense law firm, as well as operating his own private practice focused on estate planning and business law and litigation.

Today, Mr. Binkley draws on his background and experience to exclusively represent employees in workplace disputes. He brings a unique and strategic perspective to employee-side advocacy, informed by years of experience on the other side of the aisle.

Mr. Binkley grew up in Oviedo, Florida, and graduated with honors from The George Washington University before earning his J.D. from Case Western Reserve University School of Law. He is an active member of the Hillsborough County Bar Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Christina Bisset was born in Kissimmee, Florida; however, she was raised in Belize, Central America. She received her Bachelor's degree from Rutgers University, The State University of New Jersey in Political Science. She then went on to receive her Juris Doctorate from Barry University School of Law, where she graduated at the top of her class and held leadership roles on the school's Law Review.

During her time in law school, Ms. Bisset also held positions working as Clerk to Circuit Court Judge Donald A. Myers, Jr. and as Law Clerk at a well-established firm in Orlando with an emphasis on Personal Injury and Medical Malpractice matters.

After passing both the Florida and New Jersey bar exams in 2015, Ms. Bisset continued her legal career with a focus on helping those injured through the fault of others. Ms. Bisset has spent her entire legal career fighting for the rights of her injured clients. She has recovered millions of dollars for clients injured in various slip and fall, trip and fall, and motor vehicle accidents.

Ms. Bisset cares deeply for her clients and helping them obtain the recovery they deserve.

attorneys.name: David G. Blake
attorneys.practice_type: Police Misconduct Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Dave Blake is an aggressive and committed trial attorney who concentrates his efforts in personal injury, wrongful death and police misconduct litigation. His passion for his clients extends far beyond the realm of the cases he tries-he takes each case personally and ensures that his clients are provided for in every way possible.

Dave brings a wealth of hard-edged courtroom experience and a unique skill set to Romano Law, PLLC. Having excelled in national moot court and mock trial programs during his time in law school, Dave was destined to utilize his skills for the betterment of his wrongfully injured clients.

Early in his career, Dave gained invaluable courtroom experience while working as an Assistant State Attorney. During his time as a prosecutor, he tried in excess of 40 cases to jury verdict. More importantly, he became intimately familiar with law enforcement training techniques, use of force procedure and protocol, and related law enforcement practices.

Following his tenure as a prosecutor, Dave spent time as a litigation associate in law firms representing some of America's largest corporations and manufacturers in complex litigation matters throughout the United States. It was during this time that Dave made the decision that his true passion was in the courtroom-representing clients who have been the victims of negligent acts and wrongful conduct of others.

In addition to maintaining an active caseload, Dave is an active member of the Michigan Association of Justice and serves indigent clients as a pro bono attorney for the Michigan Legal Aid and Defenders Association. As a recent testament to his trial abilities and legal acumen, Dave was recently named a 2012 Michigan Super Lawyers Rising Star. This distinction is based entirely on peer review and is an honor bestowed on less than 2.5 percent of all lawyers under the age of 40 in the United States.

Dave is admitted to practice in all State Courts in Michigan and Florida, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Michigan, the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit.

Dave resides with his wife and daughters in metro Detroit.

Awards and Honors

Honors

NACDL National Mock Trial Team Member, 2001

attorneys.name: Norman S. Bledsoe
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Gainesville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Norm's practice is focused on providing efficient solutions to complex legal problems. Norm focuses on business law and family law. Norm's business law experience includes serving as outside general counsel for local companies. In this capacity, Norm drafts and negotiates leases and lease terminations, along with employment agreements and severance agreements, and is well-versed in drafting non-competition and non-disclosure covenants. Norm also assists medical groups with healthcare compliance and with employment law.

Norm assists clients with a variety of commercial transactions, including stock sales and asset sales. As part of this work, he regularly assists clients in forming and maintaining corporations and limited liability companies and advises business owners on "buy/sell" agreements with "tag-along" and "drag-along" rights in various types of business entities. Having formerly practiced securities law, he advises clients on the appropriate structures for their business ventures.

Norm's family law litigation experience includes multi-state divorce and family support actions (Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act and Uniform Interstate Family Support Act cases), imputation of income, and analysis of complex income and asset issues (for example, determining whether deferred executive compensation plan payments may be divided in divorce).

Norm also assists clients with business litigation, such as contract disputes, challenges to/defense of covenants not to compete, and real property litigation, including partition, contribution, and boundary disputes.

attorneys.practice_type: Biking Accident Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Eric "Rick" Block is an accomplished personal injury attorney and longtime Jacksonville, Florida, resident, the son of a U.S. Navy captain fighter pilot. Mr. Block is a graduate of the Nova University Center for the Study of Law in Fort Lauderdale, earning his Juris Doctorate and starting off a career advocating for those injured by the negligence of others. He's won 202 jury verdicts in his more than two decades advocating for the people - many of those victories worth a million dollars or more.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan in 2017, Mr. Block owned and operated his own successful law firm in Jacksonville, representing clients in automobile, truck, and bicycle accidents, in addition to those who suffered brain and spinal cord injuries. Among his wins is a $7.8 million knee-injury verdict and a $5 million verdict for a woman injured by falling vending machines.

Mr. Block is a founding member of the Jacksonville Justice Association, a non-profit organization that provides plaintiffs' attorneys with education and resources to enhance their trial practice. He has served as one of the organization's early presidents and board of directors.

If you've been injured and are looking for justice, contact Mr. Block's office today for a free, no-risk case review.

attorneys.name: Michael E. Blum
attorneys.firm_name: Kibbey Wagner Injury & Car Accident Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Stuart, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael decided to dedicate his entire legal career to seeking justice on behalf of those injured due to the negligence of others in 2012. Before joining KW Stuart Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers, Michael represented clients who have suffered both physically and emotionally after being harmed as a result of careless drivers, businesses, and property owners. Michael has successfully resolved over twenty million dollars of personal injury cases over the course of his career.

He litigated a variety of cases for over three years throughout the state of Florida, including personal injury matters, commercial disputes, foreclosure cases, real estate controversies, and homeowner's association disagreements.

Michael received a bachelor's degree in Political Science from Rollins College (Winter Park, Florida) and graduated with Magna Cum Laude Honors. He then proceeded to earn his Juris Doctorate from the University of Florida (Gainesville, Florida) and has practiced law full time since graduating.

Michael was born in Livingston, New Jersey, and graduated from Ridge High School located in Basking Ridge, New Jersey. He currently resides in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and has been a resident of Florida since 2002.

attorneys.name: Joseph C. Bodiford
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
The principal attorney of Bodiford Law, located in Tallahassee, Florida, Joseph C. Bodiford, distinguishes himself with a robust portfolio in criminal law, focusing on defending people charged with DWI/DUI, white collar crimes, drug charges and a comprehensive list of other criminal offenses. His enviable reputation is his solid track record of successfully handling criminal appeals and post-conviction proceedings, combined with a deep commitment to his clients, especially in violent and property crime cases.

After earning his Juris Doctor and an LL.M. with honors from Stetson University College of Law, Mr. Bodiford received his board certifications in criminal trial law and criminal trial advocacy from The Florida Bar and the National Board of Trial Advocacy, respectively. Mr. Bodiford is a certified Advocate by the National Institute of Trial Advocacy (NITA). He is licensed to practice before the Supreme Court of the United States, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the U.S. District Courts for the Middle and Northern Districts of Florida, and all the Florida state courts.

Colleagues and clients frequently herald Mr. Bodiford for his strategic legal insight and dedication to justice. His 28-plus years of legal service have culminated in many settlements and verdicts, a testament to his prowess in the courtroom. His contributions as an author and educator resonate through his published works and his role as an adjunct professor, where he imparts advanced advocacy skills to law students.

As part of his career trajectory, Mr. Bodiford has several impressive affiliations with professional organizations. His tenure includes roles as a state prosecutor, a legal analyst for WCTV, and numerous positions within legal organizations such as the Tallahassee Bar Association (including President), the Tallahassee Chapter of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the Hillsborough County Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.

Mr. Bodiford has been recognized by peers and the legal industry at large. While his inclusion in Florida Trend’s Legal Elite and the National Trial Lawyers’ Top 100 speak volumes, his AV Preeminent* rating through Martindale-Hubbell confirms the high regard in which he is held. He has been honored with a “Superb” rating and a Clients’ Choice award by Avvo. He also devotes his time and effort as much as possible to various public causes.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.

attorneys.name: Rani Nair Bolen
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
I am an Indian-American attorney born and raised in this country. My parents arrived in the United States from India in 1969 with two PH.D.s behind their names and $8 in their pockets. While my mother recently retired, my father still continues working as a research scientist in the field of biochemistry. My parents' determination, sacrifice, and hard work are the embodiment of the American Dream and have given me the opportunity to help others achieve the same.

Growing up in an immigrant household just outside Washington, D.C., my influences are a blend of my parents' Indian culture, scientific discipline, and the diverse Americana that is prevalent in the Maryland suburbs. I began playing the piano at age six and by high school, I discovered my talent in vocals. My love of performance and singing led me to the school chorus and musical theater, which in turn led to appearances on a cruise ship and at Epcot Center in Orlando. In college, I was captain of the co-ed flag football team, displaying the kind of competitiveness, athleticism, and teamwork that runs strong in my family. I continued with my love of music, enrolling in Maryland's voice minor program.

Although I did not follow my parents' footsteps into the field of science, I did inherit their perseverance, work ethic and fervent respect for education. I graduated summa cum laude from the University of Maryland's Smith School of Business with a B.S. in Finance and International Business.

Upon graduation, I entered the management training program at Marriott International where I worked as an assistant controller of one of Marriott's major properties in Washington, D.C. Perhaps the best feature about Marriott's training program is their "learn by doing" approach. The genius in this initiative is quite simple: The company feels that, before you can be qualified to effectively manage a hotel, you need to learn and understand all of the jobs that are necessary to operate a hotel property. So in addition to traditional accounting duties, I learned about everything from working at the front desk to setting up the soft drinks-and-coffee tables outside convention meetings. This gave me a hands-on appreciation for the importance of the role that working men and women play: without them, nothing would get done.

Shortly afterwards, I was promoted to the international operations department at Marriott's worldwide corporate headquarters. There I honed my accounting, analytical, and computer skills that have made me a valuable contributor in business litigation at The Amlong Firm.

When I attended law school at George Mason University School of Law in Arlington, Virginia, I was one of a small number of non-whites in my class. So I do not just litigate about the importance of diversity, I live it everyday and I understand the challenges that still exist in our society.

As an associate at The Amlong Firm, I bring who I am and what I have learned into the courtroom, trying to ensure that our clients' hard work and perseverance will provide them as many opportunities and as much success as I have had.

attorneys.name: Clark J. Bolton
attorneys.practice_type: Whistleblower/Qui Tam Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Clark Bolton brings unique insight and skills to his law practice. As a former whistle-blower himself, he has walked the walk. His experience as a whistle-blower, investigator, certified fraud examiner, and now an attorney, combine to provide a tremendous advantage for Morgan & Morgan clients.

Before joining Morgan & Morgan, Clark practiced whistle-blower law with James, Hoyer, Newcomer & Smiljanich, P.A., one of the most successful whistle-blower firms in the nation. After leaving James Hoyer, and before joining Morgan & Morgan, he had his own practice, Bolton Law, PLLC, where he effectively represented whistle-blowers.

In October 2007, Clark's initial experience with whistle blowing law began when his attorneys filed on his behalf a federal false claim act complaint in the Middle District of Florida. He eventually became one of four whistle-blowers in the successful $137.5 million health care fraud case that globally settled in 2012 between WellCare Health Plans of Tampa, Florida, and the United States Department of Justice. After resolution of that case, Clark enrolled in law school to build upon his career as a civil and criminal investigator. His intent was to use his law degree and prior experiences as a vehicle to combat fraud and to represent whistle-blowers.

Prior to law school, Clark had a three-decade-long distinguished career working in complex criminal and civil litigation as an investigator, investigative manager, and health care fraud consultant in both the public and private sectors. His broad investigative experience included serving for 7 years as a New York State Senior Investigator tasked with preparing the guilt phase in death penalty cases for trial, to managing national teams of health care and insurance fraud investigators for corporations in pursuit of civil recoveries. He holds professional certifications as a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) and Accredited Health Care Fraud Investigator (AHFI).

Also, Clark is a proud U.S. Army veteran of 10-years and initially served as an Airborne Infantry Pathfinder Sergeant in the United States and Europe and subsequently served in various special operations units in the Army Reserves in New York and Massachusetts. Since leaving the military, he has been committed to serving veterans- initially, as a peer-counselor in college at R.I.T. and later in law school as a volunteer mentor with the Hillsborough County Veterans' Treatment Court.

Clark is married and has two daughters. His hobbies are golf, working out, reading history, international travel, and spending quality time with his family.

attorneys.bio:
Rob Bonanno was born and raised in Tampa, Florida and attended Jesuit High School. After graduating, Mr. Bonanno attended and received a Bachelor's degree from the University of Florida. While at the University of Florida, Mr. Bonanno was a four-year varsity letter winner as a pitcher on the baseball team. He earned All-SEC honors and third-team All-American honors his senior year. He was also a member of the Florida Blue Key. After a four year career in the minor leagues, Mr. Bonanno attended and received his Juris Doctorate from Stetson University College of Law.

After law school, Mr. Bonanno went to work at a large, statewide insurance defense firm, where he defended insurance companies and their insureds. While there, Mr. Bonanno litigated numerous cases, many of which went to trial. Since leaving the defense practice in 2008, Mr. Bonanno has exclusively represented individuals injured in accidents through no fault of their own.

Mr. Bonanno has three children and is active in coaching youth baseball in the area. He is the Vice President of North Brandon Youth Baseball and a member of the Nativity Catholic Church.

attorneys.name: Bill Bone
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Bill Bone has dedicated his law practice and much of his spare time to helping people in need. From his service work in college as a member of the exclusive Florida Blue Key Leadership Honorary Society to his endowment of the Trial Advocacy Book Award at the University of Florida Law School, he has always strived to "give something back" to his community. His work on behalf of injured clients has earned him a well-deserved reputation as a tough negotiator and an even tougher litigator.

Bill Bone attended the University of Florida as an undergraduate and received his Bachelor of Science in Business Administration in 1981. He received his Juris Doctorate degree from the University Of Florida College Of Law in 1984. While a student, Mr. Bone was named to the University of Florida Hall of Fame for his successful enrollment in numerous campus activities and leadership positions including Student Government and the Interfraternity Council. Bill Bone is a past President of the University of Florida Law School Alumni Council and a Trustee of the University's College of Law. Bill Bone is also a graduate of Leadership Palm Beach County.

Bill Bone is admitted to practice in all the state courts of Florida. He is certified as a Specialist in Civil Trial Law by The Florida Bar Board of Legal Specialization: Personal injury, Medical Malpractice and Wrongful Death. He is Past Chairman of the Plaintiff's Personal Injury Law Committee, Past Chairman of Law Week and Past Chairman of the Public Relations Committee for the Palm Beach County Bar Association and a member of The American Bar Association, The Florida Justice Association and EAGLE member of The American Association for Justice.

The independent lawyer rating publication, Martindale-Hubbell, has repeatedly awarded Bill Bone and his firm the highest accolades in both categories evaluated: Legal Ability and General Ethical Standards. Law and Leading Attorneys: A Florida Consumers Guidebook, surveys thousands of Florida attorneys in over 30 specialized areas of law to identify those regarded by their peers as reputable and qualified. Mr. Bone was selected as an outstanding practitioner in the area of personal injury law and as such is part of a group that represents less than 5% of Florida's practicing attorneys.

Bill Bone is a leader in the community and serves as: Chairman, of the Town of Palm Beach Centennial Commission; Chairman, Do the Write Thing Challenge for the National Campaign to Stop Violence; Executive Committee of the Kravis Center for the Performing Arts Corporate Partners and Member of the Center's Education Committee; Trustee of the Legal Aid Society of Palm Beach County; Vice President, CycleFest, Inc; and Founding President and Trustee of Florida Stage. Bill Bone has been recognized as an exemplary volunteer of numerous organizations including: The March of Dimes; American Heart Association; Palm Beach Police Foundation and The South Florida Science Museum. Other community involvement includes: Past President of the Forum Club of the Palm Beaches, Inc., Past President, Rotary Club of West Palm Beach, Inc., Past-Trustee of the Palm Beach Community Chest/United Way; Past President of the Board of Healthy Mothers/Healthy Babies, and Past Board Member of the Palm Beach Opera and Ballet Florida.

Bill Bone is passionate about Cycling as a sport and hobby. He is the title sponsor of the Bill Bone Racing Team. The Bill Bone Bike Tour which is part of the Marathon Festival of the Palm Beaches is named in his honor as is the Bill Bone Grand Prix cycling race.

Bill Bone has successfully represented hundreds of clients with serious personal injuries such as spinal fractures, brain damage and neurological disorders, as well as clients who have lost family members because of the negligence of others. Bill Bone has numerous successful verdicts and settlements in excess of 1,000,000. Sample cases include: bicycle, car, truck and train collisions, complex multi-party negligence, harmful product litigation, insurance litigation and medical malpractice matters.

The independent lawyer rating publication, Martindale-Hubbell, has repeatedly awarded Bill Bone and his firm the highest accolades in both categories evaluated: Legal Ability and General Ethical Standards. Law and Leading Attorneys: A Florida Consumers Guidebook, surveys thousands of Florida attorneys in over 30 specialized areas of law to identify those regarded by their peers as reputable and qualified. Mr. Bone was selected as an outstanding practitioner in the area of personal injury law and as such is part of a group that represents less than 5% of Florida's practicing attorneys.

Bill Bone is a leader in the community and serves as: Chairman, of the Town of Palm Beach Centennial Commission; Chairman, Do the Write Thing Challenge for the National Campaign to Stop Violence; Executive Committee of the Kravis Center for the Performing Arts Corporate Partners and Member of the Center's Education Committee; Trustee of the Legal Aid Society of Palm Beach County; Vice President, CycleFest, Inc; and Founding President and Trustee of Florida Stage. Bill Bone has been recognized as an exemplary volunteer of numerous organizations including: The March of Dimes; American Heart Association; Palm Beach Police Foundation and The South Florida Science Museum. Bill Bone is passionate about Cycling as a sport and hobby. He is the title sponsor of the Bill Bone Racing Team. The Bill Bone Bike Tour which is part of the Marathon Festival of the Palm Beaches is named in his honor as is the Bill Bone Grand Prix cycling race.

attorneys.name: Summer L. Book
attorneys.practice_type: Educational Law Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Summer Book, a Florida native, embarked on her legal journey at Nova Southeastern University, where she obtained her Juris Doctor degree and was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2023. At NSU, Summer was an active member of the Nova Trial Association and the Student Bar Association as she consistently demonstrated her unwavering dedication to the legal profession and educational advocacy.

Prior to joining the firm, Summer volunteered her time as a Guardian Ad Litem, where she passionately championed the rights of children. Her internships with the Department of Children and Families and a Family Court Judge further refined her skills in protecting society's most vulnerable members. She further honed her legal knowledge during her time in the Disability Inclusion and Advocacy Law (DIAL) Clinic, where she worked to promote equitable access to quality education and legal services.

Complementing her legal pursuits, Summer is an Adjunct Professor. She also acquired valuable experience in the areas of Student Conduct and Title IX. Her well-rounded background equips her with a nuanced understanding of the legal complexities within the educational landscape. Coming from a large family of educators spanning from pre-K to higher education, Summer's commitment to students, educators and their families is deeply ingrained.

Beyond her legal endeavors, Summer enjoys traveling with her husband and their beloved rescue dog, Tucker.

Boomershine is a seasoned criminal defense lawyer dedicated to protecting the rights of people facing charges ranging from DUI, traffic violations, and possession offenses to serious felonies such as fraud and attempted murder. attorneys.name: Peter W. van den Boom
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Lakeland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Peter van den Boom is a board-certified trial attorney. He was born in Schiedam, The Netherlands. Mr. Van den Boom attended the highest level of high school in Hoofddorp, The Netherlands. Peter was three-time national junior tennis champion in the Netherlands and a member of the Dutch Junior Davis Cup team. He made his way to the United States as a result of an athletic scholarship to play tennis for The University of Alabama. Peter earned a degree in Finance from the University of Alabama and secured an SEC doubles title.

Mr. Van den Boom earned his law degree (cum laude) from St. Thomas University School of Law. Before joining Morgan & Morgan Peter Worked for the John Frost law firm in Bartow, Fl where he practiced law for 20.5 years.

Peter has tried many lawsuits to a successful jury verdict. Notable cases include a $4,915,588.00 jury verdict for a brain injury victim of a car accident: a $1,778,877.00 verdict for the wrongful death in a medical malpractice case of an emergency room patient: a $1,093,505.00 for a victim in an automobile crash. Peter has also recovered millions of dollars for clients through settlements with Bausch & Lomb Incorporated, Ford Motor Company, Firestone, Wal-Mart, Pirelli, and many other major organizations and entities.

He was raised on the fundamental principles of hard work and fairness to everyone, and lives his life and operates his law practice with those basic tenants at the forefront of his mind. He deeply cares for those who have been wronged by the recklessness or arrogance of others, and true to his competitive nature welcomes a fight against those who would act with such disregard as to mistreat their fellow man.

Peter is a life long athlete who enjoys MMA, lifting weights, running, swimming and all other challenging mental and physical activities. Peter is a proud family man, married to his wife Carrie, he is the step-father of four children and grandfather of seven.

Florida Civil Trial Board Certification

attorneys.name: Raissa Booze
attorneys.practice_type: Dog Bite & Animal Attacks Lawyers in Ocala, FL
attorneys.bio:
Raissa Booze is a personal injury attorney based in our Ocala office. Her practice focuses primarily on premises liability, slip/trips and falls, and animal attacks in Marion and Lake Counties. She is licensed to practice law in both Florida and New York.

Ms. Booze graduated from the University of Colorado at Boulder with a major in Business Marketing and a Minor in Philosophy. While at CU, Ms. Booze worked part-time and served as Director of Philanthropy and VP of Chapter Operations for her sorority, Alpha Phi.

Prior to attending law school, Ms. Booze worked for the Colorado Attorney General's Office in their Consumer Protection Department. She then worked directly for the owner of a group of mortgage, title, and marketing companies in various positions. Ms. Booze graduated from Wake Forest School of Law in 2009. While there she served on several committees including the Dean Search Committee, was President of Women in Law, and was Vice President of Trial Bar. Ms. Booze tried her first case while a student.

Upon graduating from Wake Forest Ms. Booze moved to New York City. There she had a fellowship with Legal Aid where she second chaired three trials. She then worked full time in doing document and privilege review for several large corporate firms while also interning at a personal injury firm in Manhattan. Ms. Booze was then offered a position with a trial firm specializing in personal injury and civil rights false arrest cases. There she gained significant experience both in and outside the courtroom while working for two talented trial attorneys. Ms. Booze then joined a Bronx-based firm where she gained more hands-on experience spending almost every day in the courtroom and/or handling depositions.

In 2016 Ms. Booze and her family moved from New York to Florida. After passing the Florida bar exam, she began practicing with a large personal injury firm in central Florida. There she worked for several years handling car accidents, slips/trips and falls, dog bites, and other personal injury cases.

Ms. Booze is now a proud member of the Morgan and Morgan team. She enjoys working with her clients to help them navigate the ins and outs of their cases and fighting for their best outcome.

attorneys.name: Scott T. Borders
attorneys.practice_type: Consumer Protection Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Scott Borders is a native of Tampa, born in 1962. He graduated from Chamberlain High in 1980. After Chamberlain, he attended the University of South Florida where he obtained his Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice in 1984. His academic performance at USF earned his acceptance into The National Criminal Justice Honor Society, Alpha Phi Sigma.

Mr. Borders attended law school at Stetson University College of Law and graduated in 1987. While at Stetson, he was a member of the College's first Labor Law Moot Court Team and represented the school at the national competition at New York University in 1987.

In April 1988, Mr. Borders began his career representing individuals in Florida's civil courts. Since that day, he has represented the consumer, the injured and their families. He has taken on most insurance companies in Florida, many auto manufacturers, many auto dealerships, debt collectors, negligent doctors and hospitals. Not all of those battles ended in the courtroom.

In 1997 The Florida Bar granted him "Board Certification as a specialist in Civil Trial Law". In order be eligible for Board certification, a lawyer must have extensive trial experience as the lead attorney in jury trials. Once eligible, the attorney must pass an extensive written examination focusing specifically on civil trial law. Less than 5% of all attorneys ever become Board Certified.

Mr. Borders has been honored with the prestigious "AV rating" by Martindale-Hubbell, the preeminent national publication in the legal field. This rating is based upon evaluations by other lawyers and is the highest ranking attainable by an attorney for ability and ethics in the practice of law. It is a distinction reserved for a select few in the legal community.

In 2008, he was admitted into the prestigious American Board of Trial Advocates having been found by his peers to "possess the requisite skill, integrity and experience in the special art of advocacy to qualify for admission". This was one of Scott's proudest accomplishments.

In January of 2000, he joined Morgan & Morgan. Since then, he has had extensive litigation and trial experience in medical negligence cases and catastrophic negligence cases. He has represented our clients in many cases resulting in large settlements and verdicts. As Scott says above, "Success in a lawsuit can be measured in many ways. I measure my success by my client's satisfaction that they were represented with skill, effort and heart.

Outside of the practice of law, Mr. Borders is a proud husband, father and member of the Bay Area community. He and his wife Anne have 3 children Matthew, Bridgett and Jackson. He has been a volunteer coach of soccer teams at Hillsborough County United Soccer since 2000. He has participated in the "Great American Teach In" for Hillsborough County Schools since 1999.

attorneys.name: Paul M. Botros
attorneys.practice_type: Discrimination Lawyers in Plantation, FL
attorneys.bio:
"Paul M. Botros is an attorney in the employee rights department of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. Mr. Botros limits his practice to representing people with unpaid wage claims under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); discrimination and retaliation claims under Title II and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (Title VII) and 42 U.S.C. §§ 1981 and 1983; medical leave claims under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA); disability discrimination and retaliation claims under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended; and age discrimination and retaliation claims under the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA).

Mr. Botros has been selected by his peers as a Florida Rising Star every year since 2013. Each year, no more than 2.5 percent of the lawyers in the state are selected by the research team at Super Lawyers to receive this honor.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, P.A., Paul owned and managed his ownlaw firm Miami, Florida, after working for a top tier Miami full service law firm. Paul M. Botros was born in Birmingham, England and moved to the United States at an early age. Paul completed a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and International Finance while at Trinity University in San Antonio, Texas, and then went on to earn his Juris Doctor Degree from the University of Michigan School of Law.

Mr. Botros is admitted to both the Texas and Florida Bars, as well as the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, the United States District Courts for the Southern and Western Districts of Florida, the Southern, Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas, and also the United States Bankruptcy Courts for the Southern District of Florida and the Southern District of Texas."

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Boynton Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Charles A. Bowen Jr. is a skilled and dedicated personal injury attorney at Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A., where he zealously represents clients seeking justice after suffering harm due to negligence or defective products. Licensed to practice in Florida, New York, and Arizona, Mr. Bowen brings a wealth of legal experience and a client-focused approach that has led to significant verdicts and settlements.

Mr. Bowen’s academic foundation includes a Master of Laws in Intellectual Property from the University of Illinois Chicago School of Law. He earned his Juris Doctor from North Carolina Central University School of Law, where he demonstrated outstanding leadership as Editor-in-Chief of the Biotechnology and Pharmaceutical Law Review and as Captain of the Trademark Moot Court Board. His undergraduate education was completed at The University of North Carolina at Greensboro, where he pursued dual majors in Political Science and Classical Studies.

His achievements have earned him recognition among elite legal professionals, including:

- National Black Lawyers Top 40 Under 40

- National Black Lawyers Top 100

- Life Member, Million Dollar Advocates Forum

- Life Member, Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum

These honors reflect Mr. Bowen’s capacity to deliver high-value results through strategic negotiation and litigation.

At Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A., Mr. Bowen guides clients through every phase of the legal process—from comprehensive case evaluations to final resolution—with diligence and care. His work is distinguished by thoughtful legal analysis, courtroom tenacity, and a genuine commitment to client success.

He is admitted to practice law in the following jurisdictions:

- Florida

- New York

- Arizona

- U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida

Through his multifaceted experience and dedication to excellence, Charles A. Bowen Jr. continues to be a valuable advocate for those navigating personal injury claims.

attorneys.name: Robert Boyers Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robert Boyers is a civil trial lawyer who specializes in cases involving catastrophic personal injury, medical malpractice and product liability cases. He has obtained millions of dollars in awards for his clients and has been repeatedly named one of the Best Lawyers in America in the fields of personal injury and medical malpractice, a Super Lawyer in Florida Super Lawyers magazine, a Top Lawyer in the South Florida Legal Guide, as one of Florida's Legal Elite in Florida Trend magazine and was profiled as a Legal Impact Leader in the 2008 and 2010 issues of Business Leader magazine. Mr. Boyers has received lifetime achievement recognition as one of America’s Top 100 Attorneys and is listed as one of the Top 100 Attorneys in Florida by the National Trial Lawyers association. He was named one of the Top 100 Super Lawyers in Miami in the 2012 listing of Florida Super Lawyers as published in the Wall Street Journal. He also holds an AV preeminent rating – the highest rating for skill and ethics - from the Martindale-Hubbell legal directory and was given a 10/10 rating by the Avvo lawyer rating system.

Following his graduation from the Emory University School of Law in 1990, Mr. Boyers began his legal career as a trial lawyer in New York City where he practiced law with a prominent civil trial firm in Manhattan. He also served as an Assistant District Attorney in Queens County, New York and was appointed a Special Prosecutor in Kings County, NY (Brooklyn) to oversee the investigation of a high-profile officer-involved fatal shooting case. He has devoted his legal career to the pursuit of justice and to holding wrongdoers accountable for the harm that they cause.

Mr. Boyers is a frequent author and lecturer on civil trial matters. He is also a Past-President of the Miami-Dade Trial Lawyers Association and served as a past-Director of the Florida Justice Association and the Dade County Bar Association. In 2016, he completed a three-year term as Chair of Florida Bar Grievance Committee “D” for the 11th Judicial Circuit in Miami-Dade County, Florida. Mr. Boyers presently sits on the Civil Rights Committee of the Anti-defamation League and is an active member of the Miami Dade Trial Lawyers Association, the Florida Justice Association, the New York State Trial Lawyers’ Association, the American Association for Justice and the American Bar Association. He is admitted to the state bars of Florida, New York and Connecticut and is admitted to practice in the federal courts of New York and Florida.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
Bill Boyes has been Board Certified by the Florida Bar in Wills, Trusts and Estate for more than 25 years, and has been AV rated by Martindale-Hubbell for over 30 years. Board Certification is the single highest individual honor achievable by member attorneys of the Florida Bar. Less than one-third of one percent of all Florida lawyers are Board Certified in Wills, Trusts and Estates. attorneys.name: Michael A. Bracchi
attorneys.practice_type: Probate & Estate Administration Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael is an experienced attorney and trusted advisor with more than twenty years of legal experience. His practice focuses on probate administration, where he represents personal representatives, beneficiaries, and families throughout Florida in navigating the legal and procedural complexities of estate administration. Known for his analytical approach and practical guidance, Michael helps clients efficiently resolve estate matters while minimizing conflict and delay during what is often a difficult time.

Michael brings a uniquely multidisciplinary background to his legal practice. In addition to his law degree, he holds a Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) from the University of Kansas, a Master of Science in Business Management and Leadership from the City University of New York, and a Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy from St. John’s University. This rare combination of legal, healthcare, and business training provides him with a broader perspective when advising clients on matters involving financial assets, fiduciary responsibilities, and complex estates.

He earned his Juris Doctor from St. John’s University School of Law in 2002 and began his legal career in the New York metropolitan area, where he practiced in the areas of intellectual property, business law, and contract disputes. During this period, he successfully negotiated and resolved hundreds of matters across a wide range of industries, advising businesses and individuals on contract negotiation, dispute resolution, and settlement strategy.

Michael later expanded his experience in dispute resolution through service as a mediator and arbitrator. He served as an Arbitrator for the New York City Civil Court, Small Claims Division, and currently serves as an Arbitrator with the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), presiding over arbitration matters involving disputes between investors and brokerage firms.

In addition to his legal practice, Michael is actively engaged in public service and leadership within the legal profession. In November 2020, he was elected to the Wilton Manors City Commission, where he participates in local governance and policy decisions affecting the community.

Michael also completed the Florida Bar’s prestigious Wm. Reece Smith, Jr. Leadership Academy, where he was selected as a Fellow (Class X) in 2023. The program is designed to identify and develop future leaders within the legal profession and the State of Florida. He has also served on the Florida Bar Probate Rules Committee (2023–2024), contributing to the review and development of procedural rules governing probate practice in Florida.

Originally from Long Island, New York, Michael earned the rank of Eagle Scout in the Boy Scouts of America, reflecting a longstanding commitment to leadership, discipline, and community service.

Michael is admitted to practice law in Florida and New York.

Outside of his professional work, he enjoys international travel and spending time with his two Yorkshire Terriers.

Probate Rules Committee, 2023 - 2024

attorneys.name: Rocky Brancato
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Rocky Brancato is one of Tampa Bay's most experienced and trial-tested criminal defense attorneys. Over a career spanning more than 25 years, he has defended clients facing the full spectrum of criminal charges — from DUI, drug possession, and domestic violence to sex crimes, child abuse, and first-degree murder. He is AV Preeminent-rated by Martindale-Hubbell, selected to Super Lawyers, and death-qualified to handle Florida capital cases.

Rocky served as Chief Operations Officer of the Hillsborough County Public Defender's Office, one of the largest criminal defense agencies in Florida. He led and mentored a staff of over 100 attorneys while continuing to personally try homicide and sex crime cases. His years in a specialized Major Crimes Unit — dedicated exclusively to homicide, sex offenses, and aggravated child abuse — gave him a level of case-specific experience that few defense attorneys in private practice can match.

That background shapes how The Brancato Law Firm approaches every case. Rocky is known for identifying the legal and factual weaknesses in the government's case before the State even recognizes them. He works alongside medical, forensic, and digital experts to challenge the prosecution's evidence at every stage — whether that means dismantling forensic conclusions, exposing flawed police procedures, or presenting alternative theories to a jury.

As a former police academy instructor, Rocky trained law enforcement officers on criminal procedure and courtroom testimony. He doesn't have to guess how officers are taught to investigate and testify — he taught the courses. That insider perspective drives his approach to cross-examination, Fourth Amendment challenges, and motions to suppress.

Rocky is a member of the National College for DUI Defense (NCDD) and brings specialized training to breath test challenges, field sobriety defense, and CDL-related cases. He also has deep experience with Florida's mental health courts and diversion programs, having served on the 13th Judicial Circuit's Problem-Solving Court Committee to expand treatment-based alternatives to incarceration.

A respected voice in the criminal defense community, Rocky has trained and mentored hundreds of attorneys across Tampa Bay and lectured statewide at Florida Bar continuing legal education seminars on topics including sex offense defense, treatment court innovation, and the intersection of the opioid crisis and the justice system. He is admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of the United States, the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida, and all Florida state courts.

He is an active member of:

National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (NACDL)

Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (FACDL)

Hillsborough County Bar Association (HCBA)

Hillsborough County Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (HCACDL)

He is the author of How to Choose a Major Crimes Attorney — or Any Criminal Defense Attorney for That Matter, available on Amazon or as a free download at brancatolawfirm.com.

If you are under investigation or facing criminal charges in Hillsborough, Pinellas, or Pasco County, the attorney you choose will define how your case is fought.

He led and mentored a staff of over 100 attorneys while continuing to personally try homicide and sex crime cases. His years in a specialized Major Crimes Unit — dedicated exclusively to homicide, sex offenses, and aggravated child abuse — gave him a level of case-specific experience that few defense attorneys in private practice can match.

That background shapes how The Brancato Law Firm approaches every case. Rocky is known for identifying the legal and factual weaknesses in the government's case before the State even recognizes them. He works alongside medical, forensic, and digital experts to challenge the prosecution's evidence at every stage — whether that means dismantling forensic conclusions, exposing flawed police procedures, or presenting alternative theories to a jury.

As a former police academy instructor, Rocky trained law enforcement officers on criminal procedure and courtroom testimony. He doesn't have to guess how officers are taught to investigate and testify — he taught the courses. That insider perspective drives his approach to cross-examination, Fourth Amendment challenges, and motions to suppress.

Rocky is a member of the National College for DUI Defense (NCDD) and brings specialized training to breath test challenges, field sobriety defense, and CDL-related cases. He also has deep experience with Florida's mental health courts and diversion programs, having served on the 13th Judicial Circuit's Problem-Solving Court Committee to expand treatment-based alternatives to incarceration.

A respected voice in the criminal defense community, Rocky has trained and mentored hundreds of attorneys across Tampa Bay and lectured statewide at Florida Bar continuing legal education seminars on topics including sex offense defense, treatment court innovation, and the intersection of the opioid crisis and the justice system. He is admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of the United States, the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida, and all Florida state courts.

National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (NACDL)

Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (FACDL)

He is the author of How to Choose a Major Crimes Attorney — or Any Criminal Defense Attorney for That Matter, available on Amazon or as a free download at brancatolawfirm.com.

If you are under investigation or facing criminal charges in Hillsborough, Pinellas, or Pasco County, the attorney you choose will define how your case is fought.

attorneys.name: WM. Dennis Brannon
attorneys.firm_name: Brannon & Brannon Car Accident & Personal Injury Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Walton Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Dennis Brannon was born on May 10, 1949, at Fort Benning, Georgia. His father was a career Army officer. Following his father's retirement from the Army, Dennis moved with his family to DeFuniak Springs, Florida. He graduated from Walton County High School in 1967 with honors. He attended Chipola Jr. College in Marianna, Florida, and graduated with honors in 1969. Dennis then attended Florida State University and graduated with honors, Phi Beta Kappa, in 1971. During his time at Florida State he was Commander of the Army ROTC unit and graduated as a Distinguished Military Graduate, the No. 1 graduate in the Army ROTC graduating class for 1971. Following his graduation from Florida State, he was awarded a full graduate school fellowship and from 1971-1972 attended the Universities of Alabama, Kentucky and Tennessee, which universities participated in and sponsored the fellowship program. In 1972 he received his Masters Degree in Public Administration from the University of Tennessee.

Immediately upon completing his fellowship he entered active duty as a Second Lieutenant and graduated both from Infantry Officer Basic Training at Fort Benning and then from the Army Security Agency Military Intelligence School at Fort Devens, Massachusetts. Following graduation from the ASA school at Fort Devens he was assigned to the 303 Army Security Agency Battalion at Fort Hood, Texas, in support of the First Cavalry and Second Armored Divisions. During his assignment at Fort Hood he served a period of time as the Battalion S-2, with responsibilities for armed security and intelligence operations of the Battalion. In 1974 Mr. Brannon completed his reserve officer active duty commitment and then worked for one year with the State of Alabama before attending the Florida State University School of Law. During his time at law school, Dennis served as the school's representative for the University Student Council.

Following graduation from law school, Dennis returned to Northwest Florida in 1979 to work with the law firm of Timmel and Denny, a law firm specializing in insurance defense work. In 1980 he moved to the law firm of Dewrell, Blue and Brannon where he was lead counsel and responsible for the personal injury litigation division of that firm. In 1990 Dennis left that firm to establish the firm of Wm. Dennis Brannon, PA, continuing to limit his practice to personal injury, wrongful death and insurance litigation. He continues to restrict his practice to representing people who have been wrongfully injured.

During his 40 years of practice as an attorney, Mr. Brannon has tried cases in Walton, Okaloosa, Santa Rosa and Escambia counties. He has a particular love and affinity for Walton County. He has served with distinction as the Chairman of the Florida Bar Grievance Committee for Okaloosa and Walton County. He has been honored by Mothers Against Drunk Drivers (MADD) for his work in attempting to limit the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages in Okaloosa County. He has been awarded an AV rating for many years by Martindale Hubbell, the AV rating signifying the highest ability and integrity rating that can be awarded by his peers in the practice of law.

Mr. Brannon is an ordained deacon in the Baptist Church. He has taught adult Sunday School for more than 20 years. He has served on countless committees in various churches and has served as the Chairman of the Deacon Body in one such church. He has provided pro bono legal service to his church for many years and remains committed to serving the body of Christ.

Dennis is married to Venita Brannon and they have been married since 1975. They reside in Destin, Florida. They have two sons, Paul and Patrick, who both have followed their father into the practice of law. They also have five grandchildren with more to come. Paul currently practices law with his father and Patrick practices law in Tampa, Florida.

Awards and Honors

AV Rating, MartinDale Hubbell, 2003

Honored by Mothers Against Drunk Drivers (MADD)

attorneys.practice_type: Total Disability Lawyers in Clearwater, FL
attorneys.bio:
Areas of Practice

Ralph Bratch is a VA Accredited Attorney who limits his practice to helping veterans and their dependents throughout the country obtain disability and other benefits from the VA for various conditions/disabilities including but not limited to the following:

Mental disorders including post traumatic stress disorders (PTSD), depression, anxiety and schizophrenia, Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) and related symptoms.

Disabilities from exposure to Agent Orange including diabetes mellitus, peripheral neuropathy, hypertension, etc. and various types of cancer including prostate, skin, lymph node and respiratory cancers.

Physical injuries from blasts including shell fragment wounds, muscle wounds and scars.

Other physical injuries including bone fractures, back and neck injuries.

Various diseases including but not limited to Hepatitis.

Individual Unemployability.

Ralph has been recognized by his lawyer peers for inclusion in the prestigious publication The Best Lawyers in America®

Civilian Experience

Ralph has over 21 years of legal experience representing disabled people in various cases against the government, insurance companies and corporations. For the last five years Ralph has limited his practice to helping veterans and their dependents throughout the country obtain disability and other benefits from the VA.

Lectures/Publications

Ralph has authored numerous articles and lectured on various veteran, military, disability and litigation topics including, among others, National Guard/Reserve VA disability claims and Traumatic Brain Injury. As part of his continued advocacy for veterans on VA disability issues, Ralph also occasionally provides written guidance and comments to the VA about the inadequacies and unfairness of various current and proposed VA disability regulations.

Military Experience

In addition to his civilian legal experience, Ralph is also currently a Major in the JAG Corps of the Army Reserve serving as Senior Defense Counsel in the 154th Legal Support Organization where he defends individual soldiers against the Army in administrative separation actions and criminal proceedings. Ralph has served in support of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan and has received numerous awards and decorations including:

Army Commendation Medal

Army Achievement Medal

Army Reserve Components Achievement Medal

National Defense Service Medal

Armed Forces Reserve Medal with "M" device (M denotes mobilization)

Volunteer Work

Ralph provides financial support to various veteran related charitable organizations. He also currently participates in the Homeless Veterans Project providing free legal assistance to homeless veterans helping them obtain disability benefits. He also volunteers with local homeless veteran shelters in order to assist and education veterans regarding disability benefits. Ralph has also served as a volunteer Ombudsmen with the Employer Support of the Guard & Reserve (ESGR), an organization that helps guarantee the employment rights of military service members.

Veterans Administration

United States Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims

State of Indiana
