attorneys.name: Michael A. Camadeco Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael A. Camadeco, Esq.

Founding Partner

**DUI and Criminal Defense Attorney**

In the field of DUI and Criminal defense in Florida, there stands a steadfast guard against the Goliath known the State Attorney; a dedicated advocate who embodies the essence of constitutional principles and unwavering commitment to safeguarding the rights of the accused. Originally hailing from New York, Michael A. Camadeco, Esq., a founding partner of Titan Law, PLLC, is that formidable defender, driven by an unshakable belief in the Constitution and the rights it upholds.

**A Champion of Constitutional Rights:**

As a defender of the accused, Michael knows that the Constitution isn't just a piece of paper; it's a sacred covenant that protects every citizen's rights. It's this profound conviction that propels him forward, serving as the unwavering shield for his clients when they face accusations. With Michael, it's not just a profession; it's a calling, a solemn duty to be the voice for the voiceless and the protector of those unjustly accused.

**Exceptional Legal Education and Experience:**

Michael's journey to becoming an outstanding DUI and Criminal Defense Attorney is marked by excellence. He is a graduate of Delaware Law School, where he honed his legal acumen and trial skills, emerging victorious in several national trial competitions.

His academic achievements extend to his undergraduate years at MSU of Denver, where he attained degrees in Criminology, Criminal Justice, and Political Science, all while achieving Summa Cum Laude honors. He's not only a legal scholar but also a natural leader, having served as the Captain of the men's lacrosse team.

Michael's unique understanding of the juvenile delinquency system is unparalleled, having previously served with the Florida Department of Juvenile Justice. This experience sets him apart, offering invaluable insights few others possess within the State’s Juvenile System.

His dedication to criminal defense led him to work with the Community Justice of New Jersey, Pennsylvania Criminal Defense Clinic and the Bucks County Public Defender's Office. In recognition of his remarkable contributions to the field, Michael has earned the distinction of being a Top 40 Under 40 Criminal Defense Attorney by the American Institute of Trial Lawyers, Attorney Of The Year by the National Alliance of Attorneys and Criminal Defense to 40 Under 40 Attorney by the American Institute of Trial Lawyers.

**A Multifaceted Force:**

Beyond the courtroom, Michael is a dynamic individual, displaying his tenacity in various aspects of life. He's an avid CrossFit competitor, demonstrating the same relentless drive that he brings to his legal practice. Moreover, he's a certified Level 1 Fire Fighter, highlighting his commitment to public safety and service and his community.

In every facet of his life, Michael A. Camadeco, Esq. embodies the spirit of unwavering dedication to justice, an indomitable force fighting for the rights of the accused. With his legal expertise and resolute commitment to the Constitution, he stands as a true pillar of strength in the world of criminal defense.

Awards and Honors

National Alliance of Attorneys- Attorney of The Year- 2020

attorneys.name: Adam J. Campbell
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Law Lawyers in Daytona Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Adam Campbell is an associate attorney litigating cases primarily in the area of insurance law, including insurance defense, insurance coverage litigation, and bad faith. Prior to joining the team at Smith Bigman Brock, P.A., Adam worked as a staff attorney for Progressive Casualty Insurance Company, where he practiced mainly in insurance defense. Adam served as a law clerk for Progressive prior to graduating law school, and transitioned to becoming a full time staff attorney upon becoming a member of the Florida Bar.

Adam graduated with honors from Stetson University College of Law in 2016. During law school, Adam participated in the Florida Supreme Court Internship Program for Distinguished Florida Law Students, where he functioned as a law clerk to Justice James E.C. Perry. Adam was responsible for reviewing petitions for discretionary review and making recommendations as to whether jurisdiction existed, conducting extensive legal research, preparing legal memoranda on pending cases, attending oral arguments, discussing cases with staff attorneys and Justice Perry, and assisting in the drafting of opinions. In addition to the Florida Supreme Court Internship Program, Adam also interned with the U.S. Department of Justice and Florida State Attorney's Office.

Prior to law school, Adam graduated with honors from Marshall University where he earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in International Affairs. During undergrad, Adam spent a semester in Argentina where he became fluent in Spanish. After college, Adam began working for a small law firm in Charleston, West Virginia, as a paralegal. His experience as a paralegal inspired him to attend law school. During law school, Adam worked full and part time as a paralegal and law clerk for a small law firm specializing in probate litigation, real estate transactions and estate planning.

attorneys.name: Claudia Canizares
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Claudia Canizares is originally from Habana, Cuba.

In 2009, she graduated Summa Cum Laude with Bachelors Degree in Criminal Justice with a Minor in Psychology from Florida International University.

In 2012, she graduated cum laude from Nova Southeastern University where she obtained her Juris Doctor degree. She was admitted to the Florida Bar on September 19, 2012.

She started her law career doing Personal Injury. She then transitioned into Immigration Law which has been her main area of practice since the beginning of 2013. Since then, Mrs. Canizares has completed thousands of cases before USCIS and the immigration court.

Ms. Canizares's case experience includes asylum applications, adjustment of status applications, waivers for unlawful presence, fraud, criminal issues, smuggling and others, cancellation of removal, special visas for crime victims, victims of domestic violence and juveniles, humanitarian deferred actions, TPS applications, Parole in Place and others.

She has appeared in USCIS interviews and court hearings in various places of the United States including but not limited to: Florida, California, Georgia, New York, New Jersey, Texas, Missouri, Nevada, Arizona, Minneapolis, Tennessee, Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and Louisiana.

Mrs. Canizares came to the US at the age of 16 and endured detention at the southern border followed by a lengthy immigration removal proceeding. Thankfully, Mrs. Canizares was granted lawful permanent residency. During her early years in the United States, she did not imagine that she would become an immigration attorney. However, it is her personal experience that has allowed her to empathize with the thousands of people she has met and serviced during her last decade as immigration attorney.

attorneys.name: Richard A Canina
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Melbourne, FL
attorneys.bio:
Richard was born and raised in Brevard County, FL. After graduating from Holy Trinity Academy in Melbourne, FL, he attended Florida State University in Tallahassee, FL. At Florida State, Richard obtained an undergraduate degree in psychology with a minor in criminology and criminal justice, graduating with honors. Richard was a member of the National Society of Collegiate Scholars and Phi Gamma Delta Fraternity.

Richard received his Juris Doctorate from Stetson University College of Law in Gulfport, Florida. While at Stetson, Richard geared his course selections toward criminal defense work and criminal trial advocacy. He successfully completed internships at the Public Defender's Office for the Sixth Judicial Circuit and at several local criminal defense law firms.

After graduating from law school, Richard went to work as an Assistant Public Defender for Kathleen Smith, Public Defender 20th Judicial Circuit (Lee County, FL) for several years. Richard handled thousands of misdemeanor cases, many of which were DUI and domestic violence charges. He was quickly promoted to representing clients charged with felonies ranging from theft and driving related offenses to high profile cases involving sexual battery, robbery, burglary, aggravated assault, and felony drug charges.

Richard also has extensive experience handling complex criminal cases such as white collar crimes, frauds, schemes to defraud, and large-scale theft charges. Richard's experience has given him invaluable insight into the workings of the State Attorney's Office, as well as many police agencies and other state departments.

Richard continues to dedicate his career to helping those accused of criminal offenses. He is committed to aggressively defending his clients utilizing resources such as private investigators, doctors, psychologists, DNA experts and advanced technology to obtain the best possible outcome for his clients. He is passionate about criminal law and guarantees top-notch personal service to all of his clients and their needs. Richard is a seasoned trial attorney who knows the legal system and its players. He is committed to giving his clients the best defense possible.

attorneys.bio:
For over THREE DECADES, attorney Richard G. Canina has been practicing exclusively in the area of Criminal Defense in Brevard County, FL. He later attended Stetson University College of Law, where he received his Juris Doctorate. Cantor & Cantor is a law firm dedicated to representing people accused of crimes in Southwest Florida. When you are arrested for a crime the final result on your case will be the determinative factor you use to gauge your lawyers performance. Your lawyer at Cantor & Cantor will be mindful of your priorities from start to finish as we work with laser focus to provide you with the best possible outcome on your case. attorneys.name: Steven A. Capriati
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Steven Capriati was born in New York and raised in Wesley Chapel, FL. He graduated from the University of Arizona in Tucson. Mr. Capriati was the top-ranked player on the men's tennis team where he earned All-Conference honors and competed in the NCAA Championships. He then attended the School of Law at Hofstra University for his first 2 years of law school before completing his legal studies at the Florida State University College of Law in 2006.

During law school, Mr. Capriati clerked for the Office of the General Counsel to Governor Jeb Bush and the law firm of GrayRobinson. After graduating, he worked on Charlie Crist's campaign for governor as a policy advisor. Following the campaign's success, Mr. Capriati joined the law firm of Carlton Fields, where he handled cases involving business transactions, mergers & acquisitions, and securities law.

Ultimately, Mr. Capriati knew that he wanted to be a trial lawyer so he became a prosecutor in Hillsborough County for more than 5 years. During his time at the State Attorney's Office, Mr. Capriati became the lead trial attorney and lead traffic homicide prosecutor for his felony division where he was responsible for prosecuting violent crimes and drug trafficking. As a result, Mr. Capriati successfully prosecuted crimes involving murder, armed robbery, traffic homicide, and trafficking in illegal drugs.

Mr. Capriati joined Morgan & Morgan so he could put his wide array of legal and trial experience to work for those who have been injured as a result of another's negligence.

attorneys.name: Ryan Michael Cardoso
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Pensacola, FL
attorneys.bio:
If you are looking for an attorney who cares about getting you the most compensation for your case, call Ryan Cardoso. As founder and principal attorney of Cardoso Law, PLLC, Ryan puts his clients first and obtains the best possible results for each case. Ryan and his team provide personal and individualized attention to each client’s case – no matter how big or small. As a result, he’s recovered many millions of dollars for people injured in car accidents, trucking accidents, wrongful death negligence cases, and many other serious personal injury cases. He is a Life Member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum which is one of the most prestigious groups of trial lawyers in the United States. Membership is limited to attorneys who have won million and multi-million-dollar verdicts and settlements for their clients.

Ryan’s track record includes winning jury trials, obtaining large settlements for his clients, and building a strong reputation in court and throughout his community. He works tirelessly to maximize personal injury awards for his clients. Ryan fights as hard as he can, as long as he can, to get justice for his clients. He stands up to powerful insurance companies, corporations, and governmental entities when they are at fault for injuring his clients. All the while, he sends a continual message to those who try to lowball or deny accident victims: “I won’t stand for it.” Ryan will never settle a case without client approval and always works hard to make sure his clients are fully informed throughout the process.

How Ryan Cardoso Makes a Difference

Ryan cares about each of his clients and provides them with the best possible legal representation. The way Ryan approaches a personal injury case is through clear communication with his clients. He puts an emphasis on transparent and meaningful client communication. Before prospective clients meet with him, they are often physically and emotionally hurt, confused, and stressed about their situation. Ryan takes the time to listen closely to what each client has to say about the accident and the impact that it has had on them and their family. He will then explain their rights and legal options while carefully answering any questions they may have about the process. He immediately makes his clients aware of any important developments in their cases, and he’s prompt when returning client calls.

Since 2014, Ryan has made a name for himself in the Pensacola community as a fierce advocate for accident victims. Ryan is an experienced trial lawyer who handles a wide array of personal injury cases throughout Florida. His practice areas include motor vehicle and boating accidents, motorcycle accidents, slip-and-falls, trip-and-falls, spinal cord injuries, traumatic brain injuries, and wrongful death cases.

attorneys.bio:
Thomas W. Carey is the founding partner of the Clearwater firm of Carey & Leisure. Following the tragic loss of his wife, Joni, to a drunk driver, Mr. Carey served as the State Chairman for Mothers Against Drunk Driving (MADD) in 1986 and was the Pinellas County President from 1984 to 1985. Mr. Carey has been an adjunct professor of Trial Practice at Stetson University College of Law and has lectured on funeral home and cemetery malpractice, the Dram Shop Act, and other topics. Mr. Carey has litigated complex liability and medical issues in courts throughout West Florida and has been lead counsel in a large number of cases involving victims of drunk driving.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey P. Cario
attorneys.practice_type: Marital and Family Law Lawyers in Brooksville, FL
attorneys.bio:
JEFFREY P. CARIO, born in Patchogue, New York, in 1962, admitted to bar, 1987, Florida. Education: University of Florida (B.S., 1984); Nova Law School (J.D., 1987). Member: While at Nova, Mr. Cario was the President of the American Association of Trial Lawyers for two years, Chief Prosecutor for the Honor Court and a member of the University's State and Regional Mock Trial Teams.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Cario returned to Hernando County where he was raised and began his law practice as an Assistant State Attorney for the Fifth Judicial Circuit. While at the State Attorney's Office, Mr. Cario specialized primarily in the Felony division. His trial experience ranges from simple infractions to prosecution of capital murder trials, sexual batteries, child abuse and drug related crimes. After leaving the State Attorney's Office in 1989, Mr. Cario began a private law practice in Spring Hill and Brooksville, primarily devoting his practice to matrimonial and family law litigation; criminal defense; and civil litigation.

Mr. Cario is a member of both the Florida Bar and the Georgia Bar. He is admitted to practice in State Courts of Florida and Georgia, the United States District Courts for the Middle District of Florida, the United States Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States Supreme Court. Mr. Cario is a Florida State certified family court mediator and is also Board Certified in Marital and Family Law.

In addition to the practice of law, Mr. Cario was on the Board of Directors and attorney for the Dawn Center/Rape Crises-Spouse Abuse Shelter, former President of the American Heart Association Board of Directors, former Board of Directors of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, a former member of MADD, former Director of the Hernando County Chamber of Commerce, former Chairman of the Board of Directors for Professional Therapy Center, Inc., and former Chairman of the Hernando County Republican Party Executive Committee, and former Charter Member of the Citrus-Hernando Inns of Court.

attorneys.name: Gene M. Carlino
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Gene M. Carlino is a Partner with Pannone Lopes Devereaux & O'Gara LLC. He is a highly respected attorney with more than 25 years of experience in all areas of estate and tax planning and administration, Medicaid planning, probate administration and trust litigation. His practice includes advising and advocating for clients in all matters involving federal and state taxation, including representing individuals before the Internal Revenue Service in contested assessments during the examination phase, before the Appeals Division, and at trial in the United States Tax Court, the United States Court of Federal Claims, and the Federal District Court. Prior to joining the firm, he was the founder and successful business owner of Carlino Law Associates, PC since 1999.

Attorney Carlino is a prominent member of the legal community. In 2022, he was chosen as a Fellow of the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC), the most prestigious organization in the United States for estate planning and trust counsel, based on his "outstanding reputation, exceptional skill, and substantial contributions to the field." In addition, he received the peer-evaluated Professional Excellence in Law Award in 2022 from Rhode Island Monthly, a distinction recognizing only 5% of attorneys in the area. Attorney Carlino has also been honored by his peers and judges with the AV Preeminent rating from Martindale Hubbell, which is the highest rating based on both legal ability and ethics, is a published author and was the recipient of the 2020 Rhode Island Bar Journal Lauren E. Jones, Esq. Writing Award. He has vast experience in all phases of the tax collection process, including negotiating installment agreements, Offers in Compromise, penalty abatement requests if reasonable cause exists and advising clients on how to properly structure their affairs within the bounds of the law, so as to better position clients for a favorable settlement and to avoid unnecessary exposure to collection procedures. In addition, he advises clients in all matters of federal income tax planning, including structuring and implementing like-kind exchanges from routine to a highly sophisticated nature, and advising corporate taxpayers and shareholders in connection with tax-free reorganizations.

In his estate and trust planning and administration practice, he counsels clients in a wide range of areas that include funded revocable trusts, funded irrevocable trusts, funded life insurance trusts, planning for families with a noncitizen spouse and for families with special needs children or beneficiaries, grantor retained annuity trusts, sales to irrevocable trusts using a conventional promissory note and/or using a self-canceling installment note, and domestic asset protection trusts. In addition, Attorney Carlino has significant experience in the practice of Elder Law, including advising individuals in all phases of the Medicaid planning and the eligibility process, assisting in designing and implementing Medicaid plans and handling appeals through the state administrative hearing process.

Attorney Carlino earned his J.D. from Boston University School of Law, his LLM in Taxation from New York University School of Law and a B.S. in Accountancy from Providence College, magna cum laude. He is licensed to practice in Rhode Island, Massachusetts and Florida and also admitted to the United States Tax Court, United States Court of Federal Claims, the Federal District Court of Rhode Island and the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida. He is also licensed by the National Football League Player's Associations as a contract advisor.

attorneys.bio:
Caroline Nitsche Carlson is a Partner in Chartwell's Miami Office. She graduated, magna cum laude, from Barry University in Miami Shores, Florida where she received a Bachelor's degree in Political Science and History. In 1988, Ms. Nitsche Carlson graduated, cum laude, from the University of Miami School of Law, where she served as Report's Editor for the Inter-American Law Review. Ms. Nitsche Carlson served as a legal intern in the U.S. District Court, Southern District of Florida for Judge James W. Kehoe and was an associate at the Miami offices of Katten Muchin & Zavis & Dombroff & Gilmore.

In 1996, Ms. Nitsche Carlson co-founded the firm of Pivnik & Nitsche, P.A. and for over 14 years has represented carriers and self insureds throughout Florida in all types of general liability claims including: auto and truck accident cases, shipping, product liability, construction defects and matters involving premises liability, including slip and fall, inadequate security, wrongful eviction, false arrest, assault and malicious prosecution. Ms. Nitsche Carlson also provides clients with advice and counsel on first party and third party coverage matters. She is a Florida Supreme Court Certified Circuit & County Court Mediator.

Ms. Nitsche Carlson lectured for a semester at Barry University, on Legal Research Methods and is fluent in Spanish.

attorneys.name: Mitzi Sommer Carr
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury/Wrongful Death Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mitzi Sommer Carr has practiced law in the Orlando area since 2006 and has worked in the legal profession since 1995. Mrs. Carr is a shareholder with the Carr Law Firm, P.A. (www.carrlawpa.com) and successfully litigates cases involving Personal Injuries, First Party Insurance disputes, Commercial and Construction Litigation disputes. Mrs. Carr obtained her law degree from the University of Florida College of Law and has since represented consumers against multi-billion dollar corporations.

Community Involvement

Mitzi Sommer Carr has served on the Board of Directors for the Florida Justice Association and on the Board of Directors for the Central Florida Trial Lawyers Association. On a state level, the Florida Justice Association works tirelessly for the rights of the injured and downtrodden and works to preserve the adversary trial system. The Florida Justice Association is "dedicated to strengthening and upholding Florida's civil justice system and protecting the rights of Florida's citizens and consumers. We passionately believe that all Floridians benefit when deserving individuals have a fair chance to seek justice in our state's courts and that Florida's consumers are made safer when large corporations and industries are held to a high ethical standard and accept fair responsibility for their actions."

Mitzi Sommer Carr has served on the Board of Directors for the Hispanic Bar Association of Central Florida and served as Fundraising Chair. The Hispanic Bar Association of Central Florida is a non-profit corporation comprised of local attorneys, judges, law clerks and law school students “who advocate for the rights of the Hispanic community and help Hispanics learn and understand their legal rights and gain greater access to the courts and the legal system.”

The Carr Law Firm believes in giving back to the community and helping those less fortunate through its involvement in and support of organizations such as The Coalition for the Homeless, The Second Harvest Food Banks, and others.

We are also compassionate towards animals that do not have a voice. We help protect animal welfare rights through our work with the American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) and the People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA).

Awards and Honors

Honors

2013 Women Who Mean Business Award

I have taken numerous cases to trial throughout the State of Florida, including in federal court, state court and the American Arbitration Association. Contributing author of Ex Parte Communications with Current and Former Employees of a Corporate Defendant, The Florida Bar Journal, December 1997

I have represented clients in high dollar, contractual disputes, as well as those who have been the victims of wrongful conduct by large corporations, insurance companies, and negligent tortfeasors.

attorneys.name: Jessica Carrier Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Bradenton, FL
attorneys.bio:
"Jessica Carrier grew up in Puerto Rico and moved to Miami, Florida with her family in the early 1980's. Jessica earned her Bachelor of Arts from Indiana University located in Bloomington, Indiana in December of 1998.

Jessica received her Juris Doctorate in May of 2002 from Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad Law Center, with a Concentration in International Law and Business. She was the Senior Editor of the ILSA Journal of International & Comparative Law, Spanish Language Edition from 2001-2002. She was admitted to the Florida Bar in September of 2002.

Since 2002, Jessica has primarily focused in the area of workers' compensation. Jessica has years of experience representing both the interests of the Employer/Carrier/Servicing Agent's and the rights of the Injured Worker. Beginning in May of 2018, Jessica served the State of Florida, specifically Manatee and Sarasota Counties, as Senior Attorney and State Mediator for the Office of the Judges of Compensation Claims. Her experience brings a unique and well-rounded perspective, providing effective and zealous advocacy on behalf of her clients.

She has served as an Adjunct Professor of Civil Pretrial Practice at Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad Law Center from 2009-2010. Jessica is fluent in Spanish and Certified by the Madrid Chamber of Commerce in Business Spanish.

In addition to her work as an attorney, Jessica is a classically trained vocalist and enjoys serving her community through music and the arts. Jessica and her husband enjoy serving their community together through volunteering and participating in children's charities.

Jessica considers it a privilege to defend the rights of the Injured Worker and a great honor to assist the Injured and their families in navigating the Florida Workers' Compensation system."

attorneys.name: Liana M. Carrozza
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Liana was raised in Boca Raton attending elementary school through college at Florida Atlantic University. Liana attended St. Thomas University in Miami for law school wherein she received her Juris Doctorate in 2.5 years and was a recipient of the Dean’s merit scholarship every semester. After graduating from law school in 2005, and passing the Florida Bar in 2005, Liana moved to Chicago where in she passed the Illinois Bar in 2006 and spent the next 5 years practicing family law in Chicago at one of the top matrimonial law Firms in the City. Driven by her commitment to becoming an expert in the practice of family law and her service to her clients, in the evenings, Liana attended Chicago Kent School of Law part time for 2 years wherein she received her Masters of Law in Family Law (LL.M.) in 2008. Liana has been back in South Florida since 2010 practicing family law at some of the top Family Law Firms in Florida wherein she has continued to gain expertise in her field. In January 2025, Liana opened Carrozza Family Law in her “home town” of Boca Raton. Being raised in Boca, it has provided her with a deep understanding of the local community and its unique needs.

Liana’s expertise Include:

Divorce and separation proceedings

Divorces involving narcissists

High net worth divorce

Divorces involving family owned businesses

Prenuptial and Postnuptial Agreements including renegotiating these Agreements to meet with ever changing needs of individuals and families.

Property division and marital agreements

Child custody and visitation rights

Child and spousal support

Domestic violence protection

Liana is recognized for combining legal expertise with compassion and clear communication. Every client receives personalized attention, with strategies tailored to their specific circumstances and goals. By staying current with Florida family law developments and local court practices, Liana ensures effective representation and advocacy.

Committed to giving back, Liana participates in local Boca Raton volunteer initiatives and offers educational resources on family law topics. This involvement strengthens ties to the community and supports families beyond the courtroom. With roots in Boca Raton and a focus on family law, Liana is dedicated to guiding clients through life’s transitions with professionalism, empathy, and a deep understanding of the local community.

attorneys.name: Keith M. Carter
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Born in Starke Florida in 1959. Mr. Carter spent his entire life and legal career in Florida. In 1981, he earned a Bachelor of Science from The Florida State University College of Business with a major in finance. He graduated with honors from Stetson University of College of Law in 1985. From 1985 through 2001, Mr. Carter's practice consisted of general insurance defense with a focus on automobile insurance law, commercial transportation, products liability and professional liability. He was a founding partner of Mitchel and Carter, P.A., a shareholder and managing director of the Tampa firm of Shackleford Farrior Stallings and Evans (founded in 1907) and ended his defense career as an attorney and shareholder of Gray, Harris, Robinson, Shackleford, Farrior (now Gray Robinson).

In 2002, Mr. Carter joined the Tampa office of the largest plaintiff's injury law firm in the United States, Morgan and Morgan. His current role with the Tampa office is to serve as trial counsel on cases involving general negligence, medical malpractice and unfair debt collection practices. In the last decade, he achieved eight separate verdicts in excess of $1 million dollars and his total damage verdicts exceed $80 million dollars.

He is board certified by the Florida Bar Association since 1994, AV rated by Martindale Hubbell since 1995, regularly included on the list of Florida Super Lawyers and Florida Legal Elite. He is an Eagle member of the Florida Justice Association.

In 2002, Mr. Carter joined the Tampa office of the largest plaintiff's injury law firm in the United States, Morgan and Morgan. His current role with the Tampa office is to serve as trial counsel on cases involving general negligence, medical malpractice and unfair debt collection practices. In the last decade, he achieved eight separate verdicts in excess of $1 million dollars and his total damage verdicts exceed $80 million dollars.

He is board certified by the Florida Bar Association since 1994, AV rated by Martindale Hubbell since 1995, regularly included on the list of Florida Super Lawyers and Florida Legal Elite. He is an Eagle member of the Florida Justice Association.

attorneys.name: Maria Isabel 'Marisa' Casablanca Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Coral Gables, FL
attorneys.bio:
With more than three decades of experience in U.S. Immigration and Nationality Law, Maria Isabel “Marisa” Casablanca is officially joining the offices of Kurzban Kurzban Tetzeli & Pratt, P.A. as “Of Counsel”. Marisa represents corporate clients and individuals in obtaining immigration assistance and benefits. She is Board Certified in Immigration and Nationality Law by The Florida Bar and Chairs the Unlicensed Practice of Law Committee (11D) Law. She has also served on national liaison committees with USCIS, the Department of Labor and the Department of State. She has published numerous articles and been quoted in Law360 and other media posts. She recently published the 5th edition of her book “Immigration Law for Paralegals” by Carolina Academic Press.

Clients seek Marisa’s reliable counsel on the full spectrum of immigration issues, including obtaining employment visas, investment and business-related visas and residency for foreign nationals, representing family members of permanent residents and U.S. Citizens, and assisting those seeking asylum. She has developed an expertise in the EB-5 field of visas as one of the first Spanish speaking attorneys handling high net worth clients from Latin America.

Marisa is a highly experienced litigator that practices in all areas of Immigration law. She has filed a petition for certiorari with the Supreme Court on an immigration issue that conflicted with different states. She files writs of mandamus and habeas with the Southern District of Florida. Additionally, Marisa advises employers on worksite compliance procedures and represents employers before Immigration and Customs Enforcement with respect to audits. She continues to counsel individuals on how to maintain their status in the United States and assist them in planning their permanent residence in the United States. Clients refer to her as the attorney of hard cases as she can think out of the box and apply innovative strategies.

attorneys.name: Ricardo A. Casasola
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ricardo A. Casasola is a passionate and dedicated attorney who graduated from Ave Maria School of Law in May 2019 and was admitted to the Florida Bar in September 2019. Since joining the firm in 2023, Ricardo has assisted hundreds of clients in criminal and family law.

Originally from Miami, FL, Ricardo grew up in Naples, FL, and has been practicing law for the past four years in Lee and Collier Counties. He is a proud veteran and a fluent Spanish speaker. His experience as both a Trial Court Staff Attorney and an Assistant Public Defender has allowed him to sharpen his litigation skills. As an Assistant Public Defender, Ricardo represented clients in cases ranging from county ordinance violations to first-degree felonies, trying both jury and non-jury trials to verdict.

Ricardo takes pride in actively listening, communicating with clients, and analyzing cases to provide a strong legal defense and achieve the best possible resolution for his clients. His enthusiasm for guiding individuals and families through the complexities of the legal system sets him apart from other attorneys.

Ricardo's dedication to his clients contributed to being honored as Best of Collier in 2023 for Criminal Law, DUI, and Family Law. In addition, he was named a Rising Star by Super Lawyers, a prestigious recognition awarded to only 2.5% of attorneys annually.

On a personal note, Ricardo lives in Naples with his wife, Lauren. In his free time, he enjoys exploring new restaurants with his wife and spending time with their two labradoodles, Ruby and Jade.

attorneys.name: Sharon Caserta
attorneys.practice_type: Disability Discrimination Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Sharon Caserta was born in the Boston, Massachusetts area and began her professional career as a certified American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter. She interpreted extensively in the legal systems in Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Vermont for many years. She was awarded the Specialist Certification for Legal Interpretation by the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf which is a credential awarded to less than 400 interpreters in the country.

Ms. Caserta obtained her Bachelor's in Science Degree magna cum laude from New Hampshire College. Ms. Caserta later moved to Florida and attended Florida Coastal School of Law (FCSL) where her internships included clerking at the Office of the Public Defender Fourth Judicial Circuit, Jacksonville Area Legal Aid, Inc. and with the Honorable Thomas E. Morris at the U.S. District Court, Middle District of Florida.

In 2005 upon graduating cum laude from FCSL she was awarded an Equal Justice Works Fellowship and created the first deaf/hard of hearing litigation unit in Legal Aid. She has dedicated her practice to representing persons with disabilities as they fight for equality, dignity and advancement. Litigation on behalf of her clients has resulted in increased access for members of the deaf and disabled community in many forums and monetary damages for their discrimination.

In addition to her litigation experience accommodating persons with disabilities, Ms. Caserta has extensive experience lecturing about the rights of persons with disabilities, and training ASL interpreters to work in legal settings. She created on-demand training tools to assist lawyers to effectively represent deaf and hard of hearing individuals, and her articles on that subject have been published in the Clearing House Review Journal of Poverty Law and Policy.

attorneys.name: John Castro
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
John S. Castro graduated cum laude with a B.S. in psychology from Florida State University in 2001. He earned a J.D. from the University of Florida’s Levin College of Law in 2004. While at FSU, he worked as a substitute teacher for Leon County Schools. In law school, Mr. Castro excelled inside and outside of the classroom. Mr. Castro was an active member of the John Marshall Bar Association and a volunteer at the University of Florida’s student legal services. Prior to completing law school, he spent a semester studying abroad in Montpellier, France.

Mr. Castro began his legal career with Bell, Leeper, & Roper, P.A. in Orlando, where he represented litigants in both state and Federal Court on matters of civil liability, personal injury, insurance defense, and wrongful death. He then returned to Tampa, where he accepted a position with the State Attorney’s Office for the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit. In this capacity, he quickly rose through the ranks of the juvenile, misdemeanor, and felony divisions, bypassing several lawyers with longer tenure. As a prosecutor, Mr. Castro litigated over 300 trials, hearings, and motions.

In 2008, Mr. Castro joined former Thirteenth Judicial Circuit chief prosecutor Robin Fuson in his law practice, where he represented clients on matters of criminal defense and personal injury. His litigation skills quickly gained him the respect of colleagues and opposition council alike, who described him as a knowledgeable, persuasive, and skilled litigator. He received many letters of appreciation from clients expressing gratitude for his dedication, kindness and attention to detail in handling their cases.

In 2010, Mr. Castro joined family law attorney Christina Anton Garcia to form the Anton Castro Law group. His expertise in criminal law, personal injury, and litigation represents major contributions to the firm. Together, Mr. Castro and Ms. Anton are committed to making exemplary client service and excellence in the practice of law their top priority in matters of criminal defense, personal injury, and family law.

Mr. Castro and his family have been an active part of the Tampa Bay community since 1991. Mr. Castro is a member of the board of directors for the First Tee of Tampa Bay, a non-profit organization aimed at teaching youth positive life skills and lessons through the game of golf. Additionally, Mr. Castro volunteers with the United Way’s program Hands on Tampa. He is an avid outdoorsman and loves spending time with his dog, Hank.

Mr. Castro is licensed to practice law in all Florida state and county courts and for federal matters in the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Taren L. Castro
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
The Castro Law Firm, PLLC, located in Royal Palm Beach, Florida, provides a range of legal services to clients that focus on probate, estate planning and guardianship matters.

We offer assistance in navigating the probate process for individuals who have recently lost a loved one. Different types of probate administrations exist in Florida, depending on the value of the estate and whether the decedent left a properly executed will. Furthermore, The Castro Law Firm, PLLC provides estate planning services to individuals who wish to ensure their family's well-being and understand how their estate will be divided in the absence of a will. Estate planning and probate administration can be a complex and daunting process, and having a lawyer who can answer questions and guide clients through the process is invaluable.

Additionally, the firm, led by Attorney Taren L. Castro, guides families through the complex process of guardianship for both adults and minors. Whether assisting parents in establishing legal authority to make important decisions for a child or helping families protect the rights and well-being of an incapacitated adult, we approach each case with compassion and clarity. Our goal is to provide trusted legal support that ensures vulnerable loved ones receive the care, protection, and advocacy they need.

The Castro Law Firm, PLLC accepts credit cards and offers free consultations and Attorney Castro is available to provide legal assistance. Clients can reach our office via phone, online contact form or email to schedule an appointment and receive the necessary support in their legal matters.

attorneys.name: Shayna K. Cavanaugh
attorneys.practice_type: Marital and Family Law Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Shayna K. Cavanaugh is passionate about helping her clients obtain the best possible outcome for their legal issues, however complex or problematic their cases may seem. She focuses on what is most important to each individual and family and strives to give her clients the support, advice, and guidance they need and deserve.

Shayna primarily practices in Marital and Family Law but also handles Administrative DUI Board of Administrative Review hearings and assisting DUI clients in regaining their driving privileges through business purpose licenses.

Shayna moved to Naples in 1997 with her husband and business partner, Daniel M. Cavanaugh. She began her career focused on Marital and Family Law, handling issues of Divorce, Paternity, and Domestic Violence. Prior to starting her own practice, Shayna was an attorney for Legal Aid of Collier County, where she worked with clients who had limited means and substantial needs in their divorces. Through this experience, she learned how to customize her services to her clients and provide top-tier legal representation, even in challenging circumstances.

Mrs. Cavanaugh worked as a contract attorney representing hundreds of victims of domestic violence and spoke on the topic of domestic violence and divorce at the Shelter for Abused Women and Children for many years. In addition, she served on panels with judges, advocates, and psychologists to engage in discussions about how domestic violence impacts spouses and children during divorce.

Shayna has also served as a guest instructor at local colleges and universities to speak on issues of Family Law. She has written a book entitled Divorce in Florida, which answers hundreds of questions that can arise during a divorce.

Shayna has been recognized by several organizations for her zealous legal work and was named a “Top 10” Family Law Attorney in client satisfaction by the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys. In 2023, she was honored with the Best of Collier award for Family Law, further highlighting her dedication to excellence in the field. She also serves on the Family Law Rules Committee of the Florida Bar and the Grievance Committee for the 20th Judicial Circuit.

More personally, Shayna and Dan raised their two children in Naples, and both adult children are now contributing to the growth of their law practice. In their free time, they enjoy the outdoors and traveling.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense - DUI/DWI Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Daniel M. Cavanaugh - Distinguished Trial Attorney with Over 25 Years of Experience

Daniel M. Cavanaugh is a highly accomplished trial attorney with over 25 years of experience, during which he has earned numerous awards and secured countless successful outcomes for his clients. Originally from West Springfield, Massachusetts, Dan moved to Naples, Florida, in 1997 to build his legal career. Known for his sharp trial skills, extensive knowledge, and unwavering dedication to his clients, Dan has become a trusted leader in the legal profession.

Commitment to Excellence and Legal Innovation

Dan’s career is marked by a steadfast commitment to staying at the forefront of legal and scientific advancements. In 2022, he became one of only four attorneys in Florida to achieve the prestigious "ACS Forensic Lawyer-Scientist Designation," as recognized by the Chemistry and the Law Division of the American Chemical Society. This rare designation reflects his mastery of the forensic science often critical to complex criminal cases, particularly DUI litigation.

Recognizing that DUI cases often involve intricate legal and scientific issues, Dan continually engages in advanced training to ensure he is fully prepared to tackle the myriad challenges these cases present. His dedication to ongoing education allows him to deliver the highest level of defense for his clients.

Recognized for Trial Expertise

Dan has been recognized as a top trial attorney, earning awards such as Attorney of the Year at the State Attorney’s Office in Fort Myers. He also holds the AV Preeminent® rating, the highest possible peer rating, signifying exceptional legal ability, professionalism, and ethical standards. In addition, he was honored as Best of 2023 in Collier County for Criminal Defense and DUI and has been selected for Super Lawyers in 2025. These accolades underscore his reputation as a fierce advocate and skilled litigator.

Leadership in DUI Defense and the Formation of DUI Law Group

A cornerstone of Dan’s practice is his leadership in DUI defense, an area where his extensive expertise and commitment to excellence shine. Recognizing the unique challenges posed by DUI cases, Dan has made it a priority to stay at the forefront of forensic science, evolving legal strategies, and procedural developments. His dedication to ongoing education ensures he is fully prepared to address the myriad complexities these cases present, from breathalyzer inaccuracies to roadside testing protocols.

Dan’s passion for this critical area of criminal law led to the formation of the DUI Law Group, a specialized practice dedicated to providing exceptional defense for clients facing DUI charges. This focus enables him to deliver comprehensive and cutting-edge representation, ensuring his clients receive not only a robust defense but also the benefit of his deep understanding of the science and law behind DUI cases.

Dan’s leadership in DUI defense reflects his broader commitment to justice and advocacy, setting a high standard for excellence in this critical area of law.

Extensive Criminal Defense Experience

With over 25 years of experience in criminal law, Dan has handled virtually every type of case in Florida. His approach to criminal defense emphasizes clear and open communication with his clients. Understanding the anxiety and uncertainty that come with criminal charges, he takes the time to guide clients through each step of the process, ensuring they feel informed and supported.

Before transitioning to criminal defense, Dan served as a prosecutor in various high-level roles, including:

Chief Assistant State Attorney in Hendry and Glades counties

Misdemeanor and Juvenile Chief in Collier County

Special Victims’ Unit prosecutor in Lee County

Chief Deputy State's Attorney in Vermont's capital

While serving as Chief Deputy State’s Attorney in Vermont’s capital, Dan gained even greater insight into the philosophical approaches to crime, justice, and accountability. During this time, he authored two articles addressing critical aspects of the criminal justice system: one on criminal justice reform and another on the role of victims within the criminal system. These publications underscore Dan’s thought leadership and dedication to meaningful reform in the legal field.

This role broadened his perspective on the complexities of criminal law and enhanced his ability to navigate the nuanced strategies of both prosecution and defense. His combined experiences in Florida and Vermont have given him a unique, well-rounded understanding of prosecutorial strategies and the intricacies of the criminal justice system.

Dan prosecuted serious and high-profile cases, including those featured on Dateline NBC’s “To Catch a Predator”, where he made real-time legal decisions. He also served on the State Attorney’s hiring and death penalty committees, gaining invaluable experience in case evaluation and prosecutorial decision-making.

Dedication to Training and Mentorship

Dan’s commitment to education extends beyond his own practice. He has trained law enforcement officers in both Florida and Vermont, sharing his expertise on arrest procedures, investigations, and the complexities of criminal cases. Additionally, Dan independently arranged inter-agency training exercises with various law enforcement agencies, fostering collaboration and enhancing the skills of officers across jurisdictions.

As a part-time instructor at the Southwest Florida Public Service Academy, Dan further contributed to the professional development of law enforcement professionals, emphasizing the importance of thorough preparation and nuanced understanding of legal processes. His dedication to training underscores his belief in the value of education at every level of the criminal justice system.

A Trusted Advocate

Dan Cavanaugh’s over 25 years of experience, dedication to continued education, and passion for justice have made him a highly respected attorney. Whether defending a DUI case, navigating a complex wrongful death suit, or mentoring the next generation of legal professionals, Dan is steadfast in his pursuit of excellence and advocacy for his clients.

attorneys.name: Carlos J. Cavenago III
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Carlos J. Cavenago, III was born and raised in Southwest Florida. He graduated from Bishop Verot High School in 1996. He graduated from Florida Gulf Coast University with a degree in criminal justice with an emphasis in legal studies, the first person in the school's history to be granted that distinction.

While attending law school at St. Thomas University in Miami, he worked at a criminal defense law firm. The highlight of his law school experience came when he interned for a United States Magistrate Judge for the Southern District Court, West Palm Beach Division. Carlos assisted writing briefs during a two week jury trial pertaining to a trade secrets violation. To this day he maintains a relationship with the Judge he served and values their friendship. Carlos graduated law school on the Dean's List of academic achievement.

Carlos passed the bar exam in 2004, after which he started working as a prosecutor for the State Attorney's office for the 20th Judicial Circuit in Fort Myers. His first jury trial was a DUI case involving serious bodily injury. Speaking to the victims of the accident and gaining their trust for such an important time in their life gave Carlos a strong sense of purpose. He won that trial and prosecuted many other crimes. He was eventually transferred to the domestic violence unit.

While a prosecutor, Carlos was assigned a four count voyeurism case. A man was secretly video-taping his girlfriend's daughter in the shower. On the first day of trial, the defendant pled guilty to all counts. The victim asked Carlos to refer her to a civil lawyer for a violation of privacy suit. He studied lawyers' resumes and communicated with local legal professionals. One name kept coming up – Allan Parvey. He met with Mr. Parvey and spoke to him about the evidence and handling the case. Mr. Parvey was successful in securing a confidential settlement.

After working on that case together, they realized that they would work well as a team. Carlos is passionate about helping victims of negligence seek justice, the first duty of society. In order to maintain our society we must always protect justice.

Carlos is a member of the Florida Justice Association, past member of the Calusa Inns of Court, Honorable Peter T. Fay Inn of Court and the Lee County Bar Association. Over the years he has taught several law courses at Florida Gulf Coast University. He is continually volunteering his time at Ave Maria School of Law as a judge for their moot court competition and mock trial judge for the Lee County mock trial program. In 2011, Carlos was selected by Super Lawyers as a Rising Star within his profession, a distinction which continued in 2012 and 2013.

As this community has given so much to Carlos, he is always interested in ways to give back to our community. He serves on the board of directors for the FGCU Alumni Association and is currently serving as chairman of the board. He is active with the Rotary Club of downtown Fort Myers. The American Cancer Society is near and dear to his heart and he and his wife have hosted events for that very worthy cause. As an avid angler he is a member and contributor to the Coastal Conservation Association, an organization dedicated to preserving and protecting the environment.

attorneys.name: Melissa Nicole Champagne
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio: Melissa grew up and pursued her early education in Tampa, graduating from Lee Academy in Carrollwood in 2000 and earning her bachelor's degree in History and Literature from Eckerd College in 2004. She then attended Boston University School of Law, where she competed in the Stone Moot Court and Sutherland Moot Court competitions and earned her juris doctor in 2008. After completing law school, Melissa practiced in Boston for 2 years, working for the non-profit AIDS Action Committee of Massachusetts where she provided a range of legal services to an at-risk, underserved population. She returned to Tampa in 2010, and has been practicing real estate law since. Melissa has experience in a wide range of real estate matters, including landlord/tenant, HOA litigation, title disputes, and commercial and residential transactions. She joined Frank Charles Miranda PA in 2020, after running her own successful practice for 8 years. She is admitted to practice in Florida, Massachusetts, and the Middle District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Kelly Chanfrau
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Daytona Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kelly Chanfrau concentrates her practice in employment law, wage and hour law, litigation and client counseling. She has successfully handled cases in a variety of substantive areas before both State and Federal Courts in Florida, the EEOC, DOL, OFCCP, DOAH, City Pension Boards, and County Human Resources Boards. She has successfully represented private and public employers of all sizes in a wide variety of industries.

Kelly regularly lectures on labor and employment laws to private and public employers, non-employment lawyers, and in-house counsel across Florida. She has provided and created management and employee training, handbooks and policy building materials to a wide variety of employers, both large and small. She has also written articles for HR Professionals on a variety of important employment related topics.

In 2009, Kelly was elected President of the Hillsborough Association for Women Lawyers.

During law school, Kelly was honored by being chosen by her professors to work as a Teaching Assistant for Stetson's well known Trial Advocacy Program. Prior to attending law school, Kelly interned for the Office of Naval Intelligence in Washington, DC, in its Editorial Department for two years, where she received a "Special Act Award For Exceptional Competence and Devotion to Duty." Kelly also worked for Arnold Worldwide Advertising Agency in Boston, Massachusetts where she was chosen to serve on the Advertising Agency's first Professional Enrichment Program Committee.

attorneys.bio: Brooke Charlan is a proud graduate of Stetson University College of Law where she graduated with Honors and in the top 10% of her class. Ms. Charlan was a member of the Law School's nationally recognized Trial Team and Law Review. Following graduation, she commenced her practice of law by joining a very active and busy medical malpractice trial group, where she primarily handled cases involving birth injuries and birth trauma. She spent this invaluable time litigating and trying birth injury cases across multiple jurisdictions and against nearly every large hospital system in Florida. To learn more about the innerworkings of the healthcare industry, Ms. Charlan briefly transitioned her practice to the defense of physicians and healthcare entities. While this time proved informative, her desire to resume service as a consumer/patient advocate drove Ms. Charlan to join Morgan & Morgan. Today, she devotes 100% of her practice to fighting for families who have fallen victim to birth injuries and/or birth trauma.

attorneys.name: David R. Chase
attorneys.firm_name: Law Firm of David R. Chase, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: SEC Investigations, SEC Subpoenas, SEC Wells Notices, DOJ Securities Investigations and FINRA 8210 Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
David Chase, a nationally recognized and acclaimed SEC investigation lawyer, represents those under SEC, DOJ securities fraud and FINRA investigations around the country.

David uniquely understands how the SEC conducts its investigations, settlement negotiations, and prosecutions as he served in the SEC’s Enforcement Division as a Senior Counsel in the SEC’s Miami Regional Office for approximately four years. He now uses this inside knowledge to strategically defend his clients to avoid charges or negotiate favorable settlements where required.

For over the last twenty-five years, David has successfully represented individuals, securities professionals, investment advisors, hedge fund managers, and companies who find themselves under the SEC’s crosshairs. Cases handled include insider trading, stock manipulations, crypto fraud, Ponzi schemes, and investment advisor fraud, among others.

David will personally handle your case and patiently guide you through the complex and oftentimes stressful investigatory process. He crafts a defense strategy for each of his clients based upon their objectives and personal circumstances.

David has been widely quoted and published on SEC cases, and has appeared on Bloomberg, CBC and other media outlets. Additionally, David served for over a decade as an Adjunct Professor of Law at the University of Miami School of Law, where he taught a course on SEC Investigations.

attorneys.name: Cory Chastang
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of Cory Chastang, PA
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Bartow, FL
attorneys.bio:
I am passionate about defending my clients. Ever since the mid-1990s, when I was in high school, I've known that I wanted to be a lawyer because of my deep sense of justice and commitment to doing the right thing. I began my career in 2005 as a prosecutor at the State Attorney’s Office in Bartow, Florida. During that time, I honed my trial and negotiation skills, enabling me to successfully handle cases ranging from misdemeanor DUI to violent crimes such as robbery and murder.

Since 2012, I have been in private practice. In 2014, I achieved Board Certification in Criminal Trial Practice, which recognizes my skills, experience, knowledge, ethics, and professionalism as a specialist in criminal law. Since 2015, I have focused exclusively on criminal defense, and I've developed a reputation for tirelessly advocating for my clients and preparing every case as though it will go to trial. From 2015 to 2024, I had the privilege of working with one of the top criminal defense attorneys in the Tampa Bay area, defending clients against some of the most serious charges, including first-degree murder cases where the prosecution sought the death penalty.

My extensive experience has taught me two crucial lessons about being a great attorney: always care deeply about your clients and remember that you are only as good as your last case.

attorneys.name: Ruben V. Chavez Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: A to Z Injury Law, PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
I am a partner and trial attorney at A to Z Injury Law, where I represent clients in serious personal injury and wrongful death matters throughout South Florida.

I bring more than 20 years of trial experience to the firm, having litigated and tried cases in state and federal courts across Florida. I began my career defending corporations and insurance companies at large Miami law firms, gaining first-hand insight into how cases are evaluated and defended before shifting my practice to represent injured individuals.

My experience includes arguing cases before the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals and Florida’s Third and Fourth District Courts of Appeal, as well as taking more than 30 civil jury trials to verdict. In 2017, I was inducted into the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA), a peer-selected organization recognizing experienced trial lawyers.

While trial readiness and maximizing recovery are central to my work, effective representation extends beyond the courtroom. At A to Z Injury Law, we focus on guiding clients through both the legal and practical challenges that follow a serious injury, providing comprehensive support from start to finish.

A native of Mobile, Alabama, Ms. Childs earned a bachelor of arts in Political Communication from Louisiana State University. Upon graduating law school, she began her legal career as an Assistant State Attorney for the First Judicial Circuit of Florida prosecuting criminal cases from investigation to jury trial. She then worked as a Senior Attorney with the Department of Children and Families in the Fourteenth Circuit prosecuting child welfare cases in Bay County Dependency Court.

After relocating to Pensacola, Ms. Childs opened her own law firm focused on criminal defense and family law matters. She also worked for a local legal aid firm battling for justice for indigent clients and victims of domestic violence in bankruptcy, landlord-tenant, probate, divorce and child custody matters. Just prior to joining the team at Morgan & Morgan, Ms. Childs was employed with a premier insurance defense firm specializing in premises liability, general liability and casualty, insurance coverage, fraud, and first party property cases. After becoming disenchanted with working for big insurance, she decided to go back to her roots and fight for the people instead of corporate interests. She is ready to fight for you.

attorneys.name: Staci Kelly Chisholm
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Steven J. Glaros & Associates
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Staci Kelly Chisholm believes that successful advocacy starts with setting her client’s expectations up front, followed by sound preparation, good faith negotiations and efficiency in processes. In Staci’s 18 years practicing exclusively family law, this foundation, she finds, is the best approach for families experiencing the angst of separation and divorce.

Staci is a proud native of Quincy, Florida. She received a Bachelor’s of Science degree in Business Economics from Florida A & M University. She went on to earn a Master’s degree in Economics from Florida State University and completed her Juris Doctor at the University of Florida Levin College of Law.

Staci is a Supreme Court of Florida Certified Mediator. She is also trained in Collaborative Divorce which is a confidential, cost-effective approach to divorcing outside of court. Staci is a Former Board Member of Bay Area Legal Services and the Clearwater Bar Association. She is also the past Section Chair of the Family Law Section of the Clearwater Bar Association and a member of the Family Law Section of the Florida Bar and a member of Canakaris Inn of Court. Staci volunteers her time assisting Bay Area Legal Services with their Family Law Forms Clinic in an effort to provide individuals with pro se legal assistance and partners with them providing limited representation to members of the community who cannot afford representation. Staci volunteers her time to provide legal assistance to the Clearwater Bar Annual Legal Fair which helps members of the community, regardless of income, with family law matters. Staci is passionate about helping the underserved in our community. She was the recipient of the first ever Clearwater Bar Association President’s Award for Excellence in Pro Bono Legal Services in 2017.

Staci is a proud mom of two girls, Kennedy and Karsyn and dog mom to “Quincy.” In Staci’s free time she enjoys spending family Fridays with her family. She also enjoys art, jazz, and all things Napa Valley.

attorneys.name: Andrew J. Chmelir Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Jacobson, Chmelir & Ferwerda Attorneys At Law
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Winter Springs, FL
attorneys.bio:
Andrew J. Chmelir earned his B.A. degree in 1993 from Florida State University's School of Criminology. Andrew then attended law school at St. Thomas University in Miami, Florida, where he excelled and received several academic scholarships and the prestigious Book Award in Criminal Law, Federal Income Taxation and Property Law. While in law school, Andrew interned at both the Brevard County State Attorney's Office and the Miami-Dade County State Attorney's Office. At the Miami office, Andrew worked as a Certified Legal Intern and served as lead counsel in several jury trials. After law school, Andrew joined the Orange County State Attorney's Office as a trial attorney and gained extensive experience prosecuting cases within Felony, Misdemeanor, Traffic and Juvenile Divisions.

After serving as a prosecutor in Orlando for over three years, in 1999, Andrew and his law partners formed the law firm of Jacobson, Chmelir & Ferwerda and have been providing legal representation to countless individuals in both family and criminal law related matters.

Andrew and the firm have defended numerous individuals facing state and federal criminal prosecutions. Andrew has represented clients in high-profile cases and has served as lead counsel in jury trials throughout Central Florida including federal district courts in both Tampa and Orlando. Andrew and his law partners are well known and respected within the federal judicial court system.

Andrew and the law firm are also experienced family law trial attorneys. The firm has handled hundreds of cases involving divorce, paternity, child support and time-sharing disputes. Andrew has received the requisite training in collaborative law and is a member of the Collaborative Family Law Group of Central Florida. Andrew is frequently retained by his peers to serve as an expert witness regarding attorney's fees matters.

Andrew is a seasoned appellate attorney and has authored numerous criminal and family law related appellate briefs; he has presented oral argument before state and appellate judicial panels including the 11th Circuit Court of Appeal in Atlanta, Georgia, the 6th Circuit Court of Appeal in Cincinnati, Ohio and the Fifth District Court of Appeal in Daytona Beach, Florida. Andrew is licensed to practice law before the United States Supreme Court and has represented individuals who have sought appellate review before our nation's highest court.

Andrew's legal ability and high ethical standards have been acknowledged as he received and maintained the coveted Martindale-Hubbell "AV" peer review rating, the highest rating bestowed upon an attorney by fellow lawyers and judges.

attorneys.bio:
Jaafar Choufani practices in the area of trademarks, copyrights and licensing and handles various intellectual property transactional matters. He also specializes in business law matters pertaining to corporate formation, acquisition, and governance. Previously, Mr. Choufani worked at a large Florida law firm where he represented entrepreneurs as well as public and private businesses in the areas of corporate, international business, and intellectual property law. In addition to his law practice, Mr. Choufani provides career management services to professional athletes and entertainers and has assisted his clients in the negotiation of multi-million dollar endorsement contracts as well as player contracts with major professional sports leagues worldwide.

Mr. Choufani attended Suffolk University Law School in Boston, Massachusetts where he received his Juris Doctorate and served as the President of the Student Bar Association. He has also studied intellectual property and corporate law at Lunds Universities in Lund, Sweden and clerked for a major European law firm in Stockholm, Sweden. Mr. Choufani is fluent in French.

attorneys.name: Adam Chrzan
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Vero Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Adam Chrzan practices primarily criminal defense, personal injury and family law from his office in downtown Vero Beach, Florida. Mr. Chrzan began his legal career at the State Attorney’s Office in Indian River County after graduating from Nova Southeastern University’s Shepard Broad Law Center in 2003. He spent six years as a prosecutor along the Treasure Coast, taking more than 100 cases to jury trial and conducting hundreds of probation-violation hearings and non-jury trials. This experience helped him learn how prosecutors and police think, how they put together a criminal case and how to attack the evidence and protect a client’s rights. It means a marked advantage for his criminal defense clients when he goes up against assistant state attorneys on Florida’s East Coast.

In private practice, Mr. Chrzan has represented hundreds of clients on a wide range of criminal matters, from first-degree violent felonies to drug possession and trafficking offenses to misdemeanors such as DUI, battery and shoplifting. An aggressive approach to protecting each client’s constitutional rights and an almost around-the-clock availability to his clients are the hallmark of Mr. Chrzan’s practice.

Prior to his legal career, Mr. Chrzan spent more than a decade as a staff writer at the Press-Journal in Vero Beach, as well as other newspapers in St. Lucie and Palm Beach counties. A New York native, Mr. Chrzan has lived in Florida since 1970, graduating from the University of Central Florida in 1986 with a bachelor of arts in Journalism.

Mr. Chrzan is a member of the Florida Bar and the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. He is president of the Indian River County Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and a member of the Indian River County Bar Association. Additionally, Mr. Chrzan is admitted to practice in the United States District in the Southern District of Florida.

Whether you have been arrested and charged with a crime, are contemplating a divorce or have been injured through no fault of your own, Mr. Chrzan stands ready to represent you. Consultations for criminal matters and personal injury cases are free. Consultations for family law cases carry a nominal fee. Call the office to make an appointment to meet with Mr. Chrzan.

attorneys.name: Mitch Chubb
attorneys.practice_type: Motor Vehicle Accidents Lawyers in Lake Mary, FL
attorneys.bio:
The founder of Chubb Law, Mitch Chubb has over a decade of experience in personal injury law. The son of a pastor and teacher, he was raised in a family whose focus was serving others and helping those in need. This upbringing served as the foundation for his future as a lawyer representing injured people who need to make their voices heard by large corporations and insurance companies. A native of central Florida, he seeks to provide his unwavering support to its residents in matters of:

Car accidents

Truck accidents

Wrongful death

Pedestrian accidents

Product liability

Medical malpractice

His passion for personal injury was sparked early in his legal journey, when he helped the people and small businesses affected by the BP Oil Spill, recovering about $50 million for his clients. Following that, he has had numerous multi-million dollar wins for his clients in all types of personal injury cases including, truck accidents, pedestrian accidents, and motor vehicle accidents.

Considering his clients as his own, Mr. Chubb takes it upon himself to convey their story and truth in full impact to the other side so as to increase their chances of getting full compensation. Recognized for his professional merits, he is a certified member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and is included on the list of Top 40 Under 40 Civil Plaintiff Trial Lawyers in Florida by The National Trial Lawyers. Apart from being rated “Excellent” on Avvo, he also has professional affiliations with The Central Florida Trial Lawyers Association and the Florida Justice Association.

attorneys.name: Clara Crabtree Ciadella
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning and Administration Lawyers in North Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
"After spending years representing hospitals against insurance companies, I realized I was missing the human element of this profession. Working in this practice area allows me to get to know my clients and their families on a personal level and help them to protect or recover the assets they've often worked so hard to build. As an attorney, it's easy to get caught up in the minutia of the law but ultimately, we are here to help our clients address some of their greatest, and often most emotional, challenges. I'm proud to say Kitroser & Associates does that every day."

Clara Crabtree Ciadella is an Associate Attorney at Kitroser, Lewis & Mighdoll, having joined the firm in April 2022.

Ms. Ciadella is a fourth generation Palm Beach County resident who began her legal career with a company that specialized in helping hospitals recover denied claims from insurers. After quickly rising the ranks, Ms. Ciadella was promoted as the company's first compliance officer, a testament to her ability to learn the intricacies of the law and management's confidence in her to implement and oversee a compliance department for a multi-million-dollar company.

After three years in that role, Ms. Ciadella realized she wanted to work with people, not big businesses. This led her to her various positions with several prominent Palm Beach County law firms specializing in estate planning, probate, trust and guardianship administration and litigation.

Ms. Ciadella comes to Kitroser Law with an abundance of experience and comprehensive knowledge of the practice area that enables her to advise clients with respect to a wide range of issues.

attorneys.name: Scott Cichon
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Daytona Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Cichon is a Florida Supreme Court Certified Mediator and a Certified Mediator for the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida. He is also Board Certified in Business Litigation and a former Certified Public Accountant. In 1989, Mr. Cichon was also admitted into the Supreme Court of the United States.

A native of Daytona Beach, Mr. Cichon graduated as valedictorian from Seabreeze High School in 1977 prior to continuing his education at the University of Florida where he graduated with high honors with a Bachelor of Science in Accounting. Mr. Cichon graduated from the University of Florida Law School in 1984 with high honors. While in law school, he served as an editor of the University of Florida Law Review. Mr. Cichon practiced law for four years in Palm Beach County, Florida, before joining Cobb Cole in 1988. He has been a partner in the firm since 1992.

Actively involved in various professional associations and organizations, Mr. Cichon is a member of the Florida Bar Association, a Volusia Civil Trial Lawyers Association Past President, Volusia Home Builders Association Past President, Volusia County Mediation Services Board of Directors Past President, Past President of the Bethune-Cookman University Board of Counselors, and past Board Member of the Heart of Volusia, Inc.

Mr. Cichon practices commercial litigation concentrating on actions involving real property, foreclosures, secured transactions, debtor/creditor law, landlord-tenant disputes, mediation, sales, eminent domain, construction law, broker/customer relations and all manner of contracts. When away from the office, Mr. Cichon can be found at the local gym or cycling long distances in the Daytona Beach area.
