attorneys.name: Brian P. Deeb Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in St Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brian P. Deeb is a St. Petersburg, Florida native whose practice focuses primarily in the area of commercial litigation with particular emphasis on matters relating to the construction industry. Mr. Deeb was the first attorney in Pinellas County, Florida to become Board Certified in Construction Law under the Florida Bar's Board Certification Program. Additionally, his practice includes employment law, real estate and contract litigation, corporate matters, aviation law and matters related to the entertainment industry.

He has served on the Board of Directors for the Contractors and Builders Association of Pinellas County, Inc., and as a Presidential Advisor. He also served as a Florida Supreme Court certified mediator, and on the panel of arbitrators for construction disputes through the American Arbitration Association. He has written a variety of articles and chaired several seminars for the legal and construction communities on various aspects of construction liens and other construction issues.

Mr. Deeb, who has served as an Adjunct Professor at Stetson University College of Law, has been a member of the Florida Bar since 1985 and the North Carolina State Bar since 1998. He received his B.S. from the University of Tampa and his J.D. from Stetson University College of Law. He is admitted to practice before all state courts in Florida and North Carolina as well as the U.S. District Court for the Middle and Northern Districts of Florida and the U.S. District Court in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina.

Mr. Deeb is AV Rated by Martindale-Hubbell* - the highest possible rating. For the last several years, he has been listed in several State and National Registers for Construction Law including "The Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers" published by Martindale-Hubbell, "Florida Super Lawyers" and "The Best Lawyers in America.

attorneys.name: Susan Delbosq
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Pensacola, FL
attorneys.bio:
Susan Delbosq is an Attorney for Watson Firm. She has handled hundreds of criminal cases, foreclosure defense cases and bankruptcies. She believes everyone deserves equal justice in the law, that is why she focuses on what is in the best interest of her clients, treating every client with trust, respect, and dignity.

Susan grew up in South Florida, it was a very difficult upbringing, not a very close family. Susan decided to join the Air Force at 17 yrs of age. During her time in the Air Force, she was trained in munitions, and was quickly promoted to the rank of Tech Sergeant, she was honorable discharged and went on to make a living in civilian life.

Upon returning to South Florida, Susan went to work in the hospitality business working at a restaurant as a server, moving up to become a trainer and then was asked if she would like to become a bartender, which she did. Working in the hospitality business taught Susan to appreciate the differences of people and becoming a great listener. Never to judge a book by its cover, treating everyone she meets with respect and honesty.

Susan met her husband and moved to Northern California, got married and had her first child, a delightful baby girl. After a few years, the family moved to Southern California and Susan had her second beautiful daughter. Unfortunately, the marriage did not work out, so Susan moved to Denver, Colorado.

Susan attended Columbia College to prove to herself that she could do it … get a degree while being a single mother!! Susan went to school at night while she worked full time during the day, while taking care of 2 small children. During her time in Colorado, Susan and her daughters were in a terrible auto accident. They were pushed off the road by a drunk driver at 10:00 in the morning, and the car rolled three times. She said, “The best sound I have ever heard in my entire life, was my daughters crying when the car stopped rolling”. By the grace of God her two daughters were not injured, but she sustained lifelong injuries. While undergoing many doctor’s and physical therapy appointments, Susan completed her Bachelor of Arts Degree in Criminal Justice and graduated Cum Laude with a 3.62 GPA.

After completing her undergraduate degree, Susan wanted to take on a more difficult challenge and moved to Lansing, Michigan to attend Law School. She started Thomas M. Cooley Law School in the Fall of 1998 and acquired a concentration in Litigation. Susan was the President of the St. Thomas More Society and participated in Moot Court. Susan worked part time at the State Prosecutor’s office, volunteered at her daughter’s school and, attended many doctors and physical therapy appointments while attending law school.

After graduation, Susan wanted to move back to Sunny Florida, she visited Pensacola in 2003 and fell in love with it. After studying for and taking the Florida Bar Exam she had a difficult decision to make, whether to leave her oldest daughter in Michigan to finish College at Michigan State University and move to Florida or stay in Michigan. She decided to move to Florida. Susan feels that she made the right decision as now her oldest daughter is an Emergency Room doctor, and her younger daughter is an attorney.

Susan was an assistant State Attorney in Okaloosa and Escambia Counties. During her time in the Prosecutor’s office Susan was thrown into court in her first week and she oversaw hundreds of cases including misdemeanors and felonies, attended court daily, arguing motions and trying cases. Susan was a past President of the Okaloosa/Walton Bar Association in 2009. After 3 years at the State Attorney’s office, Susan opened her own law firm focusing primarily on criminal defense, bankruptcy, consumer law, and foreclosure defense.

With a combination of life experiences, education, training, and the multiple hours spent in the courtroom, Susan is distinctively qualified to represent your interests when you need it most. Susan doesn’t look at the law as just another job, she believes that the law is revolving, and that justice is the backbone of the law. She will respect advocate, communicate, and give it her all when working for you.

Cooley Law School in the Fall of 1998 and acquired a concentration in Litigation. Susan was the President of the St. Thomas More Society and participated in Moot Court. Susan worked part time at the State Prosecutor’s office, volunteered at her daughter’s school and, attended many doctors and physical therapy appointments while attending law school.

After graduation, Susan wanted to move back to Sunny Florida, she visited Pensacola in 2003 and fell in love with it. After studying for and taking the Florida Bar Exam she had a difficult decision to make, whether to leave her oldest daughter in Michigan to finish College at Michigan State University and move to Florida or stay in Michigan. She decided to move to Florida. Susan feels that she made the right decision as now her oldest daughter is an Emergency Room doctor, and her younger daughter is an attorney.

Susan was an assistant State Attorney in Okaloosa and Escambia Counties. During her time in the Prosecutor’s office Susan was thrown into court in her first week and she oversaw hundreds of cases including misdemeanors and felonies, attended court daily, arguing motions and trying cases. Susan was a past President of the Okaloosa/Walton Bar Association in 2009. After 3 years at the State Attorney’s office, Susan opened her own law firm focusing primarily on criminal defense, bankruptcy, consumer law, and foreclosure defense.

With a combination of life experiences, education, training, and the multiple hours spent in the courtroom, Susan is distinctively qualified to represent your interests when you need it most. Susan doesn’t look at the law as just another job, she believes that the law is revolving, and that justice is the backbone of the law. She will respect advocate, communicate, and give it her all when working for you.

attorneys.name: Steven Neil J. DeLaroche
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Law Lawyers in Daytona Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Steven deLaroche, as a former County Judge, has unparallel experience in the legal profession. He has previously worked as an Assistant States’ Attorney in the Career Criminal Division, and has represented an extensive list of private practice clients in family, business, and criminal law. An attorney can be your guide in challenging times. It is best to select one who will understand all aspects of your problem, and can chart a path to your best possible resolution.

I am the only practicing attorney in Volusia County with judicial experience. My specialized knowledge of the law and procedure gives me a distinct advantage in resolving your case. I have a dedicated firm that offers personal attention to my clients. I am available to answer your questions whenever needed. I believe communication between you and me is the key to a successful result. No two cases are alike. You and your concerns will be treated with respect and professionalism.

EMPLOYMENT

County Judge, Volusia County Florida Elected by the people of Volusia for two terms- November 2000-February, 2007

Chief Administrative County Judge Elected by the body of County Judges- October 2004 - October 2006

I was charged with the responsibility of managing the administration of justice in the County Court system for Volusia County, Florida. My duties included supervision of eight other County Court judges, in addition to my own docket. During my tenure, I completely revamped our case distribution system to account for shifts in population and issue complexity. I was the youngest Chief Administrative County Judge in Florida history.

Criminal Court -assigned 2001 - 2002 & 2004 - 2006

I presided over the largest criminal docket in Volusia County. I closed more criminal cases in each year than any other court in the four county Circuit. I was responsible for every aspect of each case from arraignment to trial and sentencing.

Civil Court -assigned 2003 -2004 & 2007

I presided over a wide array of different types of civil trial cases. Some of my expertise includes subjects such as: contracts and interpretation, land use, landlord/tenant issues, zoning, condominium associations, foreclosure, auto insurance, medical insurance, and debt collection. I was also responsible for all repeat violence injunction

cases for the east side of Volusia County.

Additional Supervisory Responsibilities:

Chairman of the Volusia County Elections Canvassing Board. I was charged with the responsibility of supervising the Presidential primary and the main election of 2004. My job was to oversee all employees and streamline and monitor the innovative procedures and hardware used to conduct the election. Voter turnout was the largest on

record and was a highly charged situation following the issues in the 2000 Presidential election. In this day of election turmoil, neither political party could find any fault or flaw in the conduct of either of the two rounds of election.

Chairman of Probation Selection Committee

I was charged with the review and selection of the vendor for probation services in Volusia County every two years. I negotiated several multimillion dollar contracts between service providers and the county government.

Instructor- Deland Citizen's Police Academy I instruct members of the Citizens on Patrol program in the law, as well as in courtroom presentation and procedures.

Law Office of Steven N.J. deLaroche August, 1995- November, 2000

My practice concentrated on the areas of business, criminal, and family law. I represented small businesses in the construction and personal service industries in contract and commercial actions. I also represented people accused of committing criminal offenses before the Circuit, County, Juvenile Courts of the Seventh Judicial Circuit.

Law Office of David R. Damore August, 1994 - August, 1995

My practice concentrated in the area of criminal law. Offenses ranged from capital crimes to traffic infractions.

Office of The State's Attorney, 7th Judicial Circuit July, 1990 - August, 1994

I prosecuted cases at all levels: misdemeanor, felony, and capital crimes. I specialized in the prosecution of child sex crimes from June, 1991 to December, 1993.

I was one of only two attorneys circuit-wide selected by the State's Attorney to run the Career Criminal Division from December, 1993 to August, 1994. We were charged with the duty to seek the toughest possible sanctions and penalties for criminals deemed to be of the greatest danger to the community in the four counties of the 7th Judicial Circuit.

PERSONAL

Married to Dr. Sondra Avant, D.D.S., M.A. Endodontist Two children, Marina age 9, Grant age 7 Avid Competitive cyclist. Current holder of two state bicycle racing records.

attorneys.name: Thomas DeLattre
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Tom DeLattre was born in Yorktown, New York, and raised in Syracuse, New York. He joined the firm in 1994 and is currently a partner at Wieland & DeLattre, P.A. His practice is primarily dedicated to advocating for clients who have suffered injuries in trucking, motor vehicle, and motorcycle accidents. Additionally, he has extensive experience handling cases involving negligent road construction design, premises liability, defective products, and workplace injuries.

Mr. DeLattre is a distinguished member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, an exclusive group of trial lawyers who have secured settlements or verdicts of $1 million or more. He also holds an AV Preeminent® rating from Martindale-Hubbell, the highest peer-review rating awarded by this globally recognized attorney rating service.

He is admitted to practice law in Florida and the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida. He is also an active member of the Florida Bar Association, the Orange County Bar Association, the Florida Justice Association (formerly the Academy of Florida Trial Lawyers), and the American Association of Justice (formerly the Association of Trial Lawyers of America).

Tom earned his law degree from Barry University School of Law in 2001. He completed his Bachelor of Science at Oneonta State University, where he also played NCAA Division III basketball.

attorneys.name: Jason Delgado
attorneys.practice_type: Nursing Home Abuse Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jason is a Florida native who has modeled his legal career on the fundamental principles of holding others responsible and accountable for their actions. He has been practicing law since 2002. His career began as a Personal Injury Attorney in South Florida representing the injured. In 2005, he became an Assistant State Attorney in Tampa where he gained extensive trial experience prosecuting thousands of cases.

In 2008, Jason left the criminal arena and dedicated his practice to protecting individuals neglected in nursing homes and assisted living facilities. He has successfully litigated cases from the Florida Panhandle to Miami; recovering hundreds of millions for those that have been wronged by facilities entrusted with the protection of their loved ones. The importance Jason places on family is the driving force behind his commitment to his clients. He is known and respected throughout the legal community as a trial attorney that passionately advocates for those without a voice.

Jason’s Tampa roots run strong and deep and have shaped him into the family man he is today. He is married to Patrizia and together they have been blessed with two special children. As an active participant with Southeastern Guide Dogs, their Labrador, Lightning, is an integral part of the family. A blend of Latin and Italian families, the Delgado household believes in Food, Family and Love.

attorneys.name: Michelle Nichols DeLong
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Jupiter, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michelle Nichols DeLong is the Owner and Managing Partner of Michelle N. DeLong, PLLC, doing business as MD Law Florida, a law firm dedicated to representing plaintiffs in medical malpractice and nursing home negligence cases. Michelle has a proven track record of successfully litigating complex cases to resolution, advocating for victims of catastrophic injuries and families facing the wrongful death of a loved one. Her clients often describe her as both a compassionate lawyer and a fierce advocate.

In 2024, Michelle founded her own firm to focus exclusively on plaintiffs’ healthcare law, driven by her commitment to deliver high-quality, client-focused legal services rooted in excellence and empathy. She understands her clients are often enduring the most difficult moments of their lives, and she strives to guide them with care and clarity every step of the way.

Before launching her firm, Michelle built and led the medical malpractice and nursing home negligence division of a startup law firm, developing the practice area from the ground up. She also honed her skills at a boutique firm in South Florida, handling complex medical malpractice and nursing home cases, and has additional experience litigating complex commercial disputes in Florida state courts and federal courts nationwide. Michelle is licensed to practice law in Florida and admitted to the U.S. District Courts for the Southern, Middle, and Northern Districts of Florida.

Michelle earned her J.D. magna cum laude from Nova Southeastern University, where she received multiple merit-based scholarships, served as a junior and senior editor for the Nova Law Review, and won first place in the ABA Mendes Hershman Student Writing Contest, a prestigious national competition. She holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a major in Marketing from the University of Florida, graduating cum laude and was a member of Chi Omega Sorority.

Before practicing law, Michelle gained valuable business experience working in sales, marketing, and management for several prominent retail and wholesale companies—a background that continues to inform her practical approach to managing her firm and communicating effectively with clients, opposing counsel, and the broader legal community.

Michelle is an active member in the Florida Justice Association (FJA), having served on its Board of Directors (2019–2024) and as a past Chair of the FJA Women’s Caucus (2019–2020). She remains deeply involved in the Women’s Caucus, helping to plan its annual Leadership Retreat. Michelle is passionate about advocating for meaningful reforms that advance gender equity within the legal profession and lobbying to protect the constitutional rights of Florida’s citizens.

attorneys.name: Jacob Delorme
attorneys.practice_type: Condominium Law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jacob Delorme is an attorney in the Tampa office of Stockham Law Group, P.A. Mr. Delorme focuses his practice on providing general counsel and litigation services for community associations throughout Florida. He represents homeowners’ associations, condominium associations, and other community associations in a wide range of matters, including contract disputes, enforcement actions, collections, and litigation.

Mr. Delorme brings a distinct advantage through his extensive experience as a defense attorney and former prosecutor. Before joining Stockham Law Group, he practiced at Wood, Smith, Henning and Berman LLP and Cole, Scott & Kissane, where he represented corporate clients, property owners, and insurers in cases involving premises liability, trucking and transportation, and general liability claims. Earlier in his career, he served as an Assistant State Attorney for Florida’s 13th Judicial Circuit, where he managed hundreds of cases, negotiated resolutions, and litigated over 20 jury and non-jury trials. This diverse background provides him with valuable courtroom experience and strategic insight that benefits the firm’s association clients.

Mr. Delorme received his Juris Doctor from Stetson University College of Law in 2021. While at Stetson, he served as President of the Real Property, Probate, and Trust Law Society and Parliamentarian of the Black Law School Student Association. He also worked as a Research Assistant in real property law and was awarded the Dean Richard Dillion Excellence in Real Property Award. He earned his Bachelor of Arts in Legal Studies, with a minor in Business Administration, from the University of Central Florida.

Mr. Delorme is also committed to community engagement. He currently serves as Treasurer of the Fred G. Minnis Bar Association and previously volunteered as a Guardian ad Litem, advocating for children in dependency proceedings. He is licensed to practice law in the state courts of Florida.

attorneys.name: Bryan E. DeMaggio
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in Jacksonville, Florida, Bryan E. DeMaggio joined Sheppard, White & Kachergus, P.A. in 2008, after a prior clerkship with the firm. Mr. DeMaggio practices in the fields of criminal defense, appellate, and civil rights litigation. Mr. DeMaggio is admitted to the Florida Bar and a member of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit and the United States District Courts for the Middle, Northern and Southern Districts of Florida, and the District of Columbia.

After graduating in the top ten of his class at Paxon School for Advanced Studies, Mr. DeMaggio attended Florida State University where he received his undergraduate degree in both History and Political Science, summa cum laude. In addition, his academic achievements resulted in his induction into the Phi Beta Kappa and Phi Kappa Phi honor societies.

He then received his law degree from the University of Florida Levin College of Law. While attending law school, he served as a Certified Legal Intern at the Office of the Public Defender for the Eighth Judicial Circuit of Florida, where he represented indigents accused of various crimes. Additionally, Mr. DeMaggio worked as a legal assistant at Three Rivers Legal Services, a non-profit legal service center, where he assisted the homeless in addressing their legal issues. He also served in an externship with the Circuit Court Judge Peter K. Sieg, where he evaluated post-conviction claims. Mr. DeMaggio was also a student pupil in the Chester Bedell Inn of Court. As a result of his hard work and commitment to his clients, Mr. DeMaggio was made a partner after five years of practice with the firm. His zealous advocacy and legal skills have resulted in him being recognized as a Super Lawyer (Criminal Defense) and a listing in the Best Lawyers in America in the fields of Appellate Practice and Civil Rights Law and Criminal Defense (both General Practice and White Collar). Best Lawyers also named him 2023 Lawyer of the Year in Civil Rights Law in Jacksonville.

attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Dennis was born and raised in Rochester, Michigan. While growing up in Michigan, Mr. Dennis was a competitive tennis player, ranked nationally throughout his junior career. He continued competing in tennis by accepting an athletic scholarship to Western Michigan University. While at Western Michigan University, Mr. Dennis was an Intercollegiate Tennis Association Academic All-American. He completed his degree with a Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance.

Thereafter, he continued his education by attending the University of Florida College of Law. While at the University of Florida, Mr. Dennis earned honors in Appellate Advocacy and Trial Practice. In addition, Mr. Dennis externed for the 20th Judicial Circuit State Attorney's office, where he represented the State of Florida in criminal infractions. In 2008, Mr. Dennis completed his law degree and gained admission into the Florida Bar.

After law school, Mr. Dennis began his career as a defense attorney in Miami, Florida, defending insurance companies against personal injury and wrongful death claims. Armed with the knowledge of how insurance companies deny claims and benefits to individuals, Mr. Dennis began working for a Miami plaintiff's personal injury firm dedicated to representing injured individuals and consumers. Mr. Dennis now works as an associate at Wooten, Kimbrough, Damaso, & Dennis, P.A., where he continues to represent injured individuals in personal injury, wrongful death, medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, insurance disputes and wrongful discharge matters.

Mr. Dennis is licensed to practice in all state courts in Florida and the U.S. District Court, Southern District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Jason R. Derry
attorneys.practice_type: Debt Collection Harassment Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jason Derry was born in Iowa where he lived briefly before moving to Florida, spending time on both coasts before settling in the Tampa Bay Area. He earned his Bachelor of Science Degree in Finance at the University of Florida after transferring from Wake Forest University where he spent his first two years of college. After deciding that he wanted to be a lawyer, he returned to the Tampa Bay Area, where he earned his Juris Doctor at Stetson University College of Law.

Following law school, Mr. Derry served as a prosecutor for the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit in Tampa for ten years. During his tenure with the State Attorneys Office, Mr. Derry served as a Lead Trial Attorney in the Economic Crimes division, specializing in complex fraud cases. He also served as a Deputy Chief supervising attorneys in the felony division. As a prosecutor, Mr. Derry tried over 100 jury and non-jury trials ranging from misdemeanors and DUIs to trafficking in narcotics and first degree murder. He was also a part of the team of prosecutors who tried the longest jury trial in Hillsborough County history, lasting four months, involving multiple defendants and complex racketeering charges.

Ultimately, Mr. Derry knew that he wanted to continue serving the public and helping people but in a different way, which is what led him to Morgan & Morgan, where he works in the Consumer Protection Department.

attorneys.name: Brian S. Dervishi
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brian S. Dervishi graduated with high distinction from the University of Michigan in 1978, where he also received his law degree. He was admitted to The Florida Bar in 1982, practiced with Jeff Weissman at a prominent South Florida law firm for the next six years, and joined Mr. Weissman’s firm in 1990. He has participated in many jury and non-jury trials, evidentiary hearings, and appeals in state and federal courts. He became a member of the Trial Bar of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida in 1983. In addition to practicing in all of Florida’s state courts, Mr. Dervishi is admitted to practice in the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, and the U.S. District Courts and U.S. Bankruptcy Courts of the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida. He is the managing partner of the firm’s Miami office.

Mr. Dervishi is a member of the Development and Alumni Relations Committee of the University of Michigan Law School and the Business Inflation Panel of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta. He formerly served as the Chair of MCCJ, Miami’s oldest non-profit organization and host of the longest, continuous interfaith clergy dialogue in the country.

attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Personal Injury Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Austin R. Diaz focuses his practice in the areas of catastrophic personal injury, vehicular negligence, trucking, maritime, premises liability, products liability, construction defect, negligent security, and medical malpractice litigation at the state and federal level.

Austin previously worked for one of Florida’s most prominent defense firms representing both insureds and carriers. While the experience was rewarding, he quickly realized that his calling was to help people hold corporations and individuals accountable through the court system.

He spent several years litigating plaintiff personal injury cases at a boutique law firm in West Palm Beach before joining the team at Lesser, Landy, Smith and Siegel.

Austin is admitted to practice law in all Florida Courts including the Florida Supreme Court and the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida.

Austin is a member of the Florida Justice Association, FSU Law Alumni Association, ABA Legal Opportunity Scholars, and the Palm Beach County Bar Association, where he serves on the Judicial Relations Committee and Law Related Education Committee. He is a board member of the Craig S. Barnard Inn of Court and serves as a pupilage group leader. on

Born and raised in Miami, Austin graduated from the Florida State University College of Law where he was repeatedly recognized for his academic achievement and stellar advocacy as part of their nationally top ranked Trial Team. He also spent time studying comparative law at Oxford University in England.

Austin and his wife, Cristine Hamilton-Diaz, proudly call Palm Beach County their home.

Call Austin today at 888-557-5718 or email adiaz@lesserlawfirm.com.

attorneys.name: Pat T. DiCesare II
attorneys.practice_type: Worker’s Compensation Lawyers in Lakeland, FL
attorneys.bio:
PAT T. DICESARE, II, born Lakeland, Florida, September 22, 1960; admitted to bar, 1986, Florida; 1989, U.S. District Court Middle District of Florida. Board Certified in Workers' Compensation (2000 to present). Education: Florida Southern College (B.S., cum laude, 1982); Stetson University (J.D., cum laude, 1986). Phi Theta Kappa; Pi Gamma Mu; Dana Scholar, Stetson University. Assistant Public Defender, 1986-1990. Awarded AV® Preeminent Peer Review Rating by LexisNexis Martindale-Hubbell.

I am Board Certified by The Florida Bar in the field of Worker's Compensation since 2000. The Florida Bar has recognized me as a Worker's Compensation Specialist. I have been selected as a Super Lawyer in the field of Worker's Compensation by Thomson Reuters since 2011. I have the designation of AV Preeminent by Martindale-Hubbell/Lexis Nexis. This is the highest possible ranking in the rigorous peer review process by Martindale-Hubbell. At least 10 years of experience is required. AV rating is recognized for having the highest levels of integrity and skill.

After graduating from law school in the top 10 of my class, I began working for the Public Defender's office in the Florida 10th Judicial Circuit. I represented criminal defendants for over 3 years handling various cases from misdemeanor up to capital felonies. I tried over 30 jury trials over the 3 years I practiced there.

In 1990, I began practicing in the field of Worker's Compensation and Personal Injury. Subsequently, I began practicing in the field of Social Security Disability. The Supreme Court of Florida has certified me as a Circuit Mediator since 2015.

Over the last 30+ years, I have represented thousands of injured workers and other litigants in disputed claims.

I am a member of Florida Workers Advocates, an organization that works tirelessly to improve the laws affecting injured workers. I am a long-term member of American Association for Justice. Additionally, I am a sustaining member of NOSSCR, National Organization of Social Security Claimant's Representatives. I am a member of the Polk County Trial Lawyers and the Lakeland Bar Association.

I was born and educated in Lakeland, Florida. I have been married since 1989 and have 3 wonderful children. I recently became a proud grandfather.

I enjoy my work. When not working, I travel and love the outdoors.

attorneys.practice_type: Discrimination & Harassment Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Thomas L. Dickens, III, joined the national law firm of Morgan & Morgan, P.A., after practicing employment law with one of the top employment law firms in Florida.

He is a specialist in the field of employment law with both jury trial and bench trial experience. Mr. Dickens is also part of a unique group of civil trial attorneys who have practiced as both a civilian attorney and a military attorney. Because of this experience, he has concentrated his practice to specifically include prosecuting cases arising under the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act (USERRA).

Mr. Dickens has litigated claims throughout the state, under federal and state law, including sexual harassment, race, age, disability, gender as well as whistleblower claims. Additionally, Mr. Dickens defends veterans who have been discriminated against in their workplace, based on their military status.

Mr. Dickens is a combat veteran, having deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. He has served in the Army as a platoon leader, detachment commander and a Judge Advocate. Mr. Dickens has been on multiple deployments as a Rule of Law advisor to both the Iraqi and Afghan governments.

Mr. Dickens received his Bachelor of Arts degree from Hampden-Sydney College and his Juris Doctor degree from Florida State University. Mr. Dickens is admitted to practice in Florida state courts, and the U.S. District Courts for the Northern and Middle districts of Florida.

attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
David Dickey was admitted to The Florida Bar and the U. S. District Court, Middle District of Florida in 1992. David received his Bachelor of Arts Degree in political science from the University of Florida in 1981 and his Juris Doctor Degree, with honors, from the University of Florida in 1992. Law school recognitions included Legal Research and Writing - Best Paper Award; the American Jurisprudence Book Award in Natural Resources; the American Jurisprudence Book Award in Conflicts of Law; and being on the Dean's List - five out of six semesters.

David is a veteran U.S. Naval Officer having served on active duty from 1981 to 1989 with Fighter Squadron Two (VF-2) as an F-14 RIO, graduated from the Naval Fighter Weapons School (TOPGUN) in 1986, and was assigned to a special projects position with the Navy Operational Intelligence Center. He received the Navy Achievement Medal for professional achievement in 1984 and the Navy Commendation Medal for meritorious service from 1987 to 1989. Following active duty, David continued in the active Naval Reserves with assignment to a Defense Intelligence Agency support unit with U.S. Central Command, MacDill AFB, Florida until 1994. He remained in inactive reserves until being honorable discharged in 2001.

David practices primarily in the areas of commercial litigation, personal injury, and professional negligence. He is a member of the Hillsborough Count Bar Association, Trial Lawyers Section, American Bar Association, and Academy of Florida Trial Lawyers.

attorneys.name: Andrew W.J. Dickman
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Dickman, a native of Tampa, Florida, has cultivated a diverse and impactful career in law and urban planning. His academic journey began at Santa Fe Community College and led him to the University of Florida, where he earned his bachelor's degree and his master's degree in urban and regional planning.

Andrew’s professional path is notable for his work in growth management at the North Central Florida Regional Planning Council and his expertise in geographic information systems at the St. Johns River Water Management District. He continued in his commitment to public service as he planned for children and families and anti-poverty programs in Miami as a state employee.

While serving the Department of Children and Families (DCF), Andrew pursued his legal education at Nova Southeastern Shepard Broad Law Center's evening division. He was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2000, marking the beginning of his legal practice.

In 2002, Mr. Dickman founded the Dickman Law Firm as a solo practitioner in Miami, Florida. His firm has since expanded and relocated its main office to Naples, Florida, reflecting its decades of growth and success. In 2025, Andrew was recognized by Florida Trend as a Legal Elite Notable Managing Partner, a distinction that highlights his leadership and contributions to the legal profession.

Today, Mr. Dickman’s legal acumen is reflected in his roles as Assistant City Attorney for the City of Naples and Hearing Examiner for Collier County. He previously served as the City Attorney for the City of Tarpon Springs and for the City of St. Pete Beach.

Andrew Dickman's career is a testament to his versatility and dedication to both the legal profession and the communities he serves. His expertise and leadership continue to make a significant impact for clients across Florida.

attorneys.name: Odelsa “Ody” Dickman
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mrs. Dickman is a Cuban American lawyer, born in Puerto Rico and raised in South Florida. She has a diverse cultural background and a local upbringing that gives her a distinctive outlook on her legal practice. As an experienced civil litigator, Ody handles both plaintiff and defense cases with excellence. Her outstanding negotiation skills and steadfast commitment to justice are evident in her successful case settlements.

Mrs. Dickman’s professional credentials reflect her devotion to her field. She is certified as a circuit court mediator and a qualified arbitrator. She obtained her Associate of Arts degree from Miami-Dade College, her Bachelor of Arts from Florida International University, and her Juris Doctorate from Nova Southeastern Shepard Broad Law Center. She was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2000, after building a strong foundation of academic achievement and practical experience.

While pursuing her law degree at night, Ody spent her days working for the Florida Department of Children and Families in Miami. She advocated for underprivileged individuals, especially children and the developmentally disabled, showing her deep empathy and dedication to social justice.

In 2005, Ody moved to Naples, where she brought her expertise and compassionate advocacy to the community. She joined the board of the Hunger & Homeless Coalition of Collier County, where she continued her work to help impoverished individuals. Today, Ody serves as the Firm’s administrator, leading client development efforts with the same enthusiasm and professionalism she applies to her legal practice.

attorneys.name: Wesley C. Dicus Sr. Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Property Insurance Claims Lawyers in Saint Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Wesley C. Dicus, Sr. was born and raised in Saint Petersburg, Florida. He attended Florida State University earning a Bachelor of Science in Social Sciences with a minor in American History. After graduating Florida State University, Mr. Dicus attended and is a graduate of Stetson University College of Law in Gulfport, Florida.

While in law school Mr. Dicus received Book Awards including the Book Award in International Sales Law and Arbitration. Other awards include the Victor O. Wehle Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy, as well as earning first place in Stetson University College of Law’s first ever Advanced Trial Competition.

Mr. Dicus began his career at the State Attorney’s Office for Pinellas and Pasco County under State Attorney Bernie McCabe. As an assistant State Attorney, Mr. Dicus prosecuted all matter of criminal cases from misdemeanor traffic offenses to first degree murder. As a misdemeanor prosecutor Mr. Dicus was promoted to Anti-Gang Prosecutor and Lead Trial Attorney. As a felony prosecutor, Mr. Dicus was promoted to handle sensitive and critical cases of felony domestic violence and crimes against children. Mr. Dicus also tried several high exposure cases and was featured on Investigation Discovery’s 20/20 Deadly Women, Snapped, and CNN’s Vengeance: Killer Lovers.

After leaving the State Attorney’s Office, Mr. Dicus began his civil career at a prominent St. Petersburg law firm litigating commercial and residential insurance claim disputes. In 2013, Mr. Dicus accepted a partnership at the largest woman and minority owned law firm in the country. While there, Mr. Dicus represented Florida’s largest insurance companies in all manner of insurance claims litigation covering a wide variety of daily and catastrophic claims throughout the entire state of Florida.

Today, Mr. Dicus, and Mr. Burke are co-owners of Dicus Burke & Lewis, PLLC, where their primary focus is representing individuals and business owners in claims against their insurance companies, as well as claims against at-fault, negligent parties and the criminally accused. Together they handle a variety of cases including but not limited to commercial and residential property insurance claim dispute litigation, personal injury and premises liability (slip and fall), insurance agency negligence litigation, products liability and criminal defense. Dicus Burke & Lewis, PLLC is also regularly engaged by other law firms as co-counsel in disputed insurance claim trial cases.

During his career, Mr. Dicus brought over 70 cases to jury trial, with outstanding results for his clients. Dicus Burke & Lewis, PLLC has recovered millions of dollars in settlement proceeds and jury verdicts for its clientele.

In 2020 and 2021 Thomson Reuters and Superlawyers.com awarded Mr. Dicus the prestigious title of Super Lawyer in Civil Litigation in Florida. Super Lawyers are selected using a multiphase evaluation process on twelve indicators in peer recognition and professional achievement. The lawyers who rank and the top 5% of lawyers in the state are selected as Super Lawyers.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Felipe E. Diez, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Litigation (auto, property/home, health, life) Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Diez has handled thousands of lawsuits for both plaintiffs and defendants and has accrued significant trial experience, having personally litigated dozens of trials to verdict both in the County Courts and in the Circuit Courts of the State of Florida. Mr. Diez has also litigated insurance coverage, personal injury, and civil rights lawsuits in Federal Court.

Although his primary focus has been in the area of insurance coverage litigation (auto, property/home, health, life), Mr. Diez also handles wrongful death claims, personal injury claims (auto, motorcycle, boat, cruise ship, aviation, slip & fall) and other civil litigation matters. Prior to focusing on the representation of plaintiffs in the year 2015, Mr. Diez represented a number of automobile insurers and/or their policyholders for 12 years.

Because of his significant experience representing “both sides of the fence,” many plaintiff lawyers throughout Florida routinely refer their clients to Mr. Diez when they need assistance with an insurance coverage dispute. Mr. Diez also serves as an expert witness for other lawyers in the South Florida legal community on their claims for attorney’s fees.

Mr. Diez was selected to the Super Lawyers Rising Stars in Florida for the years 2012 and 2013, to Super Lawyers for the years 2022 through 2025 and is a member of the Million Dollar and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum. Membership in the Million Dollar and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum is limited to attorneys who have won million and multi-million dollar verdicts, awards, and settlements — less than 1% of U.S. lawyers are members.

attorneys.name: John W. Dill
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
John W. Dill was born in Fort Walton Beach, Florida in 1967. He received his B.A. with honors from the University of Florida in 1990. In 1993, he graduated cum laude from Stetson University College of law where served on Law Review and led the trial team to numerous victories in state and national competitions. He also served as a Judicial Intern for Federal Judge Elizabeth A. Kovachevich. Upon graduation Mr. Dill worked with the state wide law firm Rumberger, Kirk and Caldwell where he represented the nation’s largest manufacturers and insurance companies.

Mr. Dill is a Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer with the Florida Bar. He is also a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, having obtained numerous verdicts and settlements of over one million dollars. He has tried over 100 cases to verdict, including one of the longest federal trials in history, lasting over nine months. Mr. Dill has tried cases in numerous jurisdictions throughout the nation. He has published articles on trial practice and procedure, as well as been called upon to lecture to other attorneys on trial techniques. Mr. Dill has handled many high profile cases, including complex litigation involving the world’s largest companies. He also has obtained significant jury verdicts on behalf of injured clients in particularly difficult cases, including complex medical malpractice cases and matters involving police misconduct.

In the past four years, Mr. Dill has obtained settlements and verdicts on behalf of his clients exceeding fifty million dollars- including jury verdicts of $25 Million and $6 Million in Central Florida. In the first four months of 2010, Mr. Dill has obtained verdicts for $2.5 million, $46.3 million, and $1.1 million dollars, the last two coming on the same day from two different juries. The $46.3 million dollar verdict was obtained in a lawsuit against R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co. on behalf of a woman whose husband died of lung cancer after years of smoking and was named as one of the Top Ten Verdicts of 2010 by Lawyers USA Magazine.

Mr. Dill has also been honored with the prestigious AV® Peer Review Rating by Martindale-Hubbell, the preeminent national publication in the legal field. According to Martindale-Hubbell, "An AV rating is a significant accomplishment - a testament to the fact that a lawyer's peers rank him or her at the highest level of professional excellence. A lawyer must be admitted to the bar for 10 years or more to receive an AV rating. This rating is based upon evaluations by other lawyers and is the highest ranking attainable by an attorney for ability and ethics in the practice of law. It is a distinction reserved for a select few in the legal community."

In 2009, Mr. Dill was named a diplomate in medical malpractice by the American Board of Professional Liability Attorneys (ABPLA). The ABPLA is the only organization accredited by the American Bar Association to certify attorneys in the area of medical malpractice. Medical malpractice lawyers who are ABPLA Certified must meet and exceed rigorous standards and are recognized as leaders in negligence law.

Mr. Dill has been selected for inclusion in the 2010 Florida Super Lawyers' list, an honor that is awarded to only 5% of Florida attorneys each year. A multiphase selection process is used to determine which attorneys will receive this distinction, and nominees are evaluated on the basis of peer recognition and professional excellence.

Mr. Dill has also been named to the list of 2010 Florida Legal Elite attorneys. In order to compile the list, Florida Trend magazine invited in-state members of the Florida Bar to participate in the voting process. Only 918 attorneys were selected for this honor, representing less than 2% of the nearly 63,000 Florida Bar members who practice law in Florida.

attorneys.name: Michele Diglio
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Winter Garden, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michele Diglio-Benkiran is the founder of Legal Counsel, P.A. Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran has been practicing law since 1999 with a specific emphasis on Business and Real Estate Law.

Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran grew up in an entrepreneurial family where she learned business fundamentals at a very early age. Over the years Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran owned several thriving businesses including a multi-million dollar manufacturing company, a shelving distribution company, a full-service hair salon, title companies and other types of businesses. As such, Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran is not just an attorney, she is a business entrepreneur who understands the fundamentals of successful business practices. Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran incorporates her “hands-on” business knowledge and experience when counseling her business clients. Her business law experience involves both litigation cases (non-compete violations, partnership breakups, contract disputes) and transactional matters (buying and selling business, contracts, and corporate governance matters).

Additionally, Ms. Diglio-Benkiran dedicates a significant portion of her practice to the practice of Real Estate Law. For over 2 decades, Ms. Diglio-Benkiran has represented commercial and residential clients in real estate acquisition and sales, commercial condominium developments, homeowner/condominium associations, leasing, financing, and real estate related litigation cases. Her real estate law experience involves litigation cases (foreclosures, quiet title actions, partitions, ejectments, etc.), closings, transactional matters, tax deeds, homeowner associations, commercial development, and investor representation. Ms. Diglio-Benkiran has a special interest in her investor/wholesale clients as she assists her investor/wholesale clients by “cleaning up” properties containing various encumbrances, code violations, defects, tax liens, judgments, etc. Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran

Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran is a member of Residential Real Estate & Industry Liaison Committee for the Real Property Section of the Florida Bar, Central Florida Real Estate Attorneys Council, and The Fund. She is an authorized title insurance agent of CATIC, Old Republic National Title Insurance Company, and WFG National Title Insurance Company. In addition to her memberships, Ms. Diglio-Benkiran was a guest educator and lecturer at several real estate agencies including La Rosa Realty, Keller Williams, and Coldwell Banker. During her time as a Partner at NeJame Law, P.A., Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran appeared on television as a legal commentator to discuss different real estate related topics and was interviewed by reporters from various newspapers concerning the then current real estate topics.

Among Mrs. Diglio-Benkiran most prized accomplishments is being a dedicated wife and mother, as well as being an ordained Minister.

attorneys.bio:
Scott M. Dimond was born May 3, 1968 in Falls Church, Virginia. A graduate of Ransom Everglades High School in Coconut Grove, Florida, Mr. Dimond received his B.A. with distinction from the University of Virginia, where he was a member of Phi Beta Kappa. Mr. Dimond graduated from Columbia University School of Law in 1993, where he received honors in all three years of matriculation.

From 1993 until 1999, Mr. Dimond was employed by Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP in Miami, Florida, where he was involved in all aspects of a national complex-commercial-litigation practice.

In April 1999, Mr. Dimond joined the firm of Hanzman & Criden, P.A., a well-respected litigation boutique located in Coral Gables, Florida, where he was named a partner in January 2002. At that firm, Mr. Dimond focused his practice on the areas of general commercial litigation, claimant-side securities arbitration, and plaintiff-side class-action litigation.

Mr. Dimond serves as Chair of the Southern District of Florida Local Rules Committee. He has served as Chair of the Florida Bar Rules of Judicial Administration Committee and Chair of the Sealed Docket and Court Records Subcommittee. Mr. Dimond is a past Vice-Chair of the Florida Bar Civil Procedure Rules Committee, a past Chair of the Civil Procedure Rules Drafting Sub-Committee, and past Chair of the Miami-Dade County Federal Court Committee.

attorneys.name: Theodore L. DiSalvo
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Stuart, FL
attorneys.bio:
Theodore L. DiSalvo is a distinguished civil trial attorney and founding partner of Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A., a premier Florida law firm devoted exclusively to personal injury law. With over two decades of unwavering dedication to justice, Mr. DiSalvo has become a trusted advocate for individuals affected by auto accidents, catastrophic injuries, and wrongful death.

Board Certified by the Florida Bar in Civil Trial Law, Mr. DiSalvo exemplifies elite legal competence, integrity, and courtroom excellence. His AV Preeminent rating from Martindale-Hubbell underscores peer-recognized mastery in both legal proficiency and ethical standards.

Mr. DiSalvo earned his Juris Doctorate from Suffolk University in Boston in 1988, where he was honored with induction into the prestigious Phi Delta Phi legal fraternity for academic excellence. He completed his undergraduate studies cum laude at Johnson & Wales University in Providence in 1984.

Before establishing Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A. in 1994, Mr. DiSalvo held a successful litigation career at Paxton, Crow, Bragg, Smith & Keyser, P.A., managing complex civil and insurance cases. His earlier legal experience in Massachusetts adds a valuable dimension to his broad jurisdictional knowledge.

Licensed to practice before the United States Supreme Court, multiple federal appellate and district courts, and state courts in both Florida and Massachusetts, Mr. DiSalvo holds memberships in numerous prestigious legal organizations, including the American Bar Association, American Association for Justice, Florida Justice Association, and the Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

His ongoing contributions to the legal community include service as Treasurer of the South Palm Beach County Bar Association and leadership roles on various Florida Bar and judicial advisory committees. Known for his compassion, skill, and commitment, Mr. DiSalvo continues to be a powerful force for those seeking justice and recovery.

attorneys.name: John C. Distasio
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
John Distasio is an attorney who specializes in consumer protection law. He handles each case with passion and professionalism, and is a true advocate.

Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Distasio served the people of the State of Florida as an Assistant State Attorney for the 13th Judicial Circuit. He worked alongside some of Florida's most respected prosecutors, trying over one hundred jury and non-jury trials. He handled a caseload in excess of two hundred cases, ranging from DUI to Attempted Murder. During his time as a prosecutor, Mr. Distasio earned his Master of Law (LL.M.) in Advocacy from Stetson University College of Law, the number one trial advocacy school in the country according to U.S. News & World Report.

Mr. Distasio received his Bachelor of Arts in Communication Studies from Florida State University, where he graduated cum laude. He later attended Florida International University, receiving his Juris Doctor degree. While in law school, Mr. Distasio was a member of the Trial Team and was awarded the Book Award in Florida Law and Procedure.

He has completed internships on both the state and federal level. Most notably, Mr. Distasio had the privilege of interning at the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey in the Honorable Judge Mark Faulk's chambers. Mr. Distasio's previous experiences in the Civil Division at the U.S. Attorney's Office, Middle District of Florida and Office of the State Attorney, 11th Judicial Circuit are some other experiences that have shaped the lawyer he is today.

attorneys.name: Robert Doan
attorneys.practice_type: Mediation Lawyers in Deland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robert Doan primarily devotes his practice to businesses, land owners and professionals in the construction and real estate industry. He is board-certified as an expert in construction law by The Florida Bar. He attended the University of Florida on a Florida Academic Scholars scholarship, where he participated in the undergraduate honors program and was selected for membership in Florida Blue Key. He remained in Gainesville after earning his bachelor's degree and attended the University of Florida Law School. Upon graduation, Mr. Doan accepted an associate attorney position in the construction litigation department of the West Palm Beach law firm of Boose, Casey, Ciklin, Lubitz, Martens, McBane & O'Connell, beginning his career as a construction and real estate attorney.

Mr. Doan handles cases in all counties of Florida. In addition to representing clients, Mr. Doan frequently teaches continuing education courses to the construction industry and real estate professionals, and has served as a guest lecturer at the University of Florida College of Building Construction and the College of Law. He is currently the secretary of The Florida Bar Construction Law Committee and serves on the Legislative Subcommittee for Construction Law. Mr. Doan has served as a peer reviewer for The Florida Bar's Construction Law Institute since 2010 and was a presenter in 2012. Mr. Doan was listed in the Wall Street Journal and Miami Herald in 2012 in the Super Lawyers Rising Stars list in construction and surety law.

Mr. Doan left his practice as a shareholder of Silverman, Vorhis & Doan in Gainesville in 2013 to relocate to Volusia County to be closer to family. He served for more than two years in the Volusia County Attorney's office, primarily handling economic development, real estate and as counsel to the Daytona Beach International Airport. Mr. Doan joined Cobb Cole in 2016. In his free time, Mr. Doan enjoys family beach trips, golf, camping, fishing and many other outdoor activities.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jimmy Doan is a highly experienced personal injury lawyer with an unparalleled record of success. He has built The Doan Law Firm into the largest personal injury law firm in the United States, with offices throughout the country and multiple attorneys who are always ready to address clients' needs, respond to their questions or concerns 24 hours a day and seven days a week, and fight to secure the full compensation they deserve.

Mr. Doan attended the University of Texas at Austin, where he majored in Economics. He received his law degree from Texas A&M University School of Law, and after graduating in 2000, he started his legal practice. Since then, he has dedicated his career to advocating for people who have suffered serious injuries, working to ensure that they receive the justice and compensation they deserve.

Jimmy Doan provides representation for people who have been injured in car accidents, truck accidents, slip and fall accidents, swimming pool accidents, and other dangerous situations. He works with parents to address child injuries, helps people who have experienced serious health concerns and disabilities due to catastrophic injuries, and works with families to address the wrongful deaths of loved ones.

With an emphasis on making a positive impact on the lives of his clients, Mr. Doan has built his practice around compassionate, determined legal representation. He has achieved record-breaking verdicts and settlements for injury victims across the country, and The Doan Law Firm has recovered a total of more than $1 billion for injury victims. Jimmy Doan has the experience and passion needed to advocate on behalf of clients, as well as a strong attention to detail and an understanding of the best ways to build legal strategies designed to maximize clients' compensation.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
Rebecca G. Doane is a founding partner of Doane & Doane, P.A., a Florida law firm established in 2003, now with offices in the cities of North Palm Beach, West Palm Beach and Stuart. Admitted to the Florida Bar in 1986, her experience includes many years as a senior equity shareholder in a prestigious local law firm. Due in large part to Mrs. Doane's experience, both she and the firm have received an AV Preeminent peer review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, which is the highest rating an attorney or law firm can achieve.

Mrs. Doane's practice focuses on the areas of estate planning, trusts, wills, estate and gift taxation, probate, estate and trust administration and guardianship law. She is board certified in the law of wills, trusts and estates by the Florida Bar Board of Legal Specialization and Education. In addition to holding a law license, Mrs. Doane is a Certified Public Accountant. Over the course of her career, she has been an active member of several professional organizations, including the Florida Bar, the East Coast Estate Planning Council and the American Association of Attorney-Certified Public Accountants. She has also authored a number of articles and other materials on various estate and tax planning topics.

Mrs. Doane shares her active legal practice with her husband, attorney Randell C. Doane. She is a parishioner of St. Paul of the Cross Catholic Church and resides in North Palm Beach with her husband and their three children, Elizabeth, Bryan and Randell.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell peer review ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards

Due in large part to Mrs. Doane's experience, both she and the firm have received an AV Preeminent peer review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, which is the highest rating an attorney or law firm can achieve.

She is board certified in the law of wills, trusts and estates by the Florida Bar Board of Legal Specialization and Education. In addition to holding a law license, Mrs. Doane is a Certified Public Accountant. Over the course of her career, she has been an active member of several professional organizations, including the Florida Bar, the East Coast Estate Planning Council and the American Association of Attorney-Certified Public Accountants. She has also authored a number of articles and other materials on various estate and tax planning topics.

Mrs. Doane shares her active legal practice with her husband, attorney Randell C. Doane. She is a parishioner of St. Paul of the Cross Catholic Church and resides in North Palm Beach with her husband and their three children, Elizabeth, Bryan and Randell.

attorneys.name: Matthew A. Dolman Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Dolman Law Group Accident Injury Lawyers, PA
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Clearwater, FL
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Dolman is the President and Managing Partner of Dolman Law Group, a Clearwater personal injury and civil trial law firm. Mr. Dolman focuses much of his practice on the litigation of catastrophic injury and wrongful death cases throughout Florida. In fact he only represents plaintiffs who have been physically injured as a result of the negligence exhibited by an individual or corporation. The Dolman Law Group, has not and will not represent the interests of a Florida insurance carrier.

Mr. Dolman is a proven fighter for injury victims and has been honored for his many achievements. He is a lifetime member of both the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum. Membership in the Million and Multi-Million Advocates Forum is limited to attorneys who have obtained million and multi-million verdicts and/or settlements on behalf of their injured clients. Less than 1% of practicing lawyers in the U.S. are members. Mr. Dolman was previously recognized by Florida Trends Magazine as a 2010 “Legal Elite Up and Comer” which honored the top attorneys in the State of Florida under the age of 40 as voted by fellow members of the Florida Bar. He has been selected a Florida Super Lawyer by his colleagues in both 2013 and 2014. (The “Super Lawyers” publication is a consumer ratings service of preeminent lawyers from numerous areas of practice published annually in Law & Politics magazine. Super Lawyers is a listing of the top five percent of attorneys who have attained a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement. The selection process is multi-phased and includes independent research, peer nominations, and peer evaluations.)

Mr. Dolman has also been selected by National Trial Lawyers as a top 100 trial lawyer in both 2013 and 2014 and was selected as one of the top 40 trial attorneys under the age of 40 in 2013 by the very same organization. He has been awarded a perfect 10.0 score by Avvo.com; a national consumer rating service for attorneys and was recognized in 2012 with the “Client Choice Award” by Avvo, based on feedback from former clients.

After earning a B.S. in Communications with a dual focus in Broadcast Journalism and Screenwriting from the prestigious Roy H. Park School of Communications at Ithaca College, Mr. Dolman received his Jurist Doctor from Stetson University College of Law. Stetson is regarded as one of the top trial advocacy programs in the United States and routinely ranks among the top three by U.S. News & World Report.

Mr. Dolman resides in Clearwater, Florida, and has built his practice based on word of mouth referrals from current and former satisfied clients. His business model is based on personal service for his personal injury clients and he seeks to differentiate himself from the settlement mills by regularly litigating his cases and remaining accessible. In fact, his cellphone number is listed on his business card.

attorneys.name: Julia Dolman Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Dolman Law Group Accident Injury Lawyers, PA
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Clearwater, FL
attorneys.bio:
Julia Dolman is a 2008 graduate of The University of Tampa, earning a Bachelor of Science degree with a major in Criminology. Before starting law school, Julia worked in the legal field gaining valuable insight into the area of insurance litigation and interned for the United States House of Representatives on Capitol Hill.

In May 2013, Julia graduated from Stetson University College of Law, Cum Laude, with Honors. While in law school, Julia was Captain of Stetson’s National Moot Court Team, earning two consecutive Regional Championships and Best Brief Awards. In January, 2013, Julia’s team became the first in Stetson’s history to win the New York City Bar’s National Moot Court Competition— one of the oldest and most prestigious law school competitions in the country. During the competition, the American College of Trial Lawyers awarded Julia with a Best Advocate Award.

Throughout law school, Julia was an active member of the Phi Delta Phi Legal Honors Fraternity, the Bruce R. Jacobs Appellate Inn of Court and the ABA Law Student Division. Julia also received the Highest Grade Award in Contracts, Pretrial Practice and Florida Probate.

In addition to pursuing her passion to become a litigator, Julia has acquired knowledge into the intricacies of our legal system by serving as a judicial intern to the Honorable Chris Altenbernd and the Honorable Darryl C. Casanueva at the Second District Court of Appeal, as well as the Honorable William P. Levens and the Honorable Nicolas Nazaretian at the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit in Tampa.

Upon graduating from Stetson, Julia was presented with the Michael P. Allen Award for Excellence and Professionalism—an award given to the member of the graduating class who combines the qualities of academic achievement, skill in both oral and written advocacy, professionalism, and civility.

Today, Julia combines her passion for advocacy and helping those who are injured as an associate attorney at Dolman Law Group. She practices in the areas of personal injury, trucking and motorcycle accidents, traumatic brain injury, wrongful death and insurance carrier bad faith. Julia is dedicated to serving her clients with the utmost degree of zeal, diligence and integrity. In fact, her clients are given her personal cell phone number and encouraged to contact her with any concerns they may have during the pendency of their case. Julia resides in Tampa and in her free time enjoys swimming, biking and fishing.

Awards and Honors

In 2020, he served as chairman of Rotary Club of Fort Myers’ second largest fundraiser, “The Screaming Orphans Concert.” The Irish rock band performs annually at the Alliance of the Arts. Dommerich is a member of the Federalist Society and the Lee County Bar Association. He’s a board member of the Southwest Florida Seminole Club and volunteers for Habitat for Humanity.

Mr. Domnick has been recognized by Florida Trend magazine as a member of Florida's legal elite, and has been listed by Florida Monthly as one of the state's top lawyers. He is named in The Best Lawyers in America, an independent study published by Harvard University law professors.

A frequent lecturer to lawyers and law students on litigation and trial tactics, Mr. Domnick served for three terms as a member of the executive committee of the Florida Justice Association, formerly known as the Academy of Florida Trial Lawyers. He is past president of the Dade County Trial Lawyers and a former member of the board of governors of the Young Lawyers Section of The Florida Bar.

Mr. Domnick is a ""double Gator:' he received an undergraduate degree in finance from the University of Florida, and a juris doctor degree from the University of Florida College of Law.

James Donohue (Jim) is a shareholder with the firm where he represents creditors primarily in bankruptcy and creditor rights, with an emphasis on cases involving insolvency and reorganization.

attorneys.name: Justin Donovan
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Justin J. Donovan is an attorney in the Orlando office of Morgan & Morgan, where he represents accident victims in their quest for rightful compensation for their injuries. Mr. Donovan was born in New York, New York and raised in Livingston, New Jersey. Mr. Donovan decided to become an attorney after working for several years as a paralegal and moved to Florida in 2017 to attend Barry University, Dwayne O. Andreas School of Law. While attending law school, Mr. Donovan interned for a Superior Court Judge in Newark, New Jersey as well as for the Department of Children and Families in Orlando, Florida. Mr. Donovan earned his Juris Doctorate in May 2020 and was admitted to the Florida Bar in November that same year.

Prior to attending law school, Mr. Donovan earned his bachelor's degree in History from Southern New Hampshire University. There, Mr. Donovan was a member of the National Society of Leadership and Success.

An active member of the community, Mr. Donovan is a member of the Congregation of Reform Judaism, as well as a volunteer with Clean the World Foundation, an organization that recycles hotel soap and amenities so that they may be sanitized and re-packaged for distribution to those in need.

When Mr. Donovan is not fighting "For the People", he enjoys spending time with his family and wife, Angela, cooking, reading a good non-fiction book, or exploring Central Florida.

attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Delray Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Originally from Boston, Mr. Donovan began visiting Delray Beach in the early 1990's. He fell in love with the city and decided to relocate here permanently.

Mr. Donovan brings a diverse financial, tax and legal background to Palm Beach County. For several years he practiced law in Massachusetts focused on real estate, tax, business and litigation matters. Prior to that, Mr. Donovan worked with the "Big Four" in New York and Chicago advising multi-national Fortune 500 companies on complex tax matters.

Since moving his practice to Florida in 2019, Mr. Donovan has represented real estate developers in the acquisition, financing, development and disposition of several multi-family housing developments throughout the southeastern United States. Also, Mr. Donovan has advised real estate investors on the formation of domestic private equity funds. In addition, he has provided sophisticated tax and business counsel to numerous high net worth clients and their businesses. Further, Mr. Donovan's knowledge and experience have been sought after by top South Florida divorce attorneys to assist in the negotiation and litigation of several high profile marital matters.

attorneys.practice_type: Trademark and Copyright Acquisition and Counseling Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Doppelt is a Florida Board Certified Intellectual Property Law Attorney. She advises clients on trademark, publishing, entertainment, licensing, franchising, and copyright matters. She manages trademark and copyright portfolios, and has substantial litigation experience in federal and state courts and administrative agencies. Ms. Doppelt speaks frequently on intellectual property, publishing and entertainment law. She has served as an expert witness. Ms. Doppelt was formerly an attorney for Prentice-Hall, Inc. and The Reader's Digest Association, Inc. She serves on the boards of the Orlando Ballet, Florida Lawyers Mutual Insurance Company and The Association to Preserve the Eatonville Community (Zora Neal Hurston Festival). Ms. Doppelt was the Treasurer and member of the Executive Council of the Orange County Bar Association, and the recipient of it’s William Trickel, Jr. Professionalism Award in 2002. She is a member of the Florida Association for Women Lawyers (President 1990 – 1991) and was the Recipient of its Golden Star Award in 2001. Ms. Doppelt also served as a Commissioner of the Ninth Circuit Judicial Nominating Commission (1992 – 1996, Chair 1996 - 1996) and the Ninth Circuit Grievance Committee. Ms. Doppelt has been an adjunct professor at Barry University Law School. She is a co-author of the chapter on Trademarks, Service Marks and Other Related Intellectual Property Rights in Florida Franchise Law and Practice. Ms. Doppelt has been named by Florida Trend as one of "Florida ’s Legal Elite" for 2004-09, has been included in the Florida Super Lawyers list for 2006-09, and has been selected by her peers to be included in the 2006 and 2008 edition of The Best Lawyers in America.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Ms. Doppelt is a Florida Board Certified Intellectual Property Law Attorney. She advises clients on trademark, publishing, entertainment, licensing, franchising, and copyright matters. She manages trademark and copyright portfolios, and has substantial litigation experience in federal and state courts and administrative agencies. Ms. Doppelt speaks frequently on intellectual property, publishing and entertainment law. She has served as an expert witness. Ms. Doppelt was formerly an attorney for Prentice-Hall, Inc. and The Reader's Digest Association, Inc. She serves on the boards of the Orlando Ballet, Florida Lawyers Mutual Insurance Company and The Association to Preserve the Eatonville Community (Zora Neal Hurston Festival). Ms. Doppelt was the Treasurer and member of the Executive Council of the Orange County Bar Association, and the recipient of it’s William Trickel, Jr. Professionalism Award in 2002. She is a member of the Florida Association for Women Lawyers (President 1990 – 1991) and was the Recipient of its Golden Star Award in 2001. Ms. Doppelt also served as a Commissioner of the Ninth Circuit Judicial Nominating Commission (1992 – 1996, Chair 1996 - 1996) and the Ninth Circuit Grievance Committee. Ms. Doppelt has been an adjunct professor at Barry University Law School. She is a co-author of the chapter on Trademarks, Service Marks and Other Related Intellectual Property Rights in Florida Franchise Law and Practice. Ms. Doppelt has been named by Florida Trend as one of "Florida ’s Legal Elite" for 2004-09, has been included in the Florida Super Lawyers list for 2006-09, and has been selected by her peers to be included in the 2006 and 2008 edition of The Best Lawyers in America.

attorneys.name: Richard E. Doran
attorneys.practice_type: Antitrust and Trade Regulation Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
Former Florida Attorney General, Richard Doran's practice focuses on state government regulation and civil litigation. He represents individuals and business in consumer protection matters including UDTPA, advertising substantiation and negative options, civil and administrative Medicaid Fraud cases and other government regulatory matters.

Richard frequently represents business clients in matters investigated by the Florida Attorney General's Office and multi-state investigations by state attorneys general. He also advises clients on Florida constitutional and statutory law issues.

Additionally, Richard is counsel of record in over two hundred reported appellate cases.

Prior to his appointment as Attorney General by Governor Jeb Bush, Richard had twenty years of government service including five years as Chief Deputy Attorney General. As Chief Deputy, Richard supervised the efforts of approximately 450 Assistant Attorney Generals, managed the daily operation of the office and oversaw all major litigation such as the state's antitrust lawsuit against Microsoft and hundreds of consumer fraud investigations including investigations of Ford Motor Company, Rite Aid, MCI, Firestone and Bank One. He also oversaw the office’s legislative agenda and was the principal liaison with the Governor’s Office and the other elected Cabinet offices of the Comptroller, Treasurer, Secretary of State, Education Commissioner and Agriculture Commissioner.

From 1995 through 1997, Richard served as General Counsel of the Florida Department of Health and Rehabilitative Services and was a key participant in carrying out the legislative directive to split the massive agency into the Department of Children and Families, the Department of Health, and the Agency for Persons with Disabilities.

From 1990 through 1995, he served as Assistant Deputy Attorney General supervising the Criminal Appeals Division and Civil Litigation Divisions and serving as a member of the Attorney General’s Legal Opinions Committee.
