attorneys.bio:
Mr. Ganz has been with the firm of Smith Bigman Brock since 2015. He became a partner in 2020. Mr. Ganz earned his Board Certification in Condominium and Planned Development Law in 2021. He has been recognized by the Florida Bar as an expert in the area of law that involves representing community associations and their members, property owners, sellers, purchasers, developers, lenders government agencies and investors in matters related to community associations and planned developments. He also has extensive experience in civil/commercial litigation. Along with Partner, Sarah L. Metz, Mr. Ganz manages the firm’s commercial/property litigation and community association practice group where he represents a wide range of businesses and individuals in all facets of business, property and association law. His work includes advising individuals and organizations on the operation of businesses and community associations, and representing those clients in disputes that may arise related to contracts, corporations, employment, homeowners/condominium associations, insurance, real and personal property, and trusts. Mr. Ganz appears on behalf of clients regularly before state and federal courts across the State of Florida.

Prior to joining Smith Bigman Brock, Mr. Ganz worked for a Northeastern regional firm representing dozens of national corporate clients in multiple fields of litigation. Mr. Ganz is a member of both the Florida and Connecticut Bars positioning him to provide counsel to clients who travel between Florida and New England or those who hold assets in either Florida or Connecticut.

attorneys.name: Kenia Garcia
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Kenia Garcia was born in Cuba. She came to the United States with her family at the age of 14 aboard a raft. She, her family and her dog were detained by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security/U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (DHS/ICE), formerly the U.S. Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS), at the Krome Service Processing Center detention center.

Ms. García graduated from Troy University, where she obtained the highest honors, summa cum laude. She attended law school at Florida International University and graduated cum laude, ranking third in her class. While she was attending law school, she participated in the prestigious Immigration and Human Rights clinic at Florida International University under the tutelage of Mr. Juan Gómez.

Ms. García worked at Miami Legal Services, dealing with landlord and tenant matters. Subsequently, she had the opportunity to conduct several trials while serving as a certified legal intern at the Miami-Dade State Attorney’s Office. During the time she served on the Third District Court of Appeal, she provided assistance to U.S. District Judge Barbara Lagoa, who is currently a justice of the Supreme Court of Florida.

Backed by her own life experiences, Ms. García is a committed and dedicated advocate for her clients. She is fluent in English and Spanish.

attorneys.name: Jose H. Garcia Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Community Association/Condominium Law Lawyers in Coral Gables, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jose H. Garcia is a Shareholder and Attorney at Cuevas, Garcia & Torres, P.A., where he focuses his practice on Real Estate Transactions and Litigation, Construction and Development Law, Community Association Law, and Commercial Litigation.

Mr. Garcia oversees the firm's Real Estate Practice, including its wholly owned title insurance company, Vantage Property Title Company, and its Construction and Development Practice. Mr. Garcia provides guidance to real estate developers in all aspects of residential and commercial acquisitions, sales, and development, and represents them in the negotiation and drafting of complex purchase and sale agreements, constructions contracts, joint venture agreements, operating agreements, financing documents, community association documents, easement agreements, declarations of restrictive covenants, utility agreements, and license and use agreements.

Mr. Garcia’s significant experience in real estate transactions includes drafting and negotiating loan documents, closing commercial and construction real estate loans, closing land acquisitions and sales, and closing hundreds of residential sales and purchases. In addition, his experience also includes representing developers at the time of community association turnover, drafting and negotiating on behalf of both landlords and tenants major lease agreements for residential, retail, warehouse, and office use, representing condominium associations and homeowners associations, drafting and negotiating company documents, and representing clients in contract disputes and commercial litigation matters, including construction defect claims.

Mr. Garcia received his Bachelor's Degree in Accounting from St. Thomas University in Miami, Florida, in 2007 and his Juris Doctor from Florida International University College of Law in Miami, Florida, in 2011.

attorneys.bio:
Michael Garcia is an experienced litigator with a focuses on construction, real estate, commercial litigation, government procurement and affairs. Michael has more than 15 years of combined experience as an Attorney and paralegal.

As a litigator, Michael has represented individuals, municipalities, residential and commercial construction companies in Civil Lawsuits, Administrative Hearings, Mediations or Arbitrations. Michael has prosecuted construction and municipal lien foreclosure actions, and has also defended construction lien foreclosure actions. Michael has also successfully represented clients at administrative hearings regarding real estate tax appeals. Michael has also been involved in several successful bid protest, government procurement matters, municipal lawsuits, and shareholder lawsuit.

The complexities of the various cases have allowed Michael to develop his litigations skills, in order to properly tailor the litigation strategy to meet the specific needs of each case. In addition to Michael’s litigation experience, Michael has also drafted various construction and municipal agreements, such as: government procurement, design-build, general contractor and subcontractor agreements. The detailed attention and analysis performed in drafting such agreements has enabled Michael to effectively counsel and assist clients regarding the terms of the agreements.

Michael received his Juris Doctorate from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Board Law Center, and his undergraduate degree from St. John's University. Michael is admitted to practice in all Florida State Courts, and in the U.S. District Court Southern District of Florida.

Michael Garcia is an experienced litigator with a focuses on construction, real estate, commercial litigation, government procurement and affairs. Michael has more than 15 years of combined experience as an Attorney and paralegal.

As a litigator, Michael has represented individuals, municipalities, residential and commercial construction companies in Civil Lawsuits, Administrative Hearings, Mediations or Arbitrations. Michael has prosecuted construction and municipal lien foreclosure actions, and has also defended construction lien foreclosure actions. Michael has also successfully represented clients at administrative hearings regarding real estate tax appeals. Michael has also been involved in several successful bid protest, government procurement matters, municipal lawsuits, and shareholder lawsuit.

The complexities of the various cases have allowed Michael to develop his litigations skills, in order to properly tailor the litigation strategy to meet the specific needs of each case. In addition to Michael’s litigation experience, Michael has also drafted various construction and municipal agreements, such as: government procurement, design-build, general contractor and subcontractor agreements. The detailed attention and analysis performed in drafting such agreements has enabled Michael to effectively counsel and assist clients regarding the terms of the agreements.

Michael received his Juris Doctorate from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Board Law Center, and his undergraduate degree from St. John's University. Michael is admitted to practice in all Florida State Courts, and in the U.S. District Court Southern District of Florida.

Michael is fluent in Spanish.

attorneys.name: Senen D. Garcia
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Coconut Grove, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Garcia has been an Entrepreneur from an early age. Mr. Garcia was sole owner of two businesses before completing his Bachelors’ Degree in Business Administration. His concentration in Entrepreneurship and International Business only fueled his desire to pursue life as an Entrepreneur. Prior to receiving his undergraduate degree, Mr. Garcia opened a tax practice. Concurrently with his tax practice, Mr. Garcia also consulted small to large companies advising them on areas of accounting.

While continuing to manage the operation of his tax practice, Mr. Garcia would eventually complete his Graduate and Juris Doctorate degrees. Following the completion of both degrees, Mr. Garcia would eventually open his law practice to compliment his accounting and tax services. Mr. Garcia now operates a thriving law practice to assist clients with their corporate formations as well thier transactional needs.

Mr. Garcia has spoken on a variety of topics such as: How to start a business, Defining a business’ cost & profit centers, Seeking financing for a business, Proper budgeting, Communication within your organization, Maximizing your tax refund while minimizing your costs, Tax planning, and Reducing member apathy.

attorneys.bio:
Mr. Garnett specializes in complex commercial litigation involving business torts, contract disputes, real estate development, consumer protection, and commercial lending, among others. He has experience litigating these and other types of complex cases in courts and arbitration forums throughout the country, including in Florida, Illinois, New York, North Carolina, Tennessee, and Texas.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, P.A., Mr. Garnett performed the responsibilities of a judicial law clerk with the United State Court of Federal Claims, Office of Special Masters in Washington, D.C. attorneys.name: Casey Gartland Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Gartland was born in Newtown, Connecticut, and moved to the Southwest Florida area when he was a child with his parents and younger brother Colin. Since then, Mr. Gartland has always called and considered southwest Florida his home. After graduating from Port Charlotte High School, Mr. Gartland attended Florida Gulf Coast University (“FGCU”) where he received a Bachelor of Science degree in Criminal Forensic Studies and Criminal Justice, graduating with academic honors. Mr. Gartland then attended the University of Cincinnati where he received his Master of Science degree in Criminal Justice with academic distinction. Mr. Gartland then attended the esteemed and prestigious University of Florida, Levin College of Law in Gainesville, Florida – where he earned his Juris Doctorate degree in 2018.

While in law school, Mr. Gartland was a member of and participated in trial team, served as president of the Law Student Transfer Organization, received the Wildcard Award for oral advocacy, obtained a certificate of concentration in Criminal Justice, and a pro-bono award for his philanthropic work volunteering while in law school. During his time at UF Law Mr. Gartland took numerous courses centered around litigation, negotiation, advocacy, and trial. During his academic career at UF Mr. Gartland also worked as a certified legal intern (“CLI”) with the Law Offices of Kathleen A. Smith, Public Defender, for the Twentieth Judicial Circuit of Florida in Fort Myers to gain trial experience before graduating from law school.

After graduation and passing the Florida Bar Exam. Mr. Gartland began his legal career as an associate attorney at Swope, Rodante P.A., in Tampa, where he represented and assisted individuals and families who had been injured or killed because of greed, carelessness, and negligence. While at Swope, Rodante P.A., he assisted in the litigation and trial of a personal injury case that resulted in a top 25 trial verdict for the State of Florida in 2019, with a jury award of over $3.83 million dollars. Mr. Gartland continued to realize success as a litigation attorney at Gunter Firm in Fort Myers where he litigated, negotiated, and settled numerous employment, breach of contract, and personal injury type matters, claims, and cases. In April of 2021, Mr. Gartland joined The Pendas Law Firm’s Fort Myers office to continue to develop and hone his litigation and trial skills. During his time at The Pendas Law Firm Mr. Gartland succeeded in resolving more than $8,000.000.00 dollars’ worth of cases, claims, and legal matters for his clients. During his time at The Pendas Law Firm, Mr. Gartland organized and spearheaded the Pendas Law Firm Disaster Relief Center in the aftermath following Hurricane Ian wherein food, water, supplies, and information was given out and disseminated to individuals and families in need after the storm to help them start their respective post-storm recoveries.

In the first quarter of 2024, Mr. Gartland joined the litigation team at Garvin Injury Law, bringing with him his wealth of experience and successes in compassionately and zealously representing individuals and families who have been injured or killed because of someone’s greed, carelessness, or negligence. Mr. Gartland takes a client-centered approach to the personal injury process, which begins at the time that a client retains the Firm and continues all the way up and through the trial process. Mr. Gartland focuses on the medical recovery and treatment of his clients before ever attempting to resolve a claim, recognizing that a quick resolution of an injury claim is often not the best resolution of an injury claim. Mr. Gartland works tirelessly and aggressively to be a light for his clients during what can often be the darkest time of their respective lives. As a result of Mr. Gartland’s relentless pursuit of justice for his clients, the legal industry in Florida has taken notice. In 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Mr. Gartland was named to the prestigious “Top 40 Under 40” list by The National Trial Lawyers Association in the State of Florida, for his work in plaintiff side civil litigation. In 2023, Mr. Gartland served on the executive board of the Lee County Bar Association, the Lee County Bar Association Foundation, and was also the President of the Young Lawyers Division of the Lee County Bar Association (a/k/a “Lee YLD”). Mr. Gartland’s drive, dedication, compassion, legal acumen, and no-quit attitude have culminated with him being named as a “Rising Star” by Super Lawyers in 2023 and 2024, an honor bestowed upon less than 2.5% of all lawyers in the State of Florida.

In his little free time Mr. Gartland enjoys giving back to the Southwest Florida community by volunteering with various philanthropic organizations, serving as a board member of the Lee County Bar Association Foundation, attending and sponsoring events locally in partnership with the Lee County Bar Association, playing sports, traveling, camping, writing music, going to the beautiful beaches of Southwest Florida, traveling, and attending church.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey R. Garvin
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jeffrey R. Garvin is a Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer who has litigated catastrophic injury and death cases throughout the country for over 30 years. During that time period he has tried before juries: cases involving aviation, automobile and boat accidents, medical and legal malpractice and defective products and has achieved multiple verdicts in excess of $1 Million. Mr. Garvin has been a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum® since 2004.

Beginning in law school Mr. Garvin demonstrated excellence in advocacy by receiving the Best Trial Lawyer Award. That tradition has continued throughout his career and in 2005 he was selected by his peers for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America® in which he has been listed in each successive year. He is also listed in Law and Leading Attorneys and selected for inclusion in Florida Super Lawyers® continuously since 2006. Additionally, Mr. Garvin has achieved an AV® peer review rating from the Martindale-Hubbell group; this is their highest possible rating.

Mr. Garvin is the President-Elect of the Florida Chapter of the American Board of Trial Advocates, a past president of the Calusa Inns of Court, Past President of the Edison Community College Endowment Corporation, and Past President of the Sanibel-Captive Rotary Trust Fund. He has served on the Board of Directors of the Academy of Florida Trial lawyers for 14 years chairing virtually all of their committees. Mr. Garvin has lectured extensively to numerous legal associations including the Academy of Florida Trial Lawyers, the Association of Trial Lawyers of America, the Georgia and South Carolina and Maine Trial Lawyers Associations. He has published numerous articles and was a co-author of Trial Advocacy: The Official Handbook of the Academy of Florida Trial Lawyer.

A 1973 graduate of the University of Florida, College of Law, Mr. Garvin is licensed to practice law in Florida, and North Carolina, and has been admitted to numerous Federal Courts and various state courts throughout the country.

Mr. Garvin has been a pilot since 1975 and holds both single engine, multi-engine, and instrument ratings and his hobbies include flying, fishing and skiing. He has been married to his wife, Susan since 1975 and they have two children, Leland with whom he practices law and Daryl who teaches school in Fort Myers.

attorneys.name: Leland E. Garvin
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Leland Eric Garvin, a Florida native and second generation trial attorney, began his legal career working as a State Prosecutor. While at the State Attorney’s office, he gained invaluable trial experience representing the State of Florida in countless jury trials at both the misdemeanor and felony levels.

Prior to taking the job with the State, and throughout law school; Mr. Garvin worked for a large personal injury law firm in South Florida. When he wasn’t handling injury and auto accident cases; he made time for the Moot Court Honor Society. It was during his time with Moot Court that he developed a love for the courtroom and passionate advocacy.

After leaving his job as a prosecutor, Mr. Garvin started his own firm handling both criminal defense and injury cases. He and his father Jeff later decided to combine their two practices in an effort to better serve the needs of their clients.

In 2009, Leland was selected as “one of the best up and coming attorneys” in the state of Florida by Florida Trend Magazine and listed in the 2009 edition of Strathmore’s Who’s Who.

In 2010, Mr. Garvin was named by Florida Super Lawyers magazine as one of the Top Young Lawyers in Florida. Only 2.5 percent of the lawyers in the state are selected by Super Lawyers for this list. He has remained on this list each year since 2010.

Leland was also selected as one of the top 40 lawyers under the age of 40 in Florida by The National Trial Lawyers Association in 2012.

He is a founding Board of Directors of Captains for Clean Water in addition to being a founding member and current Vice President of the Southwest Florida Trial Lawyers Association.

Leland has served on the Florida Bar Grievance Committee in and for the Twentieth Judicial Circuit as well as the Florida Bar Standing Committee on Advertising.

Leland is a member of American Association for Justice, the Calusa American Inn of Court, the Lee County Bar Association, and the Florida Justice Association. He concentrates his practice in the areas of personal injury and wrongful death litigation.

He is admitted to the Florida Bar, the Colorado Bar, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida and the Middle District of Florida.

In his spare time, Leland enjoys fishing, boating, working on home and vehicle repairs, traveling and spending time with loved ones.

Feel free to contact Mr. Garvin Today to discuss your case.

Call the Garvin Injury Law to schedule your free consultation.

attorneys.name: Mollie Marie Garza
attorneys.practice_type: Tax Law Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio: I was born in Texas as the child of an immigrant, an experience that shaped my perspective early in life and instilled in me a deep appreciation for opportunity, hard work, and service. Growing up, I saw firsthand how complex legal and financial systems can feel overwhelming to individuals and families who are simply trying to do the right thing. That perspective continues to guide my work as an attorney today. I attended Prairie View A&M University, where I earned my bachelor's degree in Political Science with a minor in Naval Science. I developed a strong foundation in government, public policy, and leadership. In May 2012, I was commissioned as an officer in the United States Navy, beginning a demanding and formative chapter of my career. I served five years as a commissioned officer in the U.S. Navy. In this role, I managed complex systems, led enlisted personnel, and was responsible for mission execution and the safety of the ship and crew. This experience required precision, accountability, and sound decision-making under pressure, and it instilled in me discipline, leadership, attention to detail, and an unwavering sense of responsibility—skills that directly inform my legal practice. After completing my military service, I transitioned from the Navy to the legal profession. I was drawn to law because it allows me to advocate for others and provide clarity during moments of uncertainty. I earned my Juris Doctor from Thomas Jefferson School of Law in San Diego, California, where I developed a strong interest in tax law and tax controversy. I came to understand that tax problems are often not the result of bad intent, but rather life circumstances, lack of information, or systems that are difficult to navigate without guidance. For many individuals and small business owners, dealing with the IRS can be intimidating and stressful. Helping clients through those challenges is where I found my purpose. Today, I focus my practice on tax law, assisting clients with resolving tax disputes, understanding their obligations, and regaining financial stability. I approach each case with the same mindset I carried as a naval officer: assess the situation carefully, develop a clear strategy, and advocate relentlessly for the best possible outcome. As a veteran and the child of an immigrant, I bring both structure and empathy to my work. I understand the importance of clear communication, trust, and practical solutions. Helping people who are in need is not just a professional goal—it is the reason I chose this path.

attorneys.name: Glenn Frederick Gaver
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Trial Litigation Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Glenn Gaver was born in St. Louis, Missouri in 1975 and moved to Tampa, Florida in 1983. He received his Bachelor's degree from the University of South Florida in 2000 and graduated from Florida Coastal School of Law in 2009. Prior to attending law school, Mr. Gaver was a High School English Teacher in Duval County, Florida. While attending Florida Coast School of Law, he was a member of the Mock Trial Team and competed in multiple trial competitions while also working as a law clerk at a local boutique personal injury firm.

After graduating law school, Mr. Gaver joined the above referenced law firm as an Associate Attorney focused on handling Personal Injury Protection, auto negligence, wrongful death, and premise liability suits. After several years working as a plaintiff's counsel, he opted to join Cole, Scott & Kissane, a local insurance defense firm, where he defended insurance companies in auto accident cases, wrongful death, slip and falls, PIP, and first-party cases. From his time spent on representing victims of accidents and also defending insurance companies, Mr. Gaver has learned the intricacies of successfully prosecuting his client's cases to positive resolutions.

attorneys.name: Charles Edward Geary
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Stuart, FL
attorneys.bio:
Charles E. Geary is a fourth generation Martin County resident and has practiced law on the Treasure Coast for nearly 40 years. e is licensed to practice law in Florida and Washington D.C., and is a licensed mortgage broker. He served as attorney for the Martin County Code Enforcement Board, the St. Lucie County Code Enforcement Board, and the City of Stuart Variance Board. He was also a Judge for the American Arbitration Association.

Over the years Chuck has continued his family's tradition of community involvement, leadership, and entrepreneurship, building several law firms and two local title companies which served the Treasure Coast for many years. He founded and served as the first President of both the Executive Club of Stuart and the Brass Plaque Exchange Club.

Chuck is married to his wife Becky for 35 years, and they have two adult sons. He enjoys local boating, fishing, diving, and cruising in the Bahamas. He is an avid cyclist and often participates in local cycling events. He was instrumental in bringing early cycling lanes and bike paths to Martin County. He has bicycled across Florida three times and rides his bicycle to Key West every year. He has also cycled coast to coast across the entire U.S. and has cycled through many countries in Europe.

His family has a deep history of legal and community service on the Treasure Coast. Chuck's great grandfather was the first Justice of the Peace in Martin County, his great aunt was the Clerk of the Circuit Court of Martin County, his uncle was a local Judge, and his father served as Chairman of the County Commission. Chuck has a long history of handling many types of cases and is joining the Firm "Of Counsel" to become part of our team handling personal injury cases throughout the State of Florida.

attorneys.name: Steven Anthony Geller Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Land use and zoning Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Geller is the Principal of Geller Law Firm, concentrating his practice in the areas of land use, zoning and code enforcement; administrative law and lobbying; and Commercial litigation, representing numerous local and national clients.

Mr. Geller has been practicing law in Florida since 1982. He is an "AV- Preeminent" rated attorney, AVVO rated, is or has been listed in Florida SuperLawyers, South Florida’s Top Rated Lawyers, the Martindale-Hubbell "Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers", Lifestyle Magazine “leaders in Law”, etc. Between 2008 and his election to the Broward County Commission in 2016, Geller was a Shareholder at the AmLaw 200 firm of Greenspoon Marder, where, at various times, he chaired the Government Law Practice Group, the Zoning and Land Use Practice Group, the Gaming Law Practice Group, and the First Party Insurance Law Practice Group.

Mr. Geller currently is a Broward County Commissioner, and is a former Mayor of Broward County. He has also served multiple terms as Chair of the South Florida Regional Planning Council (SFRPC). Mr. Geller was a member of the Florida Legislature for 20 years, where he served as the Minority Leader of the Florida Senate. He served two terms as Chair of the Broward County Legislative Delegation, and two terms as Chair of the Hendry County Legislative Delegation. He was appointed as a Committee Chair by Presiding Officers of both political parties. Among his Committee Chairmanships was the Comprehensive Planning Committee, which regulated local governments and growth management in Florida. He has also served as National President of both the National Conference of Insurance Legislators (NCOIL) and the National Council of Legislators from Gaming States (NCLGS). He is the General Counsel of NCLGS. He has been a frequent speaker across the country on both gambling and insurance issues, and has spoken frequently in Florida on local government and growth management issues. He is the long-time Chair of the Broward County Water Advisory Board.

Mr. Geller has received far too many awards to list here, including the Senator of the Year Award from the Florida League of Cities, the Lifetime Achievement Award from the Florida Association of Counties, the Legislator of the Year Award from the Florida AFL-CIO and the Florida Chapter of the American Planning Association, as well as Legislative awards from the Police Benevolent Association, the Professional Firefighters, and numerous attorney groups. He currently serves on the Executive Committee of the Florida Association of Counties (FAC), and has served as Chair or Vice Chair of various FAC Committees. Through his leadership on FAC and the SFRPC, as well as his service in the Legislature, Geller knows elected officials throughout Florida.

Mr. Geller was born in New York, New York, in 1958. He has lived in South Florida since 1965. He attended Florida State University for college and law school, where he was a member of AEPi Fraternity. He has lived in South Broward since his graduation from Florida State University College of Law in 1982. Geller was the longtime Chair of the Holocaust Documentation and Education Center in Dania Beach, Florida.

attorneys.practice_type: Brain Injuries Lawyers in Pensacola, FL
attorneys.bio:
"In 2000, Mr. Gerth graduated from Spring Hill College, located in Mobile, AL with a Bachelor's of Science in Business Administration and a concentration in Accounting. While at Spring Hill College, he was awarded the 4.0 GPA Greek Honor Award, was selected for Who's Who Among Students in American Colleges and Universities, as well as the Order of Omega Greek Honor Society recognizing the top 3% of all Fraternity/Sorority members on campus.

In 2004, Mr. Gerth graduated from Cumberland School of Law at Samford University, where he was named a Scholar of Merit and Dean's List Member. At Cumberland, Attorney Gerth was chosen for the Order of the Barrister naming him one of the top ten trial lawyers in his graduating class at one of the nation's top trial law schools, and Who's Who Among American Law Students. He was a member of Cumberland's 2003 and 2004 National Mediation Teams and its 2004 National Negotiation Team. He was Director of Mediation for the Trial Advocacy Board and a member of the Henry Upson Sims Moot Court Board.

As an attorney named one of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers in all of North Florida, Mr. Gerth has performed extensive work in complex and high value trial matters.

Having handled both jury trials and non-jury trials, Mr. Gerth brings the experience necessary to achieve maximum value in all his cases. His focus on winning and aggressively pursuing his client's best interests separate him from other lawyers that merely seek quick settlements over obtaining the best result for the client.

Attorney Gerth has litigated cases in personal/catastrophic injury and wrongful death, insurance liability and coverage, business/commercial/banking cases, complex business contract/tort cases, tractor trailer accidents, hurricane insurance coverage, civil rights, landlord/tenant rights, mental health law, legal malpractice, probate, warranty matters including the Magnuson-Moss federal warranty act, products liability, invasion of privacy, real estate and property disputes, premises liability, breach of fiduciary duty, medical liability, construction, and various other matters. His vast experience has taught him how to approach cases from a multitude of angles and philosophies. Mr. Gerth understands how the outcome of cases can hinge on party and expert witness depositions and has the background to skillfully handle both. Attorney Gerth highly values representing clients at a disadvantage in David versus Goliath battles and believes that justice must be available to all regardless of age, race, and income level.

As a result of Attorney Gerth's background, experience, and achievements, he has been asked to provide education for other lawyers. Some of his presentations have included lecturing on warranty litigation, a foray into jury selection and psychology, jury persuasion - strategies and tactics, and how to protect your business from unfair competition. He was honored with admittance to the Paul Brock Inns of Court In Mobile, AL and is now an active member of the Pensacola Inns of Court, which is an invitation only society to promote relationships between lawyers and judges through social interaction. Mr. Gerth was named an honorary member of Mobile's first African- American Mayor's staff and received a service award from that administration for his contributions to the city. Attorney Gerth has worked to promote justice throughout his career and sought involvement and built relationships in countless organizations, even being a select guest for one business leader named one of the top African-American businesses in Mobile. attorneys.name: E. Lynn Gibbons
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St. Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
E. Lynn Gibbons decided to be an attorney after prevailing as the prosecuting attorney for the “Goldilocks,” trial in Mr. Tom Haight’s Business Law class at Seminole High School in 1989. She earned her B.A. degree from the University of South Florida in three years in May of 1992. She attended law school at Stetson University College of Law in Gulfport, FL and received her Juris Doctor degree in December of 1994. She was admitted by the Florida Bar to practice law in the State of Florida in May of 1995. She is also admitted to practice in the Federal District before the Middle District of Florida.

She has limited her practice of law to the representation of injured workers, social security disability claimants and those injured in accidents resulting from the negligence of others. She has never represented an insurance company. She is a member of the Florida Bar, The Academy of Florida Trial Lawyers, the St. Petersburg Bar Association Workers Compensation and Social Security sections, and the Workers Compensation section of the Florida Bar. She has been Board Certified by the Florida Bar as a workers' compensation specialist since 2002. Her Certification was renewed in 2008 and again in 2012. She has been certified by the Supreme Court of Florida as Circuit Civil Mediator since 2002. Ms. Gibbons has not lost a workers compensation trial since 2008. Her very first jury trial in a personal injury case resulted in a $2.4 million dollar verdict for her client.

She was born in Cincinnati, Ohio and relocated with her family to Florida in 1984. She has been married for 23 years to her husband, Shannon, and has four children, Katie, Reilly, and twins Delanie and Dillan. Her hobbies include fishing, boating, snorkeling, cooking and watching her children play basketball and football. Her daughter, Katie, has followed in her footsteps – earning her B.A. from U.S.F. in two years, working as a paralegal at the firm and is currently attending Stetson University College of Law. Her son, Reilly, attended U.S.F., playing football for the Bulls and is now attending law school at the University of Notre Dame.

Craig A. Gibbs is a shareholder in the Law Office of Craig Gibbs. He received his J.D. degree from Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland, Ohio in 1976. attorneys.bio:
Mr. Gibson is a native "Hoosier". He is a 1982 graduate with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Economics and Finance from Ball State University in Muncie, Indiana. Mr. Gibson worked in the retail and banking fields until enrolling in law school in 1984. He moved to Florida after obtaining his Doctor of Jurisprudence Degree in 1987 from the Robert H. McKinney School of Law - Indiana University, in Indianapolis, Indiana.

Mr. Gibson is a founding partner of the law firm. He has practiced in Sarasota since 1988. Mr. Gibson's practice emphasizes business, real estate and commercial litigation. He is Board Certified by the Florida Bar in business litigation. As of December 2022, only 219 out of over 92,330 attorney who are members in good standing and eligible to practice in Florida have achieved this certification.

Mr. Gibson has also achieved an "AV" rating by Martindale Hubbell Law Directory, the highest rating possible based on peer and judge review. The rating signifies the highest level of professional expertise and ethical standards. In 2022, he was designated an "Elite Lawyer". An Elite Lawyer must demonstrated a high degree of skill and success in his or her career, be peer recognized, have exceptional experience, and be active in their community.

In 2020, Mr. Gibson was named an Elite Top Attorney Honoree as designated by SRQ Magazine. Mr. Gibson has been a member of the Florida Bar since 1987. He is also a member of the Bar of the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals and the Federal District Courts of the Middle District of Florida. He is a long-standing member of the American Bankruptcy Institute.

Mr. Gibson is happily married with three adult sons and two adult step daughters. He has coached youth sports for many years and is a longtime supporter of The Suncoast Youth Basketball League.

attorneys.name: Jonathan R. Gigele
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Stuart, FL
attorneys.bio:
"Serving the community as an elder law attorney is extremely rewarding, both professionally and personally. It is a uniquely challenging practice. The laws, regulations and informal policies, both state and federal, are many, complex and ever changing. My clients come to me with a unique problem and deserve an innovative solution tailor-made to achieve their desired result. Hearing stories about old times, repairing family rifts, or even enabling a client to fulfill a goal and leave their legacy is immensely satisfying to me as both an attorney and as an individual. There is nothing more fulfilling than the hug from a grateful client or family member knowing that you were there to help them when they were in a time of great need."

JONATHAN R. GIGELE is an associate attorney with Kitroser & Associates. Mr. Gigele earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Florida and juris doctorate from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law, where he was a member of the school's transactional lawyering team.

Mr. Gigele focuses his practice on guardianship administration and litigation, probate and trust administration and litigation, fiduciary litigation, estate planning, business succession planning, and legal issues involving the formation, operation, and dissolution of small businesses. Mr. Gigele is also adept at assisting personal injury attorneys with the unique family issues often associated with wrongful death litigation and catastrophic injury litigation involving minors and loved ones.

A native Floridian and a resident of Palm Beach County for over 25 years, Mr. Gigele is an active member of the Florida Bar, the Florida Bar's Elder Law Section, the Florida Bar's Real Property, Probate, and Trust Law Section, and the Palm Beach County Bar Association serving on the Probate and Guardianship Practice Committee.

attorneys.name: Diego Gil Jr. Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Diego Gil Jr., Esq.

I am a Passionate Advocate and Personal Injury Attorney

**About Diego Gil Jr., Esq.:**

Diego Gil Jr., Esq. was born and raised in Elizabeth, New Jersey, embarking on a path of unwavering public service and a relentless pursuit of justice. Diego is bilingual and fluent in Spanish. Mr. Gil began this journey as a Master at Arms and Military Police Officer in the United States Navy in 2003, serving two deployments in support of Operation Enduring Freedom, attached to Joint Task Force Guantanamo from 2005 to 2007.

Following an honorable discharge, Mr. Gil made the decision to relocate to Cape Coral, Florida, to be closer to family and to pursue higher education, furthering his career in the legal field.

**Education and Credentials:**

Diego Gil Jr., Esq.'s steadfast commitment to justice led to the pursuit of a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice at Southwest Florida College. During this academic journey, he discovered a true calling for the law. His passion for justice was further ignited during an internship with the Office of the State Attorney, 20th Judicial Circuit of Florida, where he witnessed the profound impact of a dedicated attorney on people's lives.

This experience served as the catalyst for Mr. Gil's decision to enroll at Ave Maria School of Law, where an unwavering dedication to the study of law flourished. During this period, he was honored with the prestigious Robert Bork Appellate Competition award, reflecting exceptional legal skills. Additionally, Diego Gil Jr., Esq. had the privilege of serving as the President of the Veterans Law Student Association on campus, further cementing his commitment to veterans' rights and advocacy.

**Community Involvement:**

Beyond the legal arena, Diego Gil Jr., Esq. actively participates in the community by serving on the Board of Directors for Wounded Warriors of Collier County. In this role, he provides invaluable assistance to all veterans in Collier County, addressing their housing, education, and mental health needs. His commitment to support those who have made tremendous sacrifices for the nation extends to his legal practice.

**Areas of Focus:**

With a unique background encompassing military service and legal education, Diego Gil Jr., Esq. brings a distinctive perspective to the practice as a personal injury attorney. His practice area focuses on helping those injured and handling personal injury cases with the same dedication and discipline that characterized his military service. His areas include:

- Car Accidents

- Slip and Fall Injuries

- Medical Malpractice

- Premises Liability

- Wrongful Death Claims

- Veterans' Rights Advocacy

As a personal injury attorney, Diego Gil Jr., Esq. is dedicated to achieving the best possible outcomes for clients, approaching each case with a sense of duty, integrity, and unwavering commitment reminiscent of his military service.

When clients choose Diego Gil Jr., Esq. as their attorney, they gain more than just a legal representative; they secure a passionate advocate who leaves no stone unturned in the pursuit of justice. His mission is to ensure that the rights of those who have suffered harm are upheld and defended, fighting tirelessly on their behalf.

Diego Gil Jr., Esq. is ready to serve as a trusted guide through the legal process, working together to seek the justice and compensation clients rightfully deserve.

attorneys.name: Irwin R. Gilbert
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Irwin Gilbert is a senior partner at Conrad & Scherer's Fort Lauderdale office with a practice concentrating primarily on complex commercial litigation, general business litigation, construction defect litigation, class actions and professional liability.

Practicing in State and Federal Courts in Florida and across the Country, Irwin represents fortune 100 companies in high stakes litigation. He has been selected as lead counsel for the defense in mass shooting cases.

Irwin believes that success depends on communicating with the client to fully understand the client's needs and expectations and designing a strategy to achieve those results in the most efficient manner possible. He has repeatedly "compressed the timeline" of litigation to conserve the client's resources and minimize the disruption of the client's business. When it comes to litigation, time is money. Compressing the timeline means getting the case on the fastest track, deflecting delay strategies by opposing counsel and getting the case to a resolution before his clients exhaust their patience and their resources. While Irwin has extensive experience taking complex litigation through trial, he believes that most disputes have the potential for less expensive resolution if the issues and objectives are clearly identified at the outset.

Irwin's clients have included banks, investment firms, executives, celebrities, legal professionals, and Fortune 500 companies. In some of his more groundbreaking decisions, Irwin reigned in fiduciaries who had exceeded their powers, including court-appointed guardians and Assignees for the Benefit of Creditors. Irwin has also protected business clients from lawsuits, including class action, antitrust matters and trade secrets cases. In several of these cases, more than one hundred million dollars was at risk.

Irwin has a wide range of experience practicing throughout the United States and has litigated cases in Great Britain and Japan. His original training was in antitrust and unfair competition, defending companies in Robinson Patman and price-fixing conspiracy cases. He also served as Chairman of the Business Law Section of The Florida Bar's Antitrust & Trade Regulation Subcommittee and also as Chair of the Florida Bar's Business Litigation Committee.

Prior to studying law, Irwin studied physics and electrical engineering and was engaged in government service. Irwin earned his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Buffalo, John Lord O'Brien School of Law and after clerking, began practicing in two large New York City law firms. Prior to joining the firm, Irwin was a Partner in his own practice also defending private lenders, construction companies and commercial real estate developers in complex commercial litigation.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Recognized as a Best Lawyer by Best Lawyers in Commercial Litigation, 2021 - 2022

Selected as a “Top Lawyer” by Fort Lauderdale Illustrated Magazine for Commercial Litigation & Mass Tort Litigation/Class Actions, 2021

Listed in South Florida Legal Guide, “Top Lawyer”, 2021

Listed as one of the “FACES of Fort Lauderdale” In Complex Commercial Litigation by Fort Lauderdale Illustrated, 2020

Erie County Trial Lawyers Association Award, Excellence in Trial Technique

attorneys.bio:
Jonathan T. Gilbert was born and raised in Orlando, Florida, completing the International Baccalaureate program at Winter Park High School. Jon went on to attend the University of Florida where he was a member of Golden Key and the Pre-Legal Honor Society. He graduated from UF in three years, attaining high honors in Political Science and graduating Magna Cum Laude. From there, Jon attended Stetson University College of Law where he was inducted as a member of the Phi Delta Phi International Legal Fraternity.

During his time in law school, he studied abroad at Universidad de Buenos Aires in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Upon graduating from Stetson University Cum Laude, Jon also received the William F. Blews Award for exceptional Pro Bono Service and received the Certificate of Leadership.

Jon has been a member of the Florida Bar since April 2009. He is also a member of the Florida Justice Association and Orange County Bar Association. Jon's practice is devoted to medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, personal injury, and automobile accident claims.

attorneys.bio:
The firm's personal injury attorneys have a preeminent record of favorable verdicts and multi-million dollar settlements that allows us to provide a quality of representation second to none. To assure that each and every client is privy to the dedicated involvement and full scope of our services, Colling Gilbert Wright & Carter offers clients state-wide accessibility with offices centrally located in Orlando, Florida.

Past Career Experience:

Mr. Gilbert began the practice of law in 1983 in Orlando with an emphasis in insurance defense litigation representing primarily automobile insurance companies. In 1986 he began representing injured victims and their families exclusively, with an emphasis in medical malpractice litigation. Mr. Gilbert was a founding partner of Morgan Colling & Gilbert from 1989 through 2005. He then founded his current law firm of Colling, Gilbert, Wright & Carter. He now practices with an emphasis in all cases of serious personal injury and wrongful death. Mr. Gilbert has substantial experience handling medical malpractice litigation. He has lectured nationally at seminars on numerous topics ranging from jury selection techniques to closing arguments.

attorneys.name: Grant R. Gillenwater
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Grant R. Gillenwater is a trial attorney at the Melbourne and Titusville, Florida offices of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. Grant focuses his practice on representing clients who have been seriously injured as a result of the negligence and carelessness of others. Grant handles all types of cases including serious automobile collisions, motorcycle crashes, wrongful death and slip and fall accidents. Mr. Gillenwater has been named a "Rising Star" by Florida Super Lawyers magazine- an annual publication that recognizes the top 2.5% of the state's young lawyers for the past four years. Over the years, he has recovered millions of dollars for his clients and their families and continues to obtain settlements from insurance companies and other major corporations.

Over the years, Grant has recovered millions of dollars for his clients and their families. Grant has been on Morgan & Morgan's trial team in Brevard county that has obtained some of the highest multi-million dollar verdicts in recent county history including $2 million (motor vehicle crash) in 2021, $4.6 million (motor vehicle crash) in 2019 and $1.6 million (motor vehicle crash) in 2018.

Grant was born in Chicago and raised in Rockford, Illinois. He then moved to St. Augustine, Florida to attend Flagler College where he graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in political science. Mr. Gillenwater went on to attend Stetson University College of Law where he obtained his Juris Doctor. While at Stetson Law, Grant was selected by the faculty and members of the regional bar to be a member of the Advocacy Board, which has repeatedly placed Stetson Law as the top law school in the nation for advocacy by U.S. News & World Report. As a member of the Nation's Top Trial Team, Grant competed at the state and national level. Upon graduation, Mr. Gillenwater was inducted into the Order of Barristers and was presented with the Victor O. Wehle Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy.

Mr. Gillenwater is a member of the Florida Bar Association, the American Bar Association, the Florida Justice Association, the Brevard County Bar Association and the Indian River County Bar Association. In addition to his legal practice, Mr. Gillenwater sits on the Board of Directors for the Economic Opportunities Council of Indian River County, which aims to transition individuals and families from poverty to self-sufficiency.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Saint Augustine, FL
attorneys.bio:
Please Note: As of June 2020, John spends the majority of his time working with Parable, LLC, an affiliated wealth management company, but remains of-counsel to advise clients of Ginn & Patrou, PA, on a limited basis. As such, as a client you should not assume that John R Ginn is acting as your attorney, unless Mr. Ginn has agreed to act as legal counsel in writing.

On behalf of Parable Wealth Advisors, John R. Ginn serves as a private wealth management advisor to high-net-worth individuals, their families, and their businesses.

With a background in law and estate planning, John is able to give clients a unique perspective on the integration of their wealth management, estate planning, and asset protection.

John was first introduced to investing by his grandfather at a young age where they would frequently watch stock prices scroll across the tv screen and discuss his grandfather’s investments, building a fundamental understanding of investing at a young age.

From there, John obtained a law degree from the Washington College of Law at American University and studied Finance and Accounting at the London School of Economics. After formal education, John eventually co-founded the law firm Ginn & Patrou, PA, which focuses its practice in the areas of estate planning, asset protection, and real estate.

After five years in private practice for Ginn & Patrou, PA, John continued to pursue his zeal for investing and co-founded the affiliated Registered Investment Advisory firm (RIA) Parable Wealth Advisors. As an investment professional, John strives to be a faithful steward of all that is entrusted to him by his clients and their families.

Philanthropy & Community Involvement:

John is a true local with his family having lived in the area for five generations.

- John is an active member of the Saint Augustine Sunrise Rotary Club

- John serves as a board member for the YMCA and the Hope for Haiti Foundation.

- John serves as a Deacon with Anastasia Baptist Church.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey Lee Gionet
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Claims Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jeffrey Gionet is a trial attorney who specializes in first party property insurance litigation. He received his Juris Doctorate Degree from Stetson University College of Law. While in law school, Mr. Gionet graduated Cum Laude and received several distinctions including Dean's List, Honor Roll, and Booking Awards (awards given to the student with the highest grade in the class). He also had the opportunity to intern with several judges including the Honorable Anthony Porcelli at the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida, where he gained invaluable experience and insight into the inner workings of the federal court system.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Gionet worked at a defense firm and represented many insurance carriers in first party property disputes at the trial and appellate levels. His first party property practice included defending multiple insurance carriers in tropical storm and hurricane claims, wind and hail claims, and other perils causing damage to homes. With that experience in hand, Jeff joined Morgan & Morgan in order to help homeowners who had their insurance claims wrongfully denied or underpaid. He vigorously fights for homeowners to ensure that the insurance companies properly pay claims and homeowners receive the protection they deserve.

attorneys.name: Peter L. Gladstone
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
PETER L. GLADSTONE, PRINCIPAL/SHAREHOLDER, is Board Certified in Marital and Family Law (1999) and a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (2003), who has practiced exclusively in this field since 1988. AV-Rated by Martindale-Hubbell, Gladstone has been repeatedly selected for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America (2005-2023 editions), Florida Trend Legal Elite magazine, Florida Super Lawyers ("Top 100 List - S. Florida”) magazine, and South Florida Legal Guide - Top Lawyers. He is a graduate of Brandeis University (B.A., 1985) and The Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law, Yeshiva University (J.D., 1988).

Gladstone is also the Past President of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, Florida Chapter and sits on the Board of Managers. He is also a past Chair of the Family Law Section of The Florida Bar, making him one of the few in the entire state to serve in both positions. Having sat on the Executive Council from 1997 to 2010, Gladstone has held many positions within the Family Law Section, including serving as Chair of both the Legislation Committee, Publications Committee (Editor, Family Law Commentator, 2002 - 2003 and Editor, The Florida Bar Journal, 2001 - 2002). He is also a past Chair of the Family Law Section of the Broward County Bar Association (1995-1996), and continues to serve as the Circuit Liaison for the Pro Bono Mentor Program for Broward County (1996 - present). Gladstone recently was selected to become a Founding Master of the Susan B. Greenberg Family Law American Inns of Court of Palm Beaches, which promotes professionalism and ethics in the legal system.

Gladstone has lectured throughout the state on assorted topics concerning Family Law, including Equitable Distribution, prenuptial agreements, discovery and depositions, temporary relief hearings, child custody and timesharing, and is a published author of articles appearing in The Florida Bar Journal. He is a past member of the Family Law Rules Committee of The Florida Bar (1996 - 1999), and is a member of the Family Law Section of the American Bar Association (1988 - present). Gladstone is licensed to practice law in both Florida and New York.

Moreover, The Law Offices of Peter L. Gladstone, P.A. has been named to the 2023 list of 'Best Law Firms' by U.S. News - Best Lawyers® as a ‘Tier-1' Marital and Family Law firm in the United States.

attorneys.name: William H. Glasko
attorneys.firm_name: Golden Glasko Haddy and Associates, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Guardianship and Trust Litigation Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio: After receiving his MBA in Finance from the University of Miami and Doctor of Jurisprudence degree from the Florida State University, William Glasko practiced exclusively in the area of Family Law litigation in both Tallahassee, Florida and Miami, Florida from 1999 until 2003. In 2003, William left his family law practice to concentrate exclusively in the areas of Probate, Guardianship, and Trust litigation when he joined Edward Golden. William is uniquely experienced in appellate practice including actions in the areas of probate, guardianship, and domestic relations, including practice in the Florida Supreme Court. William is a member of the Real Property Probate and Trust Law Section of the Florida Bar, and has served as an officer of the Dade County Probate and Guardianship Committee of the Dade County Bar Association. William has traveled to Cuba to represent Cuban national Beneficiaries of Florida Estates. William is an effective and experienced attorney who provides both fervent advocacy, and attentive personal service and counseling. While remaining focused on the and strategic aspects of a case, Mr. Glasko believes that it is important to quickly and sensitively address the personal concerns of clients in these unfamiliar circumstances. The lawyer is often the buffer between the client and the opponent and this relationship requires trust.

sections.title: Representative Cases
content: Citation: Mr. Glasko prevailed in the Florida Supreme Court in this appeal to defend his previous win in the 4th DCA for which conflict was certified with the 1st and 5th District Courts of Appeal. The issue was the striking of a Creditor's Statement of Claim. Prior to this case, Florida law required that known or reasonably ascertainable creditors must first file a motion for enlargement of time to file any Statement of Claim after the expiration of the statutory 3 month publication period. This Florida Supreme Court opinion created law in Florida to protect known or reasonably ascertainable creditors of estates who do not receive actual notice of their right to file a claim.
Ripoll v. Comprehensive Personal Care Services, Inc. 963 So. 2d 789 (Fla. 3rd DCA 2007)

Citation: Mr. Glasko prevailed in this appeal which recognizes the probate court’s inherent authority to monitor a guardianship and to take all action the Court deems necessary, including temporary injunctions, to preserve the assets for the benefit of the beneficiaries, even though ultimate ownership of those assets may be in dispute.

Citation: Mr. Glasko prevailed in reversing a trial court order adjudicating a “pretermitted child” as a probate beneficiary. A child was born to the Decedent before the will was executed, but the Decedent did not learn of the child until after the will was executed. Upon learning of the child, an adjudication of paternity was made in the Family Court. The probate trial court found, erroneously, that the child was a pretermitted beneficiary because there was an adjudication of paternity. Glasko correctly argued that, because the parental relationship was not created after the execution of the will, the paternity adjudication merely acknowledges a previously existing relationship. Hence, the child was not a “pretermitted” beneficiary under the statute.

Citation: Mr. Glasko successfully appealed a Miami-Dade County trial court Order which invalidated a deceased woman's revocation of her Trust. The Decedent instructed her attorney to revoke her Trust, and the attorney attempted to accomplish the revocation through language in the Decedent's Last Will. The trial court refused to recognize the revocation based upon its interpretation of §736.0602 Fla. Stat. On appeal, Mr. Glasko asserted an alternate interpretation of that statute, which was adopted by the 3rd District Court of Appeals. This case created Florida law ,which allows any language in a Will to be used as evidence to demonstrate any Decedent's intent to revoke a Trust.

attorneys.name: Steven J. Glaros
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Steven J. Glaros & Associates
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Steven grew up in New Orleans, Louisiana. He received his Bachelor of Arts degree in Sociology from Southeastern Louisiana University, where he graduated Cum Laude and received the Roy E. Hyde Award for Top Graduate in Major. Steven J. Glaros attended law school at Thomas M. Cooley Law School in Lansing, Michigan where he received his Juris Doctor after only two years in the school's accelerated program. While there he participated in the American Bar Association, Moot Court Competition, and was a member of the Phi Alpha Delta Fraternity.

Initially, Steven J. Glaros worked under then-Attorney General Charlie Crist for the State of Florida as an Assistant Attorney General in St. Petersburg, Florida. As an Assistant Attorney General, he researched, drafted pleadings, and litigated thousands of trials. Thereafter, he joined a law firm in Palm Harbor, Florida, as their primary family law associate. While there he managed a high number of primarily family law cases; his emphasis being divorce, child custody, domestic violence injunctions, and dependency.

Steven then became a solo practitioner, where he represented mostly family law matters. His experience includes representation of several divorcing wives of other Family Law attorneys, and he has prevailed in many highly contested custody battles. Steven has completed the Supreme Court of Florida certification course for family law mediators and will soon be a Supreme Court of Florida Certified Family Law Mediator.

In his spare time, Steven has volunteered for a variety of community interest projects. He volunteers at the annual Lawfest Workshop in St. Petersburg providing free legal advice to attendees. Steven volunteers for the guardian ad litem program assisting children within the legal system. He's also hosted benefits for the animals of the Humane Society and, after Hurricane Katrina, he collected and distributed necessary aid to its victims before spending three weeks assisting in the cleanup effort.

attorneys.name: Marisa K. Glassman
attorneys.practice_type: Class Action Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Marisa Glassman is an attorney is the Firm's Complex Litigation Group. Her practice focuses on complex litigation, class actions, and consumer protection. She is based in our Tampa office.

Ms. Glassman represents plaintiffs in a wide variety of cases. Ms. Glassman has held a lead role in state and federal class actions and obtained significant recoveries for class members in many cases. Ms. Glassman is currently co-liaison counsel for consumer plaintiffs in Arby's Restaurant Group, Inc. Data Security Litigation. She is a zealous advocate and committed to obtaining justice for her clients.

Ms. Glassman was selected and invited to be a member of The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 Under 40 - an invitation-only professional organization comprised of America's top trial attorneys 40 years of age and under. She is a member of the American Association of Justice and Hillsborough County Bar Association.

Ms. Glassman has presented on emerging topics in class action litigation. Her presentations include: Harris Martin's MDL Conference: Equifax Data Breach: What Happened? Who Was Impacted? What Are the Damages? And HB Litigation Conferences Mass Tort Med School + Class Actions: Class Remedies.

Previously, Ms. Glassman was an associate with Sullivan & Cromwell LLP in New York where she had a wide-ranging civil litigation and regulatory enforcement practice.

Ms. Glassman graduated magna cum laude from Georgetown University where she received a degree in International Politics. Ms. Glassman received her law degree from Rutgers School of Law-Newark. During law school, she excelled as a Norman Samuels Fellow, Kinoy/Stavis Fellow, and a Dean's Merit Scholar. Ms. Glassman acted as the business editor for the Rutgers Law Review and as a Legal Research and Writing Teaching Assistant. She graduated magna cum laude, Order of the Coif, and was also awarded for Outstanding Scholastic Achievement.

Following law school, Ms. Glassman served as a law clerk to the Honorable Virginia Long, New Jersey Supreme Court.

Ms. Glassman is licensed to practice in Florida, New York, and New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Brian D. Glatzer Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brian D. Glatzer has been an associate with our firm since April 2001. Mr. Glatzer is one of the law firm's finest personal injury trial attorneys exclusively handling personal injury litigation. Mr. Glatzer handles litigation cases throughout the state of Florida. He has mediated over 200 cases to successful settlement, tried numerous cases before a jury and has extensive experience in Appellate practice. Although, Mr. Glatzer has developed a niche due to his expertise and excellent reputation in handling the cases of minor children who have been significantly injured, he also specializes in automobile, premises liability and negligent security litigation.

Mr. Glatzer attended Gulliver Preparatory School until college, wherein he attended Clark University as a psychology major, receiving his B.A. While at Clark, Mr. Glatzer was President of The Prelaw Society; also leading the Drake University Mock Trial Competition in Des Moines, Iowa over teams such as Harvard and Yale. Mr. Glatzer then entered law school with a focus on Environment Law at one of the nations leading Environmental law programs at the University of Tulsa College of Law. He then went on to the University of Miami School of Law and received his Juris Doctorate Degree. Mr. Glatzer remains actively involved in the Dade County Bar Association School Committee where he regularly lectures to high school students in the Miami area.

attorneys.name: Michael J. Glazer
attorneys.practice_type: Administrative Law and Government Affairs Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael J. Glazer practices administrative and governmental law with an emphasis on health care matters. He regularly advises clients on a wide array of both state and federal regulatory issues. He has substantial experience in administrative law including the representation of clients in numerous cases before the Florida Division of Administrative Hearings, handling dozens of cases with trials lasting anywhere from several hours to complex cases with hearings lasting several months in length. These cases run the gamut, including certificate of need, disciplinary cases, bid disputes, rule challenges and others. His administrative trial experience includes cases before federal Administrative Law Judges. He also regularly interfaces with government officials on a wide range of issues, including the development of administrative rules, petitions for declaratory statements and others. Mike was one of the first lawyers in Florida to achieve Florida Bar Certification in State and Federal Government and Administrative Law and is one of the small number of lawyers in the state to hold that designation.

More specific to health care, Mike has represented for profit, not-for-profit and governmental hospitals including general and specialty hospitals, mental health centers, nursing homes, home health agencies, pharmaceutical companies, medical gas suppliers, hospices, ambulatory care centers and a variety of different physician specialties. He has also provided legal services to insurance and managed care companies. This work includes, among others, business transactions, contracts, compliance, fraud and abuse, licensure and certification, litigation (administrative and civil), Medicare, Medicaid and other third-party payors, mergers and acquisitions, privacy, professional discipline and licensure, regulatory issues including legislative and executive branch representation, self-referral and surveys.

In addition to his regulatory practice, Mike also has significant appellate law experience with almost three-dozen reported appellate cases. Mike also practices media law representing media organizations on a wide range of First Amendment issues, Public Records, Government in the Sunshine, defamation, access, subpoenas to reporters and related matters.

attorneys.name: Katherine Piccin Glynn
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Ocala, FL
attorneys.bio:
Katherine Piccin Glynn was born in Southfield, Michigan on May 29, 1969. She was a Ford Foundation Scholar at Eckerd College, from which she graduated with honors in 1991. She then graduated from St. Thomas University School of Law, was admitted to The Florida State Bar in 1995 and US District Court, Middle District in 1999. Upon graduation, she was appointed Assistant State Attorney for the Fifth Judicial Circuit. During the next four years, she gained extensive jury trial experience, mainly with white-collar crime and other felony cases.

Katie was hired as the first in-house General Counsel for the Marion County Clerk’s Office in 2007. In the last year there, she was appointed as the Chief Deputy of Courts for the Clerk’s Office.

Katie has enjoyed litigating civil cases with her father for fifteen years now. Currently, as Managing Partner, Katie handles complex personal injury cases, trucking cases, wrongful death cases, product liability, and medical malpractice cases.

When she isn't fighting for justice on behalf of injured folks in Ocala and surrounding areas, she's engaging in equestrian events such as playing polo, show jumping and other horse-related pursuits.

attorneys.name: Michael Goetz
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael Goetz was born in St. Petersburg, Florida on December 28, 1966. In 1989, he earned a Bachelor of Arts degree with high honors in political science from Emory University. And In 1992, he earned his law degree with honors from the University of Florida.

After graduating law school, Mr. Goetz joined the international law firm of Holland & Knight LLP where his practice focused on the defense of claims involving product liability, medical negligence, and general liability, as well as complex commercial litigation matters. He became a Partner in the firm on January 1, 2000.

In 2002, Mr. Goetz joined Morgan & Morgan, where his practice shifted to the prosecution of personal injury and wrongful death claims on behalf of individuals and consumer classes. He has represented hundreds of clients in cases involving automobile and premises liability, nursing home abuse and neglect, and environmental torts.

Since 2008, Mr. Goetz has served as head of the Mass Tort Section of the Morgan & Morgan Complex Litigation Group. In this capacity, he handles mass tort actions for the firm nationwide, including product liability claims involving dangerous drugs and defective medical devices. Mr. Goetz has been appointed to Plaintiffs' Steering Committee ("PSC") positions in federal Multi-District Litigation including: Zostavax (MDL 2848, Co-Lead Counsel); Pradaxa (MDL 2385); Transvaginal Mesh (MDLs 2187, 2325, 2326, and 2327); and Total Body Formula (MDL 985). He has also served on standing PSC subcommittees including Chinese Drywall (MDL 2047, Co-Chair of Public Relations Subcommittee); Yaz (MDL 2100, Discovery Subcommittee); and Depuy ASR (MDL 2197, Science Subcommittee).

Mr. Goetz was admitted to The Florida Bar in 1992. He holds the highest rating awarded to lawyers for legal ability and ethics ("AV") by Martindale-Hubbell. Additionally, in multiple, successive years he was designated by Florida Trend's Magazine as a "Florida Legal Elite" in the field of Civil Trial, and by Law & Politics Magazine as a Florida "Super Lawyer" in the field of Class Action / Mass Torts.

In 2018, Mr. Goetz was selected to membership in America's Top 100 High Stakes Litigators, a designation received by less than one-half percent of active attorneys in the United States.

attorneys.name: David H. Gold Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
David H. Gold, founding partner, has practiced personal injury law for more than three decades and has tried over 300 cases to a jury verdict. Since 1978, when Mr. Gold graduated the University of Miami School of Law cum laude, he has built his practice and reputation on giving his clients individualized attention while keeping an intense focus on getting the best possible results.

Mr. Gold is AV-rated by Martindale-Hubbell and has been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America, South Florida Legal Guide List of Top Lawyers, Leading American Attorneys in the State of Florida, Florida Trend’s Legal Elite Top Florida Attorneys, Florida Super Lawyers, and Miami Herald Top Lawyers.

Despite recognition and honors, Mr. Gold has never forgotten where he came from, a lower-income neighborhood where friendship, loyalty and looking out for others were the currency of the street. His father was a bartender and his mother worked in a factory. To this day, he likes to make sure that everyone always receives his due.

Even though Mr. Gold has been practicing personal injury law for over thirty years and has in-depth knowledge of the law and medicine involved in his cases, he always approaches his practice "willing to outwork the competition". He takes the time necessary to consult with the best experts and to understand the very complex medical and engineering aspects of his cases.

attorneys.name: Philip A. Gold Esq
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Philip Gold is a native of Miami, Florida where as a young child he had the good fortune of watching his father, David Gold, practice law and build his law practice from the ground up. Now, Philip is proud to be a partner with his father at the law offices of Gold & Gold, P.A.

Philip has built his reputation on hard work and dedication, and by placing his clients' needs above all else. His clients trust his ability to handle their claims and litigate their claims to a successful resolution, whether through negotiations or at trial. He successfully tried his first jury trial only six months after being admitted to the bar, and continues to obtain excellent verdicts at trial. His reputation for success is recognized by his peers. In 2009, Philip was selected by Florida attorneys as a "Top Up and Comer", as featured in Florida Trend's Legal Elite.

Philip received his B.A. from the University of Florida in 2002, after completing a dual degree in Political Science and Sociology. Philip earned his J.D. from the University of Miami School of Law. He made sure to work as a law clerk with his father's firm to expose himself to the practical side of trial litigation while building his foundation of legal knowledge at law school. Now a young attorney, Philip has already impressed favorably upon his clients and peers in the legal community.
