attorneys.name: Jonathan P. Hermes Esq., B.C.S.
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Saint Augustine, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jonathan Hermes is licensed in Florida and Wisconsin, and is recognized as a Board Certified Specialist in Wills, Trusts, and Estates law by the Florida Bar (a certification attained by less than 1% of Florida-licensed attorneys).

At Ginn & Patrou, PA, Jonathan focuses his practice on estate planning, tax issues, real estate, business law, and elder law. His primary focus is assisting high net worth families with estate and succession planning, wealth transfer tax, and asset protection. Jonathan also frequently acts as co-counsel to other attorneys on advanced tax and estate planning concepts.

Raised in rural Wisconsin, Jonathan moved to St. Augustine to attend Flagler College, where he graduated with honors with a B.A. in Political Science. Jonathan then accepted a full scholarship to study at Wake Forest University School of Law, obtaining both his Juris Doctor and a Master of Studies of Law with a concentration in tax law. Jonathan also serves on the Florida Probate Rules Committee, which develops and recommends probate rule amendments to the Florida Supreme Court.

In his spare time, Jonathan enjoys playing guitar, hiking, watersports, assistant coaching Little League, and spending time with his wife and four children.

attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Angelica Hernandez, Esq. is a Supervising Senior Attorney with over eight years of experience. She was born and raised in Ponce, Puerto Rico, and has a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration from the Pontifical Catholic University of Puerto Rico. She later obtained her Juris Doctor also from the Pontifical Catholic University of Puerto Rico School of Law. In February 2015 she was admitted to the Law Practice by the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico. During the first two years of her career as an attorney she dedicated her practice to Family, Criminal, and Civil law in Puerto Rico. In 2017 she moved to Miami and started practicing Immigration Law which she continues to practice.

As an immigration attorney she has successfully represented individuals and families from different nationalities before the Immigration Court, USCIS, and ICE in a variety of cases such as asylum, withholding of removals, cancellation of removal, adjustment of status, family petitions, naturalizations, waivers, temporary protected status (TPS), detained custody redetermination requests, stays of removals, and more.

attorneys.name: Patricia Hernandez
attorneys.firm_name: Rotella & Hernandez Immigration and Family Law
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration and Nationality Law Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
I was born in Colombia and immigrated with my family to the United States at an early age. Experiencing first-hand the struggles faced by immigrants in coming to the U.S. shaped my life and instilled in me humility and the importance of hard work. At an early age I knew that my life calling would be to speak out against injustice, fight for equality, and help immigrants achieve the American Dream.

I obtained my Bachelors in Psychology from Florida International University. I later went on to obtain my Juris Doctor Degree and a Certificate in Intercultural Human Rights from St. Thomas University School of Law where I graduated with honors. Throughout my career, I have represented countless clients nationwide in deportation/removal proceedings. I have also represented clients seeking asylum, withholding of removal, cancellation of removal, applications for residency, applications for citizenship and family-based petitions including countless same-sex marriage and fiancé petitions.

I have spoken extensively on the importance of Collaborating with Criminal Counsel in Immigration Removal Defense Cases, Immigration as it relates to Same-Sex Marriage, on How Transgender Identity Influences an Individual’s Immigration Experience, and have conducted several “know your rights” presentations.

Through my work, memberships, and community involvement I will continue to fight for equality and justice. I envision a future where every individual can enjoy a life free from persecution, discrimination and biases no matter their sexual orientation, race, religion, gender, nationality or ethnic background. As an outspoken advocate I will continue to share my personal experiences and educate the community to break down walls that divide.

In 2018, I was recognized by the Miami-Dade County Bar Association and was presented with the Visionary Award. Most recently I was recognized by the Miami-Dade County Hispanic Affairs Advisory Board and was presented with the Community Champion Award and I was also recognized by SAVE who presented me with the People’s Luminary Award.

Top Rating on Avvo, highest rating awarded by publication

Human Rights Community Honoree Award Recipient 2017

Miami-Dade County Bar Association and was presented with the Visionary Award, 2018

Recognized by SAVE who presented me with the People’s Luminary Award

Pedro Herrera's practice focuses on public sector employee benefits law. Working with Bob Sugarman and Ken Harrison, he provides counsel to the boards of trustees of governmental employee benefit plans that provide pension and health benefits for public sector employees, including general employees, police officers and fire fighters. Pedro assists the trustees in complying with all regulatory and legislative matters governing the funds, and provides legal opinions and analysis in a wide array of ancillary matters.

Pedro's practice also includes representing multiemployer Taft-Hartley pension and welfare benefit plans, advising on all relevant ERISA, Internal Revenue Code and trust law principles. He counsels clients concerning fiduciary responsibility matters such as conflict issues, duties of directed trustees, co-fiduciary liability, and the application of prohibited transaction rules. He also represents unions in all facets of labor law and litigation.

Mr. Herrera was born and raised in Miami, Florida. He is an alumnus of Christopher Columbus High School where he was an accomplished scholar athlete. Pedro went on to attend the University of Miami.

Pedro is a summa cum laude graduate of the University of Miami and a cum laude graduate of the University of Pennsylvania Law School, where he was an editor on the Journal of International Economic Law. Mr. Herrera also received a Certificate in Business and Public Policy from the Wharton School of Business at the University of Pennsylvania, where he completed coursework geared towards providing an improved understanding of the relationship and strategic interaction of the private and public sectors.

Mr. Herrera is active in the Miami community. He is a member of the Cuban American Bar Association and the Coral Gables Bar Association. He volunteers his time working with Amigos for Kids, an organization providing opportunities for at-risk and impoverished youth in the greater Miami community. He is also currently pending initiation at the Kiwanis Club of Little Havana.

Pedro is fluent in Spanish. He has worked at Sugarman & Susskind since 2004.

attorneys.name: Michael R. Herron Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Michael R. Herron, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael R Herron is a native of Tampa, Florida who graduated from Chamberlain High School in 1986. Upon graduating, Michael joined the U.S. Army for 4 years and was accepted into an elite Airborne Infantry Unit. Michael spent his first 2 years stationed in Vicenza, Italy and his military career culminated with a combat tour during Operation Desert Storm. His unit in Desert Storm was heralded for making one of the deepest penetrations into enemy territory as well as with the destruction of an elite Iraqi Republican Guard Unit.

After receiving an Honorable Discharge from the military, Michael earned a B.A. in History from The Florida State University and a Law Degree from Nova Southeastern University . Upon graduation from Law School in 1997, he joined the Hillsborough County State Attorney's Office where he prosecuted DUI, Traffic and Criminal Offenses. In 1999, Michael went into private practice with a focus on Injury, DUI and Criminal cases. Michael has conducted over 60 Jury Trials, 250 Bench Trials and Thousands of Court appearances. As of January 2010, Mr. Herron has personally handled in excess of 3000 Criminal and Traffic cases and 1,500 accident and injury cases. Michael lives in Tampa with his Wife, 2 children and a German Shepard.

attorneys.name: Craig R. Hersch
attorneys.practice_type: Wills, Trusts & Estates Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
CRAIG R. HERSCH is a Florida Bar Board Certified Wills, Trusts & Estates attorney and CPA. He is the creator of The Family Estate & Legacy Solution®, a unique process designed to transform his clients' legal, tax and financial concerns into a coordinated and understandable estate plan. His firm's web site contains trademarked Family Estate & Legacy Minutes™, short videos answering common estate planning questions. Hersch's Family Estate & Legacy Series™ workshops and accompanying videos help his clients identify the legal and tax issues that his clients should address, and then provides them a framework to work together to accomplish their goals. An example of this is his process that addresses estate planning issues common to new Floridians.

Hersch has authored several articles appearing in a variety of professional journals. He pens a weekly estate planning column in a Sanibel and Captiva newspaper that can also be seen as a blog on his firm's web site. Hersch enjoys an AV Martindale Hubbell rating, the highest attainable by the independent national attorney rating service, has been selected as a Worth 100 Top Attorney and is a SuperLawyer Top US Lawyer.

Craig is a frequent lecturer at legal and CPA continuing education workshops. A multiple graduate of the University of Florida, with accounting and law degrees, he is married to wife Patti. Craig & Patti have three daughters, Gabrielle, Courtney and Madison, who they are very proud of.

attorneys.name: Julie A. Herzlich
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Plantation, FL
attorneys.bio:
"Julie A. Herzlich is AV-rated by Martindale-Hubbell with special recognition from the Judiciary. Born and raised outside Boston, Massachusetts she began her legal career in the Northeast before moving to Florida in 2011. She received her Bachelor of Science in Real Estate and Urban Economics from the University of Connecticut and her Juris Doctor from Western New England University School of Law. With more than a decade of litigation experience, Ms. Herzlich has appeared in court in nearly half of the 67 counties in Florida. She is also licensed to practice law in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts and State of Connecticut.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Ms. Herzlich was a Partner at a prestigious insurance defense firm where she represented corporations, hospitals, insurance companies, inter and intrastate motor carriers, and government agencies and their subcontractors in automobile negligence, premises liability, products liability, medical malpractice, transportation litigation and wrongful death litigation. Recognizing her clients' needs and the benefit of a rapid response at the time of a catastrophic accident, Ms. Herzlich developed, implemented and was the Director of the first Catastrophic Accident Response Team, which provided 24/7 access to a team of dedicated attorneys and experts available to respond to an accident scene within hours. Through early involvement, she frequently served as a liaison between her clients and various law enforcement agencies throughout Florida.

As a trial attorney at Morgan & Morgan, Ms. Herzlich uses her background in insurance defense to provide her clients with the added insight into how the insurance company operates. She recognizes the insurance companies' limitations, anticipates their common strategies and successfully navigates her clients through the legal process in order to achieve optimal and just results on their behalf. She is a zealous advocate who believes that civility and fierce advocacy can coexist.

Outside the courtroom, Ms. Herzlich enjoys spending time with her family. She loves dogs, true crime stories, participating in athletic activities, and supporting collegiate and professional sports teams."

attorneys.practice_type: Incapacity Issues Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
Victoria Elizabeth Heuler is Past Chair of the Florida Bar’s Elder Law Section and has been an active Elder Law Attorney since 2000. Victoria is a Board Certified Specialist (B.C.S.) by the Florida Bar in Elder Law and has been continuously certified since 2007. Victoria is a member in good standing of both the Florida and Georgia bars and concentrates on matters involving incapacity and guardianship issues; protection of the rights of people with disabilities and people as they age; representation of fiduciaries and health care agents; end-of- life issues and advanced directives; advocacy and representation in matters involving exploitation of vulnerable adults; and estate and trust administration. Victoria is a prior board member and Past Chair of Elder Care Services, Inc., and a prior board member and President of The Alzheimer’s Project, Inc., both extraordinary non-profit organizations in Tallahassee, Florida. In her free time, Victoria walks, plays tennis and pickleball, rides her mountain bike, enjoys eating great food with her husband, travelling and spending time with her adult daughters. She also enjoys time with her rescues, kitty cat Aspen and pug Aristotle.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Victoria Elizabeth Heuler is Past Chair of the Florida Bar’s Elder Law Section and has been an active Elder Law Attorney since 2000. Victoria is a Board Certified Specialist (B.C.S.) by the Florida Bar in Elder Law and has been continuously certified since 2007. Victoria is a member in good standing of both the Florida and Georgia bars and concentrates on matters involving incapacity and guardianship issues; protection of the rights of people with disabilities and people as they age; representation of fiduciaries and health care agents; end-of- life issues and advanced directives; advocacy and representation in matters involving exploitation of vulnerable adults; and estate and trust administration. Victoria is a prior board member and Past Chair of Elder Care Services, Inc., and a prior board member and President of The Alzheimer’s Project, Inc., both extraordinary non-profit organizations in Tallahassee, Florida. In her free time, Victoria walks, plays tennis and pickleball, rides her mountain bike, enjoys eating great food with her husband, travelling and spending time with her adult daughters. She also enjoys time with her rescues, kitty cat Aspen and pug Aristotle.

attorneys.name: Kiersten Hewitt Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Lakeland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kiersten Hewitt is a first-generation attorney who recently transitioned from Mississippi to Winter Haven, Florida. Raised in a small Southern town by two loving, hardworking parents and alongside her younger sister, Kiersten’s upbringing instilled in her the values of determination, service, and perseverance. These principles guide her legal practice and commitment to making a meaningful impact in her clients’ lives.

Kiersten began her academic journey at The University of Southern Mississippi, where she earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration on a prestigious academic scholarship. Majoring in Sports Management, she honed her organizational and leadership skills through an internship with the university’s athletic department and active involvement in the Alpha Delta Pi sorority and the Sports Management Club. Her academic dedication earned her invitations to esteemed honor societies, including Phi Kappa Phi and Beta Gamma Sigma, recognizing her as a top performer in her field.

Driven to elevate her career, Kiersten attended Mississippi College School of Law on a significant academic scholarship. Graduating cum laude and in the top 20% of her class, Kiersten also earned a Certificate in International and Comparative Law, an ABA-recognized distinction. Her leadership roles as President of the International Law Society and Finance Officer for the Moot Court Board highlighted her natural ability to lead and inspire. She also served as a Teacher’s Assistant in Civil Procedure and Federal Taxation, where she mentored and guided fellow students.

Kiersten’s excellence didn’t stop in the classroom. Her dedication to advocacy earned her induction into the prestigious Order of the Barristers, a national recognition for outstanding advocacy skills. She was honored with the William B. Lovett Jr. Memorial Award, celebrated for her tenacity and perseverance. She placed second in the 2024 Bayou Classic Trial Competition and earned the title of Best Attorney Defendant in the Richard Schwartz Internal Trial Competition.

Kiersten’s practical legal experience is just as impressive. As a Law Clerk at Frascogna Law Group, she drafted critical legal documents, conducted in-depth legal research, and helped clients navigate complex legal landscapes. Later, as an Immigration Specialist with VisaLex, Kiersten provided personalized guidance on immigration processes, ensuring compliance with ever-changing laws while crafting tailored strategies to help clients achieve their goals.

Kiersten believes that the practice of law is most effective when it fosters collaboration and constructive dialogue among all parties, while thoughtfully integrating the client’s personal goals. She approaches each case with a distinctive blend of empathy and determination, striving to achieve resolution whenever possible. However, when litigation becomes unavoidable, Kiersten fiercely advocates for her clients with unmatched dedication. Her commanding courtroom presence and unwavering passion for her clients set her apart, particularly in litigation, where her exceptional advocacy skills truly shine.

Outside the office, Kiersten is a devoted wife to her husband, Caleb Hewitt, and a lover of life’s simple joys. She spends her free time reading, exploring Disney parks, and cherishing moments with her family.

attorneys.name: John H. (Jack) Hickey
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jack Hickey is a trial attorney. Since 1980, he has been trying personal injury and wrongful death cases in the areas of admiralty and maritime, railroad, medical malpractice, product liability, and general liability.

Hickey is Board Certified as a Civil Trial Lawyer by The Florida Bar and by the National Board of Trial Advocacy (NBTA), and Board Certified as an Admiralty & Maritime Lawyer by The Florida Bar. The NBTA is the only national certification program for trial attorneys and is accredited by the American Bar Association. The Florida Bar Board Certifications require that a significant portion of the practice be devoted to the area, review by peers (lawyers in the area of practice and judges), and passing a written, day long examination.

Hickey is rated A/V by Martindale-Hubbell (the international listing of attorneys, a rating achieved by only 5% of attorneys). The rating indicates that the attorney "has reached the height of professional excellence" and is "recognized for the highest levels of skill and integrity". He is also listed in Who's Who in America, Who's Who in American Law, and Who's Who in Emerging Leaders in America. He has been chosen by other lawyers as a: "Top Lawyer in South Florida" in the areas of personal injury and maritime in the South Florida Legal Guide (2004- Present); "Legal Elite" in Florida Trend Magazine(top 1.7% of attorneys) (2006-Present); and Superlawyer in the area of personal injury in Superlawyers.com (2006 -Present).

Hickey is a member of The Florida Bar Board of Governors. The Board of Governors is the governing body of all 101,000 members of The Florida Bar, that is, every lawyer in Florida.

attorneys.name: Clifford C. Higby
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Trial and Appellate Practice in State and Federal Courts Lawyers in Panama City, FL
attorneys.bio:
Cliff Higby previously served as the managing partner at the law firm of Bryant, Higby & Barr in Panama City, Florida, where he practiced from 1991 until August 2022, when he and Kevin Barr joined Walborsky Bradley & Fleming, PLLC.

Cliff graduated from Vanderbilt University in 1985 and the University of Florida Law Schol (JD 1988). He spent his first 3 years of practice in Jacksonville, Florida with the law firm of Marks Gray before returning to Panama City where he was born and raised.

Cliff is in his 36th year of practice, and his focus is exclusively Civil Trial practice in Trial and Appellate courts, primarily on behalf of plaintiffs. His primary areas of practice include personal injury, wrongful death, medical negligence, insurance litigation, motor vehicle accidents, premises liability, municipal liability, and products liability. Cliff is admitted to the Florida Bar, and admitted to practice in the US District Courts for the Northern and Middle Districts of Florida, the US Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court. Mr. Higby has tried numerous Civil Jury Trials in State and Federal Court as lead or co-counsel, and has participated as lead or co-counsel in over 60 Appeals in the Appellate courts for the State of Florida and the United States Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit.

Mr. Higby was AV rated by Martindale Hubbell since 2003 and has handled cases throughout Florida, as well as Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina.

Cliff is the past President (2003-2004) of the St. Andrews Bay American Inn of Court. He was a Member of the Executive Committee for the Trial Lawyer Section of The Florida Bar from 2001-2013, and served as Chair of the organization for the statewide section from 2010-2011.

Cliff served on the Board of Governors for the Florida Bar from 2019-2024, and was a member of numerous committees for The Florida Bar which governs and regulates Florida's 100,000 plus practicing lawyers.

Cliff is married and he and his wife , Susan, have two daughters. Lynne is a double Gator having gone to undergraduate and Law School at the University of Florida. She lives and works in California as a Director of Business Affairs in the entertainment industry. Mary attended the University of Georga as an undergraduate, then graduate nursing school at Vanderbilt University where she became a Women's Health Care Nurse Practitioner. Since graduation, she lives and works in the Atlanta-Gainesville , Georgia area. When time permits, Cliff enjoys golf, college athletics, travel, and the mountains of North Carolina with his family.

Continuing Legal Education

Has complied with Florida Law requiring 90 hours every 2 years. Mr. Higby was an instructor and faculty member for the Florida Bar Advanced Trial Advocacy Seminar (2010-2016) held each spring at the University of Florida Law School.

attorneys.name: Alfred J. Hilado
attorneys.practice_type: Workers Compensation Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Alfred Hilado was born in Chicago, Illinois and was raised in Winter Haven, Florida. He completed his undergraduate studies at Emory University in Atlanta, Georgia. In 1990, he received his law degree from Washington University in St. Louis, Missouri. He was a finalist of the Environmental Law Moot Court and quarter finalist in the National Environmental Law Moot Court Competition.

Mr. Hilado has been practicing law since 1991 and is admitted to the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida, the U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit and all Florida State Courts.

He began his practice of law representing employers and insurance companies in the defense of workers' compensation claims throughout the entire state of Florida. He quickly learned that he had significant compassion for injured workers. On January 4, 1993, Mr. Hilado began representing injured workers as he understood how an on the job accident not only affects the injured worker but greatly affects the injured workers' family as well. Since that time Mr. Hilado has made a significant impact in expanding benefits for injured workers by winning cases before the Judges of Compensation Claims, the First District Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court of Florida. He is an experienced attorney who is Board Certified by the Florida Bar in the area of Workers' Compensation since 1998. Mr. Hilado specializes in both workers' compensation as well as Social Security Disability claims, aiding those in need of assistance in their social security disability/SSI claims since 1994.

Mr. Hilado is a member of the Florida Bar Association; The Orange County Bar Association; was on the Board of Directors for the Florida Justice Association (2008-2010); is a past President of the Florida Workers' Advocates (2009-2010); served on the Board of the Florida Workers' Advocates from 2005-2020; is a current member of the FWA; and, is a member of the Judge William Wieland American Inn of Court. He is also a sustaining member of the National Organization of Social Security Claimant Representatives (NOSSCR).

attorneys.name: Mark E. Hill
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Melbourne, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mark E. Hill is a workers' compensation attorney practicing in the Melbourne office of Morgan & Morgan. His territory covers Brevard, Indian River, St. Lucie, Martin and Okeechobee counties. His practice is concentrated solely in the representation of injured workers.

Mr. Hill was born in 1967 in Detroit Michigan. He attended Brother Rice High School and Central Michigan University where he earned his Bachelor of Science in Business Administration in 1989. He then married his wife and moved to Florida where he attended Stetson University College of Law in St. Petersburg, Florida earning his Juris Doctor degree in 1995, where he earned the Victor O. Wehle, Trial Advocacy Award. After working as a staff attorney for the Circuit Judges in Titusville, Florida for two years, he has been practicing in area of workers' compensation since 1997. Initially, he worked for large insurance defense firms representing insurance companies, and employers, and government entities in the defense of workers' compensation claims.

In 2011 he was appointed as the State Mediator for workers' compensation in the Office of the Judges of Compensation Claims in the Melbourne/Sebastian district. This is a position he maintained until he returned to private practice in 2015. Mr. Hill successfully completed the Trial Advocacy Program of the Workers' Compensation Section of The Florida Bar.

Mr. Hill served on the Board of Directors of the Indian River Bar Association for nine years, as a board member, Secretary, Treasurer, Vice President and then as President from 2011 to 2012. He also served on the Board of Directors for the Indian River County Substance Awareness Council for 2 years. He is a member of the Florida Bar and the Indian River Bar Association. He is a founding member, organizer and Master member of the Robert D. McAliley, American Inns of Court covering the Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast. This is an organization focused on the skills and professionalism we strive to achieve in the practice of workers' compensation. He is a Florida Supreme Court certified mediator and has been an AV rated preeminent attorney for over 5 years as listed by Martindale-Hubbell, the highest rating achievable.

Awards and Honors

attorneys.practice_type: Estate and Wealth Preservation Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Michael B. Hill is a partner in the law firm of Sheppard, Brett, Stewart, Hersch, Kinsey & Hill, P.A. He is a Florida Bar Board Certified attorney in wills, trusts and estates, specializing in estate planning, probate and trust administration, and asset protection strategies. His memberships include the Florida Bar, American Bar Association, National Association of Elder Law Attorneys, Academy of Florida Elder Law Attorneys, and the Lee County Estate Planning Council.

With dual degrees from the University of Florida in accounting and law, Mike’s clients benefit from his multidisciplinary approach to their legal, tax and financial concerns. He was recently named to Thomson Reuters’ Rising Stars list of Florida Super Lawyers and to Gulf Coast Business Review’s “40 Under 40”, its annual salute to 40 up-and-coming young leaders who have distinguished themselves in their professions and in their community.

Mike has been at the forefront of bringing technology to the practice of law to maximize efficiency and proactively keep client documents updated as laws change. He has also led the firm in developing educational video content for the practice and making it widely available in the social media and on the firm’s web site at www.sbshlaw.com.

Mike and his wife, Jamie, have four children from the ages of 1 to 8 and are active in church, school and the community.

attorneys.name: Shaughn C. Hill
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Shaughn Hill was born and raised in Ocala, FL before moving to Ormond Beach, FL in 2000. He attended the University of Florida where he earned his Bachelor's degree in Building Construction in 2009. Soon thereafter, he went on to attend the Florida State University College of Law, where he graduated cum laude and earned his Juris Doctorate in 2013.

Upon graduating from law school, Mr. Hill accepted a position with a workers' compensation defense firm in Tampa. As an associate attorney, he represented numerous insurance carriers and employers in the area of workers' compensation defense. Following his desire to pursue a career in litigation, Mr. Hill left the firm in 2014 to accept a job with the Office of the State Attorney in Tampa. As a prosecuting attorney, Mr. Hill handled a multitude of cases including battery, trespass, petit theft, and DUI, amongst others. Mr. Hill served as lead prosecutor on more than 15 jury trials and sat second chair on numerous others. .

Ultimately, his continued desire to help others led him to accept a position with Morgan & Morgan in 2016. Today, Mr. Hill utilizes his extensive litigation experience to represent clients who have been injured as a result of the negligence of others.

attorneys.name: Taylor Alicia Hill Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Coral Gables, FL
attorneys.bio:
Taylor Hill is an Associate Attorney at Kurzban Kurzban Tetzeli & Pratt, P.A., focusing on medical malpractice, wrongful death, and personal injury litigation. She has been with the firm since May of 2021, first working as a law clerk before joining as an Associate Attorney after being admitted to the Florida Bar.

Taylor graduated cum laude from the University of Miami School of Law in May 2022. As a second-year law student, she competed in the 2020 John T. Gaubatz Moot Court Competition, ultimately winning the competition, receiving the Humberto J. Pena Best Advocate Award, and continuing on to serve as President of UM Law's Charles C. Papy, Jr. Moot Court Board. While on the Moot Court Board, Taylor competed in the American Bar Association's National Appellate Advocacy Competition, where she received the Best Brief Award. Taylor was also active in UM Law's Litigation Skills program, receiving honors in both the Pretrial and Trial skills courses. She received the Litigation Skills program's Richard L. Lapidus Fellowship, awarded to one student who demonstrates academic excellence, commitment to litigation as a career, excellent written and oral advocacy skills, and ethics and professionalism in the legal field. Taylor worked as a student intern with the Environmental Justice Clinic, representing clients in civil litigation and policy matters relating to energy, pollution, and constructive eviction. She also served as a Dean's Fellow for Essentials of Law School Achievement, a course dedicated to assisting first-year law students improve their legal reading and writing skills. Upon graduation, Taylor was nominated and inducted into the Order of the Barristers, a national honor society for graduating law students and practicing attorneys who demonstrate exceptional skill in trial advocacy, oral advocacy, and brief writing.

Taylor attended the University of Georgia, where she graduated cum laude with degrees in both Ecology and International Affairs. As an undergraduate, Taylor was a Center for Undergraduate Research Opportunities (CURO) Honors Scholar and published research on the impacts of climate change on water scarcity in developing nations.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Order of the Barristers

attorneys.name: Christopher J. Hinckley
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Ocala, FL
attorneys.bio:
Christopher J. Hinckley is an AV rated, board certified civil trial attorney in the Ocala office of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. in Marion County, Florida. Mr. Hinckley has been practicing law since 2007 and is admitted to the Florida Bar. He was raised in Maine, but with his father being a member of the United States Navy, his family called several different places home. In 1997, Mr. Hinckley moved to Orlando, Florida where he went on to complete his high school education in the Orange County Public School System. Mr. Hinckley attended the University of Central Florida, and graduated with a Bachelor of Science degree in Legal Studies. In 2007, Mr. Hinckley earned his Juris Doctorate from Florida A&M University College of Law.

Mr. Hinckley began his legal career with the Fifth Judicial Circuit Public Defenders Office in Inverness, Florida. As a Public Defender, Mr. Hinckley had the privilege of protecting the rights of indigent individuals that had been accused of criminal misconduct. Mr. Hinckley joined the firm of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. in April of 2009, and began aggressively pursuing claims on behalf of clients injured by the negligence of others.

Since joining the firm, he has represented more than 1500 clients and their families, and tried more than 30 cases, helping to recover millions of dollars for those clients and their families. He has obtained jury verdicts in excess of offers made by insurance companies and has successfully obtained large settlements from major insurance companies and corporations.

Mr. Hinckley is active in his community. He donates to and volunteers at the local elementary school and coaches multiple sports teams at the local YMCA. Mr. Hinckley is also a member of the Fifth Judicial Circuit Grievance Committee "A" where he, along with the committee, investigates complaints of attorney misconduct with a focus on preserving the high ethical standards of Florida attorneys in the committee's territory.

Mr. Hinckley is married and the proud father of two sons.

attorneys.name: Jennifer Hinchey
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
As a law school graduate, my passion has always been to advocate for those who often struggle to afford legal representation. I pursued my undergraduate degree at Florida State University, majoring in History with a focus on Politics and Women’s History. After college, I took a detour from the conventional path to law school, exploring various jobs and cities, ultimately landing in Albuquerque, New Mexico. My diverse work experiences, including writing for a weekly newspaper and assisting a union organizer, allowed me to gain a deeper understanding of the challenges our clients face.

My inspiration to attend law school was ignited during jury duty, where I was fascinated by the legal process and concerned about the lack of explanation provided to those most impacted. My experiences with the union further highlighted the need for dedicated legal support for marginalized communities.

Although I initially aspired to be a labor lawyer, my career took a different turn as I found more direct ways to help those in need. I have worked as a Guardian ad Litem for abused children, ensuring they received the necessary services to thrive and feel safe. I also represented domestic violence survivors seeking protection orders and served as Director of Operations and General Counsel at Washington, D.C.’s largest homeless shelter, providing transitional housing for survivors of domestic abuse, sexual assault, and trafficking.

Throughout these experiences and to this day, I have had the honor of representing people with disabilities in Social Security cases. Having represented over a thousand claimants, I find great satisfaction in helping individuals maintain their homes or access essential medical care. My commitment to advocating for the most in need remains the driving force behind my legal career.

attorneys.name: Anne E. Hinds
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO & Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Anne E. Hinds is an award-winning lawyer with years of experience in significant litigation and all aspects of family law practice. Anne started her legal career in the public service sector serving as both an Assistant Public Defender and Assistant State Attorney. Prior to joining Johnson Law Group, Anne worked at the nationally recognized litigation powerhouse of Boies, Schiller and Flexner LLP, performing and contributing to all phases of complex commercial litigation nationally, in both state and federal courts.

As managing partner with Schwartz-White she has specialized in the family law practice areas of:

Dissolution of Marriage

Alimony

Child Custody & Support

Division of Property

Modifications. Enforcement & Contempt Matters

Mediation

Paternity

Prenuptial & Postnuptial Agreements

Relocation

Dependency

Domestic Violence and Injunctions

Anne has dedicated herself to pro bono work on behalf of children in foster care, and has been recognized by the Palm Beach County Legal Aid Society with the Juvenile Advocacy Award for over ten years consecutive years. Anne is also the recipient of the prestigious Legal Aid Society’s Individual Legacy Award and the Florida Bar President’s Award. In addition, Anne has and continues to mentor high school and college students.

We are proud to have Anne lead our Johnson O’Keefe office in Florida and continue to dedicate her time, talent, and attention to clients in family law matters at Johnson O’Keefe. Anne is a certified yoga instructor and enjoys practicing yoga, skiing, hiking, and spending time with her three children and dog.

Admission to the Florida and Colorado Bars.

Honors

Legal Aid Society’s Individual Legacy Award

attorneys.bio:
Born in Rockledge, Florida, Robert Hoag is proud to call himself a Brevard County native. After graduating from Cocoa High School, Mr. Hoag attended the University of Central Florida where he earned his undergraduate degree in Business Administration. He then attended Nova Southeastern University College of Law in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, where he earned his Juris Doctorate. Upon graduating, Mr. Hoag came home to Brevard County, where he has practiced ever since.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Hoag represented many major insurance carriers. He subsequently transitioned to solely representing individuals against insurance carriers, for both personal injury and homeowner's claims. Now, he draws on his many years of experience in the insurance industry to help fight for the rights of individuals and small businesses in disputes against insurance companies.

If your insurance carrier has denied your claim, if they have failed to make an offer on any part of your damaged household, or if your insurance carrier's offer is too low, please do not hesitate to contact Mr. Hoag.

attorneys.firm_name: Hoffman Law Firm, Paul M. Hoffman, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Law Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
PAUL M. HOFFMAN is a well-known and well-respected civil trial lawyer in south Florida. The law firm was founded in 1998 litigates maritime personal injury cases in state and federal courts. Mr. Hoffman has extensive jury trial experience in representing individuals in personal injury matters, including maritime and medical malpractice litigation, with over one hundred personal injury cases tried to jury verdict. He tried the last case in Florida where a verdict for punitive damages on a seaman’s maintenance and cure claim was were upheld on appeal (Canales v. International Ships Services). He has successfully tried or arbitrated cases against Carnival Cruise Lines, Norwegian Cruise Lines and Royal Caribbean Cruises, Ltd., among others. Mr. Hoffman has never represented the cruise lines.

Mr. Hoffman received his B.A. in English Literature from Hobart College and his J.D. from Boston College Law School. He is a member in good standing of both the Massachusetts and Florida State Bar Associations, and the American Academy of Justice. He is the author of “The Mindful Cruise Passenger: A Guide to Safe Cruising and Beyond.” The Hoffman Law Firm concentrates its practice in the area of representation of injured cruise ship workers and passengers.

attorneys.name: Herbert H. Hofmann II
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Sarasota, FL
attorneys.bio:
Herb Hofmann was born in Chicago, Illinois, but after a few years, his family moved to Sarasota County, Florida where he was raised. He graduated from Pine View High School and then attended New College for a year when he transferred to Florida State University. In 1989, he received his Bachelor of Science degrees in Finance and Multinational Business Operations Cum Laude and then his Juris Doctorate degree in 1991 Cum Laude. As an undergraduate, Mr. Hofmann was elected to the Golden Key National Honor Society, Beta Gamma Sigma National Business Honor Society, U.S. Achievement Academy National Award Winner, and All American Scholar Award Winner. While attending law school, Mr. Hofmann was elected into Phi Delta Phi International legal honorary society and served as its Magister. He received the Phi Delta Phi Certificate of Merit and was a member of Who's Who Among American Law Students. He also presided on the student supreme court for Florida State University.

Mr. Hofmann began his legal career working in Sarasota for a private firm handling personal injury claims. It didn't take long and he knew that he wanted to be a trial lawyer. Instead of following the typical private firm path, he became an Assistant State Attorney for the 12th Judicial Circuit and prosecuted criminals for two years. Having tried countless jury and bench trials, Mr. Hofmann was hired by a long-standing local firm where he handled personal injury claims for injured persons and extra contractual matters defending local establishments against negligence claims. He had just begun his partnership track when he was invited to join the Law Firm of Morgan & Morgan in 1999. Today, he is one of the owners and is the managing partner of Morgan & Morgan's Sarasota & Bradenton offices. He focuses his practice on wrongful death and severe personal injuries resulting from vehicle crashes and premises liability.

Since joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Hofmann has been a frequent seminar presenter for effectively prosecuting a personal injury claim both in house and for plaintiffs' lawyers from across the country. In 2013, he was selected for membership in The National Trial Lawyers Top 100 Trial Lawyers. This organization is noted as being composed of the premier trial lawyers from across the nation. Less than one percent of all attorneys are invited to join. In 2014, he was invited and joined the Southern Trial Lawyers Association comprised of an elite group of lawyers who are among the most respected by their peers and who are honored for the work they do to protect the individuals and families they represent and the profession they uphold. He is also a member of The Florida Bar, The Sarasota County Bar Association, The Florida Justice Association, the Manasota Trial Lawyers Board and the American Association for Justice. He consistently ranks within the firm's top-producing personal injury lawyers for the Tampa office and has represented more than 10,550 clients for Morgan & Morgan. Mr. Hofmann was recently elected as the president of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA), a national association of experienced trial lawyers and judges dedicated to the preservation and promotion of the civil jury trial and elevating the standards of integrity, honor, ethics, civility and courtesy in the legal profession. Herb has also been honored with the prestigious AV® Peer Review Rating by Martindale-Hubbell, the preeminent national publication in the legal field. According to Martindale-Hubbell, "An AV rating is a significant accomplishment - a testament to the fact that a lawyer's peers rank him or her at the highest level of professional excellence. A lawyer must be admitted to the bar for 10 years or more to receive an AV rating. This rating is based upon evaluations by other lawyers and is the highest ranking attainable by an attorney for ability and ethics in the practice of law. It is a distinction reserved for a select few in the legal community."

In 2015, Mr. Hofmann was recognized for excellence and achievements by the legal community when he received the 2015 Top Lawyers of Tampa award. Another proud accomplishment was being recognized by the American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys for his exceptional performance as one of Florida's 2015 10 Best Personal Injury Attorneys for Client Satisfaction. He has been named to the list every year since. The American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys is a third-party attorney rating organization that publishes an annual list of the Top 10 Personal Injury attorneys in each state. Attorneys who are selected to the "10 Best" list must pass AIOPIA's rigorous selection process, which is based on client and/or peer nominations, thorough research, and AIOPIA's independent evaluation. AIOPIA's annual list was created to be used as a resource for clients during the attorney selection process.

One of the most significant aspects of the selection process involves attorneys' relationships and reputation among his or her clients. As clients should be an attorney's top priority, AIOPIA places the utmost emphasis on selecting lawyers who have achieved significant success in the field of Personal Injury law without sacrificing the service and support they provide. Selection criteria, therefore, focus on attorneys who demonstrate the highest standards of Client Satisfaction. Mr. Hofmann works tirelessly in his fight to help the injured people he serves.

attorneys.name: Robert D. Hogan
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Daniel Hogan was born in Ohio and raised outside of Chicago. Mr. Hogan moved to Florida following his graduation from the University of Illinois. After arriving in Florida, he taught high school for several years before attending law school at the University of Florida. As a teacher he honed his speaking skills, using stories to keep the attention of distracted students. At UF Law, Mr. Hogan found his calling when he received "Best Advocate" at the school-wide mock trial competition. He went on to win the state-wide Chester Bedell mock trial competition and the nation-wide San Antonio mock trial competition.

Following graduation in 2011, he joined the Public Defender's office, where he would have the best opportunity to try cases. Mr. Hogan has handled thousands of criminal cases, and over a thousand felonies. He has sat first chair on over forty trials, including armed robbery, homicide and capital sexual battery. He was the Chief Assistant Public Defender of Gadsden and Liberty counties before moving to the Capital Crimes division where he handled exclusively first degree murder cases. Although a skilled litigator, Daniel also brings a wealth of experience negotiating and seeking creative solutions to resolving cases.

Daniel lives in Tallahassee with his wife and fellow attorney, Kimmy, and their two boys, Harrison and Theo. In his spare time he enjoys reading, playing guitar, and cooking.

Steven Hogan joined the firm in 2010. His practice focuses on commercial litigation and tax law, as well as education law, appellate law, bankruptcy, and business law.

attorneys.bio:
A native Floridian, Jim Holliday was born in Orlando and grew up in nearby Longwood, where he graduated from Lake Brantley High School before going on to Stetson University in DeLand, FL, on a full ROTC academic scholarship. During his college years, Jim honed his leadership skills as Chairman of Stetson’s Orientation Program, Chairman for United Way Fundraisers, and serving as the ROTC Company Commander. He also served on Stetson’s mock trial team and was the social chair of his fraternity. He received his Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) from Stetson University in 1990 and was commissioned as an officer in the United States Army, going on to serve in the Transportation Corps, where his superior officers often described him as “an intelligent, motivated, and energetic officer.”

Following the Gulf War, Jim was accepted to Stetson University College of Law in St. Petersburg, FL. During this time, he interned for the United States Attorney’s office in Tampa and supplied litigation support at the Veteran's Affairs hospital. He was honored with an award for Best Moot Court Brief and "booked" his Torts, meaning that he received the highest grade in his personal injury law classes, going on to graduate from law school with honors in 1994.

Throughout the years, Jim has built a storied reputation as an extraordinary trial lawyer, known for his tireless work ethic and his thorough preparation at trial. In his effort to help injured people in the community, he has demonstrated an unrelenting dedication to finding the truth and delivering justice for his clients.

Jim is a member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates, Legends Law Society, National Trial Lawyers, American Association for Justice, and the Florida Justice Association. He is also a "Best Attorney" Lifetime Charter Member in Florida, an honor bestowed upon less than one percent of attorneys in America.

A native Floridian, Jim Holliday was born in Orlando and grew up in nearby Longwood, where he graduated from Lake Brantley High School before going on to Stetson University in DeLand, FL, on a full ROTC academic scholarship. During his college years, Jim honed his leadership skills as Chairman of Stetson’s Orientation Program, Chairman for United Way Fundraisers, and serving as the ROTC Company Commander. He also served on Stetson’s mock trial team and was the social chair of his fraternity. He received his Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) from Stetson University in 1990 and was commissioned as an officer in the United States Army, going on to serve in the Transportation Corps, where his superior officers often described him as “an intelligent, motivated, and energetic officer.”

Following the Gulf War, Jim was accepted to Stetson University College of Law in St. Petersburg, FL. During this time, he interned for the United States Attorney’s office in Tampa and supplied litigation support at the Veteran's Affairs hospital. He was honored with an award for Best Moot Court Brief and "booked" his Torts, meaning that he received the highest grade in his personal injury law classes, going on to graduate from law school with honors in 1994.

Throughout the years, Jim has built a storied reputation as an extraordinary trial lawyer, known for his tireless work ethic and his thorough preparation at trial. In his effort to help injured people in the community, he has demonstrated an unrelenting dedication to finding the truth and delivering justice for his clients.

Jim is a member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates, Legends Law Society, National Trial Lawyers, American Association for Justice, and the Florida Justice Association. He is also a "Best Attorney" Lifetime Charter Member in Florida, an honor bestowed upon less than one percent of attorneys in America.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Cape Coral, FL
attorneys.bio:

Being new to Southwest Florida, David now looks forward to servicing our community at large and handling any legal matter you may have.

attorneys.name: Brad H. Hollingsworth
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brad Hollingsworth was born in Wheaton, IL, and raised in Brandon, FL. He graduated from Florida State University in 1988, then attended Syracuse University College of Law, graduating in 1992. He began his legal career defending employers and insurance companies in workers' compensation claims. In 1995, he began exclusively representing injured workers.

Mr. Hollingsworth spent the next six years working for a preeminent plaintiff's firm, rising to the level of partner, before opening his own firm in 2001. That same year, he focused his abilities on mediation of workers' compensation claims, while still representing injured workers. Over 10 years later, and thousands of successfully mediated claims, Mr. Hollingsworth brings his experience to Morgan and Morgan, where he vigorously represents individuals who have been injured on the job.

In 2000, the Florida Bar named Brad Hollingsworth as a Board Certified Workers' Compensation Attorney, a distinction given to less than 2% of all attorneys practicing in the State of Florida. This certification is the highest level of recognition by the Florida Bar in the area of Workers' Compensation litigation.

attorneys.name: N. Diane Holmes
attorneys.firm_name: N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
N. Diane Holmes is one of the most respected family law attorneys in the state of Florida. Consistently ranked as a Florida “Super Lawyer” (most recently by the Wall Street Journal), she is held in high regard by her peers with the coveted 5.0 Martindale-Hubbell® peer rating for “high ethical standards and professional ability”. This is the highest peer ranking possible.

She holds the impressive distinction as the only woman lawyer in Central Florida who has earned the designation as a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers.

Since 1984, Ms. Holmes has built a family law practice based on her firm belief in fairness, creative strategies and results. She will represent you with the experience and tenacity that has earned her a solid reputation in the legal community.

A pioneer in collaborative divorce, she is known for developing unique and creative solutions for the benefit of her clients. She has earned great admiration and respect from the bench, her clients and opposing counsel for the caliber of representation and experience she brings to the table.

Community Involvement:

N. Diane Holmes is a celebrated leader in our community, guiding efforts to protect children, raising money to fund breast cancer research and supporting the arts in Central Florida.

She was one of the strongest advocates to build the Legal Aid Society of the Orange County Bar Association’s Guardian ad Litem program*, ensuring that thousands of abused and neglected children could rely on trained, compassionate volunteers to guide them through the sometimes scary and unfamiliar judicial process.

Ms. Holmes continues to be a dedicated mentor for young lawyers. She regularly invites young attorneys to lunch or to offer them a seat at her famous “Table for Eight.” She also inspires students to consider the profession of law.

She points to her involvement in the Florida Lawyer's Assistance Program as one of the most rewarding commitments of her career. The program was created to provide assistance to help law professionals and students who face stress-related, substance abuse and other challenges that could impact their ability to live and work effectively.

Ms. Holmes is also a proud supporter and active participant in the arts, including the Winter Park Playhouse and the Winter Park Autumn Arts Festival. Other non-profit organizations she is involved in include The Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation and “A Place for Children,” which is a free courthouse day care program in Orange County.

The cause most personal to her is the fight to find a cure for breast cancer. A two-time breast cancer survivor, she serves as a positive example to others. In recognition of her tireless efforts, she was recently selected as the 2011 Honorary Breast Cancer Survivor for the “Central Florida Making Strides Against Breast Cancer” walk in Downtown Orlando, personally raising more than $10,000 for the cause. For more than a decade, Ms. Holmes has supported the American Cancer Society as a Reach to Recovery volunteer and is featured in an American Cancer Society video, “Conqueror of Cancer: Surfing Diane.”

attorneys.practice_type: Sex Abuse Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Stacey Honowitz is a former 36 year veteran of the State Attorney's Office, dedicated to the Sex Crimes and Child Abuse Unit where she is served as a Supervisor. She was responsible for investigations, interviews, filing of motions, reviewing evidence and everything from inception of a police report to the filing and or declining of the criminal charges. She is also a frequent legal commentator who has provided legal analysis for CNN, Good Morning America, Dateline NBC, CBS News 48 Hours, MSNBC, CNBC, Fox News, NewsNation, and Court Television.

She has prosecuted several high profile cases and is also a guest lecturer who speaks about child sex abuse and the sensitive nature of these cases, the navigation of the criminal justice system and the importance of open communication with children about this important and difficult subject matter. She has provided important information for several years to both parents and children on the issues of child molestation and continues to share her message that the importance of reporting the abuse is the first step in healing.

attorneys.name: Robin Hood
attorneys.practice_type: Veterans' Benefits Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robin Hood is a former Rating Veteran Service Representative (also called an "RVSR" or "claims adjudicator") with over five years of experience with the United States Department of Veterans Affairs. He brings an insider's perspective and understanding to the Morgan & Morgan team regarding the complicated and sometimes frustrating area of Veterans claims. When a Veteran files a claim for benefits, he would apply the laws, regulations and policies of the VA to the evidence presented to make a decision.

Mr. Hood is passionate about helping Veterans and sees it as his true calling, and in late March 2014 he decided that he could best serve Veterans by bringing his institutional knowledge to Morgan & Morgan and help represent Veterans whose claims have been wrongly denied. He is married to a disabled Air Force Veteran, so he is familiar with what it's like to be a consumer of VA services as well (such as putting up with long wait times, confusing paperwork, and frustration).

Prior to working for the VA, he attended law school at Mississippi College School of Law in Jackson, Mississippi.

Mr. Hood didn't plan on becoming a lawyer until his father passed away suddenly. His education and career up to that point was computers and telecommunications, but after dealing with the legal fallout from his father's passing, he discovered an aptitude for legal work, and he was in law school the following year.

He is married to an Air Force Veteran. They recently moved away from their downtown apartment to a home. His wife, Dana, is an artist who paints with oil and watercolor. When Robin has sufficient time and money, he can usually be found working on restoring his 1968 Pontiac Catalina or his vintage motorhome, a 1977 GMC Palm Beach. They love to go kayak fishing with the Northeast Florida chapter of Heroes On The Water, an organization that takes Veterans and First Responders fishing.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Vero Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Beckett is the partner in charge of the Estate, Probate, Trust Administration & Guardianship department, in addition to the Business Transactions department. He practices in the areas of Estate Planning, Probate and Trust Administration, as well as Real Estate, Tax Law, Business and Commercial Law.

More specifically, Beckett focuses his practice on helping families shelter their estates from estate tax as well as formulating custom estate plans tailored to specific family dynamics. He also helps carry out those estate plans when the appropriate time comes, through probate and trust administration. Ancillary to his estate planning and administration practice, Beckett facilitates real estate transactions for buyers and sellers and helps large business entities with myriad opportunities, including stock and asset sales and acquisitions.

Beckett was born and raised in Vero Beach, FL and attended the University of Florida, where he earned his bachelor’s degree in history. He attended the John Marshall Law School in Chicago, IL, where he researched Property Law and was a member of the Moot Court Honors Council. After years of practicing with high net-worth clients and large business entities, Beckett earned his LL.M. in Taxation from the University of Florida.

Beckett is President of the Indian River Estate Planning Council, a Board Member and past Treasurer of Hibiscus's Children's Center's Governing Board, a Board Member and Secretary of the Youth Sailing Foundation of Indian River County, a Member of the VNA Foundation's Planned Giving Advisory Council, a Member of the Indian River County Bar Association, a Member of the Real Property, Probate, and Trust Law Section of the Florida Bar Association, and a Member of the Tax Law Section of the Florida Bar Association. When he's not working, Beckett enjoys fishing, golfing, and spending time with his wife, daughter, and French mastiff dog.

attorneys.name: Michael K. Horowitz
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Vero Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Michael K. Horowitz is a partner at Matheson & Horowitz where he provides aggressive legal representation and compassionate counsel to people who have suffered work related injuries, occupational diseases, or repetitive trauma at work, as well as representing individuals in Social Security matters and claims before the Department of Veterans Affairs.

Born in Miami, Florida, Michael is a native Floridian who has resided on the Treasure Coast since 1989. The Matheson & Horowitz law firm only represents injured and sick individuals and does not represent employers or insurance companies. Assisting injured citizens is Michael's passion. What I love about the work that I do is we have an opportunity to help injured people who don't know about the legal system, and who truly need our assistance," Attorney Horowitz says. The insurance companies will not protect the injured worker's interests. It is essential that an injured worker have someone behind them who knows these insurance companies and their tactics. Michael has been handling these cases for over 34 years now on the Treasure Coast and throughout Florida, and knows every trick in the book.

Michael became interested in the law and justice at an early age. He attended Florida State University where he obtained a degree in political science with minor degrees in philosophy and theater, all essential ingredients to create the attorney Michael is today. Michael then attended Cooley Law School in Lansing, Michigan, where he was very active in Moot Court and won several awards and scholarships for his litigation skills.

Michael takes an aggressive approach to dealing with insurance companies and is never afraid to take a case to trial. Having tried hundreds of cases to their conclusion in his nearly 35 years of practice, and handled many appeals, Michael believes that you have to be willing to go to Court to get the best results for your client. Any lawyer can "settle" a case. But is the attorney willing to do what is necessary to get full value on the claim? Most are not.

Michael also believes that the attorney must handle the case personally to get the best results for any client. Many lawyers never even meet their client until deposition or mediation or see the light on the courthouse steps. Horowitz handles every aspect of the case personally, and is always willing to meet with a client personally to discuss their case. Injured workers are frequently in the darkest time of their life dealing with their injury, medical treatment, loss of income, etc. Having an attorney to answer their questions, or simply talk about their problems, is essential to the attorney-client relationship.

"We fight for our clients to receive the best results possible, whether by trial or settlement, to secure lost wages and medical care. At the end of the case we can see how we have helped people and made a positive impact in their lives. That's what's most gratifying for us."

Michael and his partner, Ted Matheson, formed their current law firm in 2000 with a very specific philosophy. "Large enough to meet your needs, but small enough to know we care." The office was never formed to be a case mill. We believe that representation must be personal and each case must receive the full attention it deserves to secure the best possible result.

Further, the law office of Matheson & Horowitz has an exceptional staff to assist you when you need help. "We have high standards in terms of our staff and how they communicate with our clients. We want our clients to get the information that they need in a professional manner. When the case is over, we want our clients to tell their friends and family about their positive experience at Matheson & Horowitz and that they received the best possible representation. We fight for our clients like they are our own family."

"Our names are on the door of our law office. It is very important that everything about our firm represents our commitment to our clients."

Michael has been named a Superlawyer™ by Thomson Reuters for multiple years, a recognition provided to less than 5% of the lawyers in Florida.

Michael is also very active in the community. "It is important to serve the community which has supported us." Michael is the immediate past President of Florida Workers Advocates, the leading statewide Bar organization representing injured workers. FWA is extremely active in legislation to protect injured workers. In Tallahassee, the insurance companies often fight to reduce costs by cutting benefits to injured workers. FWA fights tooth-and-nail to continue to protect and preserve injured workers rights and benefits.

Michael is the founder and immediate past President of the Robert D. McAliley Inns of Court, an ethics and professionalism Bar on the Treasure Coast and Palm Beaches, an organization that breeds comradery among lawyers, and which mentors young lawyers.

Michael has also been active on the Sunrise Theatre Board of Directors, Foundation Board and Advisory Board since the theater's inception, and remains passionate about it. He and his wife, Rhonda, along with their two daughters, live locally and work to give back to the community where they live. Michael is also and avid golfer and amateur chef.

Contact Michael today to discuss your claim at 772-569-2667 or click here to email Michael.

attorneys.name: Jesse Hoyer Estes
attorneys.practice_type: Education Fraud Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jesse Hoyer is a founding member of Hoyer Law Group, PLLC. Jesse works in the firm's Tampa, Florida office where she oversees the False Claims Act qui tam division, with a focus on education fraud.

Jesse comes to Hoyer Law Group after nearly a decade at James Hoyer, P.A., where she also prosecuted numerous qui tam cases in the education fraud arena, earning herself a reputation as one of the leading authorities in for-profit college whistleblower cases.

She has successfully guided clients in their battles against these entities, including EDMC, one of the largest for-profit college systems in the country, Corinthian Colleges, which ultimately was forced to shutter its campuses, and Ed4Mil, a company that targeted active duty military and veterans to get their Tuition Assistance and G.I. Bill dollars.

In addition to for-profit college cases, she focuses her practice on healthcare fraud and defense contractor fraud cases.

Jesse is a member of the Ferguson-White Inn of Court, an organization dedicated to fostering ethics and integrity in the legal profession. At the University of Florida, Jesse received her undergraduate degrees in Criminology (B.A., 2006) and Psychology (B.S., 2006), and her law degree with honors (J.D., 2009). In law school, Jesse focused her attention on the practice of international law and spent one summer abroad studying international business law and white-collar crime in Paris and Montpellier, France. She was actively involved in the Criminal Law Society and the International Law Society. She interned in the felony division at the Public Defender's Office, Thirteenth Judicial Circuit in Tampa and conducted legal research for the Law Offices of Gilbert A. Schaffnit in Gainesville, Florida.

While at U.F., Jesse was an active, competitive horseback rider and traveler. Now that she's back in Tampa, Jesse still enjoys being as active as possible. In 2010, she picked up distance running as a hobby. To date, she has completed more than forty half marathons and six full marathons. She's also tried her hand at several sprint triathlons around the Tampa area. When she can squeeze some free time in between training runs, Jesse loves to watch football-especially her Gators, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Jesse is licensed to practice in Florida state courts and the Middle District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Robert C. Hubbard
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Coverage Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robert C. Hubbard is a civil litigation and appellate attorney whose practice focuses on Insurance Coverage, Unfair Insurance Practices, and Insurer Bad Faith. He has extensive experience representing policyholders in first and third-party coverage and bad faith disputes involving commercial general liability, directors and officers' liability, professional liability, cybercrime, as well as other personal and commercial lines policies. He also has extensive experience litigating matters involving catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death, products liability, construction defect, and professional malpractice.

Robert frequently serves as personal counsel for individual and commercial policyholders facing potential excess exposure due to the actions of their liability insurers or insurance brokers. He also serves as co-counsel in complex cases and provides trial support and other assistance, including strategies for maximizing insurance coverage and potential appellate issues.

Originally from Asheville, North Carolina, Robert graduated from Furman University with a Bachelor of Arts and received his Juris Doctor, cum laude, from Stetson University College of Law, where he was a member of the Stetson Law Review. Prior to joining the Vaka Law Group, he was a partner at a statewide defense firm where he represented individuals, businesses, and insurers in complex matters involving catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death, construction defect, products liability, professional liability, as well as insurance coverage and bad faith claims.

attorneys.name: Zachary Hudson
attorneys.practice_type: Business Torts Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Zachary Hudson is an attorney in the West Palm Beach office of the Morgan & Morgan Business Trial Group. Mr. Hudson concentrates his practice on complex commercial litigation, including business torts, probate disputes, employment matters, and securities arbitration. He believes that contingency litigation fosters a strong partnership between attorney and client, providing for the most efficient and effective representation.

Prior to joining the Business Trial Group, Mr. Hudson worked in law firms specializing in employment law, family law, and creditors' rights. Apart from the legal field, he has worked in construction, farming, communications, and in the service industry. Mr. Hudson uses his insight gained from his varied experiences to see issues from different perspectives, allowing him to understand his clients' needs and how to best achieve favorable results.

Born and raised in Palm Beach County, Mr. Hudson is dedicated to helping clients in the community who have been wronged. After graduating from Dreyfoos School of the Arts in West Palm Beach, he received his Bachelor of Arts in English and History from the University of Florida. He went on to earn his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Florida, where he graduated with honors in the top 15 percent of his class, making the Dean's List every semester. While in law school, Mr. Hudson received the book award for legal writing. He also served on the executive board of the law school's Real Property Law Association and was involved in the Christian Legal Society.

In his free time, Mr. Hudson enjoys spending time with his wife, playing music, and taking his dog to the beach.

attorneys.name: Jonathan Huffman
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan Huffman is an experienced complex commercial litigation attorney in Morgan & Morgan's Business Trial Group.

After earning an MBA from the University of Miami and a law degree from Indiana University, Mr. Huffman began his career at a defense litigation boutique in Indiana, where he gained substantial trial experience for a young attorney, working with renowned trial lawyers. He then spent the next seven years at a premier Jacksonville, Florida law firm, practicing commercial litigation. There, Mr. Huffman regularly had the privilege of handling a variety of significant matters, often involving millions of dollars, in Florida's state and federal courts, and before administrative bodies. In early 2015, Mr. Huffman transitioned to another respected Jacksonville firm to lead its Business Law practice group. Much of Mr. Huffman's experience is on the plaintiff's side, litigating and collecting large judgments against insurers, sophisticated corporate entities, and wealthy but reluctant debtors.

Morgan & Morgan's "success fee" (contingent fee) model means your claim will be evaluated according to its merit, not based upon your willingness or ability to pay exorbitant hourly fees. The beauty of the success fee model is that our interests are better aligned with yours. When we take action on your behalf, you can be sure we believed the action was absolutely necessary to pursue your recovery, because we do not get paid unless you make a recovery. Too often, under the traditional hourly billing model, the attorneys' fees paid by both sides at the end of the day should have been enough to settle the case twice, and neither side is happy. If you have a business claim that could benefit from the strength of Morgan & Morgan, and the collective expertise of its Business Trial Group, please call us.

attorneys.name: Mark A. Hughes
attorneys.practice_type: Personal injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mark A. Hughes Esq. is the proud founder and owner of Hughes Law Group. While born in Voorhees, New Jersey, he grew up in Tampa, Florida. Mark attended The University of South Florida (USF) where he received his undergraduate degree in Business Finance in 2009. While attending USF and for a short time thereafter, he gained volumes of valuable experience in the world of business finance, banking, and insurance.

Mark completed his legal education in Atlanta, GA John Marshall Law School in 2014, earning himself a Juris Doctorate. During his last year in law school, he interned with Fulton County District Attorney’s Office, where he observed many trial and criminal hearings, learned several important aspects of criminal law and gained practical experience in case preparation.

After law school, Mark decided to come back to his home state to practice law in Tampa, Florida. Shortly after his return, he embarked on a journey to serve his country in the United States Coast Guard. He also gained valuable experience working with a mid-size personal injury firm for several years before taking a leap of faith to establish Hughes Law Group. Mark is known in the community as a charismatic, down to earth individual with the spirit to help anyone down on their luck. He is also a family man who enjoys traveling, sports, entertainment, and living for the experiences of life.

attorneys.name: Michael J. Humphries
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
I am a dedicated personal injury attorney with a passion for helping individuals navigate the challenges that come with injury and loss caused by someone else’s negligence. I firmly believe that a successful case starts with building a strong relationship with my clients, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and empowered throughout the legal process. My clients appreciate my personal approach and commitment to being there when they need it most.

A 2010 graduate of the University of North Florida, I went on to earn my J.D. from Washington and Lee University School of Law in 2013. My career began with a diverse range of experience, working as in-house counsel for a Fortune 500 insurance company and then at law firms defending insurance companies and major corporations. For the last several years, my practice has solely focused on advocating for individuals who have been harmed by others’ negligence, recovering millions for my clients.

My experience doing defense work gives me valuable insight into how insurance companies and large corporations think and operate. This unique perspective allows me to effectively advocate for my clients, maximizing the value of their claims and ensuring they get the compensation they deserve.

In my free time, I enjoy unwinding by inshore fishing or hitting the golf course. Most importantly, I value spending time with my family and being active in my community.
