attorneys.name: Warren W. Lindsey
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Maitland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Warren W. Lindsey is a Florida Bar Board-Certified Criminal Trial Lawyer and one of Central Florida’s most respected criminal defense attorneys. He is admitted to practice before the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida, and all Florida state courts. Mr. Lindsey has practiced law continuously in Central Florida since 1980, following his graduation from the University of Florida College of Law, where he graduated cum laude and with honors.

Mr. Lindsey represents clients in a wide range of criminal matters, including felony, misdemeanor, and traffic offenses, and is frequently retained to represent lawyers and licensed professionals in disciplinary proceedings before The Florida Bar and the Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR).

Honors & Recognition

Mr. Lindsey’s excellence in criminal defense has been repeatedly recognized by his peers and independent legal organizations. He has been named Orlando Magazine’s “Lawyer of the Year” (Criminal Defense – Non-White Collar) and has been selected as one of Orlando Magazine’s Best Lawyers an extraordinary fourteen (14) times since 2010. He has also been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America® continuously since 2009.

Additional honors include:

Florida Trend’s Florida Legal Elite (2013–2022; including designation as a leading Criminal Law attorney)

Florida Super Lawyers (2009–2026)

AV Preeminent® Rating by Martindale-Hubbell (highest rating for legal ability and ethics)

Client Champion Award, recognizing exceptional ethics and client service

AVVO Rating: 10.0 (Top Attorney – Criminal Defense)

These distinctions reflect the high level of professional respect Mr. Lindsey has earned among judges, fellow attorneys, and clients alike.

Leadership & Bar Service

Mr. Lindsey has devoted decades of service to leadership roles within both state and local bar organizations. He previously served two separate terms on The Florida Bar Board of Governors and was elected President of The Florida Bar Young Lawyers Division. His service to The Florida Bar includes leadership and committee roles involving criminal procedure, disciplinary rules, legislation, and continuing legal education.

At the local level, Mr. Lindsey served as President of the Orange County Bar Association, following years of service on its Executive Council and as Chair of multiple committees, including Criminal Law, Judicial Relations, and Fee Arbitration. He also served as President of the Orange County Bar Association Foundation.

Mr. Lindsey is a past President of the Central Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and has served on its Board of Directors. He is also an active member of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, including service on legislative committees.

Beyond bar leadership, Mr. Lindsey is a former President of the Seminole County Legal Aid Society, a graduate of Leadership Orlando, and a graduate of Leadership Winter Park. He also served on the Grievance Committee for the U.S. District Court, Middle District of Florida.

attorneys.practice_type: Maritime Law Lawyers in Coral Gables, FL
attorneys.bio:
Charles R. Lipcon is the firm’s founding attorney and partner, with more than 40 years of experience handling personal injury, cruise line sexual assault, and wrongful death claims. Mr. Lipcon serves as head counsel and focuses on developing strategy for complex maritime legal matters.

While his team of maritime attorneys concentrates primarily on admiralty, maritime law, and litigation against cruise lines, Mr. Lipcon also has substantial experience handling aviation disasters, automobile accidents, commercial torts, and class action lawsuits.

Mr. Lipcon has been a member of the Florida Bar since 1971 and operating his own law practice since 1972. Mr. Lipcon has a Martindale Hubbell rating of AV, the highest rating for legal ability and professional and ethical standards. He is a member of the Florida Bar Association, the American Trial Lawyers Association, the Dade County Bar Association, the Florida Admiralty Trial Lawyers Association and is also a member of Mensa.

Mr. Lipcon is admitted to practice before all State and Federal Courts in Florida, the U.S. Supreme Court, the U. S. Court of Federal Claims, the U.S. Court of Appeals, Fifth Circuit, the United States District Court for the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, and the U.S. District Court, Southern District of Texas.

Graduating from the University of Miami with a B.A. in 1968 and a J.D. in 1971, Mr. Lipcon is a National Merit Scholar.

attorneys.name: Jennifer Lipinski
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Jupiter, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jennifer Lipinski is an attorney with a civil trial practice dedicated to the pursuit of justice for Florida’s injured with a focus on personal injury and sexual abuse. This also includes representing victims of crime, automobile accidents, medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, and wrongful death, among other areas.

Ms. Lipinski has been lead counsel or co-counsel for several million-dollar verdicts and settlements. Most recently, Ms. Lipinski was lead counsel in a sexual abuse case that resulted in a $2,600,000 verdict against a rehabilitation center who failed to supervise their employee/agent. Ms. Lipinski also helped secure the largest settlement of record at the time against a government entity – $1,800,000 – following the wrongful death of a mentally disabled teen. In 2014, she was a member of the trial team who obtained a $21,000,000 verdict for the wrongful death of a 37-year-old mother and wife who tragically died due to the medical malpractice of a popular laboratory company. She frequently tries cases to jury verdict and is not afraid to take on corporations or defendants who harm her clients.

Ms. Lipinski has been recognized as a Best Lawyer, Rising Star Super Lawyer, and one of Florida Trend’s Legal Elite “Up and Comers” – a section recognizing the top 2.5% of lawyers in Florida. She has been identified by the National Trial Lawyers Top 40 under 40. Palm Beach Illustrated also recognized her as a Top Lawyer in the field of personal injury for both 2018 and 2019. In 2018, the Florida Association for Women Lawyer’s Palm Beach County Chapter awarded Ms. Lipinski with the inaugural Young Lawyer of the Year award, which was presented by the Honorable Justice Pariente, a former Florida Supreme Court Justice. In 2019, Ms. Lipinski was awarded a Certificate of Recognition by the American Association for Justice or her contributions to the organization.

Ms. Lipinski currently serves as a Board of Governor representing the state of Florida for the American Association for Justice (AAJ), an organization of nearly 20,000 lawyers around the country. Ms. Lipinski is also a past chair of the New Lawyer Division, which serves the needs of 5,000 newer lawyers around the United States. Ms. Lipinski is a graduate of the prestigious Leadership Academy and currently serves as subcommittee chair for the Membership Outreach for the Membership Oversight Committee and Membership Committee for the Women’s Caucus. Ms. Lipinski also serves as a Board of Governor for the Florida Justice Association.

Ms. Lipinski obtained her law degree from Michigan State University, cum laude and was recognized as a member of the Dean’s List. She earned a certificate from the Geoffrey Fieger Trial Practice Institute, a nationally renowned two-year litigation program, and served as a teaching assistant for two professors. While in law school, Ms. Lipinski was involved with moot court, earning 1st place in the Appellate All-School Competition, and competed at Harvard and UCLA in national law competitions. She also served as an Associate Editor for the Journal of Medicine and Law.

She obtained her bachelor’s degree in political science from the University of Central Florida (UCF) in 2008 with a concentration in American Politics & Policy and a minor in Legal Studies. She was elected to serve as a Senator for the College of Health and Public Affairs and to serve as President Pro Tempore. Ms. Lipinski was also a LEAD Scholar, a member of the Alpha Xi Delta sorority, Phi Alpha Delta pre-law fraternity, Pi Sigma Alpha honor society, and the National Society of Collegiate Scholars. Ms. Lipinski was admitted to practice in Florida in 2012. She is a member of the Florida Bar, the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida, and the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit.

attorneys.name: Alexsandra A. Litowsky
attorneys.practice_type: Car Crashes Lawyers in Davie, FL
attorneys.bio:
Alexsandra “Alex” Litowsky joined Rosen Injury Law, P.A. in March 2021 as an associate litigation attorney. With her, she brings experience to the litigation aspects and strategies of cases involving Fort Lauderdale car accidents, tractor-trailer and other truck crashes, as well as slip/trip and falls and other premises liability cases.

Ms. Litowsky graduated from Montclair State University with a B.S. in Biological Sciences and Education. While working full-time as a marketer and legal case manager for a medical provider and surgery center, she completed her Juris Doctorate, magna cum laude, at Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law (“NSU Law”), where she graduated first in the evening division in May 2020.

During law school, Alex excelled both in and out of the classroom and was the recipient of numerous accolades. She was a member of NSU Law’s Trial Association, serving on the executive board as Vice President of Teams. She went on to represent NSU Law in multiple Trial Competitions, including the Buffalo Niagara National Mock Trial Competition in New York, where she and her team finished in first place, bringing NSU Law a National Title. During the championship round of that competition, she received the award for “Best Advocate”. In addition, Alex coauthored the case file Carter v. Colonial Casino & Racetrack, which went on to be used as the problem in the “Capitol City Challenge”, a national mock trial competition hosted by the American University Washington College of Law in Washington, D.C. As a result of her advocacy skills, Alexsandra was inducted into the prestigious Order of the Barristers, an award given to the best advocates for that graduating year.

Alex’s other academic accomplishments include receiving numerous Cali Awards for obtaining the highest grade in classes, receiving the Student Bar Association Award for Academic Excellence, as well as the Broward County Women Lawyers’ Association Silver Star Award, and being named NSU Law’s Student of the Year for 2020.

Alex is a Fort Lauderdale injury lawyer dedicated to the relentless and zealous advocacy of those who have been injured, ensuring each victim receives the justice he or she is entitled to under the law.

When she is not fighting for justice, Alex enjoys spending time with friends and family, lots of laughs, the ocean, good food, and of course, Leia “Larry” Litowsky, her “litigating” French Bulldog.

attorneys.name: Charles W. Littell
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Littell has devoted his career to assisting clients in their estate planning and in the difficult circumstances following the death of a family member. He brings over 40 years extensive experience in estate administration and complex disputes involving wills, trusts, estates, and guardianships. Mr. Littell is AV-Rated by Martindale-Hubbell, the highest peer review rating attainable from one of the nation's most distinguished and oldest lawyer rating services.

He received his J.D. with honors in 1973 from the University of Florida, where he was an Executive Editor of the University of Florida Law Review and a member of Phi Alpha Delta. Mr. Littell served in the United States Air Force from 1967 to 1971.

Mr. Littell is admitted to the Florida and Montana Bars, and he is a member of the Real Property, Probate and Trust Law Section of the Florida Bar. Mr. Littell served as an Adjunct Professor of Law at Nova University in 1975.

He is also a devoted husband, father, and grandfather. When time permits, he enjoys hiking the mountains and kayaking the rivers of northwest Montana with his friends and family.

attorneys.name: Kramer A. Litvak
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Transactions Lawyers in Pensacola, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kramer Litvak is a board certified tax attorney practicing with the firm of Litvak Beasley Wilson & Ball, LLP and is AV rated by Martindale.com. Kramer holds a Master of Laws (LL.M.) degree in taxation from the University of Florida College of Law. He received his law degree from Mercer University School of Law and his Bachelor of Arts Degree from Washington & Lee University. Prior to attending law school, Kramer worked as a Legislative Assistant to United States Representative Earl Hutto.

Kramer was admitted to the Georgia Bar and the Florida Bar in 1992. He concentrates in the areas of tax law, business acquisitions, commercial transactions, business law, estate planning, asset protection planning, probate, trust administration, and real estate. He is a past member of the Florida Bar's Grievance Committee for the 1st Judicial Circuit. Kramer was the 2003/2004 president of the Escambia-Santa Rosa Bar Association and is past president of the Young Lawyers Section of the local bar. Kramer is also past president of the Northwest Florida Estate Planning Council.

Kramer's community service activities include being the past President of the Northwest Florida YMCA, serving as past attorney for the Pensacola Bay Area Chamber of Commerce, a member of the Pensacola Junior College Foundation board of governors, and a past member of the board of directors of the Northwest Florida Community Foundation, Inc.

Kramer is a graduate of the Leadership Pensacola Class of 1996, and is a member of other professional associations, including the Real Property, Probate & Trust Law Section and the Tax Section of the Florida Bar.

attorneys.bio: Alexei has been a member of the Florida Bar and a licensed attorney for 9 years. attorneys.name: Edward M. Livingston
attorneys.practice_type: Copyright Law Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Edward M. Livingston is the founder of the Livingston Firm and is a Registered U.S. Patent Attorney with more than 30 years of experience in patent law and other areas of intellectual property law, including trademarks/servicemarks, trade dress, trade secrets, copyrights, franchising and litigation. Ed is also Board Certified by the Florida Bar in intellectual property law.

attorneys.name: Ada G. Llerena
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ada Gloria Llerena is a native Floridian born and raised in Miami by Cuban parents. Her lifelong passion for the law began as a child while watching Perry Mason reruns on her black and white television set. Propelled by her bilingual family's love of culture, arts, literature music and learning, Ada graduated from Southwest Miami Senior High School 1980 while participating in the high school dual enrollment program at Miami-Dade College. Ada then graduated first from the University Of Miami School Of Business with a BBA in International Finance & Marketing in 1983, and again from the University Of Miami School Of Law with a JD in 1987.

She became licensed to practice law in Florida in 1989 and also in the District Of Columbia in 1991.

Because of Ada's strong bilingual skills, it wasn't long before her career took both exciting and interesting turns. After first working for the United States Equal Employment Opportunity Commission shortly after her graduation from law school, a thoughtful mentor at the EEOC gave her name to a Univision television producer who began inviting her to various nationally and internationally viewed spanish language television programs to educate the spanish speaking public about legal issues. Not long afterwards, Ada began working as General Counsel for Editorial America, the leading spanish language publisher of popular magazines such as Vanidades, Cosmopolitan En Español, Marie Claire and many others. Working with the company's nearly 45 subsidiaries around Latin and Central America set the stage for the development of an international clientele later in her career. Her television appearances continued and soon the issue of Family Law began to emerge.

When Ada began her law practice in early 1997, Family Law came calling in the form of her very first case: a paternity case that quickly turned into a parental kidnapping case. As in the old Clairol commercial "And she told 2 friends and so on and so on", Ada quickly found herself representing many clients with family law issues of all sorts ranging from divorces and paternity actions to adoptions and gestational surrogacy. And so her Family Law practice came into being and Ada's clients came from all walks of life and every country imaginable. During the early years of her law practice, Ada became fascinated not only with getting her clients what they needed through litigation but also with the emerging need for negotiation to minimize legal fees. Ada became a Florida Supreme Court Certified Family and County Civil Mediator in 2005 and a Circuit Civil Mediator in 2009.

Ada presently continues with her Family litigation and mediation practice as well as frequent television and radio appearances to educate the public about legal rights and issues.

Ada and her husband, Manuel Mari, a Miami Real Estate and Civil lawyer, spend their leisure time enjoying Miami's diverse culture, arts, music and literature as well as spending time with their families.

attorneys.firm_name: Malka & Kravitz - Your Construction Law Firm
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Carlos Lloreda is an experienced commercial litigator who has resolved cases at every stage of a case from pre-suit to trial and even post judgment. He has represented individuals, insurance companies, financial institutions, publicly traded companies, and small businesses, including all types of construction companies. His practice specializes in the areas of construction and commercial litigation. Mr. Lloreda has experience litigating cases involving general business disputes, real estate litigation, and construction defects including related issues such as permitting, performance, licensing, contracting, payment, and collection. Mr. Lloreda prides himself on vigorous advocacy at all phases of litigation, including mediation, and arbitration throughout the state of Florida.

Prior to joining Malka & Kravitz, P.A., Mr. Lloreda worked at large, small, and medium-sized law firms with differing areas of expertise. He prides himself in using his well-rounded legal knowledge to obtain the most cost-effective outcomes for his clients. Mr. Lloreda obtained both a dual bachelor of arts degree, and Juris Doctorate from Florida State University. During law school he was a legal intern for a judge in the Eleventh Circuit and a Certified Legal Intern for the States' Attorney Office in the Second Circuit where he first chaired his first bench trial.

Jack currently serves as an elder at Margaret Street Church of Christ.

Jack's hobbies include golf, hiking, pheasant hunting, and following Florida State football.

attorneys.name: Bryan L. Loeffler
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Bryan Loeffler is an associate with the Livingston Firm and is a Registered U.S. Patent Attorney who concentrates his practice in patent law and other areas of intellectual property law, including trademarks/servicemarks, trade dress, trade secrets, copyrights, and litigation.

Bryan graduated from The University of Massachusetts with a Bachelor of Science and received his legal education at Nova Southeastern University where he graduated with honors. Prior to joining The Livingston Firm, Bryan gained courtroom and trial experience while working at the Public Defender's Office for the 20th Judicial Circuit of Florida.

Bryan has an educational background in biology and chemistry as well as business administration. Although Bryan's technical educational background focused mainly in the area of science, he also has extensive experience preparing and prosecuting patent applications covering complex mechanical and electrical devices. In addition, Bryan's business background allows him to advise entrepreneurs starting new businesses on protecting their ideas and concepts as well on avoiding liability from possible infringement of others.

As an Eagle Scout, Bryan has always been involved in the community with his work as a former volunteer firefighter and emergency medical technician and his current work with various charities throughout Southwest Florida.

PRACTICE AREAS

Patents: Bryan is experienced in all aspects of patent prosecution including performing patentability searches and rendering opinions as to the availability of patent protection for an invention, preparing and filing patent applications as well as prosecuting patent applications before the United States Patent and Trademark Office. Bryan also negotiates and prepares patent licensing agreements and renders legal opinions regarding patent infringement and patent validity. Some of the areas Bryan has prepared and prosecuted patent applications in include, but are not limited to, telecommunications, power saving devices, fuel efficiency devices, arts and crafts, boating, fishing, golfing, plants, construction, computer software, medical devices, diesel mechanics, environmental clean-up and business methods.

Licensing & Marketing - Bryan assists clients beyond the patent process by helping clients actually get their ideas and products to the marketplace and on the store shelf. That may be by submitting a client's idea to companies for licensing and negotiating licenses on the client's behalf or by assisting clients in dealing with third parties such as manufacturers, designers, website developers as necessary to ensure that the client is protected every step of the way.

Trademarks/Servicemarks Bryan is experienced in all aspects of the trademarking/servicemarking process including performing trademark/servicemark searches and rendering opinions as to whether trademark/servicemark protection is available for marks as well as filing and prosecuting federal, State of Florida , and international trademark/servicemark applications. In addition, Bryan negotiates and prepares trademark/servicemark licenses on behalf of his clients.

Copyrights Bryan has prepared and filed copyright applications for his clients in a variety of areas including building designs, artwork, manuscripts, websites, artwork, jewelry, musical works, movies, and computer software and is well versed in the laws regarding copyright infringement. Bryan is also experienced in negotiating copyright licenses.

Trade Secrets Bryan is able to advise his clients how to protect trade secrets, which include client lists, formulas, devices, and other sensitive information, all of which is confidential and not generally known to the public or is not subject to protection under patent law.

Intellectual Property Litigation Bryan is available to assist his clients in all aspects of intellectual property litigation.

BAR ADMISSIONS

Florida, 2004

U.S. District Court, Middle District of Florida

Registered U.S. Patent Attorney, United States Patent and Trademark Office

attorneys.name: Erica L. Loeffler
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
Erica Loeffler is an associate with The Livingston Firm. She concentrates her practice in the area of intellectual property law, including trademarks/servicemarks, copyrights, trade secrets, domain name disputes, franchising, and intellectual property litigation.

Erica graduated from Webster University with a degree in Business Management and received her legal education at Nova Southeastern University where she served as Articles Editor on Law Review and graduated Magna Cum Laude .

Erica enjoys working with business owners to expand their businesses throughout Florida and the rest of the country by guiding them through the franchising process, which includes protecting their business concepts as well as protecting their product names and business names through trademark/servicemark law.

Trademarks/Servicemarks Erica is experienced in all aspects of the trademarking/servicemarking process including performing trademark/servicemark searches and rendering opinions as to whether trademark/servicemark protection is available for a mark as well as filing and prosecuting federal, State of Florida , and international trademark/servicemark applications. Erica is also experienced in handling opposition and cancellation proceedings before the United States Trademark Trial and Appeal Board. In addition, Erica negotiates and prepares trademark/servicemark licenses on behalf of her clients.

Copyrights Erica prepares and files copyright applications for her clients in a variety of areas including artwork, manuscripts, websites, artwork, jewelry, musical works, movies, and computer software and is well versed in the laws regarding copyright infringement. Erica is also experienced in negotiating copyright licenses.

Trade Secrets Erica has handled several litigation matters involving theft of trade secrets and is able to advise her clients how to protect trade secrets, which include client lists, formulas, devices, and so forth which are confidential and not generally known to the public or are not subject to protection under patent law.

Domain Name Disputes Erica is experienced in handling domain name disputes under the rules promulgated by the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN).

Franchising Erica assists her clients in the growth and expansion of their businesses into new territories through franchising. Erica is very knowledgeable in the laws of franchise which are governed by the Federal Trade Commission as well as by the individual states.

Intellectual Property Litigation Erica is available to assist her clients in all aspects of intellectual property litigation and has previously handled litigation matters involving trademark/servicemark infringement; copyright infringement of building plans, websites, photographs, and artwork; contract disputes; and theft of trade secrets.

attorneys.name: Jay S. London
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jay S. London is a dedicated personal injury attorney at Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A., where he passionately advocates for individuals affected by negligence in a broad range of injury cases, including auto accidents, slip and falls, and negligent security. Inspired early in his life by the profound impact a serious injury had on a family member, Mr. London approaches every case with deep personal empathy and unwavering commitment.

Mr. London earned his Juris Doctor from Nova Southeastern University Law Center in 2014 and holds a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from Florida Atlantic University. That same year, he was admitted to the Florida Bar and has since built a reputation for delivering exceptional results—successfully resolving hundreds of cases, with numerous six-figure recoveries and several exceeding $1,000,000. In recognition of his achievements, he is a lifetime member of the prestigious Million Dollar Advocates Forum®.

Beyond his legal practice, Mr. London is deeply devoted to community engagement and social impact. He contributes his time through pro bono work and volunteers with local organizations that support individuals and families affected by personal injury. His commitment to continuing education and active involvement in professional associations reflects his dedication to staying current on legal developments and best practices.

Through his compassionate advocacy and pursuit of justice, Jay S. London continues to be a valued asset to both his clients and the legal team at Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A., consistently delivering meaningful outcomes with integrity and care.

Awards and Honors

She is married and the proud mother of two young children."

attorneys.name: John E. Long Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Naples, FL
attorneys.bio:
I have been in practice since 1965 specializing in family law related matters exclusively since 1977. What I think most distinguishes our firm from our colleagues is that we practice divorce law clinically/humanistically. The clinical part is easy to understand and that would involve resolving all the property and liability distributions, the issue of alimony, the issue of a parenting plan, child support and finally some collateral issues such as life insurance, medical insurance and other forms of collateral to secure the awards received by our client or the opposing spouse. I do not have a male or female preference in the clients, rather I accept those clients who are primarily interested in restoring their sense of self worth through the process of divorce so that when all is said and done the client's dignity is restored to the level he or she wants it. That, by the way, is the humanistic approach that we adopt in the dealing with our clients. In conclusion, please do not interpret our desire to practice in this fashion as a weakness. That would be a tactical mistake.

On behalf of property owners, individuals and business entities, Edgar handles cases from start to finish. His work usually begins during the government’s planning stage, in order to educate his clients, communicate with the government, engage the right experts, and proactively address issues that may otherwise prevent his clients from recovering full compensation. Edgar ensures that his clients receive highly skilled and responsive legal services every step of the way, and his work is only complete after his clients have been paid in full and all related legal issues have been resolved, either through negotiations or a jury trial.

Born and raised in New York City, Edgar worked as an Assistant District Attorney in Manhattan prior to becoming a Florida eminent domain lawyer.

attorneys.name: Edward A. Lopez
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Hollywood, FL
attorneys.bio:
People often ask me "How can you defend someone knowing they are guilty?" My response always is that not everyone is guilty of what they have been arrested for, and I am a believer in the constitution and the rights of the accused. I also know that bad things happen to good people.

Regardless of your background or past history being arrested is a stressful and traumatic event. You face the loss of freedom and being branded a convicted criminal. I have dedicated my law career to defending people accused of crimes because I understand that bad things do indeed happen to good people. Everyone accused of a crime has a loved one that will suffer if they go to jail and are even convicted of the crime. A spouse, child, other loved one, and the accused themselves suffer when they are arrested and accused of a crime.

I am a believer in the principle that the government’s power must be subject to a system where guilt must be proven. In that sense, it makes it even less likely that an innocent person will ever be convicted for a crime they did not commit. "It is better that ten guilty person go free then one innocent person suffer" are the words the English jurist William Blackstone in his infinite wisdom uttered in 1765. Those words are true as everyone is entitled to a dedicated and zealous defense when they are accused of a crime. It’s what makes our system the best system in the world as every accused person is treated the same with the assurance that the government must prove their guilt "beyond a reasonable doubt", and it is the government that has this complete and total burden. When the government's power is put to the test it makes even less likely that an innocent person will unjustly be found guilty and go to jail.

I gained my trial and courtroom experience first as a public defender before opening my private practice. I have gone to jury trials and obtained Not Guilty verdicts in cases ranging from DUI to life felonies like Armed Robbery. Whether a misdemeanor or serious felony like Murder I have the experience necessary to protect your interests and obtain the best result for you. All my clients get a lawyer that will personally handle their case like they were a family member.

I am a trial attorney, member of the Florida Bar, and a Board Certified Specialist (B.C.S.) in Criminal Trial Law. I am also a member of the United States Southern District Court of Florida Bar. Whether you need an attorney to go to trial or work out the best plea bargain for you I am the attorney you want working for you. I work hard and get results. I look forward to being your attorney.

attorneys.name: Andres Lopez
attorneys.firm_name: The Andres Lopez Law Firm, PA
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Coral Springs, FL
attorneys.bio:
Andres ("Andy") Lopez decided to open this firm to provide high-quality legal representation with the personal attention each client deserves. Mr. Lopez focuses his practice on personal injury, immigration, insurance coverage disputes and commercial litigation.

Mr. Lopez began his career in one of the most prestigious law firms in Maryland, where he concentrated on complex commercial litigation and bankruptcy matters. When Mr. Lopez moved to Florida, he practiced law in top boutique firms located in Ft. Lauderdale and Miami, where he focused on professional malpractice, insurance coverage, and bankruptcy.

Mr. Lopez was born in La Paz, Bolivia, and his family moved to Washington, D.C. when he was a child. He attended the University of Maryland at College Park where he received his B.A. in Political Science and later earned his J.D. from the University of Maryland School of Law.

While attending law school, he was a member of the Moot Court Board and he served on the law journal The Business Lawyer, which is published by the Business Law Section of the American Bar Association. He was also selected to become a member of the law school's National Trial Team where he successfully participated in national mock trial competitions. As a result of his success in trial competition, Mr. Lopez was inducted into the Order of the Barristers, a national honorary society that recognizes law students who have excelled in advocacy programs.

Mr. Lopez served as a Judicial Intern with U.S. District Court Judge Paul Friedman of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia.

Through his involvement in various school and community organizations, he became active in local, state and national electoral politics. Before he attended law school, Mr. Lopez served in The White House, where he assisted with the drafting and editing of presidential speeches. Afterwards, he joined the staff of the Governor of Maryland where he assisted in developing and implementing the Governor's education policies.

Mr. Lopez is a member of the Florida Bar, the Broward County Bar Association, the Maryland Bar Association and Broward County Hispanic Bar Association. Mr. Lopez is admitted to practice law in the state courts of Florida and Maryland. He is also admitted to practice in the United States District Court for the District of Maryland and the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Lina M. Lopez
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Daytona Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Lina M. Lopez was born in Bogota, Colombia. Her family migrated to the United States in the 1975. She grew up in Tampa, Florida. She attended University of South Florida, and graduated with a degree in Criminology. After graduating college, Ms. Lopez worked for the Department of Children and Families as a child abuse investigator, then moved on to continue her education. In 1999, she began law school at St. Thomas University School of Law. She attained her Juris Doctorate degree in 2001.

Ms. Lopez began her career at a plaintiff's firm based out of the Lakeland/Tampa, Florida area. She practiced in the workers compensation and social security field, then transitioned into personal injury. She has been practicing law for twelve years as a Plaintiff's attorney in the Central Florida region. Ms. Lopez is admitted to practice before the State Courts of Florida, and the United States District Court, Middle District of Florida.

Lina Lopez is fluent in Spanish. When she's not practicing law, she enjoys watching hockey, soccer and spending time with her family.

attorneys.name: Kenneth J. Louie
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Kenneth J. Louie
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Plantation, FL
attorneys.bio:
As the fourth child in a family of five, no one understands better than Kenneth that family life is not always easy. One of his earliest memories is of his older brothers attempting to glue him to a seat by taking elaborate measures to lure him into their carefully prepared chair. Yet, those same brothers were the first to jump in to protect Kenneth if ever anyone else threatened his well-being. Kenneth recognizes that family relationships can be "sticky" at times, but he also understands the value and importance of family. Kenneth grew up on a small ranch in rural northern California that has been in his family for several generations. He worked alongside his parents and siblings on the ranch and in their family business, where he learned not only life skills but also the importance of family relationships. Kenneth came to understand firsthand that life is not always easy for families Whether financial, emotional, or otherwise, families are at times faced with concerns and need somewhere to turn for guidance and assistance. Kenneth realized at an early age that one benefit of being part of a big family is that there is always someone willing to go to bat for you when times are tough. While this is comforting, some situations require expertise or assistance from outside the family.

Throughout Kenneth's childhood, his parents instilled in him an interest in being attentive to the needs of others. His parents were especially involved in the local community volunteering with civic service projects and outreach programs sponsored by their church. This influence prompted Kenneth to volunteer during law school as a summer intern at the Siskiyou County Public Defender's Office in his California hometown. Kenneth graduated, cum laude, in 2013 from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law and knew without a doubt he belonged in a Family Law practice. Continuing with the tradition of service, Kenneth's goal is to make legal services for families accessible and affordable. He understands the importance of core values and is committed to maintaining and protecting the integrity of families by finding the best alternatives and most cost-effective means of handling each client's unique situation. Just as Kenneth has worked beside his own family for more than three decades, he will stand beside his clients and work to provide representation and legal assistance on the issues mattering most to them and their families.

attorneys.name: Evan D. Lubell
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Board Certified in Civil Trial Law by the Florida Bar

In 2011, Evan D. Lubell joined Frank Aloia and Ty Roland to lead the firm as Senior Partners. Lubell’s practice focuses on managing serious personal injury and wrongful death matters from beginning to end.

Like many Floridians, Evan was born and raised in the Boroughs of New York City and made his way south to Fort Myers in the Spring of 1994. During the next 10 years, Lubell gained a reputation as a formidable trial attorney in cases of personal injury and wrongful death and rose to become a partner in a well-known Cape Coral law firm. During this time, Lubell increasingly took on injury and death cases that other attorneys deemed, “too complicated” or the corporation at fault “too powerful.” Facing a growing number of trials against industry giants, Lubell teamed up with Ty Roland who, like Lubell, was gaining a reputation for excellence in the courtroom. This collaboration resulted in a string of stunning trial victories for Lubell’s clients with awards in the millions of dollars—and that partnership in justice continues to today.

Awards & Distinctions

In 2017, according to TopVerdict.com, Lubell and his co-counsel, Ty Roland, won the No. 1 Premises Liability Verdict in Florida. The Estate of Dominguez v. Florida Power & Light Co. case was fought and won after the Dominquez family lost their 15-year-old son who was electrocuted while climbing bamboo near power lines in 2011. Among his other notable successes, he refused to accept a ridiculously low settlement offer from Walmart regarding a client’s slip-and-fall accident. He took the matter to court and, along with his legal partner, was able to secure one of the largest verdicts ever awarded in Lee County for this type of claim. He has also obtained a verdict of $2.1 in a premises liability case for a child who suffered a traumatic brain injury and a $2 million verdict for a client wrongfully terminated because of his disabilities.

Lubell is a true student of the law and of the corporations and insurance companies against which he battles on behalf of his clients. Routinely during a court hearing or trial, Lubell has shown judges and juries just how little such businesses know about their own policies for employee conduct and their customer’s safety. Lubell is masterful at sorting out half-truths from the whole truth and in ensuring justice wins out over corporate power and influence.

Involvement & Education

Lubell is a past president of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA) Southwest Florida Chapter, the Southwest Florida Trial Lawyers Association, the Cape Coral Bar Association and an active member of numerous other legal organizations, including the Florida Justice Association and the Lee County Bar Association. Lubell is a trusted resource for attorneys who have taken on especially complex premises liability and death cases, and has co-counseled around the state. He frequently lectures and hosts complimentary seminars for local doctors and other professionals, keeping them up to date on important issues affecting their practices. He has achieved Board Certification in Civil Trial by the Florida Bar and joins the less than 1% of all civil trial attorneys in Florida to earn the distinction.

attorneys.name: Chad Sumner Lucas
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Lucas grew up in a small town south of Chicago. He attended high school in Fort Lauderdale and earned a baseball scholarship to Mercer University in Macon Georgia. He then transferred to Florida State University, graduating with a degree in Political Science in 1992. Mr. Lucas attended Cumberland School of Law at Samford University in Birmingham, Alabama. While in law school, he was the winner of the Robert F. Donworth Moot Court Competition, Albert P. Brewer Client Counseling Competition and was member of the Henry Upson Sims Moot Court Board. Mr. Lucas graduated in 1997.

After law school, Mr. Lucas started practice in Tallahassee, Florida as a trial attorney in a small defense firm. In 2000, Mr. Lucas moved to Orlando and became a trial attorney for one of the leading products liability and personal injury defense firms in the United States. While at the firm, he represented Fortune 500 companies, including Ford Motor Company and Walt Disney World.

During his legal career, Mr. Lucas also had the privilege to represent hundreds of individuals, companies and communities whose homes, condominiums and businesses were damaged from storms that struck Florida in 2004 and 2005. Mr. Lucas recently was a trial attorney with one of the largest insurance carriers in the United States, where he tried cases from Jacksonville, Florida to Vero Beach, Florida. Mr. Lucas has now joined Morgan & Morgan in its Orlando office and has the honor and privilege of representing individuals who have been injured through the negligence of others.

Mr. Lucas is admitted to practice in the State of Florida, the Northern District of Florida, the Middle District of Florida, the Southern District of Florid and the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals.

Mr. Lucas has one son and enjoys spending his time golfing and watching Florida State football and baseball games.

attorneys.name: Antonio Luciano Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Raised in Jacksonville, Mr. Luciano takes pride in representing the people of his hometown as well as those throughout the State of Florida. Mr. Luciano attended Terry Parker High School before leaving Jacksonville for Tallahassee, where he earned his Bachelor of Arts in Advertising and his Juris Doctor from the Florida State University. While in law school, he was a member of the Florida State College of Law Moot Court Team and competed nationally in writing and oral advocacy competitions. Antonio also earned the Criminal Law Book Award for outstanding academic achievement. After graduating with honors, Mr. Luciano returned home to join Morgan & Morgan in the firm's Jacksonville office.

Since 2013, he has focused primarily on litigating on behalf of Florida residents and their families against the major U.S. tobacco companies for the negligence, fraud, and conspiracy committed by them beginning in the 1950s. In that time, Mr. Luciano has also gained experience in general personal injury litigation and has assisted in both Engle Tobacco and medical malpractice trials.

Mr. Luciano is a passionate advocate for individuals injured by others. He's also active in his community. In April 2016, he competed as an American Ninja Warrior in order to raise money for the Jacksonville Area Legal Aid organization which helps low income and special-needs residents.

attorneys.practice_type: Family (Divorce, Child Support, Custody, Paternity, etc) Lawyers in Crestview, FL
attorneys.bio:
Stanley K. Luke is a lifelong resident of Crestview, Florida. He attended the University of Florida in Gainesville and the University of West Florida in Pensacola, and graduated from Mississippi College School of Law in 1985. He has been a licensed member of the Florida Bar Association since 1986 and is a former state prosecutor. Stan represents clients primarily in Okaloosa and Walton counties, and has also represented clients throughout North and Central Florida.

The Law Office of Stanley K. Luke handles family law cases including Divorce, Child Support, Child Custody, Child Dependency, Adoptions and all other areas of family related matters including Wills and Probate. In addition to family law, Stanley Luke also handles criminal defense matters including Domestic Violence cases, Theft or Fraud, Drug Possession, DUI/DWI and other Felony or Misdemeanor Charges.

The basic right of every citizen is to have strong and effective representation during the course of their legal issue. Clients of Stanley K. Luke will be aggressively represented during the course of their case. One of the keys to a successful case is to have legal counsel during the earliest stages of the case. Early and strategic planning will enable clients to make wise decisions as their case progresses.

Call the Law Office of Stanley K. Luke today at 850-682-1190.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Tavernier, FL
attorneys.bio:
James S. Lupino received his Bachelor's Degree from Augustana College in 1974 and his Juris Doctorate from Hamline University in St. Paul, Minnesota in 1977. Mr. Lupino represents clients in the areas of Civil Litigation, Probate, Real Estate, Contract and Construction Law, Wills, Probate and Product Liability Litigation.

Mr. Lupino is admitted to the Bar in the states of Florida, Minnesota and Colorado, as well as, the Federal Courts in the Southern District of Florida and for the District of Minnesota. He is a Supreme Court certified civil dispute mediator. He is listed in Who's Who of Florida Lawyers. Mr. Lupino is the representative of the 16th Judicial Circuit to the Florida Bar Board of Governors. He is the chairman of the Florida Bar Member Benefits Committee for 2000-2002 and is on the Budget and Investment Committees. Mr. Lupino serves on the Upper Keys Rotary Club Board and is a past Chairman elect of the Key Largo Chamber of Commerce, the Monroe County campaign coordinator for the Jeb Bush gubernatorial election campaign in 1994 and 1998 as well as for George W. Bush's presidential campaign in 2000.

attorneys.name: Thomas Lutz
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Mary Esther, FL
attorneys.bio:
Tom Lutz graduated with honors (Cum Laude) from FSU School of Law in May 2022. During Law School, Tom gained a wide range of practical experience, completing internships with the State Attorney’s Office, the State Attorney General’s Office, and with an individual practitioner focusing primarily on Family Law. In addition, Tom participated in the School’s Veterans Clinic, assisting Veterans with housing and employment issues. Tom earned his bachelor’s degree in Earth and Atmospheric Science from Rutgers University in 1981, and his Masters in Humanities (History) from California State University in 1996.

Tom comes to the practice of law as a second (or possibly his 3rd career). He entered the Air Force in 1982 and served 25 years as an Air Force officer and pilot, primarily flying Special Operations C-130’s. Tom retired from active duty in 2007, after 25 years of service, with the rank of Colonel. He continued to work for the Air Force for another 12 years in a civil service capacity, serving as the Deputy Director of the 1st Special Operations Group at Hurlburt Field. He retired from civil service in 2019 and entered Law School.

Tom and his wife Marge have lived in the Fort Walton Beach/Mary Esther area since 2002. Marge teaches Middle School at St Mary Catholic School. They have two children, their son Chris and his wife Debby are both Attorneys living in Washington DC, and their daughter Katie is the Communications Manager for the Global Food Bank Network based in Chicago.

attorneys.name: Stephen Lynch
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Stephen C. Lynch was born and raised in Long Island, New York and moved down to central Florida with his family when he was a young child. After completing high school, he graduated from the University of South Florida in Tampa with two Bachelor's Degrees. After graduating from USF, he enrolled in law school and graduated with his Juris Doctorate, cum laude, with honors, from Barry University School of Law in Orlando, Florida.

Following graduation from law school, Stephen took and passed the Florida Bar Examination, was admitted to the Florida Bar, and began practicing law in Florida.

Now, Stephen advocates for those injured in car crashes, slips and falls, and other incidents that cause personal injury because of the negligence of others and fights for the people against powerful entities and insurance companies. He understands the importance of being there for his clients during arguably the most stressful time of their lives and is always there to listen and lend a helping hand. Stephen is an active member of the Florida Justice Association and is prepared to fight for you.

attorneys.name: Kathryn Ashley Lynch
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kathryn Lynch has been practicing family law in Tampa, FL since 2012. Ms. Lynch is a dedicated and compassionate attorney who works hard to protect the rights of her clients. She understands the difficulties and emotional phases clients endure during the legal process. She is dedicated to helping families through difficult times. Kathryn's goal is to represent every client with care, compassion, and attention to detail.

Ms. Lynch is trained in the Collaborative Divorce process and is a member of Next Generation Divorce, a group of local collaborative divorce professionals who help resolve divorce and other family law matters through a non-litigated, peaceful, and respectful team-based approach. Ms. Lynch strongly believes that the collaborative divorce process a much healthier alternative to litigation. In a collaborative divorce, both parties and counsel commit themselves to resolve differences fairly, equitably, in a respectful manner without resort or threat of resort to the courts. Borth spouses and attorneys strive to communicate respectfully and constructively with each other to settle legal issues promptly and economically. Collaborative Family Law attorneys utilize a multi-disciplinary network of professionals to provide expertise and advice as needed on issues relevant to the ultimate settlement of the case. Kathryn Lynch is also a member of the Florida Academy of Collaborative Professionals is Florida's statewide organization of lawyers, financial, and mental health professionals whose mission is to guide families to peaceful divorce using the Collaborative Divorce Process.

Ms. Lynch is a fourth generation Floridian and is an active participant in the Family Law legal community. She is a member of the Florida Bar and specifically the Family Law Section of the Florida Bar. She is a member of the Hillsborough County Bar Association, the Marital & Family Law Section, the Young Lawyers' Division and the Collaborative Section of the Hillsborough County Bar Association. Ms. Lynch has been elected to the Hillsborough County Bar Association's Marital and Family Law Section Executive Council for the 2017-2018, 2018-2021, and 2021-2024 terms. Kathryn is also a member of the Stann Givens Family Law Inn of Tampa which is an organization of family law judges, general magistrates, hearing officers, attorneys, and law students, who are dedicated to professionalism, ethics, civility, and excellence in the practice of family law. Ms. Lynch is a member of the National Association of Divorce Professionals, which unites professionals in the legal, financial, mental health and residential industries who serve divorcing clients.

Ms. Lynch was selected as a 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021 Florida Super Lawyers Rising Star. She also serves as a pro bono attorney with Crossroads for Florida Kids, which is a non-profit organization that represents poor children and young adults in the Hillsborough County area.

Ms. Lynch earned her Juris Doctor from American University's Washington College of Law in Washington, D.C. During law school, Ms. Lynch spent a summer in Buenos Aires, Argentina, volunteering with local youth living in poverty. While she was a student attorney in Washington College of Law's Women and the Law Clinic, she fought to represent low-income clients in family disputes in D.C. Superior Court with a focus on how clients' gender, race, nationality, disability, and economic status affect their experiences in the legal system and within the lawyer-client relationship. Kathryn Lynch also advocated for the educational rights of children with disabilities in Washington D.C. and Maryland under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Improvement Act. She represented the parents of children with disabilities such as autism, learning disabilities, and emotional disturbances and worked with school districts to ensure they received the appropriate Special Education services. After she graduated from law school, Ms. Lynch started her professional career at the US Department of Energy as a Freedom of Information Act Analyst in the Loan Programs Office before moving to Tampa.

attorneys.name: Lake Lytal Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Law Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Lake Lytal, Jr. has had a highly successful career as a civil trial attorney. He started practicing law in 1967 in West Palm Beach, Fl. Lake carries on the Lytal family tradition of highly visible service to the community. His father, Lake Lytal, Sr. came to Palm beach County in and served as a Palm Beach County Commissioner for 32 years, beginning in 1941. His mother, Ruth, was a school teacher for many years.

Lake's parents instilled in him the importance of helping others. Through their involvement in the community, he was often surrounded by the country's leading politicians, businessmen and civic leaders.

Lake is a graduated of Palm Beach High School, class of 1958. He attended Palm Beach Junior College and then graduated from Florida State University in 1962. He earned his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Florida in 1965. Lake is a past President of the Palm Beach Community College and Palm Beach County Florida State University Alumni associations.

Lake is a Florida Bar Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer and was one of the first attorneys in the country to be certified as a Civil Trial Advocate by the National Board of Trial Advocacy.

Lake and Joe Reiter have been working together in personal injury law since 1968. Lake now specializes in medical malpractice litigation, helping people who have suffered an injury or death as a result of medical negligence. He measures his success by his growing list of satisfied clients and believes that an individual deserves equal representation when facing highly skilled defense attorneys hired by hospitals and insurance companies.

Lake is past President of the Florida Justice Association and has received the organization's highest honors for his outstanding contributions to the cause of civil justice, including the Perry Nichols Award in 2000 and the Lifetime Achievement Award in 2003. He has graded answers and prepared questions for The Florida Bar Trial Certification Examination and is a lecturer in The Florida Bar Continuing Legal Education Program and has been an instructor at The Bar's annual Advanced Trial Advocacy Program. He is also a former Chairman of The Florida Bar Grievance Committee of the 15th Judicial Circuit. He is also a charter member of the National Board of Trial Advocacy and is a Director of the Florida Lawyers Mutual Insurance Company. His other legal associations include The Florida Bar, the Palm Beach County Bar Association, and the American Justice Association. In addition, he served as the first lay member of the Florida Board of Chiropractic by Gubernatorial appointment.

Recognizing the need for more minority attorneys in our community, Lake has endowed a scholarship in his name for African American students to attend the University of Florida College of Law.

attorneys.practice_type: Auto Accidents Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Lake H. "Trey" Lytal, III is a top civil trial attorney specializing in personal injury and wrongful death litigation including automobile accidents, products liability and premises liability. He is a Florida Bar Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer, the highest level of recognition for attorney competency and experience. He has obtained numerous multi-million dollar verdicts and settlements for clients throughout Florida and the United States.

In one example, Trey brought a case to trial after an insurance company only offered his client $25,000 for an automobile accident that resulted in several spinal surgeries. A West Palm Beach jury returned a verdict of over $2 million in favor Trey's client to help offset the cost of medical bills, lost wages and future medical care.

Trey has been recognized as one of the best personal injury lawyers in the United States by the prestigious publication, The Best Lawyers in America. He has also been nominated by his peers for inclusion in Florida Super Lawyers, which includes only the top five percent of Florida Attorneys. Trey has been listed as a "Top Lawyer" by the South Florida Legal Guide's publication of top lawyers and law firms. He is also a recipient of the Pro Bono Public Service Award from Palm Beach Community College, for his time and efforts to assist pre-law students in advancing their trial skills.

attorneys.name: Loren Maccarone
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Vero Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Loren Maccarone is a seasoned Title and Closing Attorney licensed in Florida and Rhode Island, with over a decade of experience managing complex residential real estate transactions throughout Florida. She has overseen every facet of the closing process, from detailed title examinations and contract negotiations to post-closing compliance, ensuring seamless transactions and superior client outcomes. Loren’s deep expertise includes resolving intricate title issues involving FIRPTA, probate, bankruptcy, trusts, estates, domestic relations, and 1031 exchanges. Her meticulous attention to detail and collaborative approach with underwriting counsel, lenders, municipalities, and other stakeholders have established her as a trusted legal resource within Florida’s real estate community.

In addition to her transactional expertise, Loren has demonstrated exceptional leadership in business development and operations management. She has successfully expanded real estate legal services across multiple locations, significantly contributing to revenue growth while streamlining office operations and workflows. Her dynamic training programs for real estate agents, covering critical topics such as CFPB regulations and contract compliance, have enhanced agent competency and strengthened long-term client relationships. Her ability to merge legal precision with strategic business acumen positions her uniquely to advise clients and industry partners on both routine and highly complex real estate matters.

Throughout her career, Loren has also contributed to staff recruitment, attorney mentorship, and human resources management, reinforcing her commitment to cultivating strong, client-centered teams. Her combination of legal expertise, industry knowledge, and leadership continues to set her apart as a premier practitioner in the Florida real estate legal landscape.

attorneys.name: Katherine Elizabeth Macdonald
attorneys.firm_name: Katherine E. Macdonald Attorney at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Child Support Lawyers in Gainesville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Katherine (Kit) E. Macdonald has practiced law since 1983 in the following areas of law:

Marital law, family law, and paternity

Estates, probate, wills, and trusts

Katherine Macdonald has practiced law in the following Florida counties:

Alachua, Baker, Bradford, Gilchrist, Levy, Union, Columbia, Marion, Putnam, St. Johns, Clay, Pasco, Volusia, Hernando, and Citrus

Family Law

Her family law cases have included issues of marital dissolution (divorce), child custody and visitation (time-sharing), child support, alimony, parental responsibility, enforcement, paternity, modification, parenting plans, and time sharing. With statutory amendments, child custody and visitation are no longer the terms, and parenting plans and time sharing are the new concepts. She represents men and women equally, and has extensive experience with litigated family law hearings.

Estates, Wills and Trusts

Her probate cases have included issues of admission of wills to probate, estate administration, appointment of personal representatives, homestead, missing heirs, elective share, and final accountings. Katherine Macdonald has lectured at seminars on estate administration topics for the National Business Institute, and has presented programs for local groups about estate planning, wills and trusts.

Professional Memberships

Katherine Macdonald's professional memberships have been as follows:

The Florida Bar: Member since November 22, 1983

Clara Gehan- FAWL (f/k/a 8-FAWL) (Florida Association for Women Lawyers) Gainesville, Florida; President, 1994-1995

Eighth Judicial Circuit Bar Association: Member, Probate and Family Law Section, Gainesville, Florida

James C. Adkins, Jr. Inn of Court Member since 2001

Education, Honors, Awards and Publications

Katherine Macdonald received her Bachelor of Arts in Political Science in June 1965 from the New School for Social Research in New York, NY, her Master of Arts in Political Science (Public Administration) from the University of Florida in December 1980 and her Juris Doctorate with Honors from the University of Florida in May 1983. While at law school, Katherine Macdonald was Executive Editor and Title Standards Editor of the University of Florida Law Review and received Honors in appellate advocacy. She studied family law and wrote about family law at law school. She received the George W. Milam Award, for most outstanding Law Review Comment, in the fall 1981 semester. Her comment, Domestic Relations: Military Pay and Equitable Division in Divorce Courts - Preemption, was published at 34 U.Fla.L.Rev.280 (1982).

Katherine Macdonald attended Hollins College in Roanoke, VA from September 1961 - May 1964. As a Hollins student, she attended the United Nations Semester at Drew University in Madison, NJ in the fall semester, September 1963 - January 1964. Following graduation from The New School for Social Research, she worked at the national office of the United Nations Association of the United States of America (UNA-USA), in New York, NY, June 1965-September 1966. From April - August 1967 Katherine Macdonald served as secretary for most of the European portion of the project which resulted in the publication of Great Houses of the Western World by Nigel Nicolson, author, photographs by Ian Graham (New York: G.P. Putnam's Sons, 1968).

attorneys.name: Alejandro Machin
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Alejandro Machin is an Associate Attorney with the Canizares Law Group practicing in the area of Immigration Law.

Alejandro graduated from Suffolk University Law School in 2019. He also graduated as an attorney from the University of Havana School of Law in 2010. Mr. Machin is licensed to practice law in Massachusetts and has been a member of the Massachusetts Bar Association since 2020.

Born and raised in Havana, Cuba, until later in 2014, he made the decision to move to the United States. Upon arriving in Miami, he worked as a legal assistant at a Construction Company. Alejandro wanted to continue being an attorney, so he moved to Boston to pursue a legal career in the United States. After graduating in 2019, he practiced Real Estate Conveyancing Law in Boston, Massachusetts, until he relocated to Miami in 2023.

Alejandro has a passion for helping others. He worked as an intern at Greater Boston Legal Services, placing homeless women with children into shelter. During his last year as a law student in Boston, he became part of the school’s immigration clinic helping clients with their asylum applications. Ultimately, because of his own personal experience with the United States Immigration System, Mr. Machin decided to focus on a different type of law in order to help others to obtain legal status in the country.

attorneys.firm_name: Immigration Law Group of Florida, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Saint Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kathlyn M. Mackovjak is shareholder and co-owner of Immigration Law Group of Florida, P.A. She has been practicing immigration law for over 18 years. Before opening her own firm, she supervised the Immigration Law Unit at Gulfcoast Legal Services and coordinated an immigration law clinic for Stetson Law School. She was recognized in 2013 by the Hispanic Outreach Center with their Gracias Award for her work with the immigrant community, and by the Clearwater/Tampa Bay Area Human Trafficking Task Force for her work with survivors of human trafficking.

Kathlyn has a degree in environmental engineering from the University of Florida, and graduated cum laude from the Washington College of Law at American University in Washington, DC. In the early 1990's she was a volunteer with the Peace Corps in Mali, West Africa. She then worked as an environmental engineer for the International Committee of the Red Cross in Rwanda, Angola, the Republic of Congo, Kosovo and Afghanistan. Kathlyn is a dual citizen of the U.S. and Canada.

attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Pompano Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Shalimar, FL
attorneys.bio:
Prior to joining the Law Offices of James C. Campbell, P.A., John Madden, a Shalimar native, was an Assistant State Attorney in the First Judicial Circuit of Florida, where he handled Juvenile, Misdemeanor Crimes including DUI's and Domestic Violence, and all degrees of serious Felony cases. In his 5 years with the State, John handled thousands of cases throughout Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton and Bay Counties. He has tried over 20 jury trials to verdict, and was recognized statewide as "Outstanding Prosecutor" by Mother's Against Drunk Driver's in 2014. Throughout the Circuit, John has established valuable relationships with fellow attorneys, prosecutors, judges, clerks, law enforcement and probation officers. His knowledge of the law, the legal process, and his experience in the courtroom, allow him to successfully defend the rights of his clients.

John attended Florida State University where he obtained both his Bachelor's of Science in Business Administration and his Juris Doctorate.

attorneys.name: Bobbi Madonna
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dade City, FL
attorneys.bio:
Bobbi Madonna was born in Peoria, Illinois and raised in Middletown, Ohio. Ms. Madonna graduated magna cum laude from Miami University with a degree in Speech Communications. She then attended the University of Cincinnati College of Law where she received an Ohio Innocence Project Fellowship as well as served on the Moot Court Honor Panel as the Judges’ Director.

After graduating from law school, Ms. Madonna worked as a staff attorney for the Innocence Project of Florida where she worked to free wrongfully incarcerated individuals from prison based on DNA evidence. Following her tenure at the Innocence Project of Florida, she worked as a public defender in both Hillsborough and Pinellas County and as a private criminal defense attorney throughout Florida.

Subsequent to her time practicing criminal defense, Ms. Madonna worked as in-house counsel for the Law Office of Robert Smith where she represented Allstate Insurance Company as well as their insureds. Ms. Madonna defended both insured individuals against bodily injury claims as well as the insurance company itself against uninsured/underinsured motorists claims. She also worked as an attorney for Allstate’s Special Investigative Unit where she investigated fraudulent insurance claims made by individuals as well as medical care providers.

Ms. Madonna now uses her litigation skills and knowledge acquired from practicing insurance defense to zealously represent individuals injured as result of negligence. She joined the Mander Law Group in 2019. She focuses on personal injury and medical malpractice.

attorneys.name: Gavin D. Magaziner
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law Lawyers in Clearwater, FL
attorneys.bio:
Gavin David Magaziner, born Miami, FL; admitted to the Florida Bar, 2005.

Prior to establishing his firm, Mr. Magaziner represented clients in complex criminal matters as an Assistant Public Defender for over six years. He subsequently spent seven years in the military and discharged honorably as a Captain in the U.S. Army Judge Advocate General's Corps. As a JAG, Mr. Magaziner litigated in both defense and prosecutorial roles, directed special investigations involving military justice, and served as liaison between the Florida Army National Guard and outside government agencies. Following his military service, he entered the realm of civil litigation with practices primarily focused on defense against first-party and third-party insurance claims, including personal injury litigation, property insurance claims, sinkhole litigation, construction defect, and general negligence claims. By 2016, Mr. Magaziner's practice concentrated largely on construction defect defense, and by 2018, he almost exclusively practiced construction law.

Mr. Magaziner practices primarily in construction law, including construction defect litigation, lien claims against real property, contract negotiations, and breach of contract claims.

Army Achievement Medal, HHB 164th ADA Brigade, Florida National Guard, 2009 - Present

Anastasia Mahone is a partner at Shamy, El Fadel & Mahone, PLLC. She graduated from Florida Atlantic University in 2009 with a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Psychology along with a minor studies in Sociology. In 2014, Ms. Mahone received her Juris Doctorate Degree from Nova Southeastern Shephard Broad Law School and, upon admittance to the Florida Bar, joined Shamy, El Fadel & Mahone, PLLC at Law providing legal service to firm clients demonstrating a resilient and unbridled passion and dedication to the law and the needs of the firm's clients.

To Ms. Mahone's accolades and to the benefit of her clients, Anastasia Mahone has professional employment experience in the fields of Mental Health and Substance Abuse. Her prior employment experience affords Ms. Mahone a unique and uncanny ability to identify and empathize with the tribulation of firm clients while understanding and being compassionate knowing the extent of emotional hardship and trauma life or business can lead to that ultimately requires legal advocacy or assistance. Ms. Mahone's work experience and education offer great insight in meeting client expectations, particularly in handling the sensitive matters associated with family law efficiently, aggressively and decisively. Ms. Mahone's education, experience, dedication and compassion have her on track to becoming one of South Florida's go to legal practitioners in the litigation and family law fields.

Jed founded The Main Law Firm in 2010, where he now uses his knowledge to help those who find themselves fighting against the insurance companies after being injured.

attorneys.bio:
I am a Miami-based attorney who specializes in family law. I practice family law in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties.

I immigrated to Louisville, Kentucky from Tehran, Iran at a young age. As an immigrant, I dreamt of becoming an attorney my whole life so that I could advocate for the underdogs.

For the last 10 years, I have ​held every role you can think of in the legal field. From a receptionist, client intake personnel, legal assistant, law clerk at a major firm, and now lawyer, you name it– I’ve done it. I received my juris doctorate in 2016. I thought I wanted to be a civil litigator and defend businesses and insurance companies, but I unexpectedly fell into family law and had the opportunity to work with some of the best family law attorneys in Miami, and I consider myself lucky for that.

I fell in love with the practice of family law because I am passionate about advocating for peaceful resolutions for my clients’ familial concerns. The metamorphosis of a person going through one of the most difficult times of their lives to getting a resolution and starting over is beautiful and meaningful to me.

I believe in brutal honesty with my clients. Sometimes I tell them things they don’t want to hear, but I believe in informing them every step of the way. I believe in being there for them unequivocally and providing them with tenacious advocacy, while also understanding that minimizing litigation is conducive to reaching a resolution. I pride myself on being an excellent communicator and analyzing the big picture while never forgetting that the devil is in details.

As seen in my client testimonials, my clients appreciate that I am extremely efficient, responsive, strategic, and caring. I treat all my clients like they are part of my family.

In my free time, I like to volunteer with the pro bono Guardian Ad Litem program to represent the best interests of children. I enjoy cooking, travel, and staying active with my husband, friends, and pets.

The value of finding a lawyer who is the right fit for you cannot be overemphasized as you enter this next chapter ​of​ your life. I invite you to book a consultation with me to learn more about the process and how I can help you successfully move on to a happier life.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robert P. "Rob" Major joined Ver Ploeg & Marino in 2016 after a span of over 2 decades practicing law at one of Orlando's oldest general practice firms. Rob's litigation practice is focused primarily on assisting individual, corporate and institutional clients in insurance coverage and "bad faith" disputes against their own insurance companies. Such disputes typically involve circumstances in which a liability insurer is refusing to provide coverage for a claim against the client under an auto, commercial general liability (CGL), professional liability/errors & omissions (E&O), or directors & officers (D&O) policy. Rob's practice also extends to providing assistance to other lawyers throughout Florida whose practices occasionally embroil them and their clients in insurance related issues with which they are unfamiliar

attorneys.firm_name: N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
At N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group, located in Orlando and serving the Central Florida area, our staff offers personal and professional family law services. From pre-nuptial agreements to post-decree modifications, we provide our clients with effective family law representation.

We know how stressful any legal case can be, and when it involves your family, the emotional toll is exponentially greater. You may wonder what will happen to your children, whether you will have custody and if not, how often you will be able to see them. By far, children's issues are at the forefront of any divorce proceedings.

The lawyers at N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group understand the challenges you are facing and provide exceptionally qualified legal representation. Though negotiation is always our preferred method for resolving issues, when necessary, we excel in the courtroom.

Over the past 30 years, N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group, has had success in a variety of family law areas, including:

Divorce

Child custody

Time-sharing schedules and parenting plans

Child support

Relocation

Alimony

Paternity and paternity testing

Post-decree modifications

Pre-nuptial and post-nuptial agreements

Collaborative law

Mediation

The attorneys and staff at N. Diane Holmes, P.A. Family Law Group take pride in providing the high-quality guidance and caring representation for our clients. If you are looking for family law representation, please contact us for an in-depth consultation.
