attorneys.name: S. Hunter Malin
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Hunter has been a shareholder of Heekin Litigation Group, since 2002, and began association with the firm following graduation from law school in 1996. Hunter has enjoyed a diverse practice, including disputes amongst business owners, divorces and child custody issues, modifications in family court, creditor's rights in and out of bankruptcy court, appellate practice, landlord and tenant rights, infringement of trademarks and copyrights, securities fraud and other fraudulent practices, and other general commercial litigation and contract disputes. Hunter uses his experience as an attorney as well as his personal growth in other areas to relate to clients' needs and concerns.

Hunter was born in Englewood, New Jersey, and grew up in Pinellas County, Florida. Hunter obtained his undergraduate degree in communication studies from The Florida State University in 1993. After receiving his undergraduate degree, Hunter continued at The Florida State University College of Law where he obtained his juris doctorate degree, summa cum laude, in 1996. In law school, Hunter contributed as an Articles Editor of the Law Review and as Executive Editor of the Environmental and Land Use Journal. Hunter also became a mentor for newer students who were adjusting to the demands of law school. Having enjoyed his experience as a mentor, Hunter later enjoyed an experience as an adjunct professor at Florida Coastal School of Law.

Hunter is admitted to practice in the State of Florida as well as the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida. He is a member of the Jacksonville Bar Association.

Hunter lives in Jacksonville with his son and daughter. He enjoys coaching his children's sports teams, encouraging others, boxing, running, writing, reading and spending time with his family.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Order of the Coif

Book Awards in: Evidence, Civil Procedure, Business Associations, Legal Research and Writing, Constitutional Law

attorneys.name: Harry Malka
attorneys.firm_name: Malka & Kravitz - Your Construction Law Firm
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Malka is recognized as an expert in Florida’s Construction Law and is Board Certified in Construction Law by the Florida Bar. This certification is the highest recognition of competence provided by the Florida Bar. Mr. Malka is rated “AV® Preeminent™” by the Martindale-Hubbell Peer Review Rating system. This outstanding achievement signifies that he has earned the highest rating available for legal ability and professional ethics. He is also a Florida Supreme Court Certified Circuit Court Civil Mediator.

Mr. Malka received his Juris Doctor from Emory University School of Law in Atlanta, Georgia, in 1997. Mr. Malka is a member of the Georgia Bar (1997, inactive) and the Florida Bar (2003). He is admitted to practice before all Florida state courts, the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court.

Prior to moving to Florida in 2003, Mr. Malka was a founding member of MALKA & TRAINOR, P.C., an Atlanta-based law firm where he primarily practiced his practice on commercial litigation and construction law. Prior to establishing MALKA & KRAVITZ, P.A., in 2009, Mr. Malka was a partner at the law firm formerly known as Leiby, Stearns, & Roberts, P.A., where he concentrated exclusively on construction-related litigation.

At MALKA & KRAVITZ, P.A., Mr. Malka continues to focus his practice on matters related to construction law, including litigation, arbitration, and mediation of construction liens, payment and performance bond claims, construction defect claims and defenses, as well as construction contract preparation, review, and negotiation.

Mr. Malka has been a member of several construction related legal associations, including The Florida Bar (Real Property Probate and Trust Law Section, Construction Law Committee), the Broward County Bar Association (Construction Law Committee), and the Associated Builders and Contractors, South Florida Chapter (ABC). Mr. Malka also lectures on construction-related topics to lawyers, law students, and contractors.

attorneys.name: Ryan Malkin
attorneys.practice_type: Alcohol Beverage Lawyers in Miami Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ryan Malkin is an attorney focusing on alcohol beverage and cannabis law. He has extensive experience providing guidance to suppliers, wholesalers, retailers, agencies, and third parties within these regulated industries. As an attorney for a major global wine and spirits supplier, Ryan concentrated on supporting the sales and marketing teams to ensure compliance with rules and regulations in all 50 states. Ryan utilized his experience and knowledge of the industry to help craft compliant programs to help global brands outperform others in their categories.

Prior to his work at Pernod, Ryan was an Assistant District Attorney in Manhattan. Ryan investigated and prosecuted all manner of crimes, with an emphasis on long-term white collar crime investigations. Ryan gained unprecedented skills and an understanding of state governmental agencies.

Ryan's passion for the alcohol industry began as a staff writer for SmartMoney. Ryan specialized in travel and hospitality writing, with an emphasis on the beverage alcohol industry, covering both brands and category trends. Ryan regularly interviewed executives, brand owners, producers, and industry experts to provide guidance to readers. Ryan also regularly interviewed nightclub and bar owners, designers, managers, and doormen to bring new ventures and cocktail trends to life, and giving Ryan insight into the bar and nightclub business. His articles have appeared in such publications as Beverage Media, Liquor.com, The Wall Street Journal, New York Post, DJTimes, and Esquire to name a few.

attorneys.name: John J. Mangan Jr., Esq
attorneys.practice_type: Probate & Trust Administration Lawyers in Palm City, FL
attorneys.bio:
As the oldest of five children, John feels blessed to have been born into a family with terrific parents who stressed the value of planning for the future. He incorporates their guidance into his work as an estate planning and probate attorney by helping his clients create personalized documents that safeguard their assets, protect their loved ones, and help ensure family relationships remain strong for generations to come.

“When a robust, comprehensive plan is put into place, it increases the odds of preserving family harmony,” John said. “When there's no planning or a poorly prepared plan, conflict and tension often result.”

As the founder of Beacon Legacy Law™, John has three goals for the team:

Demonstrate a sincere interest in each client, their family, and their future in all that they do.

Take proactive action to ensure client affairs are in order.

Build a long-lasting, trust-based relationship with each client.

When you choose to work with the firm, you can expect:

A flat fee in most cases for planning services.

A customized plan (no “cookie cutter” plans) created for each client’s needs.

The opportunity for a long-term relationship with regular contact after work is completed, including the chance for a complimentary plan review every 3 years.

This personalized approach to estate planning has led to a combined list of 180+ five-star Google reviews from satisfied clients. The firm has also been designated “The Best 10 Wills, Trusts, & Probates near Palm City, FL 34990” by Yelp and named to the Law Firm 500 list as “One Of The Fastest Growing Law Firms” in the USA for each of the past six years.

attorneys.name: Andrew J. Manie Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Contract disputes Lawyers in Lakeland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Andrew John Manie was born in Queens, New York, to a family with roots in Trinidad and Tobago. Raised in the Virgin Islands and later settling in North Lauderdale, Florida, Mr. Manie’s diverse upbringing has provided him with a unique perspective on life and the law. He graduated from Boyd Anderson High School, and soon after, he answered the call to serve his country.

The day after his 18th birthday, Mr. Manie enlisted in the United States Marine Corps, where he served as a communications repairman with an infantry battalion. His military service included a deployment to Iraq, where he supported Operation Iraqi Freedom and Operation Enduring Freedom. His time in the military instilled in him the values of discipline, resilience, and a commitment to duty—qualities that continue to define his legal career.

While serving in the Marine Corps, Mr. Manie pursued higher education and earned a degree in Political Science from American Military University. After being honorably discharged in 2011, he continued his academic journey at Barry University School of Law, graduating in 2014. He was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2015 and has since dedicated his practice to providing legal counsel with a client-centered approach.

Mr. Manie’s legal experience spans various areas of law, including contract disputes, personal bankruptcy, and business law. Over the years, he has worked with several firms across Central Florida and ran his own successful practice from 2017 to 2022. In addition to his law practice, Mr. Manie also served as the lead trainer for Integreon Managed Solutions, overseeing the training of contract analysts for their Nike account.

With his extensive experience, Mr. Manie brings a wealth of legal knowledge and a passion for solving complex legal challenges. Whether negotiating contracts or helping clients navigate personal bankruptcy, he approaches each case with the same commitment and dedication that he applied during his military service.

Outside of his professional life, Mr. Manie is a devoted father who enjoys spending time on the water with his two children, kayaking and fishing. An avid sports fan, he also enjoys catching a game whenever he can.

Attorney Andrew John Manie understands that legal matters can be stressful and overwhelming. His mission is to provide clients with the same clarity, guidance, and support he relied on during his military service—helping them confidently navigate the legal landscape and achieve the best possible outcomes.

attorneys.name: Wendy A. Mara J.D., M.B.A, CAP
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Lawyers in Ormond Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Wendy A. Mara attended Stetson University where she was selected for Phi Beta Kappa, widely considered to be the nation’s most prestigious honor society. After graduating Magna Cum Laude in 1993, Ms. Mara taught language arts in both Volusia County public high schools and Father Lopez Catholic High School for 13 years combined. While teaching full time, she earned her MBA from the University of Central Florida in 2006. During her time in graduate school, she was selected for membership in Phi Kappa Phi, another of the nation’s most prestigious honor societies.

Deciding to pursue a legal career, she entered law school at Florida Coastal School of Law where she graduated in the top 10 percent of her class. While in law school, she was a teaching and research assistant, earned Dean’s Certificate for Pro Bono Work and became an award winning oralist for the Jessup International Moot Court Competition. Following graduation from law school, she was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2009 and entered the private practice of law in the Ormond Beach-Volusia and Flagler County area.

Mrs. Mara’s law practice is centered on family and domestic law, probate and wills, guardianship, and business matters. During her legal career, she has been recognized by her peers as a leader in the profession. She has served as Treasurer, Vice-President and President of the Volusia-Flagler Association for Women Lawyers. This organization honored Ms. Mara in 2015 with their Women of the Year Award for her work on behalf of women and children. Ms. Mara has also served as the Treasurer, Secretary, Vice-President, and President of the Volusia County Bar Association, and she currently serves as Chair of the Elder Law Section of the Volusia County Bar Association. Ms. Mara is AV rated by Martindale Hubbell in recognition of her ethics and legal knowledge and ability, and she has been designated a Rising Star in Family Law and Probate by Super Lawyers in 2016-2018.

Outside of the legal profession, Ms. Mara is an active leader in her community, involved in many activities and organizations. She is a former member of the Ormond Beach Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors, winner of the 2013 Ormond Beach Chamber of Commerce Leadership Award and former Chairperson of the PACE Center for Girls, Volusia-Flagler. Ms. Mara is also an active member of the Junior League of Daytona Beach and a volunteer for Community Legal Services of Mid-Florida where she donates her time to provide pro-bono legal assistance to low-income individuals. Living in Ormond Beach with her husband Robert and sons Robbie and Liam, she has six children and two grandchildren.

attorneys.name: Leon R. Margules
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Leon Margules has been a lawyer in South Florida for more than 40 years. Since beginning his legal career in 1980, Mr. Margules has worked in many areas of law with concentration in civil litigation and matrimonial and family law. Mr. Margules is a Florida Supreme Court Certified Family Mediator and has years of experience in all areas of Civil and Criminal trial work.

A significant amount of Mr. Margules's work in recent years has also been in the areas of Contracts and Sports and Entertainment Law, concentrating in the Professional Boxing industry. Mr. Margules has been a licensed Boxing Promoter for more than 20 years and is licensed in numerous states including Florida, Nevada, New York, New Jersey, California and Illinois. As a prominent Boxing Promoter, Boxing Lawyer and currently the President of the well-respected Warriors Boxing and Promotions, LLC, Mr. Margules's reputation as an expert in the Promotional Boxing industry is unsurpassed, as he has represented a substantial number of notable Boxers (including many world champions), promoters and managers.

Mr. Margules is highly regarded as a skilled and compassionate advocate and those skills translate to helping and guiding clients through their most complicated and most difficult times. As a Mediator, he has the qualifications and experience necessary for him to deal with every conceivable situation, and to make sure that he guides parties towards their best possible outcomes. As Counsel, he has always done his best to protect the interests of his clients and fight for the most advantageous result, no matter the size of the task.

attorneys.name: Kevin P. Markey
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Cocoa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kevin P. Markey has been a member of the Florida Bar since 1988 and is licensed to practice in all Florida state courts. He is an active member of the Florida Bar’s Business Law; Real Property, Probate & Trust Law; and Administrative Law sections.

After practicing with two of Brevard County’s largest firms, Mr. Markey founded Markey & Fowler, P.A. in 1994, where he served as managing partner of a five-attorney firm focused on corporate, franchise, real estate, estate planning, civil litigation, and governmental law. He currently practices in Cocoa, Florida.

Mr. Markey serves as general counsel to Eastern Florida State College and has represented numerous municipalities, including Cape Canaveral, Cocoa, and Melbourne. He has over 30 years of experience as a title agent and has served as lead real estate counsel for local financial institutions. He is also a director of Community Bank of the South.

His practice includes advising businesses, professionals, and nonprofit organizations in the areas of wills, trusts and probate, business and real property law, and government affairs. He has taught as an adjunct professor at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and the University of Central Florida and formerly served as a certified SBA business analyst and NFL contract advisor.

Mr. Markey earned a B.S. in Finance from the University of Florida and a J.D., with honors, from Florida State University. While in law school, he published in the Journal of Land Use and Environmental Law, completed a fellowship at the Policy Studies Clinic, and studied at the University of Oxford. A Brevard County resident for over 50 years, he was elected to the Port Canaveral Board of Commissioners in 2020, where he has served as Vice Chair and Chairman.

attorneys.name: C. Todd Marks Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Business law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Prior to forming the law office of Westchase Law, P.A. and Westchase Title, LLC in Tampa, Florida, C. Todd Marks attended the George Mason School of Law.

While in law school, Mr. Marks graded on to the Law Review and served as the Symposium Editor. Mr. Marks practiced law in Virginia and Washington, D.C. Mr. Marks began his legal career in Washington, DC and McLean, Virginia with the law firm of Shaw Pittman, LLP where he practiced in the emerging companies and commercial real estate practice groups.

In the meantime, Todd remained active in local and national political campaigns. Todd eventually worked for law firm Connolly, Bove, Lodge & Hutz in the commercial litigation and bankruptcy practice groups where he developed a general practice which included estate planning and other business law matters.

His experience includes real estate closings and disputes, commercial leases, commercial litigation, creditors' rights in bankruptcy, corporate formation and transactions, estate planning, employment law, and family law. Mr. Marks and his wife Jennifer are the proud parents of two boys and a girl.

Mr. Marks serves on the Board of the Westchase Charitable Foundation and has served on the Board of Church at the Bay.

attorneys.practice_type: Mergers & Acquisitions Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Marlowe is the founding shareholder of Marlowe Law, an A+ rated business with the Better Business Bureau. He is a business lawyer with over 40 years of experience, concentrating on mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures. He has extensive past experience in complex business litigation, business disputes, general business law, and personal injury litigation. He has been a shareholder, equity partner, or senior trial counsel at prestigious Florida and national firms such as Fowler White Burnett (7 years), Arnstein & Lehr (now Saul Ewing Arnstein & Lehr) (9+ years), and others. He has been rated Preeminent® (the highest possible rating) by judges and peers on Martindale-Hubbell since 1995 and has an AVVO rating of 10 (out of 10). Mr. Marlowe's Preeminent® rating is a testament to the fact that his peers rank him at the highest level of professional excellence and deem him to have very high professional ethics and preeminent legal ability. Only lawyers with the highest ethical standards and professional ability receive a Martindale-Hubbell Peer Review Rating of "AV." Mr. Marlowe has maintained that rating every year since it was initially awarded to him in 1995.

In addition to his experience in contract drafting and review as part of his mergers and acquisitions and business law practice, Mr. Marlowe's extensive past experience handling negligence, contract, business & commercial, warranty, indemnity, employment, fraud, defamation & privacy, intentional tort, physical tort, real property, construction, lien, and debt collection cases provides him with insights most pure business lawyers lack. He is also a Florida Supreme Court Approved Arbitrator.

Mr. Marlowe is a graduate of the University of Florida Levin College of Law where he was a member and editor of the University of Florida Law Review.

Mr. Marlowe, a computer programmer in the 1970s (remember COBOL?) and a former computer store owner, embraces technology in the practice of law as well as alternative fee agreements.

attorneys.name: Michael David Marrese
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in St. Augustine, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Marrese spent 10 years in Chicago as a personal injury/medical malpractice attorney, and is now currently in St. Augustine, Florida. He is still licensed in Illinois, as well as in Florida. Mr. Marrese has tried numerous catastrophic injury cases with several results between $4-6 million dollars.

Mr. Marrese is a Florida Bar Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer. This is what the Florida Bar says about Board Certification:

Board certified lawyers have met The Florida Bar's highest standards for special knowledge, skills and proficiency in various areas of law and professionalism and ethics in the practice of law. Certified lawyers' experience and competency have been rigorously evaluated, and they are the only Florida lawyers allowed to refer to themselves as specialists or experts or to use the letters B.C.S. to indicate Board Certified Specialist.

No matter how much experience a lawyer may have in civil trial, only board certified civil trial lawyers are allowed to identify themselves as specialists or experts in this area of law.

Mr. Marrese has tried all types of injury cases to verdict, in several states, and in many, many counties throughout Florida. This wide variety of trial experience has given him a unique perspective on what types of cases appeal to the jury you are likely to see.

He has five verdicts, not settlements, over $1,000,000 in the last seven years, ranging from $1,000,000 to $6,000,000, including one for $5.98 million and another $5.25 million. So if you want an attorney who the Florida Bar says is a "specialist" in trial law, then ask for Mike, specifically.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Connor grew up in Severn, Maryland where he lived until relocating to South West Florida to pursue his dream of attending law school. While in Maryland, Connor attended Salisbury University for his undergraduate studies where he earned his B.S. in Political Science and was a member of Sigma Tau Gamma Fraternity. While attending Salisbury University Connor received numerous scholastic awards and volunteered his time for the Special Olympics of Maryland.

After moving to South West Florida, Connor attended Ave Maria School of Law in Naples where he met his to-be wife during the first week of the program. During his time at Ave Maria School of Law he was a member of the Moot Court Board participating in mock trial competitions for law students and was a Dean's Delegate Award recipient.

In his early career Connor has already worked on multiple high level sex cases, violent offenses, drug trafficking cases at both the State and Federal level, numerous appellate briefs and post-conviction motions, and a wrongful death civil case.

In his spare time, Connor is a fitness enthusiast and competes in Spartan races and other agility and endurance-based obstacle courses. Connor is also an accomplished traveler, a hobby he plans to continue well into retirement years.

attorneys.name: Diana L. Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Tort Litigation Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
Diana L. Martin handles appeals for the firm in a wide variety of practice areas, including tort liability, product liability, managed care liability, and consumer class actions. She also provides litigation support to the firm's attorneys by drafting and arguing complex and case dispositive motions and providing legal assistance at trial by handling motions for directed verdicts, complex evidentiary issues, and charge conferences. Ms. Martin is admitted to practice in the Florida State Courts; the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Middle, and Southern Districts of Florida; the U.S. Court of Appeals, 11th Circuit; and the United States Supreme Court.

Before joining the firm, Ms. Martin served for three years as Staff Attorney to the Honorable Martha C. Warner in the Fourth District Court of Appeal of Florida. She is a 2002 High Honors graduate from the University of Florida Levin College of Law, where she was inducted into the Order of the Coif. Ms. Martin received her Bachelor's Degree from Flagler College after graduating summa cum laude, being awarded Departmental Honors in Philosophy/Religion, and being inducted into the Alpha Chi and Omicron Delta Kappa honor societies.

Ms. Martin was appointed by the Florida Bar to sit on the Board of Directors of Florida Legal Services and she serves as Audit Committee Chair of Families First of Palm Beach County. She is also a co-author of Florida Insurance Law and Practice, an annual publication by Thomson/West.

attorneys.name: Daniel Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
It took me a while to fully understand how my family’s fight shaped the attorney I’ve become and the way I advocate for my clients. Now I understand that if my grandfather hadn’t been willing to sacrifice and to fight, not only would I not be the attorney or the man I am today, but probably wouldn’t even be here today.

In the 1960s, my grandfather lost everything to communism in Cuba — his businesses, his home, and the life he’d built with my grandmother. With literally nothing but the clothes on their backs — even my grandmother’s wedding ring was taken at the airport — they left for Spain, spending five years awaiting U.S. visas.

When the opportunity came, he again packed up my father, my uncles, and my grandmother, and left a secure corporate job and extended family in Madrid to start over in West Palm Beach. For more than the following decade, he worked multiple low-paying jobs in order to provide for his family.

He knew at the time that his sacrifice wasn’t just for his children but the future Martin generations. Today, among his six grandchildren are a doctor, three lawyers, a psychologist, and a television producer— living proof that his fight was worth it.

That fight inspires me every day. It’s why I fight so hard for my clients and never take their trust for granted. Its why I feel so deeply that people ought to get the advocacy they not only expect but rightly deserve. Fighting for you is the least I can do to honor my grandfather’s legacy, sacrifice, and most of all, his fight.

Thanks to him, I was born and raised in Palm Beach County. I attended Dreyfoos School of the Arts, and from there, I attended Florida State University and earned a degree in economics. I decided to cap off my educational journey by moving to Northeast and attending New England Law | Boston where I earned my JD.

During law school, I worked in corporate lobbying and secured a job doing regulatory affairs for a large corporation. Realizing the cold is better to visit than live in, and that corporate law was better idea than reality, I returned to Florida with my fiancé and golden retriever—and couldn’t be happier.

Armando fought to give me the opportunity to fight for you, and to me, that is really special.

attorneys.name: Jean S. Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Class Action Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jean Sutton Martin is a lead attorney in Morgan and Morgan's Complex Litigation Group. For more than 20 years, Ms. Martin has concentrated her practice on complex litigation, including consumer protection and defective products class action. She has a unique background having handled individual personal injury and mass tort cases as well as managing large consumer class actions.

Jean has considerable experience in data breach cases, including appointments as interim co-lead counsel in In re Morgan Stanley Data Security Litigation, 1:20-cv-05914 (S.D.N.Y.), In re Warner Music Group, Case No. 1:20-cv-07473-PGG (S.D.N.Y.), In Re: Ambry Genetics Data Breach Litigation, No. 20-cv-00791 (C.D. Cal), In re Brinker Data Incident Litigation, 18-cv-686 (M.D. Fla.), and Gordon, et al. v. Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc.,17-cv-01415 (D. Colo.) She is also a member of the Plaintiffs' Steering Committee and bellwether trial team in In re: Smith & Nephew Birmingham Hip Resurfacing (BHR) Hip Implant Products Liability Litigation, No. 17-md-2775 (D. Md.) and a member of the Plaintiffs' Steering Committee in In re: Allergan Biocell Textured Breast Implant Products Liability Litigation, No. 19-md-2921 (D. N.J).

Recognizing the growing importance of ESI issues, Jean obtained eDiscovery certification from the eDiscovery Training Academy at Georgetown Law Center in 2017. She is often called upon by other members of her firm to negotiate ESI protocols, establish document review protocols and procedures, and select appropriate ESI vendors tailored to the specific litigation.

In 2016, Jean was selected by her peers as the top Litigation attorney in the State of North Carolina for Business North Carolina Magazine's Legal Elite, gaining membership in the Legal Elite Hall of Fame. Since 2012, she has been selected to the Super Lawyers list for North Carolina in the areas of mass torts and class actions, with additional selection to the Top 50 Women North Carolina list.

Jean has been honored with the prestigious "AV" rating by Martindale-Hubbell. In2015, she was inducted as a Fellow of the Litigation Counsel of America, a prestigious trial lawyer honorary society comprised of less than one-half of one percent of American lawyers. For upholding the highest principles of the legal profession and for outstanding dedication to the welfare of others, Ms. Martin has also been selected as a Fellow of the American Bar Foundation, an honorary legal organization whose membership is limited to one-third of one percent of lawyers in each state.

Jean received her Juris Doctor degree from Wake Forest University School of Law, where she served as Editor-in-Chief of the Wake Forest Law Review and a member of Moot Court. Ms. Martin graduated from Wake Forest University with a Bachelor of Science in Mathematical Economics and earned a Master of International Business from the University of South Carolina.

Prior to her legal career, she worked in Munich, Germany on the finance team of a global computer company focusing on the company's expansion into the Eastern European market after the fall of the Berlin wall. Ms. Martin also worked as a marketing manager for an international candy manufacturer where her responsibilities included product development, brand licensing, market research, and sales analysis.

Ms. Martin is a member of the North Carolina bar. She is also admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the United States Court of Federal Claims, the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit, and the Western, Middle, and Eastern Districts of North Carolina.

attorneys.name: Jonathan A. Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan Martin brought his extensive trial experience and staid reputation for dedicated service to ALOIA | ROLAND | LUBELL in the Summer of 2022. He joins Senior Partners Ty Roland and Evan Lubell in leading the firm’s Personal Injury & Wrongful Death department.

Jonathan began his law career as a prosecutor with the 20th Judicial Circuit’s Office of the State Attorney. In a short time, he was promoted to serve as the prosecutor for Glades County, where he handled every case in the county, from misdemeanors to murders. He left the SAO to begin representing the injured in 2015.

He is an AV-rated personal injury attorney who has been to trial over 90 times for both civil and criminal matters. Since entering private practice Jonathan has recovered over 36 million dollars for the hundreds of injured clients and survivors he has represented.

Jonathan is married to Amy Martin, who serves as an Assistant State Attorney with the 20th Circuit. She is an avid University of Florida fan, and they enjoy going to games with their three children.

Involvement & Education

Currently, Martin serves as the Florida State Senator representing District 33 (Lee County). He has served as the Chair of the Senate Criminal Justice Committee since 2022. Since his election to the Senate he has been the primary sponsor of over 50 bills signed into law. In addition, he has secured hundreds of millions of dollars in state appropriations for Lee County and its numerous cities to help with Hurricane Ian recovery, protect our environment, and enhance our infrastructure.

He was previously appointed by two governors to serve as a Trustee for Florida Southwestern State College from 2018 until 2022. He has started two chapters of the Federalist Society – first, at Liberty University School of Law and second, in SWFL. He has served on the 20th Judicial Circuit’s Professionalism Committee, President of the Hendry-Glades Bar Association, is an Eagle member of the Florida Justice Association, and an active member of the Bar Association in Lee County, Cape Coral, and Hendry-Glades. He has also served on the board of a local private school and represented Lee County as a Delegate to the 2016 and 2024 Republican National Conventions.

attorneys.name: W. Doug Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Brain Injury Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
W. Doug Martin is a Shareholder of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. and Board Certified in Civil Trial Law by The Florida Bar. He was born in Beckley, West Virginia in 1980 and has lived in Central Florida since the age of five. He received his Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a major in Finance from the University of Florida in 2002. Mr. Martin graduated from the University of Florida Levin College of Law in 2005, where he received the Book Award for Trial Practice and Honors for Appellate Advocacy.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Martin worked for one of the largest defense law firms in Florida defending hospitals, businesses, and insurance companies. In 2008, he joined and became a partner at a referral based personal injury firm handling claims involving wrongful death, catastrophic personal injury, medical malpractice, product liability, premises liability, nursing home, automobile and trucking negligence.

In January of 2017, Mr. Martin joined the Orlando office of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. where he currently focuses his practice on personal injury litigation. Mr. Martin provides aggressive representation while maintaining compassion for his clients. In each case, Mr. Martin brings his experience litigating cases in both state and federal courts, as well as significant trial experience as a board certified civil trial lawyer. Mr. Martin has won significant verdicts on behalf of his clients, including verdicts of $6,560,000.00; $1,657,052.65; $1,426,767.11 and $366,179.18. Mr. Martin has been recognized for his superior qualifications, trial results, and leadership as a lawyer.

Since 2011, Mr. Martin has received the honor of being named a Florida Super Lawyers Rising Star. Since 2012, Mr. Martin has received the honor of being a member of The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40. Since 2013, Mr. Martin has received an AV® Preeminent rating by Martindale-Hubbell®. Additionally, Mr. Martin was awarded Florida Trend's Legal Elite Up & Comers for 2012. Mr. Martin is 1 of 174 attorneys in the state of Florida under the age of 40 who received this honor. Mr.Martin was nominated and chosen by his peers to be a part of Best Lawyers in America. Mr. Martin has served as a member of the Board of Directors for the Make-a-Wish Foundation of Central and Northern Florida, Young Lawyers Section of the Orange County Bar Association and Legal Aid Society of the Orange County Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Susan A. Martinez
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices Of Susan A. Martinez, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Navarre, FL
attorneys.bio:
Susan A. Martinez, Esq., I am a mother, formerly in the United States Air Force, and a former Assistant State Attorney, I have always wanted to be a prosecutor because of my strong sense of justice. I have extensive experience with the criminal justice system as both a prosecutor and a criminal defense attorney. After leaving the State Attorneys Office, I continued to have a strong sense of justice so I decided that I wanted to practice consumer law and I started learning about debtor’s rights and helping consumer’s.

I treat each client as if they are an actual victim of a fraudulent criminal or civil violation that was conducted by the banking institution. I was here at the beginning of the foreclosure crisis and decided that I would attack the foreclosure proceedings against the Banks using the weapons at my disposal. There are many State and Federal Laws to protect consumers and I use them on a daily basis. Defending a foreclosure action in a court of equity requires a unique background and an understanding and knowledge of real estate, property, contracts, securities, Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), secured transactions, and bankruptcy. When I am not defending homeowners, I am a consumer advocate using multiple consumer enacted State and Federal laws to pursue justice against corrupt corporations, banking institutions, credit reporting agencies, collection agencies and other wrongdoers for their fraudulent behaviors and damages they have caused consumers or society. I continue to endeavor in criminal cases, however, if you are a banker or mortgage broker, charged for any criminal activities…don’t bother to contact me.

I have held several positions in the Okaloosa and Walton Bar Association, including President. I am currently a member of the National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys (NACBA), a member of National Association of Consumer Advocates (NACA), a member of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (FACDL), a member of the Escambia – Santa Rosa Bar Association, the Florida Bar Association and the American Bar Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Brandon, FL
attorneys.bio:
Dr. Nick Martinez is managing partner of Martinez-Odom Law Group and has practiced law for 20 years. He is a Tampa native and speaks both English and Spanish.

Because of his medical degree and strong science background, Dr. Nick Martinez is able to quickly understand the most complicated medical issues. He regularly evaluates cases of medical malpractice and personal injury caused by negligence. He regularly handles litigation related to auto accidents, motorcycle accidents, and trucking accidents.

Over the past 20 years, Dr. Nick Martinez has represented clients in federal court jury trials, circuit court jury trials, and county court jury trials; Social Security and administrative hearings and appeals; workers compensation final hearings and appeals; criminal court; bankruptcy court; and traffic court.

Dr. Nick Martinez is a Certified Circuit Court mediator and was the past chairperson appointed by the Florida Bar for the Committee on Grievance mediation and Fee Arbitration. He believes that if you have a personal injury case with serious and complex medical issues, his expanded medical knowledge and experience empower him to help you with your case. Most serious injuries have long-term physical consequences. The evaluation of your restrictions and limitations must be completely understood in order to maximize your recovery. Dr. Martinez has both the legal and medical understanding to accomplish this on your behalf.

attorneys.name: Juan R. Martinez
attorneys.practice_type: Public Client Litigation and Investigation Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Juan R. Martinez represents Attorneys General and other public entities in litigation and investigations as a member of the firm's Public Client practice group. Currently, Juan plays a prominent role in representing the Commonwealth of Kentucky and other municipalities throughout the country in litigation against the manufacturers, distributors, and dispensers of opioids. Most recently, Juan was part of the team that successfully represented the State of Montana in a settlement with Big Tobacco for wrongly withheld funds as part of their payment obligations under the 1998 Master Settlement Agreement. Additionally, Juan represents whistleblowers in federal and state false claim actions and consumers in complex class action matters.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Juan worked for several multinational law firms, where he focused his practice on government investigations and enforcement actions, as well as products liability litigation, with an emphasis on pharmaceutical, medical device, and health care litigation. He has experience litigating a variety of complex matters in both state and federal courts, including multidistrict litigation.

Juan attended Florida State University, where he studied international affairs and economics. He then attended Emory University School of Law, where he served as managing editor for the Emory Corporate Governance and Accountability Review.

Before attending law school, Juan proudly served in the United States Army. Due to the attacks of 9/11, Juan was compelled to serve and enlisted to join the Army's elite Special Forces, commonly known as the Green Berets. Throughout the grueling pipeline, training focused on developing physical and mental toughness, leadership skills, adaptability, and strong communication skills under stress. Many of these traits have served as a foundation for Juan's legal career. During his service, Juan sustained an injury, which led to disability, which forced him to leave Army. However, Juan was able to continue his service as a member of our country's intelligence community."

attorneys.name: Aleida Martinez
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation & Dispute Resolution Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Aleida Martinez-Molina is a litigator with substantial business experience and a broad skill set. After beginning her career in New York in the creditors’ rights group of an AmLaw 100 international law firm, she returned to Florida to cast a wider net and further develop her own multi-faceted practice. Through the years she has gained highly specialized experience in niche practices and industries, including hospitality, aviation, and maritime law, which overlap with her core financial reorganization practice.

In addition to her financial reorganization practice, Aleida serves as one of six Subchapter V Trustees in the Southern District of Florida, appointed upon the enactment of the Small Business Reorganization Act of 2019. She also acts as outside general counsel to various highly successful businesses in the hospitality and cruising sectors. In all these roles, Aleida has the privilege of using her varied experience to assist businesses, entrepreneurs, and their creditors in efficiently and effectively avoiding or resolving disputes.

Throughout her career, Aleida has represented foreign investors, foreign governments, government-owned entities, and multinational corporations in cross-border disputes. She is fully bilingual in Spanish and English and communicates well in Portuguese and French.

Her professional affiliations and community service include:

attorneys.name: Gary Martoccio
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law - Employee Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Throughout his legal career, Gary Martoccio has focused exclusively on representing employees against employers. Gary has earned a reputation for his commitment to advocating for workers’ rights and securing justice for his clients.

Gary’s practice spans both in State and Federal Court, as well as before the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and equivalent State agencies. With a keen understanding of employment law, he navigates complex legal landscapes to ensure that employees receive the representation they deserve.

To date, Gary has achieved remarkable success, recovering over $50,000,000 for employees throughout his career. In addition, Gary has achieved successful results for his clients in over 200 Federal lawsuits, all of which he served as lead counsel. Gary’s dedication to his clients and his track record of significant recoveries underscore his role as a leading voice in employment law. His commitment to fighting for employees’ rights remains the cornerstone of his practice.

attorneys.name: Neil I. Maryanoff Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Maryanoff has been actively practicing law in South Florida since November 1978. He received his juris doctor degree from the University of Miami School of Law on May 28th, 1978.

In 1977, Mr. Maryanoff served in the Dade County State Attorney's office for one year as a certified legal intern. The internship was conducted first while the Honorable Richard E. Gerstein held the office of Dade County State Attorney, and the internship was completed while the Honorable Janet Reno was serving as the State Attorney for Dade County Florida.

In 1978, Mr. Maryanoff left the Dade County State Attorney's office for a clerkship at the firm of Carlos Lidsky, P.A. in Coral Gables, Florida. Upon passing the state bar exam, he became an associate of the firm where he handled criminal defense cases, both misdemeanors and felonies. He also trained extensively in the personal injury field and handled all types of personal injury cases both pre-litigation and at trial. This included automobile accidents, premises liability cases, products liability cases, and general liability cases.

Mr. Maryanoff established his own law office in 1980. He handled cases in many fields of law including admiralty, bankruptcy, contracts, commercial, divorce, estates and trusts, securities, and criminal defense in both state and federal courts.

Mr. Maryanoff has represented many bail bondsmen and served as general counsel to the Dade County Bailbond Association.

Starting in 1988, Mr. Maryanoff concentrated mainly on the development of his personal injury practice. He is a member of the Florida Bar Association, Dade County Bar Association and Broward County Bar Association, and is certified to practice before the Supreme Court of the State of Florida, Federal District Court for the Southern District of Florida, and the 11th and 5th Circuit of the United States' Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Paul N. Mascia
attorneys.practice_type: Short Sales & Loan Modifications Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Paul N. Mascia, Esq., is the founder and CEO of The Mascia Law Firm. The Mascia Law Firm is a full service law firm, with a special focus on assisting clients impacted by the recent debt and housing crisis. The firm provides counsel in the areas of foreclosure defense, short sales, loan modification, debt settlement and bankruptcy, and also assists companies and individuals with corporate, real estate, litigation, estate planning and investment related matters.

This mission of the Mascia Law Firm is to transform lives by delivering superior legal solutions with excellence, integrity and compassion. Beyond serving the legal needs of clients throughout Florida and the United States, the firm and its employees actively engage in charitable initiatives around the globe and in their local community.

Mr. Mascia has addressed various professional and civic groups on the legal and economic aspects of the current debt and housing crisis. He is the author of Escape Your Debt, a book that provides the moral basis for renegotiating debt agreements and explains how to legally eliminate debt while retaining one's integrity and personal values. He also presents a Biblical paradigm for navigating the debt relationship through his Break Free seminars.

Mr. Mascia previously practiced as a commercial attorney at Gray Robinson, P.A., and later with Zimmerman, Kiser & Sutcliffe, P.A. in the firm's Tax, Corporate and Real Estate practice group where he served clients in commercial real estate, corporate transactions, estate planning, related tax matters and was the lead attorney for D.R. Horton’s multifaceted Central Florida real estate development business.

A life-long Central Florida resident, Paul and his wife Sherill live in Winter Garden, Florida and have 3 children; Isabella, Noah and Judah. They met while working together at Frontline Outreach, an Orlando-based charity that serves the needs of inner-city youth. Mr. Mascia currently serves on the board of Mosaic Global Mission, a global social justice initiative, and is active in his local church.

attorneys.name: Lyle Brian Masnikoff Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Workers Compensation Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
The firm is led by Mr. Lyle B. Masnikoff who has received an "AV Preeminent" Rating, the highest possible rating a lawyer can receive from the Martindale-Hubbell Legal Directory. Martindale-Hubbell over the past 130 years has established the ratings of lawyers nationwide through a system of complex scoring formulas and criteria. With only a small percentage of attorneys in the country attaining this respected status, and only the most experienced being considered as candidates, the AV Rating is a testament from peer legal professionals and judges that the attorney "clearly indicates a demonstration of the highest professional knowledge and ethical standards". In fact, it is the highest rating available and indicates the attorney has reached the pinnacle of legal ability and competence.

Mr. Masnikoff graduated and received his Juris Doctor, cum laude, from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad Law School in 1998. He graduated in the top ten percent of his class. Mr. Masnikoff also received a Bachelors of Science Degree in Accounting from Nova Southeastern University.

After graduating from law school in 1998, Mr. Masnikoff worked for three years at a large insurance defense law firm: Kelley, Kronenberg, Gilmartin, Fichtel, and Wander, P.A. In 2001, the Law Offices of Lewen, Reich, & Mancini recruited Mr. Masnikoff to open an office in West Palm Beach. Three years later, Mr. Lewen retired and sold his West Palm Beach and Boca Raton offices to Masnikoff & Sternberg, P.A. After five years as a partner at Masnikoff & Sternberg, P.A., Mr. Masnikoff opened his own law firm, Lyle B. Masnikoff and Associates, P.A.

Mr. Masnikoff has represented thousands of clients throughout the entire State of Florida. He has handled Final Hearings, Trials, Mediations, depositions, and all other types of litigation. Mr. Masnikoff is a member in good standing with the Florida Bar. He is also admitted to practice law in front of the Middle and North Districts of the Federal Circuit Courts in Florida. He has been happily married for over ten years and is the proud father of two children.

attorneys.practice_type: Boating Accidents Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Curtis J. Mase is the Managing Shareholder and founder of Mase Lara. He is board certified in civil trial law by the Florida Bar and National Board of Trial Advocates (NBTA). Mr. Mase is also board certified in pretrial practice by the NBTA. His main area of practice is civil litigation with an emphasis on maritime and admiralty, personal injury and class actions. Mr. Mase has tried hundreds of jury and non-jury matters.

Born in Coral Gables, Florida, Mr. Mase earned his B.A. with a dual major in English and Business from Florida State University in 1982. He graduated from Florida State University College of Law, with honors, in 1984. While in law school he was a member of the Moot Court and the Journal of Land Use and Environmental Law.

In addition to his active trial practice, Mr. Mase has argued numerous appeals in both state and federal court, including the Florida Supreme Court. Mr. Mase has written and lectured on a number of subjects including trial practice and procedure, evidence and admiralty and maritime law.

attorneys.name: Nicole Masri
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in North Miami Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Nicole Masri-Kadoch is a partner at Ford, Dean & Rotundo, P.A., based in North Miami Beach, Florida. Ms. Masri focuses her practice on representing victims of personal injury and wrongful death. Driven by her commitment to promote justice and advocate for victims of abuse and neglect, Ms. Masri has built a distinguished legal career specializing in holding nursing homes, assisted living facilities and other care providers accountable.

Before joining Ford, Dean & Rotundo, P.A., she served as an Assistant State Attorney for the Miami-Dade State Attorney’s Office. In this role, she prosecuted thousands of criminal cases from misdemeanors to serious felonies. Ms. Masri also led investigations for the State’s Police Accountability and Integrity Unit and gained extensive courtroom experience prosecuting domestic violence offenses.

Since joining Ford, Dean & Rotundo, P.A., Ms. Masri has continued her mission of seeking justice for victims and their families. She has established herself as a compassionate and fierce advocate in nursing home abuse litigation, securing significant verdicts and settlements for her clients. Most notably, in December 2022, Ms. Masri obtained an $11,050,000 jury verdict in a nursing home abuse case.

attorneys.name: Katherine M. Massa
attorneys.practice_type: Tobacco Litigation Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Katherine Michelle Massa is an attorney in the Jacksonville, Florida office of Morgan & Morgan, P.A. Ms. Massa was born and raised in Jefferson City, Missouri. She received her undergraduate degree, with honors, from Texas Christian University in Fort Worth, Texas, and obtained her law degree from the University of Missouri - Columbia, School of Law. While in law school, Ms. Massa was an editor of the Journal of Dispute Resolution.

After graduating from law school in 2005, Ms. Massa clerked for the Honorable Kathianne Knapp Crane in the Missouri Court of Appeals for the Eastern District. Ms. Massa then spent three years in St. Louis, Missouri at a civil defense firm, concentrating her practice in products liability, business litigation, and health law.

In 2009, Ms. Massa moved to Jacksonville, Florida and joined Morgan & Morgan. Ms. Massa now focuses her practice on tobacco-related litigation, representing individuals and/or families of individuals harmed by cigarettes.

Ms. Massa distinguished herself by being named a "Rising Star" by Florida Super Lawyers Magazine, which recognizes the top 2.5% of the State's young lawyers. To be eligible for "Rising Stars," an attorney must be under the age of 40 or have been practicing for 10 years or less. A multiphase selection process is used to determine which attorneys will receive this distinction, and nominees are evaluated on the basis of peer recognition and professional excellence.

Ms. Massa is licensed in Missouri, Illinois, and Florida.

attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of John R. Mathias, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St. Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
I am Board Certified by the Florida Bar in the area of Civil Trial Law. To become board certified a lawyer must have tried a minimum of 15 cases in front of a jury and taken a written examination demonstrating their expertise in the area of Civil Trial Law. Only a small percentage of Florida lawyers are Board Certified in the area of Civil Trial. Under the Florida Bar rules, only a Board Certified Civil Trial lawyer can hold himself out as a "specialist".

I was admitted by the Supreme Court of Florida to practice law in the state of Florida in 1988. I have been admitted to practice in the Northern and Middle District Courts of the United States of America since 1988. I am also admitted to practice before the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals of the United States of America. I have tried cases in both the Federal and Florida court systems.

I am a member Florida Bar Grievance Committee for the Sixth Judicial Circuit. The committee investigates and gathers facts relating to the complaints against other lawyers referred to it by the Florida Bar. The committee then makes recommendations to the Florida Bar regarding the lawyer's conduct and discipline, if necessary. I have also been trained as a Certified Civil Mediator. I have been certified by the Supreme Court of Florida as a Civil Court Mediator and Court appointed Mediator.

I am a member of the Florida Justice Association, American Association for Justice, The Florida Bar, Tampa Bay Trial Lawyers, and The St. Petersburg Bar. I am also a member of the Northeast Exchange Club. I am rated "AV" by Martindale-Hubbell. Martindale-Hubbell is the oldest and most respected national legal directory. The directory rates lawyers based on reviews by their peers. The rating is based on legal ability and ethical conduct. Legal ability is rated "A" (Very High to Preeminent), "B" (High to Very High), or "C" (Good to High). Ethical Conduct is rated "V" (Very high). "AV" is the highest rating possible. Very few lawyers achieve this rating.

I graduated from the University of South Florida with a degree in Business Administration in May of 1985. I attended Stetson University College of Law and obtained my law degree in December of 1987. I have been practicing law continuously ever since. I began my legal career working for insurance companies defending arson, fraud, and injury claims. Some of these companies included State Farm, Allstate, and Nationwide. Nationwide Insurance Company provided additional negotiation training through the Pepperdine School of Law in California. I now use this training and experience to fight those companies I once represented.

I have been married for 15+ years and have two children. In my free time, I enjoy fly fishing for snook, redfish, tarpon, and bonefish.

Awards and Honors

Honors

"AV" by Martindale-Hubbell

attorneys.name: Edward G. Matheson
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Vero Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Edward "Ted" G. Matheson is the founding partner of the law firm Matheson & Horowitz. Ted attended the University of Florida and obtained a degree in finance. After graduating from college, he attended the University of Florida College of Law. He was a member of the University of Florida Law Review - a sign of outstanding academics and writing ability. After graduating from Law School, he spent approximately 3 years representing employers and insurance companies.

After working for these insurance companies, Ted became fed up with the way injured workers and disabled individuals were being treated by these companies. Therefore, in 1990, he formed The Law Firm of Bello & Matheson with Juan Bello. The Law Firm of Bello & Matheson was dedicated to representing only sick and injured individuals and did not provide any representation for employers or insurance companies. In 2000, former partner Juan Bello left to become a worker's compensation judge in West Palm Beach, Florida. At that time, a partnership was formed with Michael K. Horowitz, another attorney representing injured workers. Ted knew that Michael had the same desire to help the injured and disabled. Additionally, Ted had known Michael in his prior work as a defense attorney when Michael had cases against him. Ted was aware of the high level of legal representation that Michael provided and knew that he would be an excellent partner.

Since 1990, Ted has always resisted hiring associate attorneys. It has always been Ted's belief that an attorney must handle every aspect of a person's case and attend all depositions, mediations and hearings personally in order to have a full understanding of that client, his case and his needs. Our lawyers handle every aspect of the case personally and are always willing to meet with a client personally to discuss their case. Ted has been working since he was 14 years old and paid his entire way through both college and law school. He knows how tough it is for people out there trying to make a living. Ted understands how difficult it can be for a person who is unable to work due to any type of physical or mental condition and understands they need someone they can trust.

We are a small three-attorney law firm. We handle every aspect of our cases personally. Our goal is to work with our clients as closely as possible and to achieve the outcome that best meets their needs. There are times when this will be accomplished by going to trial and taking a very tough stand. There will also be other times when negotiations or working out an agreement may be in their best interest. The one thing that we always insure is that we are working with our clients, they are aware of every step of the process and are involved in reaching the outcome that is preferable for them.

Furthermore, the law firm of Matheson & Horowitz has an exceptional staff to assist you when you need help. "We have high standards in terms of our staff and how they communicate with our clients. We want our clients to get the information that they need in a professional manner. When the case is over, we want our clients to tell their friends and family about their positive experience at Matheson & Horowitz and that they received the best possible representation. We fight for our clients like they are our own family."

Contact us today to handle your legal needs at 772-569-2667.

attorneys.name: Brian Mathis
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Brian K. Mathis is the founder and managing attorney of Mathis Law Group, a Florida firm with a national transportation practice. Brian is an experienced business law and commercial litigation attorney specializing in the transportation and logistics industry. He serves as outside general counsel and U.S. counsel for several national and multinational transportation companies, respectively, and has extensive experience representing clients with regulatory compliance, business transactions, mergers and acquisitions, commercial contracting, labor and employment, insurance coverage structures, business structuring and asset protection, commercial and civil litigation, cargo and freight claims, broker and intermediary liability, and defense of third party liability claims.

Brian understands the nature of business and transportation risks and incorporates a thoughtful, innovative approach to finding and developing bold business and legal solutions for his clients. More importantly, he is able to connect with clients on a personal level, providing trustworthy business and legal advice with a candid and realistic assessment of a client’s matter. Brian is proud to provide sophisticated representation to assist clients with achieving their business goals and resolving practical challenges.

Prior to embarking on his legal career, Brian served in the United States Air Force as an airborne radar technician in the 552nd Operations Group, a battle management, command and control unit at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma. Following his service, he worked as an accountant with the University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma until his admission to the University of Florida Levin College of Law. When he’s not working, Brian enjoys spending time with his wife, four children, and grandchild. He also enjoys traveling, reading, hiking, and muay thai.

attorneys.name: Marc Matthews
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Matthews spent several years working in the trial departments of some of the largest and most prestigious law firms in the U.S., including Holland & Knight, LLP and DLA Piper US LLP, representing companies in cases involving truck crashes, catastrophic injury and product liability, and business disputes.

Relying on that experience, Mr. Matthews joined forces with one of the preeminent plaintiffs’ firms in the State of Florida, prosecuting catastrophic injury and wrongful death claims through verdict. In 2013 alone, he obtained two verdicts* in excess of ten million dollars. Always striving to passionately represent his clients in seeking to maximize their recovery, Mr. Matthews formed Matthews Injury Law in 2014. In 2018, Mr. Matthews obtained one of the Top 10 Car Accident Verdicts* in the State of Florida.

Born in Bradenton and raised in Pinellas County, Mr. Matthews attended the University of Central Florida on an academic scholarship before graduating from the University of Florida College of Law with honors. Since law school, Mr. Matthews has lived and practiced law in Orlando, West Palm Beach and Tampa, Florida. Mr. Matthews previously served as a member of the national trial counsel team for an international Fortune 100 trucking company. His experience includes litigating cases throughout the State of Florida and the nation involving catastrophic trucking accidents, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, tire blowouts/rollovers, wrongful death, product liability claims, and commercial actions.

In recognition of his legal skills and ethical standards, Mr. Matthews received an AV Preeminent Rating – the highest rating given to lawyers – from Martindale Hubbell. Martindale Hubbell has been a reliable source for over 130 years for those seeking experts in the legal industry.

Mr. Matthews is admitted to practice in all of the state and federal courts throughout Florida. He has appeared in the Northern, Middle, and Southern District Courts of Florida in cases ranging from multi-million dollar business disputes to multi-million dollar insurance claims. And he has tried cases ranging from wrongful death to motor vehicle accidents to real estate property claims to breach of contract disputes. Mr. Matthews has taken cases to trial in jurisdictions ranging from Walton County to Hillsborough County to Manatee County to Orange County to Miami-Dade County. And in seeking to fully represent his clients’ best interests in pursuing the justice they deserve, Mr. Matthews has also prosecuted cases through appeal when necessary.

Mr. Matthews is a 2009 graduate of Leadership Tampa Bay. In an effort to stay involved in his community outside of work, Mr. Matthews serves on the Board of Directors of three charitable foundations – Palma Ceia Little League, Vincent Jackson’s Jackson in Action 83 Foundation, which supports military children and families, and The Ryan Nece Foundation, which strives to empower student leaders to impact giving in their communities. Mr. Matthews is the Chairman of the Board of the Ryan Nece Foundation. Mr. Matthews also supports the Sidewalk Stompers, a nonprofit committed to providing safe crosswalks and sidewalks for children trying to get to school safely. To learn more about these charitable organizations, visit our community page.

(*Verdicts are before deductions for attorneys’ fees, expenses, and comparative negligence, if any. As each case must be litigated on its own facts, past results are not indicative of future outcomes).

And in seeking to fully represent his clients’ best interests in pursuing the justice they deserve, Mr. Matthews has also prosecuted cases through appeal when necessary.

Mr. Matthews is a 2009 graduate of Leadership Tampa Bay. In an effort to stay involved in his community outside of work, Mr. Matthews serves on the Board of Directors of three charitable foundations – Palma Ceia Little League, Vincent Jackson’s Jackson in Action 83 Foundation, which supports military children and families, and The Ryan Nece Foundation, which strives to empower student leaders to impact giving in their communities. Mr. Matthews is the Chairman of the Board of the Ryan Nece Foundation. Mr. Matthews also supports the Sidewalk Stompers, a nonprofit committed to providing safe crosswalks and sidewalks for children trying to get to school safely. To learn more about these charitable organizations, visit our community page.

attorneys.name: Rachel Mattie
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Rachel Mattie is a criminal defense attorney in the Orlando area. Ms. Mattie is a former Assistant Public Defender for the Ninth Judicial Circuit in Orange County, Florida. As an Assistant Public Defender, Ms. Mattie represented hundreds of indigent clients in the Central Florida community in both County and Circuit Court, defending various criminal matters including juvenile offenses, traffic cases, DUIs, thefts, drug possession, violations of probation, and more. While at the Public Defender's Office, Ms. Mattie developed a passion for not only active litigation and trial strategy, but more importantly, client satisfaction. Ms. Mattie is not only committed to achieving favorable results, but also ensuring that her clients fully understand the legal process and are actively involved in the outcome of their case.

Ms. Mattie's decision to pursue a career in criminal law began at a young age. Born in Detroit, Michigan, Ms. Mattie was exposed to a community with one of the highest violent crime rates in America. This sparked an initial interest in the prosecutorial side of crime. However, in high school, Ms. Mattie began volunteering as a peer representative for teenagers accused of low-level offenses through the Duval County Teen Court Program. Ms. Mattie learned just how rewarding it is to be a voice for others and serve as an advocate in the criminal justice system. It was then that Ms. Mattie developed a distinct interest in effectively representing the accused and protecting constitutional rights.

Ms. Mattie graduated from the University of Central Florida with a degree in Legal Studies, with minors in Criminal Justice and Political Science. She was the recipient of the Bright Future's Scholarship and an Academic Competitiveness grant upon admission. Ms. Mattie attended Barry University School of Law in Orlando and graduated in the top 10% of her class. Ms. Mattie was elected Editor-in-Chief of Barry Law Review in her second year, authored two articles selected for publication, was employed by the school as a Research Assistant, and developed a symposium that focused on self-defense law and ethical prosecution that attracted over 100 attendees from across the state.

Ms. Mattie is currently a member of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers as well as the Central Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.

attorneys.name: Peter Matwiczyk
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
attorneys.bio:
Peter Matwiczyk has been practicing law in Palm Beach County for over thirty years. He has been board certified by the Florida Bar in wills, trusts, and estates since 1992, and has been AV rated by Martindale-Hubbell for more than thirty years. Mr. Matwiczyk has been a member of the American College of Trusts and Estates Counsel ("ACTEC") since 1992, where he has served, continuously, as a member of the Fiduciary Litigation Committee. He also currently serves as a member of the ACTEC Professional Standards Committee. He has regularly been named a Florida Super Lawyer in trusts and estates litigation and has been listed in Best Lawyers for nearly 15 years.

Prior to establishing his practice in Palm Beach County, Mr. Matwiczyk was a senior trial lawyer for the Internal Revenue Service, Office of Chief Counsel, in Manhattan, in the Tax Court Litigation Division, where he tried approximately twenty cases in the United States Tax Court to decision.

Mr. Matwiczyk assists clients in the estate planning process and counsels families in complex trust administrations, estate administrations, disputes involving trust and estate administrations, and trustee and fiduciary misconduct. He also represents clients in guardianship litigation as well as disputes with the Internal Revenue Service and in Tax Court litigation. Mr. Matwiczyk routinely cooperates with lawyers from states other than Florida as co-counsel in connection with fiduciary litigation and trust and estate administration and litigation matters.

Mr. Matwiczyk has a decades long history of service to his community, where he has served as a member of the board of the Gulfstream Council Boy Scouts of America, the Palm Beach Zoo, where he also served as President, and the Board of Directors of public television station, WPBT, Channel 2, which serves the area from Miami through Vero Beach. He is currently serving his second ten-year term as a member of the Board of Directors of the Community Foundation for Palm Beach and Martin Counties, where he currently serves on the Executive Committee. Previously, he chaired the Investment Committee for the Foundation which has responsibility for managing an endowment of approximately $150,000,000.

His family includes his wife, Carol, his daughter and two grandsons. He is an avid fly fisherman and boater and his leisure time is spent studying and reading European and American history.

attorneys.bio:
Gregory Maxwell is a member of the Florida Bar and is admitted to practice in the United States District Courts for the Northern, Middle, and Southern Districts of Florida; the United States Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals; and the United States Supreme Court. Greg holds an AV-rating from Martindale Hubbell, the highest peer-review rating bestowed on attorneys by that prestigious organization.

Greg graduated with honors from Stetson University and then served three years in the United States Navy as one of the youngest commissioned officers on active duty. A Viet Nam Era veteran, he was assigned as a Naval Gunfire Liaison Officer to the 2nd Marine Division and was qualified as a Naval Marine Corps Parachutist. As a paratrooper, he was involved in extensive field operations with the Marine Corps and the United States Army's 82nd Airborne Division, participating in numerous airborne operations stateside and abroad.

After his military service, Greg attended Florida State University's College of Law where he was awarded a Juris Doctor degree with honors. He was then honored to serve a two-year clerkship with a United States District Judge in Jacksonville, Florida.

attorneys.name: Ryan D. Maxey
attorneys.practice_type: Class Action Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Maxey grew up in Tampa, Florida. He attended the University of South Florida, where he obtained Bachelors's Degrees in Computer Science and Philosophy. During and after his undergraduate education, Mr. Maxey developed software and databases for Amalie Oil Company, an automotive lubricant manufacturer located in the Port of Tampa. Mr. Maxey later attended law school at the University of Florida, graduating order of the coif in 2008.

From 2008 to 2011, Mr. Maxey served as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Elizabeth A. Jenkins, United States Magistrate Judge, University of Florida. Mr. Maxey then worked at one of the country's largest law firms, Greenberg Traurig, for four years. In 2015, Mr. Maxey joined Morgan & Morgan's Business Trial Group as a lead attorney handling a variety of business litigation matters. Mr. Maxey later started his own law practice, litigating claims related to breach of contract, trade secret misappropriation, the FLSA, the FDCPA, and premises liability.

Since joining Morgan & Morgan's Complex Business Division, Mr. Maxey has worked on a variety of class actions involving data breaches, ranging from the exposure of personally identifiable information and protected health information for tens of thousands of individuals to tens of millions of individuals.

Mr. Maxey was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2008 and is also admitted to practice in the Middle District of Florida and the Southern District of Florida.
