attorneys.name: Tara Petzoldt Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Marital & Family Law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Tara Petzoldt, Esq. is an experienced litigator and skilled negotiator who focuses her practice on marital and family law matters. Before narrowing her practice to family law, Tara spent nearly seven years practicing general civil and commercial litigation at two large, national law firms.

During her time in commercial litigation, Tara represented a wide range of clients—from large financial institutions and corporations to small business owners and individuals—both in and out of the courtroom. She supervised cases from inception through resolution, advising clients at every stage of litigation. Her experience includes drafting and arguing dispositive motions and briefs, handling discovery and depositions, participating in mediation and settlement negotiations, and appearing in high-stakes hearings, bench trials, and jury trials. Tara also oversaw appellate matters, including the drafting of complex appellate briefs.

In addition to her commercial litigation work, Tara handled matters involving family-related legal issues, including trust, probate, and estate litigation. Notably, she second-chaired a lengthy bench trial involving the enforcement of a complex marital settlement agreement with significant tax implications, achieving a successful result for the client.

While Tara’s litigation background equips her to manage complex and high-conflict matters, her true passion lies in using her skills to help individuals during some of the most difficult—and sometimes transformative—moments of their lives. Her extensive legal experience, paired with a genuine compassion for clients, allows her to guide families through challenging legal issues with clarity, confidence, and care.

Prior to her admission to the Florida Bar in 2016, Tara attended Stetson University College of Law on a Full Presidential Merit Scholarship. She graduated magna cum laude with honors, ranking seventh in her law school class. During law school, Tara was actively involved in extracurriculars, including serving on the Stetson Law Review as an Articles and Symposia Editor and Assistant Managing Editor. She also worked as a research assistant and teaching assistant in Constitutional Law, Trial Advocacy, and Criminal Law, and served as a federal judicial intern for the Honorable James D. Whittemore of the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida.

Tara earned her undergraduate degree from the University of South Florida, where she competed as an NCAA Division I athlete on the USF Women’s Soccer Team. She was recognized as a member of the Big East All-Academic Team, participated in the USF Honors College, and graduated summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science.

Born in Boston, Massachusetts, Tara moved to Palm Harbor, Florida in elementary school and has proudly called the Tampa Bay area home ever since. She now resides in Tampa with her husband, Drew. Outside of work, Tara enjoys cooking homemade meals for family and friends, traveling, and spending time at Florida’s beautiful beaches.

attorneys.name: Paul Domenic Petruzzi
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Paul D. Petruzzi, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Petruzzi has devoted his entire legal career to the representation of clients involved with criminal matters. His clients include individuals and corporations under Federal or State criminal investigation or prosecution nationwide. His representation includes assisting clients during all stages of criminal investigation from interviews to grand jury appearances and subpoena compliance. The core of Mr. Petruzzi’s practice is the defense of his clients during jury trial, or on direct appeal or other post-conviction proceedings from writs of habeas corpus to substantial assistance. He has also assisted clients in Europe, the Caribbean, and Central and South America pending extradition or rendition. As such, Mr. Petruzzi has the experience and knowledge to have earned the reputation that he has as a tenacious and aggressive advocate who thoroughly prepares for the defense of his clients.

Originally from Olean, New York, Mr. Petruzzi is a 1990 graduate of Hamilton College where he majored in government with a minor in music and African American studies. He is a 1993 graduate of the University of Miami School of Law where he won the book award for his legal writing skills and where he was the Executive Editor of the University of Miami Entertainment and Sports Law Review. Mr. Petruzzi began his career as a criminal defense lawyer in 1993 with prominent Miami criminal defense attorney Roy Black.

During his association with Mr. Black, Mr. Petruzzi represented clients in both Federal and State court charged with a variety of offenses including complex white collar crimes, major narcotics and money laundering crimes, racketeering and wire fraud offenses. Since starting his own criminal defense law firm in January of 1999, Mr. Petruzzi's criminal defense practice has included virtually every conceivable type of criminal matter including narcotics offenses (involving both traditional and synthetic drugs), fraud and theft offenses, money laundering, murder (death penalty and non-death penalty), arson, assault, battery, aggravated assault, aggravated battery, battery of law enforcement officers, kidnapping, robbery, stalking, racketeering (RICO), tax fraud, mortgage fraud, Medicare fraud, Ponzi schemes, Medicaid fraud, wire fraud, computer crimes, firearms offenses, sex crimes, white collar crimes, and countless other felonies and misdemeanors.

Mr. Petruzzi has been a member, in good standing, of the Bar of the State of Florida since 1993. Mr. Petruzzi has also been licensed to practice before the United States Supreme Court since 1997 and dozens of Federal Courts since 1994. He is admitted to practice before the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida, the United States District Court for the Northern District of Florida, and the United States District Court for the District of Colorado, and the United States District Court for the Western District of New York. Similarly, Mr. Petruzzi has also been admitted to practice in various criminal matters before the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York, the United States District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania, the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey, the United States District Court for the Middle District of Georgia, the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina, the United States District Court for the Western District of Tennessee, United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico, and the United States District Court for the Western District of North Carolina, as well as State Courts in Connecticut, Louisiana, and Texas. He has also assisted foreign counsel in various jurisdictions on criminal extraction matters including Aruba, Canada, Colombia, Curacao, Germany, Haiti, Honduras, Israel, Mexico, the Netherlands, Nicaragua, and the United Kingdom.

Mr. Petruzzi has been recognized as one of the "Top 100 Trial Lawyers" by the American Trial Lawyers Association, every year, from 2007 to 2020. He has had the highest, 10.0, “Superb,” rating by AVVO for several years and he has also been awarded the highest rating by Martindale Hubbell for over fifteen. The Martindale-Hubbell Peer Review Ratings are an objective indicator of a lawyer's high ethical standards and professional ability, generated from evaluations of lawyers by other lawyers and judges.

Among other distinctions, Mr. Petruzzi is a Life Member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, a life member of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers-Miami Chapter, and he has been on the legal committee for the National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws for over fifteen years.

Many of Mr. Petruzzi’s criminal cases are reported in the media worldwide. Stories of his cases and clients have been featured on ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, CNN, MSNBC and many local affiliates, as well as The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, The Miami Herald, The Sun Sentinel, The New York Post, The New York Daily, Miami New Times, The Chicago Herald, The Chicago Tribune, Reuters, The Associated Press, The Key West Citizen, Ocean Drive Magazine, and many others.

To speak with Mr. Petruzzi about your case you may contacts us online, or call 305-330-1774 to schedule your complimentary personal consultation!

attorneys.name: Thomas C. Peña
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Thomas C. Peña was born and raised in the South Florida area. He attended the University of Florida and Florida State University College of Law.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Peña accepted a position as an Assistant Public Defender with the Eighteenth Judicial Circuit in Sanford, Florida. During the time he spent with the Public Defender's Office, he represented hundreds of clients charged with misdemeanor and felony offenses. As an Assistant Public Defender, he represented clients in over forty jury trials. He also represented mental health clients facing involuntary commitment under The Baker Act. In 2006, Mr. Peña moved to the Tampa Bay area and worked for several years at a small general practice firm. During his time there, he worked in the areas of family law, civil litigation, Social Security Disability, bankruptcy, criminal law, real estate, and probate matters, amongst others. Mr. Peña also worked at larger firms in the Tampa Bay area that focused on the areas of civil litigation and foreclosure.

Mr. Peña relocated back to the Orlando area in 2014, and began working for The Nation Law Firm practicing exclusively in the area of Social Security Disability. Finding this practice of law very rewarding, he continues to do this today at Morgan & Morgan, representing individuals at hearings before Administrative Law Judges. He is admitted to and has practiced in the courts of the State of Florida, and the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida. He speaks Spanish and Italian.

attorneys.name: Russell Pfeifer
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Russell M. Pfeifer is a partner in the Miami office of The Chartwell Law Offices, LLP and is a trial lawyer whose practice focuses on general business litigation with an emphasis in products liability and premises liability matters. He has a proven record of obtaining results including a defense verdict in a two week wrongful death case representing Simon Malls from the 2006 Christmas Eve shooting of a twenty-four year old at the Boynton Beach Mall. The shooting made national headlines and the suspect was captured after being featured on America's Most Wanted. The family of the deceased asked the jury to award $5 million during trial. Mr. Pfeifer was also retained as trial counsel on behalf of Mansion Nightclub (Miami Beach) in another highly publicized wrongful death case involving the stabbing and tragic death of a newlywed nightclub bouncer and two patrons. He was instrumental in securing a favorable global settlement on confidential terms. In 2013, Mr. Pfeifer obtained another defense verdict for a Tampa area condominium association. In addition to the defense verdict, the court entered a final judgment against the plaintiff in excess of $100,000 for the condominium association's attorney's fees and costs after a one week jury trial.

Mr. Pfeifer graduated from Nova Southeastern University, (magna cum laude), with a B.S. in 1999, and earned his law degree from the University of Miami School of Law, (cum laude), in 2003 where he received the Dean's Certificate of Achievement Award in Legal Research and Writing, the Cali Excellence for the Future Award in Legal Research and Writing, Dean's Merit Scholarship and the Paul B. Anton Scholarship for academic excellence. He was previously an attorney with Wilson Elser Moskowitz Edelman & Dicker, LLP and a member of the firm's appellate and trial practice groups handling the defense for national and international product manufacturers, commercial premises owners, and professional liability claims of attorneys, accountants, insurance professionals and architects. Mr. Pfeifer has argued before four of the five District Courts of Appeal in Florida and is admitted to the Florida Bar, all state courts in Florida, the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States District Courts for the Southern, Middle and Northern districts of Florida.

Prior to joining the Chartwell Law Offices, LLP, Mr. Pfeifer was also affiliated with two admiralty and maritime boutique law firms. Mr. Pfeifer headed the appellate practice groups achieving a string of favorable published decisions on forum non conveniens and other jurisdictional grounds. He is experienced in the defense of Jones Act claims, marine salvage, and recreational marine matters and has authored an article on marine insurance published by the University of San Francisco Maritime Law Journal. He also is a regular guest lecturer at the University of Miami, School of Communication in advocacy and public speaking.

attorneys.name: Jesse Philippe
attorneys.practice_type: Alimony Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Jesse Philippe-Auguste, Esq., attended Salmon P. Chase College of Law. While at Chase, Jesse excelled in advocacy and achieved numerous accolades, most notably finishing as a top three finalist in the school's Moot Court competition for first-year law students, competing as a member of the Black Law Students Association Mock Trial Team, the National Mock Trial Team, and the National Moot Court Board. While competing with the National Mock Trial Team, his team finished among the top 10 law schools in the country in the prestigious South Texas College of Law Mock Trial Challenge.

While in law school, Jesse was very active. In addition to being a member of competition teams, he also held several leadership roles. He was twice voted by his peers to serve as Secretary of the Student Bar Association and President of the Black Law Student Association. Additionally, Jesse clerked with prestigious law firms, a Fortune 500 company, and was named to the Dean's List all while working part-time at the law school library. Finally, Jesse volunteered at the Uncontested Divorce Clinic, a program sponsored by Chase College of Law and the Legal Aid Society of Greater Cincinnati. There he assisted and represented those with low economic means with filing divorce.

Jesse demonstrated a knack for litigation long before law school. While in high school at Miami Killian Senior High School, Jesse took part in a mock trial during a legal oriented elective course. Jesse's interest in law continued when he attended Florida State University. While in college, Jesse was very active with Phi Alpha Delta, a Pre-Law fraternity, where he successfully competed in numerous Mock Trial competitions and served as Mock Trial Chair. When competing, Jesse won multiple "Best Attorney" awards and at a young age demonstrated strong advocacy skills.

As an attorney, Jesse has argued before courts in the 11th and 17th Circuits. He has also written appellate briefs for matters in the 2nd and 5th District Courts of Appeals.

Jesse is an AV Rated Preeminent Attorney with years of experience practicing in family law. He has experience in very litigious and contentious matters in family law.

Jesse can serve as a tremendous asset to clients. He brings a tireless work ethic and a strong desire to help others.

When not practicing law, Jesse enjoys working out, listening to music, watching college football, and watching shows on Netflix.

attorneys.name: Crystal Phillips
attorneys.firm_name: Law Firm of Ayo & Iken PLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
I have an extensive background in psychology and social work that has paved the way for my legal career. As I worked toward my Bachelor degrees from the University of South Florida, I interned for the Spring of Tampa Bay, an organization that seeks to prevent domestic violence and provide services to survivors and their children.

After graduating, I worked full-time there and saw the need for good attorneys to help victims. Volunteer attorneys helped victims with a variety matters such as filing domestic violence injunctions and assisted in child custody and divorce matters. My admiration for those attorneys led me to practicing family law.

I went on to earn my law degree from Marquette University Law School attending the University of Wisconsin Law School in Madison while continuing to be committed to volunteerism and community involvement. My life’s work is to always aggressively help my clients reach a more positive life. It became a mission for me to help empower not only women but also men who may be suffering in a domestic situation where there are power and control abuses occurring. Domestic violence is gender neutral, so its something both men and women can experience. The perception is domestic violence is just physical but it can also be emotional and financial.

I am very compassionate in identifying how divorce and child custtody issues affect a family and help my clients work toward a path to resolution. I too have been through a divorce and have seen many others in helping clients throughout my career. It gives me a deep understanding of what people are going through. I am certainly very assertive. I am my clients’ champion, fighting for their rights.

My life has always been centered around volunteerism. I have served on numerous boards and chaired large fundraisers for various non-profits. Promoting social justice, especially empowering women, is truly a passion.

Awards and Honors

Honors

YWCA 2015 Woman of Distinction

attorneys.name: Steven B. Phillips
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in West Palm Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Steve Phillips is a native of West Palm Beach, Florida. He attended Auburn University where he was a member of the baseball team and graduated with a degree in accounting. He earned his law degree from Nova Southeastern University School of Law. He is board-certified by The Florida Bar in civil trial law, having been certified in 1998 and recertified every five years since. It distinguishes him as a specialist in the areas of personal injury, wrongful death and insurance law. Only about 5,000 of the nearly 80,000 eligible members of The Florida Bar are board certified in their respective fields. For the past 20 years Mr. Phillips has specialized in representing injured individuals and families who have lost a loved one due to someone else's negligence in automobile and truck collisions, motorcycle accidents, boat accidents and trip and fall accidents.

Prior to that time, Mr. Phillips gained extensive experience in the operation of insurance companies and the handling of injury claims as legal counsel to some of Florida's largest insurance companies and their insureds for nine years. His experience in handling significant personal injury and wrongful death cases from both sides allows him to offer quality representation to his clients who have been harmed in an accident from the perspective of an insider to the insurance claims industry. His practice also includes representing individuals and small businesses against large insurance companies in insurance coverage disputes where the insurance company has wrongfully denied a claim. He has tried over 100 jury trials in state and federal courts and obtained numerous multimillion-dollar jury verdicts and settlements. Steve has had multiple jury verdicts featured in the Daily Business Review and has been recognized on multiple occasions by the publications Florida Super Lawyers and Palm Beach Illustrated. To get in touch with Steve please contact us.

attorneys.bio:
Jessica Pickeral is a litigation Attorney in Morgan & Morgan‘s Orlando office. Miss Pickeral's practice areas include personal injury protection litigation and various first party insurance claims/disputes. Jessica is a native Floridian and received both her Bachelor's degree magna cum laude and Juris Doctorate cum laude from The Florida State University. While in law school, Miss Pickeral interned at a large financial institution in Manhattan and had the opportunity to extend her legal studies abroad at Oxford University. Miss Pickeral facilitated in publishing articles on securities fraud as a research assistant and participated in several student organizations such as Phi Delta Phi honor society, Phi Alpha Delta and the business law society.

Jessica is driven with passion by helping medical providers across the state of Florida collect the maximum amount of reimbursement from Insurance Companies, for the services provided to insured-patients who suffered bodily injuries sustained from a motor vehicle accident. Outside of advocating for her clients at Morgan and Morgan, in her free time Miss Pickeral enjoys volunteering, traveling, and tutoring aspiring law students for the LSAT.

Miss Pickeral's professional memberships include the Orange County Bar Association and the Central Florida Association for Women Lawyers. She is also a member of both the Florida Bar and the New Jersey Bar.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Boca Raton, FL
attorneys.bio:
Keith A. Pierro, Esq. joined Gold & Gold, P.A. in 2012 and has been a Partner since 2014. Keith was born in Brooklyn, New York and raised in the suburbs of New Jersey. Keith earned his Bachelor of Arts Degree in Communications from the University of Maryland in 2002 and then moved to Miami, Florida where he received his Juris Doctorate from the University of Miami School of Law in 2005.

After law school, Keith began his legal career at the law firm of Hirschhorn and Bieber, P.A., where he focused his practice in the areas of complex civil, criminal and white collar defense litigation in State and Federal Courts at both the trial and appellate levels. It was here that Keith learned the inherent value in being a true litigator, and to aggressively and zealously pursue the most favorable resolutions for his clients, no matter how difficult the task.

Keith is a personal injury attorney in Boca Raton who handles catastrophic personal injury cases involving medical malpractice, automobile, motorcycle and trucking accidents, accidents resulting in brain damage, construction and electrocution accidents, nursing home negligence, premises liability and negligent security, product liability and wrongful death claims.

Amongst his peers in the community, Keith has a reputation for striving to put ethics and integrity, as well as the needs of his clients, above all else. Keith is AV-rated by Martindale-Hubbell and has been recognized by Florida Super Lawyers every year from 2009 to present.

attorneys.name: Kevin Pillion Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Elder Law Lawyers in Sarasota, FL
attorneys.bio:
The practice of “Happy Law” may sound like an oxymoron, but not for one unique Sarasota attorney.

Kevin Pillion is the founder of the Life Planning Law Firm in Sarasota, Florida. A tall and slender man with red hair and smiling Irish eyes, Kevin’s casual demeanor is engaging. He’s always ready with a funny quip and a good cup of hot Irish tea. That down-to-earth attitude is especially refreshing when people realize that it comes with decades of personal and legal experience working with seniors and their families.

His caring approach and understanding of family needs is a direct result of personal experience. Dealing with the care of his elderly parents and the stress that resulted has given him a deep empathy for others in that situation. Although he had a successful career in Washington, D.C., Kevin was suddenly thrust into personally caring for his mother and father, who could no longer manage by themselves. Eventually, Kevin left his work to focus completely on his parents who both suffered from dementia. “Both Mom and Dad really wanted to remain in their home on Cape Cod. I wanted to honor their wishes, so I headed north from Washington, D.C., where I had been working as an Estate Planning Attorney,” Kevin says.

During the next 4 years, he personally cared for his parents full-time, spending part of the year in Cape Cod, Massachusetts and the remaining part of the year in Bradenton, Florida where his parents had a winter home. He shared their final years with them until they passed away in 2007, just six months apart. With the loss of his parents and his caregiving role, Kevin felt a huge void in his life. Thankfully, the fond memories of his parents, especially the trips they took together to visit family and friends in his mother’s birthplace of Dublin, Ireland, helped carry Kevin through this difficult period of loss and adjustment. He took time to reflect … and decided he would dedicate his life to using his personal experiences with his parents to help seniors and their families. Over the past 8 years, Kevin has created an Elder Law firm that addresses his clients’ needs from a ‘holistic’ viewpoint … by addressing legal, medical, financial, social and family issues that seniors encounter every day. Kevin’s primary goal is to promote the highest quality of life for his clients, just as he did with his own parents.

Kevin received his Juris Doctorate from Georgetown University Law Center and has been practicing law since 1990. In addition, he worked on many cases with Steven Winkelman, the prominent Estate Planning Attorney and former Adjunct Professor of Estate Planning at Georgetown University Law Center.

He is a member of The Florida Bar, National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, Florida Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, Life Care Planning Law Firms Association, Veterans Benefits Committee of the Elder Law Section of The Florida Bar, and he is Accredited by the Department of Veterans Affairs. Kevin is licensed to practice law in both Florida and Washington, DC. Kevin is also a member of WealthCounsel and a CELA, The Certified Elder Law Attorney (CELA), by the National Elder Law Foundation.

In his spare time, Kevin is an avid reader and quotes one of his favorite writers, Joseph Addison, and English scholar from the 1700’s: “Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are: Something to do, Something to love, and Something to hope for.” These are words that Kevin lives by.

Over the past 8 years, Kevin has created an Elder Law firm that addresses his clients’ needs from a ‘holistic’ viewpoint … by addressing legal, medical, financial, social and family issues that seniors encounter every day. Kevin’s primary goal is to promote the highest quality of life for his clients, just as he did with his own parents.

Kevin received his Juris Doctorate from Georgetown University Law Center and has been practicing law since 1990. In addition, he worked on many cases with Steven Winkelman, the prominent Estate Planning Attorney and former Adjunct Professor of Estate Planning at Georgetown University Law Center.

He is a member of The Florida Bar, National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, Florida Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, Life Care Planning Law Firms Association, Veterans Benefits Committee of the Elder Law Section of The Florida Bar, and he is Accredited by the Department of Veterans Affairs. Kevin is licensed to practice law in both Florida and Washington, DC. Kevin is also a member of WealthCounsel and a CELA, The Certified Elder Law Attorney (CELA), by the National Elder Law Foundation.

In his spare time, Kevin is an avid reader and quotes one of his favorite writers, Joseph Addison, and English scholar from the 1700’s: “Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are: Something to do, Something to love, and Something to hope for.” These are words that Kevin lives by.

attorneys.name: Daniel F. Pilka
attorneys.practice_type: Community Association Law and HOA Disputes Lawyers in Brandon, FL
attorneys.bio:
Since 1984, Daniel F. Pilka has represented clients all over the West Coast and Central Florida. A significant part of Mr. Pilka’s practice is devoted to representing both homeowners and condominium associations, as well as individuals who live within a deed restricted community and who are having issues with their homeowners or condominium association. As managing partner, Mr. Pilka also specializes in civil litigation. Mr. Pilka is also a certified civil mediator.

Mr. Pilka has 30 years of litigation experience, during which time he has developed a reputation for passionately and aggressively representing individuals and their businesses in all manners of civil disputes including contracts, real estate, personal injury and wrongful death, insurance disputes, etc. With his extensive experience and background, Mr. Pilka is highly trained in helping people avoid problems before they occur. Also, while he is an experienced litigator, and because he is an experienced litigator, he knows how important it is to try to avoid litigation. With such qualifications and experience, Mr. Pilka is able to use his background and experience to help both sides of an issue as a board certified mediator.

Mr. Pilka understands the importance of civic responsibility. He is very involved in the community and fully understands the importance of giving back to the community. His community involvement includes being the chairman of the St. Joseph’s Academy Foundation, the chair of the St. Joseph's Catholic School, and being actively involved as a member of St. Joseph's Parish Planned Giving Committee and member of the Parish Financial Committee and St. Joseph’s Parish Foundation. He is a member of the Knights of Columbus, 4th Degree Counsel 2505, Lakeland, Florida, as well as being actively involved in the South Lakeland Rotary Club.

Mr. Pilka is also actively in the Brandon Chamber of Commerce and The Lakeland Chamber of Commerce, previously having chaired several committees and having served two terms on the Board of Directors for the Brandon Chamber of Commerce. Pilka & Associates, P.A., was recently awarded Small Business of the Month Award for the Lakeland Chamber of Commerce. In addition, Mr. Pilka formerly served as president for the Brandon Bar Association, Brandon, Florida, and is currently an adjunct professor at Florida Southern College, Lakeland, Florida

attorneys.name: John Hutchins Pinder VI
attorneys.practice_type: Brain Injuries Lawyers in St Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Hutch, a fourth generation Florida native, attended Florida State University and Stetson University College of Law where he earned dual J.D. and M.B.A. degrees.

Hutch has tried more than 50 jury trials to verdict throughout the State of Florida. Mr. Pinder began his legal career working as an Assistant State Attorney in the Sixth Judicial Circuit. As a prosecutor, Hutch tried a multitude of different felony jury trials to verdict, including murder, sexual battery, drug trafficking, and child abuse. In 2009, Hutch accepted a position with a highly regarded boutique civil trial firm to try cases against tobacco companies and other large corporations. In this role, Hutch tried multi-week civil jury trials throughout the State of Florida and recovered millions of dollars on behalf of his clients.

Hutch has been nominated by his peers to serve as President Elect of the St. Petersburg Bar Association. The Florida Bar has recognized Mr. Pinder as a Board Certified Civil Trial Attorney, an honor given to less than 2% of all attorneys practicing in the State of Florida. Hutch has been recognized on multiple occasions as one of "Florida Super Lawyers." Mr. Pinder is also a graduate of Leadership St. Pete.

On a personal note, Hutch and his wife Jen live in St. Pete with their three children. Hutch is an avid fisherman and enjoys spending time outdoors with his family. In support of his appreciation for the outdoors and need to conserve Florida's natural marine resources, Hutch is a long-time member of Coastal Conservation Association, where he served as the State Executive Board Representative for Pinellas County.

attorneys.name: Nick J. Pineiro Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Lakeland, FL
attorneys.bio:
Nick Pineiro is a native Floridian and Cuban-American. He earned his bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration from the University of Central Florida in 2015. Before pursuing his legal career, Nick made a sought to make an impact in the community by coordinating healthcare services for injured workers under Florida’s workers’ compensation system, giving him invaluable experience in navigating complex regulations and advocating for the injured.

In 2017, Nick relocated to Saint Petersburg to attend Stetson University College of Law. During his law school journey, he honed his skills as a law clerk, gaining critical insights into Estate Planning and Probate Administration. These early experiences provided him with a solid foundation in the areas of law that continue to inform his practice today.

Upon admission to the Florida Bar, Nick began his legal career representing prominent Florida insurance companies and major automotive manufacturers. He handled complex cases involving insurance coverage disputes and breach of warranty claims, developing a keen understanding of corporate defense strategies. Now, Nick leverages this knowledge to advocate for individuals, leveraging the expertise he gained defending major corporations to protect and advance his clients’ interests.

Beyond his legal practice, Nick enjoys travel and spends his off-hours hiking, off-roading, and exploring the diverse landscapes of the country, together with his wife, Michelle, and their two dogs.

attorneys.bio:
Eloisa Pino is an Associate Attorney located in Orlando, FL. She earned her bachelor's degree from the University of Florida and then earned her law degree from Barry University, Dwayne O. She then became an advocate at Barry University, Dwayne O. Andreas School of Law's Immigration Clinic and was later invited to form part of their Advanced Immigration Clinic.

During and after law school Eloisa worked for a boutique Personal Injury firm in the Winter Park area, where she specialized in automobile collision, premises liability, and first party property cases. Eloisa is fluent in English and Spanish. When Eloisa is not passionately representing her clients, she can be found attending Zumba classes, walking around local trails, brunching with girlfriends, and most importantly spending quality time with her family.

attorneys.name: Kathryn S. Piscitelli
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Kathryn Piscitelli brings over 40 years of knowledge and experience in labor and employment law to our firm. Ms. Piscitelli’s litigation experience is wide-ranging, including cases involving claims of race discrimination, sex discrimination, disability discrimination, age discrimination, retaliation for whistleblowing, and violations of veterans’ and servicemembers’ job rights. She is board certified by the Florida Bar in labor and employment law. Ms. Piscitelli is a past Chair of the Florida Bar’s Labor and Employment Law Certification Committee. She is an active member of the national and Florida chapters of the National Employment Lawyers Association (NELA) and has served on the executive board of Florida NELA. Ms. Piscitelli was selected to the Florida Super Lawyers list 2012-2025.

Ms. Piscitelli has taken a special interest in the civilian job rights of veterans and servicemembers under the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act—best known as USERRA. She is the co-author (with Edward Still) of a treatise on USERRA, The USERRA Manual: Uniformed Services Employment & Reemployment Rights (Thomson Reuters 2025) (and all prior editions). The book was first published in 2008, and a new edition has been published annually since then. Ms. Piscitelli has served as a USERRA advisor to NELA and worked on legislation to improve the rights of veterans and servicemembers under USERRA. In 2004, Ms. Piscitelli chaired a NELA task force that submitted comments to the Department of Labor on then-proposed USERRA regulations. She has spoken on USERRA at numerous continuing legal education programs, including seminars sponsored by the Florida Bar, the American Bar Association, NELA, and the American Association for Justice.

For a full list of Kathryn’s awards, publications, speaking engagements, associations and committees, check out her Resume CV at EmploymentLawTampa.com.

attorneys.name: Rochelle A. Pitts
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
Rochelle A. Pitts, Esq. is an associate attorney at ALOIA | ROLAND | LUBELL. Her primary area of practice is Personal Injury & Wrongful Death.

Rochelle attended the University of Florida and graduated in 2013 with a bachelor’s degree in religion. After obtaining her bachelor’s degree (which required bi-weekly commutes from Cape Coral), Pitts worked as a paralegal at an injury firm before starting law school at Ave Maria School of Law in 2018.

In her final year of law school, her family was struck with tragedy as her fiance was killed in a car accident. With an incredible support system, she persevered and graduated with her J.D. in 2022, and was admitted to practice law in Florida in 2023. Pitts is very candid about grief and tragic loss. She writes often about how her personal experiences affect her life and career. She has helped to found an online support group for women widowed while pregnant and helps facilitate a sister group for young widows with over 8,000 members.

Rochelle is an active member and volunteer with Valerie’s House of Southwest Florida. She is also an active member of the legal community, participating in the Lee County Bar Association’s Young Lawyers Division events.

Rochelle is “Gung Ho about Everything” and as a mother of four children, three girls and a boy, she does her best to keep them as busy as they keep her.

attorneys.name: Jerome A. Pivnik
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Defense Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jerome A. Pivnik is a Partner in the Miami office of Chartwell. He graduated from the University of Florida with a BSBA degree in Economics, with honors. He earned his law degree from the American University's Washington College of Law in Washington, D.C. in 1983. Formerly, Mr. Pivnik was the co-founding partner of Pivnik & Nitsche, and the managing partner of the Miami offices of Katten Muchin & Zavis and Dombroff & Gilmore.

Mr. Pivnik concentrates his practice on representing the needs of insurance companies and self-insured businesses, including accident defense, employment and commercial litigation. He handles all types of general liability claims including: auto and truck accident cases, shipping, product liability, construction defects and matters involving premises liability including slip and fall, inadequate security, wrongful eviction, false arrest, assault, and malicious prosecution. He defends employers in cases involving wrongful termination, defamation, wage and hour violations, Family Medical Leave Act, Title VII cases, non-compete agreements, trade secrets, and invasion of privacy claims. He also provides clients with advice and counsel on first party and third party coverage matters.

attorneys.name: Andrew Plagge
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St Petersburg, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Plagge was born and raised in Iowa where he attended the University of Iowa. After college, he put his education on hold and joined the United States Army Reserve. He attended Basic Training and Officer Candidate School where he earned his commission to be an officer. After he finished his training, Mr. Plagge moved to the Tampa area where he started law school at Stetson University College of Law.

After graduation, Mr. Plagge began practicing in a wide variety of areas, including family law, personal injury, and criminal law. Quickly, however, Mr. Plagge found his passion in representing the negligently injured. He has represented a wide variety of clients in a wide variety of cases, including auto accidents, trip and falls, and wrongful death.

Mr. Plagge continues to serve the community through the United States Army Reserves and is also involved in numerous local organizations, such as the Brandon Chamber of Commerce.

attorneys.name: Amanda J. Podlucky
attorneys.firm_name: Marshall Dennehey Warner Coleman & Goggin, P.C.
attorneys.practice_type: General Liability Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Amanda is an attorney in the Casualty Department in the Orlando, Florida office, where she focuses her practice on representing clients in premises liability matters, including aggressively defending hotels, restaurants, retailers and recreational facilities against personal injury, negligent security and related general liability claims.

Prior to joining Marshall Dennehey Warner Coleman & Goggin, Amanda worked as an associate for a Florida-based corporate and insurance defense law firm, where she served as a division leader, managing a full case load defending clients in both premises liability and automobile and trucking negligence matters. Amanda has obtained favorable results for her clients both at mediation and trial, including a defense verdict following a trial where she represented a major hotel chain in a matter involving an alleged elevator malfunction.

Amanda attended the Georgia Institute of Technology ("Georgia Tech") where she graduated in 2004 with a bachelor's degree in public policy, with honors. After graduation, Amanda earned her juris doctor at Villanova University Law School, where she graduated also with honors in 2007. During law school, Amanda was a member of the Sports and Entertainment Law Society as well as the Pro Bono Law Society. She was elected as an officer to the Student Bar Association as Villanova Law School's ABA representative for the 2006-2007 school year. Amanda was a member of the Villanova Sports and Entertainment Law Journal, where she served as both a staff writer and managing editor for the journal. She also had the opportunity to serve as a judicial extern for the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania under the Honorable Charles R. Weiner.

attorneys.bio:
Schammua is an Associate Attorney in the Orlando office of Moore Ingram Johnson & Steele. Since 2023, she has been a member of the Litigation Department, and concentrates her practice in construction defect, premises liability, negligent security, wrongful death, automobile negligence, and general liability defense.

Schammua is a Florida native, raised in Orlando, Florida. She is of Haitian decent and speaks Haitian Creole. Schammua received her Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice, Summa Cum Laude, from Florida A&M University in 2016. She later obtained her Juris Doctor from Florida A&M University College of Law in 2020. While in law school, Schammua interned with the Honorable Vincent L. Johnson at the First Judicial District of Pennsylvania. She also interned for at a civil litigation firm and participated in defense clinics.

Prior to joining MIJS, Schammua began her legal career at the State Attorney’s Office, Ninth Judicial Circuit, as an Assistant State Attorney prosecuting misdemeanor, criminal traffic, and felony charges from preliminary examination of case through jury trial verdict. She also practiced as a civil defense attorney defending workers compensation claims.

On her spare time, Schammua enjoys shopping, traveling, and spending time with her friends and family.

attorneys.name: Jonathan E. Pollard
attorneys.practice_type: Antitrust Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan Pollard's primary area of practice is complex commercial litigation. He focuses on antitrust, fraud and non-compete cases. Although based in Fort Lauderdale, Jonathan practices throughout the state of Florida. Prior to establishing Pollard LLC, Jonathan was an attorney at the prominent litigation firm Boies, Schiller & Flexner. Representative matters include:

· Representing investors who lost billions of dollars with the Fairfield Greenwich Funds in one of the country's largest fraud cases.

· Participating in the defense of American Express in a major antitrust case brought by the Department of Justice.

· Prosecuting antitrust claims on behalf of First Quality, a consumer products company, against Kimberly Clark.

· Defending a prominent wine & spirits executive in non-compete litigation against his former company, Southern Wine & Spirits.

Jonathan earned his B.A. from Cornell University, where he served as the President of the Cornell Speech & Debate Team, earning honors as a national finalist and an All-American. During his time at Cornell, Jonathan was named a College Scholar, awarded a research fellowship through the Andrew Mellon Foundation, and selected as an inaugural member of the Goldman Sachs Global Leaders Program. In his senior year, he was tapped by University leaders to represent Cornell in the Rhodes Scholar competition.

Jonathan earned his J.D. from Georgetown University, where he was awarded a full scholarship and served as an associate editor of the Georgetown Law Journal. While working with Georgetown's asylum clinic, Jonathan and a classmate successfully represented a Cameroonian refugee in an asylum proceeding. Throughout law school, Jonathan served as a contributing writer for a number of legal publications, including The Hedge Fund Law Report and The Native American Report.

Prior to law school, Jonathan taught high school English in southwest Baltimore, Maryland. He is the founder, coach and a major sponsor of the speech & debate program at Boyd Anderson High School, in Lauderdale Lakes.

attorneys.name: Theresa Carli Pontieri
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Jacksonville, FL
attorneys.bio:
Theresa Carli Pontieri is a highly skilled attorney specializing in real estate law, contract law, family law, and business litigation. With a pragmatic and results-driven approach, she provides strategic legal counsel tailored to individuals and businesses navigating complex legal challenges. Her depth of experience in trial and appellate work across Florida state courts and the Middle District Federal Court makes her a formidable advocate for her clients.

Legal Expertise & Business Acumen

Prior to joining the firm, Mrs. Pontieri owned and operated her own successful law firm, where she represented both businesses and consumers in a broad range of disputes. Her firsthand experience as a business owner in the food and beverage industry in Jacksonville gives her a unique ability to advise clients from both a legal and entrepreneurial perspective. She understands the complexities of business operations, permitting, and compliance, making her an invaluable resource for companies of all sizes.

Strong & Compassionate Representation for Families

Mrs. Pontieri has represented both men and women facing divorce, custody battles, and other family disputes, combining fierce advocacy with genuine compassion for every client’s story.

She has helped countless mothers and fathers fight to protect their rights, their children, and their peace of mind. From assertive representation in court to calm, strategic negotiations, she stands by her clients every step of the way.

Elected Official & Advocate for Local Business Growth

In addition to her legal career, Mrs. Pontieri serves as an elected City Council member in Palm Coast, Florida, a role she has held since November 2022. Her position has deepened her knowledge of land use, business permitting, zoning laws, and municipal governance, further enhancing her ability to guide clients through local and state regulatory landscapes.

Academic Excellence & Legal Training

Mrs. Pontieri earned her Juris Doctor, magna cum laude, from Florida Coastal School of Law, receiving multiple book awards in contract law. She actively contributed to the legal community as a mock trial coach, adjunct professor, and participant in Law Review, Moot Court, and Mock Trial competitions. She gained national recognition by winning the National Mock Trial Competition in New York and serving as Pro Bono Chair, reinforcing her commitment to legal excellence and advocacy.

Before law school, she obtained her undergraduate degree in Legal Studies from the University of Central Florida, minoring in sports and entertainment law.

Athletic Achievements & Competitive Spirit

Mrs. Pontieri’s dedication to discipline and perseverance extends beyond the courtroom. A third-degree black belt, she was a member of the United States Karate Team, competing internationally and winning multiple World Championships in Madrid (2000) and Munich (2002). Her accomplishments include:

Silver Medalist at the World Championships

Bronze Medalist at the Pan-American Games

Bronze Medalist at the Goodwill Games in Tokyo, Japan

Community & Personal Life

A proud resident of Flagler County, Mrs. Pontieri lives with her husband, a lieutenant with the Osceola County Fire Department, their son, and their rescue pets—dogs Bailey and Maggie, and their cat, Beni. She is passionate about serving her community, addressing local concerns through her City Council role, and giving back through volunteerism and advocacy.

In her free time, she enjoys staying active, working out on her Peloton, exploring the outdoors with her husband, and cheering on her UCF Knights.

Why Work with Theresa Carli Pontieri?

Whether handling complex business litigation, real estate transactions, or family law matters, Mrs. Pontieri is dedicated to delivering strategic, results-oriented legal solutions. Her legal expertise, business acumen, and leadership experience make her a trusted advocate for clients across Florida.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Palm Coast City Council Woman, Elected in November 2022

attorneys.name: Randall Townsend Porcher
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Tallahassee, FL
attorneys.bio:
Randall T. Porcher is an attorney in the Tallahassee office of Morgan & Morgan. Currently, his practice is devoted to representing the interests of injured workers in Florida workers' compensation cases.

Before joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Porcher worked for seven years in the state court system as the Director of the First District Court of Appeal's Workers' Compensation Unit and as a senior law clerk for the Florida Supreme Court.

Prior to his work with the state court system, he worked in private practice, first representing the interests of insurance companies and employers in workers' compensation matters at both the trial and appellate levels and then (beginning in 2000) representing the interests of personal injury plaintiffs and workers' compensation claimants at both the trial and appellate level. As an appellate lawyer, Mr. Porcher has prevailed on many issues of first impression in the workers' compensation field.

Throughout his career, he has been recognized with many honors and awards for his legal acumen: he has a preeminent AV rating from Martindale-Hubbel; in 2008, he was named as a top workers' compensation lawyer by Florida's SuperLawyers; in 2010, he was the recipient of a Prudential-Davis Productivity Award; and in 2004 he was awarded the Kennie Edwards Award by the Palm Beach County Bar, an award bestowed annually on the workers' compensation attorney who best exemplifies the qualities of integrity and advocacy.

Mr. Porcher has lectured throughout the state on legal issues pertaining to workers' compensation jurisprudence, and he has taught workers' compensation law at both the collegiate and post-graduate level. Randall received his law degree in 1993 from the University of Florida College of Law, where he was awarded a teaching fellowship in jurisprudence.

He has a wife and two children and in his spare time he enjoys running, fitness, and playing music.

attorneys.name: Theophilos Poulopoulos
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Protection (PIP) Lawyers in Davie, FL
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Poulopoulos grew up outside of Boston, Massachusetts. He attended the Jepson School of Leadership Studies of the University of Richmond in Virginia and graduated with a dual degree in Leadership Studies and Political Science. While at the Jepson School, Mr. Poulopoulos studied English Property Rights and Legal Ethics abroad at Cambridge University in England.

Following his four years at Richmond, Mr. Poulopoulos attended the University of Miami’s School of Law. During his studies at UM, Mr. Poulopoulos was inducted into the Phi Delta Phi International Legal Honors Fraternity, served as the law school’s American Bar Association Representative from 2009 to 2010, and was Speaker to the Senate of the Student Bar Association from 2010 to 2011. In 2011, he was named Senator of the Year for his ongoing dedication to and governance of the law school’s student body.

Mr. Poulopoulos began his legal career at the Law Offices of Corredor, Husseini & Snedaker, P.A., in Miami, Florida. He spent several years litigating Plaintiff’s Personal Injury Protection (PIP) cases where he gained invaluable courtroom and deposition experience. In 2015, Mr. Poulopoulos became the managing attorney of The Schiller Kessler Group’s Personal Injury Protection department. During his tenure, Mr. Poulopoulos has been responsible for discovering and developing several breakthrough issues for the Plaintiff’s PIP bar. He is often called upon to litigate major motions for other Plaintiff’s firms and has counseled attorneys on litigation tactics.

Mr. Poulopoulos is dedicated to ensuring that his clients are exceptionally represented. He advocates vigorously on behalf of his clients to ensure that they receive proper and just compensation for medical services provided to their patients throughout Florida.

attorneys.name: Matt Powell
attorneys.practice_type: Wrongful Death Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Matt Powell is a Florida personal injury lawyer who is a Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer who represents injured victims and their families in cases involving catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, automobile crashes, brain injuries, sexual assault, trucking crashes, pedestrian accidents, medical malpractice, defective products, birth related injuries, rape cases, dog bites, motorcycle crashes, negligent security and many other injury cases. He first practiced law with a prominent insurance defense firm in Tallahassee, Florida.

The firm represented over 20 insurance companies and defended negligent drivers and doctors. During that time, he learned the methods, techniques and strategies that insurance companies use to reduce the amount of money they pay to people and families who have been injured or killed in accidents or by neglect. After learning these methods and techniques, he decided to stop representing insurance companies. He left the insurance defense law firm and opened his own law firm to represent individuals.

Matt has practiced in the historic landmark building known as the Hutchinson Mansion on Plant Avenue in Tampa since 1989. Matt Powell is an AV rated lawyer by Martindale-Hubble, the most respected legal rating service in the country. Matt is dual Board Certified as a Civil Trial Lawyer. First, he was Board Certified by the Florida Bar and secondly he is also Board certified as a Civil Trial Lawyer by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. Matt obtained his third board certification from the National Board of Trial Advocacy for Civil Practice Advocacy.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Samuel Powers is a native of Florida who has lived in the Tampa Bay area nearly his entire life. Mr. Powers was born and raised in Tampa, Florida. He graduated from H.B. Plant High School and received his undergraduate degree from the University of Florida in 2016.

Immediately following his graduation from UF, Mr. Powers was called back to the Tampa Bay area and attended Stetson University College of Law. While at Stetson, Mr. Powers was a member of the nationally recognized Stetson Trial Team. It was during his time on the team that his desire to become a trial attorney was born. While a member of the team, Mr. Powers competed in various trial competitions both in the State of Florida and beyond, helping Stetson maintain their #1 national ranking in Trial Advocacy.

During his second year in law school, Mr. Powers joined Morgan & Morgan as a law clerk. While working in this role, he was able to witness first-hand the hard work and dedication put forth for the people of Florida by the firm. After his graduation and admittance into the Florida Bar in 2019, Mr. Powers joined Morgan & Morgan as an attorney so he could continue to defend the injured and fight for the people of Florida.

attorneys.name: Robson D.C. Powers Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Lawyers in Cape Coral, FL
attorneys.bio:
Robson David Charles Powers, Esq. is a practitioner in a wide variety of high stakes litigation from commercial disputes, breach of contract cases, real estate disputes, landlord -tenant disputes, and probate and trust litigation. Robson graduated cum laude from the University of South Florida in 2009 with a Bachelor of Arts in International Studies with Certificates in Latin American Studies and Portuguese. He then received his Juris Doctor degree from Stetson University College of Law in 2012 where he was the recipient of the William F. Blews Pro Bono Service Award.

In 2017, 2018, 2019 and again in 2020 Robson was named a "Rising Star" by Florida Super Lawyers Magazine, which recognizes the top 2.5% of the State's young lawyers. To be eligible for "Rising Stars," an attorney must be under the age of 40 or have been practicing for 10 years or less. A multiphase selection process is used to determine which attorneys will receive this distinction, and nominees are evaluated on the basis of peer recognition and professional excellence. In addition, in 2016 Robson was selected by The National Black Lawyers as "Top 40 Under 40" in the State of Florida. Membership into The National Black Lawyers "Top 40 Under 40" organization is by invitation only and is extended to individuals who exemplify superior leadership, reputation, and results.

Robson is a member of the Florida Bar and the Trial Lawyers section of the Florida Bar. Robson enjoys giving back to the community and served as president of the governing board at Imagine School at North Port. In his free time, he enjoys outdoor activities such as running, camping, and kayaking with family and friends.

attorneys.name: Christopher S. Prater
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Fort Lauderdale, FL
attorneys.bio:
Chris Prater concentrates his practice on complex commercial litigation with special focus on defending efforts to enforce restrictive covenants and prosecuting false advertising claims under the Lanham Act. He also has substantial experience pursuing appeals and litigating claims involving defamation, the Fair Labor Standards Act, deceptive trade practices, internal corporate disputes, and other complex business claims. Chris aggressively pursues all possible claims and defenses for his clients and prides himself on his ability to negotiate the resolution of highly contentious litigation.

After growing up in Missouri, Chris earned his B.A. in political science from the University of Arkansas. He then attended the University of Miami School of Law where he graduated magna cum laude and was elected to Order of the Coif. During law school, he was a member of the moot court team, served as a judicial intern for Florida's Third District Court of Appeal, and was a law clerk at prestigious boutique firms including Podhurst Orseck, P.A. After law school, he litigated complex medical malpractice and other personal injury cases for three years before joining the Firm. Chris has been recognized as a Super Lawyers Rising Star since 2019.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Firm of Scott T. Moorey
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Fort Myers, FL
attorneys.bio:
"My belief in the Constitution has fueled my fight for all my clients. I continue this fight through legal research, motions, mitigation, and trials by fighting passionately to keep those rights alive."

During my time at the University of Kansas School at Law, I interned as a Judicial Clerk and a research assistant for the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU), which works in the courts, legislatures, and communities to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed to all people in this country by the Constitution and laws of the United States (aclu.org). Also, worked with the Paul E. Wilson Project for Innocence and Post-Conviction Remedies, where we fought to overturn wrongful convictions.

While at the Public Defender's Office, I handled hundreds of cases from misdemeanor petit thefts, batteries, and DUIs to felony burglaries, drug cases, grand thefts, and sex offenses. During those years as a public defender, I gained experience in dealing with mental health and substance abuse cases from competency to specialty courts.

When you become a client, you benefit both from my past years of fighting for the most vulnerable defendants at the Lee County Public Defender's Office and from the backing of the well-established, well-recognized Law Firm of Scott T. Moorey.

Your representation has the added advantage of my lifelong pursuit of criminal justice and a passion for your constitutional rights, fiercely protecting them with focus and professionalism. In addition, you gain my perspective as both a writer of laws as a past legislative aid and as a defender of your liberties and the laws as your attorney.

attorneys.name: Candace S. Preston
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Wauchula, FL
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Preston's family has lived in Hardee County for six generations. She graduated from Hardee High School in 1986, and attended Sweet Briar College in Virginia, graduating cum laude with highest honors in 1990. In 1993, Ms. Preston graduated from Stetson University College of Law in Saint Petersburg, Florida. While there, she worked in a family law clinic at Gulfeoast Legal Services and a criminal defense clinic at the Pinellas County Public Defenders Office.

After law school, Ms. Preston worked as an Assistant State Attorney in the Fifth Judicial Circuit, handling cases in Citrus, Marion, and Hernando Counties. In July of 1998, she returned to Polk County to work for the Tenth Circuit State Attorney's Office. As a prosecutor, she handled Misdemeanor, Traffic, Juvenile, Felony, and Criminal Contempt for Circuit Civil Domestic Violence cases. She also held positions as Chief of the Domestic Violence Unit in Polk County, and later the Chief of the Hardee County State Attorney's Office.

In January 2006, Ms. Preston opened her law office to provide legal services in the areas of family and criminal law. She is currently a member of the Hardee (President) and Highlands County Bar Associations, Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (FACDL) Highlands Chapter, Willson American Inn of Court, and Florida Bar Sections for Family, Criminal, and Solo and Small Office Management. She has also served as Chairperson for the Florida Bar's Continuing Legal Education Committee. Ms. Preston is admitted to the United States Supreme Court.

Ms. Preston provides representation is sensitive to the needs of the client. She strives to offer individualized attention as she and the client work toward achieving the client's legal goals. Ms. Preston handles matters in an amicable manner and attempts to negotiate legal matters with consideration for the client's need for closure. She believes compassion, understanding, and personal attention toward her clients is of vital importance in serving the best interests of her clients.

Ms. Preston is also a Florida Supreme Court Certified Family Mediator. When in that role, she strives to work in a neutral and unbiased way to help the parties negotiate a satisfactory resolution by seeking to find practical solutions and encouraging healthy and productive communication between the parties.

Since Junior High School, Ms. Preston is committed to community service. She is presently an active member of the First Baptist Church of Wauchula, the Hardee County Rotary Club, Main Street Wauchula, Volunteer Guardian Ad Litem, South Florida Community College Foundation Board, and the Hardee County Chamber of Commerce (former Board Member). She is also President of the Wauchula Woman's Club and Chairperson of the City of Wauchula Historic Preservation Board.

attorneys.name: Anthony T. Prieto
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Claims Lawyers in West Tampa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in Tampa, Mr. Prieto graduated from Tampa Catholic High School in 1993. Soon thereafter, Mr. Prieto received a Bachelor of Arts in English Literature with a minor in Criminology from Florida State University.

Mr. Prieto attended Stetson University College of Law where he completed a State Judicial Internship before receiving his Juris Doctor Degree in 1999. Upon graduation, Mr. Prieto worked as a State Prosecutor for Hillsborough County under Harry Lee Coe and Mark Ober, prosecuting cases ranging from criminal traffic violations to major drug offenses.

Subsequent to his tenure as a prosecutor, Mr. Prieto joined the law firm of Prieto, Prieto, & Goan where he successfully defended criminal matters, as well as, represented countless injured clients as the result of negligence. Mr. Prieto was the managing partner of the First Party Litigation Department that encompassed disputes arising from insurance companies' refusal to properly reimburse insurance benefits on behalf of their insureds.

Throughout his legal career, Mr. Prieto has been lead counsel on countless trials involving both civil and criminal matters. Today, Mr. Prieto is employed in the First Party Litigation Department of Morgan & Morgan where he represents the interest of thousands of insureds across Florida.

Mr. Prieto is admitted and qualified as an attorney before The Florida Bar and The U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida.

attorneys.name: Meredith A. Primeau
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Steven M. Ziegler, P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Hollywood, FL
attorneys.bio:
Meredith A. Primeau was born in Detroit, Michigan, and has been a resident of South Florida since 1986. Ms. Primeau earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Journalism, as well as a Bachelor of Arts in Theatre, cum laude, from the University of Florida in 2000. She received her Juris Doctor from Boston University School of Law in 2003. While attending law school, Ms. McCardle served as Executive Editor for the Boston University Journal of Science and Technology Law and was a first-year student advisor. Her student note, Fan Fiction, Fandom and Fanfare: What's All the Fuss?, which explored copyright concerns surrounding fictional characters, was published by the Boston University Journal of Science and Technology Law in its Summer 2003 issue. Upon graduation from law school, Ms. Primeau began working at a Miami firm specializing in representing policyholders in a variety of insurance, disability and healthcare matters. Ms. Primeau also has published an article in Coverage, a speciality publication in the insurance litigation market, titled The Hostile Fire Exception to the Pollution Exclusion: Good News for Policyholders?

At the Law Offices of Steven M. Ziegler, P.A., Ms. Primeau represents numerous health plans in health benefit cases, particularly in the area of claims disputes brought by providers. She also represents managed care clients in disputes involving direct negligence allegations based on the administration of managed care benefits, utilization management decisions, network provider credentialing, quality assurance, and medical malpractice, as well as represents managed care clients in vicarious liability claims based on theories of agency, apparent agency, respondent superior, joint venture and non-delegable duty for the alleged actions of contracted network health care providers.

Ms. Primeau is admitted to the Florida Bar and the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida.

attorneys.name: Monica Pritchard
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Cocoa, FL
attorneys.bio:
Monica is a dedicated legal professional based in Brevard County, Florida. She holds a Juris Doctor degree from Howard University School of Law, where she was awarded a Merit Scholarship and actively participated in the founding of both the Howard Environmental Law Society and the Howard Family Law Society. Her academic journey began with a Bachelor of Arts in Anthropology from Rollins College in Winter Park, Florida, where she earned multiple honors, including the Zora Neale Hurston Award for community service.

In her current role, Monica focuses on lender representation, document preparation for complex commercial transactions, zoning and land use issues, commercial lease review and preparation, and individual representation of real estate and business purchasers and sellers. Her expertise in these areas allows her to work closely with clients, ensuring their legal needs are met with precision and care.

Monica’s legal career is marked by her extensive experience in real estate law, having served as an Area Manager at Fidelity National Title for nearly a decade. Her role involved managing three offices and the commercial division, ensuring compliance with title and legal standards in real property transactions, and reviewing legal documents to clear title in complex real estate transactions. Her closing experience ranged from simple vacant land deals to multi-state, multi-site commercial real estate portfolios.

Monica gained valuable courtroom experience and honed her legal research skills through her internships and clerkships including her time as a Judicial Intern on Brevard’s 18th Circuit Court and her legal Clerkship in DC Superior Court.

Monica has also volunteered her time towards child advocacy work at organizations such as National Center for Prosecution of Child Abuse and Brevard County Legal Aid Society. Her work with incarcerated individuals at Our Place DC highlights her dedication to social justice and legal reform.

Outside of her professional life, Monica enjoys spending time with her three boys and playing pickleball with her husband. She is active in her community with her involvement at Holy Name of Jesus Catholic Church.

Using her strong background in legal research and advocacy Monica leverages her skills to make a positive impact in the legal field, always striving to achieve the best outcomes for her clients.

attorneys.name: Damien H. Prosser
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Adversary Litigation Lawyers in Orlando, FL
attorneys.bio:
Damien Prosser is Co-Managing Partner of the firm's Business Trial Group. Mr. Prosser began his legal career with a prestigious national law firm and quickly realized the economic challenge of litigating cases under the billable hour model applied to most commercial litigation.

Since joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Prosser is convinced that litigating commercial cases on a success fee basis provides clients increased access to our justice system as opposed to a model fixated on the endless quest for billable hours that foreclosed access long ago.

An additional problem is the absence of actual trial experience by most lawyers at many of the national firms. Mr. Prosser typically tries at least one business case to verdict a year and has obtained jury verdicts in excess of $1 million.

Mr. Prosser represents clients in state and federal courts throughout the country and has significant experience in complex commercial litigation, contract actions, professional malpractice, idea theft and trade secret litigation, securities litigation and business torts. Mr. Prosser also has considerable experience in the litigation adversary proceedings in federal bankruptcy courts and bankruptcy legal malpractice actions.

Mr. Prosser was named a "Rising Star" in 2010, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017 by Florida Super Lawyers magazine-an annual publication that recognizes the top 2.5% of the state's young lawyers. He has also been recognized as a "Legal Elite Up and Comer" by Florida Trend magazine, which recognizes attorneys under 40 that represent the future of the legal profession in Florida.

Prior to joining Morgan & Morgan, Mr. Prosser practiced for several years in the national law firm of Baker Hostetler as well as Shutts & Bowen.

attorneys.name: Lorenz Michel Pruss
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Lorenz Michel Prüss is an AV-rated lawyer focusing his practice on all areas of business litigation, plaintiff-side class-action, and securities arbitration and litigation representing a domestic and international clientele. Mr. Prüss has been named a "Top Lawyer" and "Top Up and Comer" by the South Florida Legal Guide, a "Top Up and Comer" by Florida Trend magazine, and a "Rising Legal Star" by Superlawyers magazine. He is licensed to practice in Florida and Washington, D.C. and also is specifically admitted to practice before the Eleventh Circuit of Court Appeals and the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida. Mr. Prüss has contributed to the firm's efforts in the following published opinions:

Burman v. Wenzel, 76 So.3d 1005 (Fla. 3d DCA 2011)

Biotanic, Inc. v. Juan Carlos Vazquez, 2010 WL 2696892 (S.D. Fla. 2010)

Sea Shelter IV, LLC v. TRG Sunny Isles V, Ltd.,2009 WL 692469 (S.D. Fla. 2009)

Kaufman v. City Place South Tower LLC, 2008 WL 4722106 (S.D. Fla. 2008)

Prior to actively practicing law, Mr. Prüss clerked at the State Department's Bureau of Cultural Affairs for Africa in Washington, D.C., analyzing public diplomacy programs on topics such as the effectiveness of U.S. cultural penetration regarding Sub-Saharan Africa. During law school, Mr. Prüss followed that with time at the United States Attorney's Office Economic Crimes Unit, in Miami, Florida, as part of the University of Miami's Clinical Litigation Program.

Mr. Prüss is a member of InterNations and the Peruvian-American Chamber of Commerce. In March 2004, he was featured in Peruvian magazine, Peru Hoy.

attorneys.name: Frederick J. Pye III Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Claims Lawyers in Miami, FL
attorneys.bio:
Frederick "Ricky" Pye III is an attorney with our Insurance Recovery Group. He focuses his practice on First Party Property Damage claims.

Ricky was born and raised in South Florida. He received his undergraduate degree from the University of Central Florida and obtained his law degree from Nova Southeastern University College of Law. He began his practice of law with a defense firm representing homeowners insurance carriers.

In early 2018, Ricky began working on behalf of policyholders, representing individuals in an effort to challenge underpaid and denied claims. Ricky is a passionate advocate for his clients. He is cognizant of the power dynamics involved in any insurance claim and is well aware of the tactics that insurance claims often deploy to intimidate policyholders into accepting underpaid and denied claims. He takes pride in fighting for those who may not be able to fight for themselves - for the people.

Outside of the office, Mr. Pye spends his time practicing Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, golfing and with his beautiful wife Nicole and dog Kali.

attorneys.name: Cynthia Pyfrom
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Boynton Beach, FL
attorneys.bio:
Originally from Frankfort, Kentucky, Cynthia attended Palm Beach Community College on a scholarship and then graduated from Florida Atlantic University in 2004, where she obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree in Interdisciplinary Studies and a Certificate in Women's Studies. Cynthia has been employed in the legal field since 1997 and began working in Matrimonial and Family Law in early 2005. She realized her passion in family law and decided to pursue her law degree in 2009, at which time she began attending Nova Southeastern University in the Evening Division while maintaining full-time employment.

While in law school, Cynthia was a member of the Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot Court team for two years in a row as a competitor. During the second year, she was team Co-Coach, traveling to Vienna, Austria to compete against 281 international law schools. Through hard work and dedication, her team placed 52nd (the best placing Nova Southeastern has had since being involved in this Moot program). The team also received an Honorable Mention for Best Team Orals.

Cynthia graduated with her J.D. from Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad Law Center, in December 2012 and became a licensed attorney on April 16, 2013. In January 2014, Cynthia established her own family law practice to further her passion of assisting clients with family law matters. "I enjoy being a Family Law Attorney because I view it as an opportunity to help my client transition from one stage in their life to another happier stage. It's all a matter of perspective."

As an adopted child whose parents subsequently divorced when she was eight (8) years old, Cynthia draws from her personal experiences which allows her to passionately and empathetically represent her clients through all facets of family law matters. Cynthia is dedicated to and passionate about her career, providing her clients with undivided attention and personal service. Call (561) 203-5940 to schedule your consultation today.
